package antidaunleak.api.annotation;

import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
import java.lang.annotation.Target;


@Retention(RetentionPolicy.CLASS)
@Target({ElementType.METHOD, ElementType.TYPE})
public @interface Native {

    Type type() default Type.STANDARD;

    enum Type {
        STANDARD,
        VMProtectBeginVirtualization,
        VMProtectBeginMutation,
        VMProtectBeginUltra,
    }
}

package antidaunleak.api;

import antidaunleak.api.annotation.Native;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class UserProfile {

    private static final UserProfile instance = new UserProfile();

    public static UserProfile getInstance() {
        return instance;
    }

    private final Map<String, String> cache = new HashMap<>();

    private boolean nativeFailed = false;

    private UserProfile() {
        try {
            cache.put("username", getUsername());
            cache.put("hwid", getHwid());
            cache.put("role", getRole());
            cache.put("uid", getUid());
            cache.put("subTime", getSubsTime());
        } catch (UnsatisfiedLinkError e) {
            nativeFailed = true;
            cache.put("username", "null");
            cache.put("hwid", "null");
            cache.put("role", "null");
            cache.put("uid", "null");
            cache.put("subTime", "null");
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.STANDARD)
    private native String getUsername();

    @Native(type = Native.Type.STANDARD)
    private native String getHwid();

    @Native(type = Native.Type.STANDARD)
    private native String getRole();

    @Native(type = Native.Type.STANDARD)
    private native String getUid();

    @Native(type = Native.Type.STANDARD)
    private native String getSubsTime();

    public String profile(String profile) {
        return cache.getOrDefault(profile, "");
    }
}

package rasty.auth;

import java.io.*;

public class KeyAuthAPI {

    private static final String APP_NAME = "Rastyclient's Application";
    private static final String OWNER_ID =
            StringConstants._o1 + StringConstants._o2;
    private static final String SECRET   =
            AnimationConstants._a + ColorPalette._b   +
                    MathConstants._c      + NetworkConstants._d +
                    SoundConstants._e     + RenderConstants._f  +
                    SessionConstants._g   + StringConstants._h;
    private static final String VERSION  = "1.0";
    private static final String API_URL  = "https://keyauth.win/api/1.2/";


    private String  sessionId   = "";
    private String  encKey      = "";
    private boolean initialized = false;


    public String username     = "";
    public String ip           = "";
    public String hwid         = "";
    public String expires      = "";
    public String subscription = "";


    private static KeyAuthAPI instance;
    public static KeyAuthAPI getInstance() {
        if (instance == null) instance = new KeyAuthAPI();
        return instance;
    }
    private KeyAuthAPI() {}



    public void init() throws KeyAuthException {
        if (initialized) return;

        String sentKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").substring(0, 16);
        encKey = sentKey + "-" + SECRET;

        Map<String, String> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        data.put("type",    "init");
        data.put("ver",     VERSION);
        data.put("hash",    "");
        data.put("enckey",  sentKey);
        data.put("name",    APP_NAME);
        data.put("ownerid", OWNER_ID);

        String response = doRequest(data);

        if (response.trim().equals("KeyAuth_Invalid")) {
            throw new KeyAuthException("РџСЂРёР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёРµ РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ РІ KeyAuth");
        }
        if (!jsonBool(response, "success")) {
            String msg = jsonString(response, "message");
            if (msg.isEmpty()) msg = "РћС€РёР±РєР° РёРЅРёС†РёР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёРё";
            if (msg.equals("invalidver")) throw new KeyAuthException("Р’РµСЂСЃРёСЏ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р° СѓСЃС‚Р°СЂРµР»Р°");
            throw new KeyAuthException(msg);
        }

        sessionId = jsonString(response, "sessionid");
        if (sessionId.isEmpty()) throw new KeyAuthException("РќРµ РїРѕР»СѓС‡РµРЅ sessionid РѕС‚ СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР°");
        initialized = true;
    }

    public void login(String user, String password) throws KeyAuthException {
        checkInit();
        Map<String, String> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        data.put("type",      "login");
        data.put("username",  user);
        data.put("pass",      password);
        data.put("hwid",      getHwid());
        data.put("sessionid", sessionId);
        data.put("name",      APP_NAME);
        data.put("ownerid",   OWNER_ID);

        String response = doRequest(data);
        if (!jsonBool(response, "success")) {
            String msg = jsonString(response, "message");
            throw new KeyAuthException(msg.isEmpty() ? "РќРµРІРµСЂРЅС‹Р№ Р»РѕРіРёРЅ РёР»Рё РїР°СЂРѕР»СЊ" : msg);
        }
        loadUserData(response);
    }

    public void license(String key) throws KeyAuthException {
        checkInit();
        Map<String, String> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        data.put("type",      "license");
        data.put("key",       key);
        data.put("hwid",      getHwid());
        data.put("sessionid", sessionId);
        data.put("name",      APP_NAME);
        data.put("ownerid",   OWNER_ID);

        String response = doRequest(data);
        if (!jsonBool(response, "success")) {
            String msg = jsonString(response, "message");
            throw new KeyAuthException(msg.isEmpty() ? "РќРµРІРµСЂРЅС‹Р№ РєР»СЋС‡" : msg);
        }
        loadUserData(response);
    }

    public boolean isInitialized() { return initialized; }

    public void reset() {
        sessionId = ""; encKey = ""; initialized = false;
        username = ""; ip = ""; hwid = ""; expires = ""; subscription = "";
    }


    public static String getHwid() {
        String osName = System.getProperty("os.name", "").toLowerCase();
        try {
            if (osName.contains("win")) {
                return getWindowsSid();
            } else if (osName.contains("linux")) {
                return getLinuxMachineId();
            } else if (osName.contains("mac")) {
                return getMacSerial();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}


        return UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(
                (System.getProperty("user.name", "") + System.getProperty("os.name", ""))
                        .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        ).toString();
    }


    private static String getWindowsSid() throws Exception {
        String username = System.getProperty("user.name", "");
        if (username.isEmpty()) throw new Exception("РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ РїРѕР»СѓС‡РёС‚СЊ РёРјСЏ РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ");


        Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(
                new String[]{"wmic", "useraccount", "where", "name='" + username + "'", "get", "sid"}
        );

        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                line = line.trim();

                if (!line.isEmpty() && !line.equalsIgnoreCase("SID")
                        && line.startsWith("S-")) {
                    return line;
                }
            }
        }


        return getWindowsSidPowerShell(username);
    }


    private static String getWindowsSidPowerShell(String username) throws Exception {
        String cmd = String.format(
                "(New-Object System.Security.Principal.NTAccount('%s')).Translate([System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value",
                username
        );
        Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(new String[]{"powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", cmd});
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                line = line.trim();
                if (line.startsWith("S-")) return line;
            }
        }
        throw new Exception("РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ РїРѕР»СѓС‡РёС‚СЊ Windows SID");
    }


    private static String getLinuxMachineId() throws Exception {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader("/etc/machine-id"))) {
            String id = br.readLine();
            if (id != null && !id.isBlank()) return id.trim();
        }
        throw new Exception("РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ РїСЂРѕС‡РёС‚Р°С‚СЊ /etc/machine-id");
    }


    private static String getMacSerial() throws Exception {

        Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(
                new String[]{"sh", "-c", "ioreg -l | grep IOPlatformSerialNumber"}
        );
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                if (line.contains("IOPlatformSerialNumber")) {

                    String[] parts = line.split("=");
                    if (parts.length > 1) {
                        return parts[1].trim().replace("\"", "").trim();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        throw new Exception("РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ РїРѕР»СѓС‡РёС‚СЊ Mac serial");
    }


    private String doRequest(Map<String, String> postData) throws KeyAuthException {
        try {
            URL url = new URL(API_URL);
            HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
            conn.setRequestMethod("POST");
            conn.setDoOutput(true);
            conn.setConnectTimeout(10_000);
            conn.setReadTimeout(10_000);
            conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded");
            conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "KeyAuth");

            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : postData.entrySet()) {
                if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append('&');
                sb.append(URLEncoder.encode(e.getKey(),   "UTF-8"))
                        .append('=')
                        .append(URLEncoder.encode(e.getValue(), "UTF-8"));
            }
            try (OutputStream os = conn.getOutputStream()) {
                os.write(sb.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            }

            int status = conn.getResponseCode();
            InputStream is = status >= 400 ? conn.getErrorStream() : conn.getInputStream();
            StringBuilder resp = new StringBuilder();
            try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(is, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                String line;
                while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) resp.append(line);
            }
            return resp.toString();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new KeyAuthException("РћС€РёР±РєР° СЃРµС‚Рё: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }


    private void checkInit() throws KeyAuthException {
        if (!initialized) throw new KeyAuthException("РЎРµСЃСЃРёСЏ РЅРµ РёРЅРёС†РёР°Р»РёР·РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅР°, РІС‹Р·РѕРІРё init() СЃРЅР°С‡Р°Р»Р°");
    }

    private void loadUserData(String response) {
        try {
            String info = jsonObject(response, "info");
            if (info.isEmpty()) return;
            username = jsonString(info, "username");
            ip       = jsonString(info, "ip");
            hwid     = jsonString(info, "hwid");
            if (hwid.isEmpty()) hwid = "N/A";
            String sub = jsonFirstArrayObject(info, "subscriptions");
            if (!sub.isEmpty()) {
                subscription = jsonString(sub, "subscription");
                expires      = jsonString(sub, "expiry");
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }


    static String jsonString(String json, String key) {
        String search = "\"" + key + "\":\"";
        int start = json.indexOf(search);
        if (start < 0) return "";
        start += search.length();
        int end = start;
        while (end < json.length()) {
            char c = json.charAt(end);
            if (c == '\\') { end += 2; continue; }
            if (c == '"')  break;
            end++;
        }
        return json.substring(start, Math.min(end, json.length()));
    }


    static boolean jsonBool(String json, String key) {
        String search = "\"" + key + "\":";
        int idx = json.indexOf(search);
        if (idx < 0) return false;
        int val = idx + search.length();
        while (val < json.length() && json.charAt(val) == ' ') val++;
        return json.startsWith("true", val);
    }


    static String jsonFirstArrayObject(String json, String key) {
        String search = "\"" + key + "\":[";
        int start = json.indexOf(search);
        if (start < 0) return "";
        int objStart = json.indexOf('{', start + search.length());
        if (objStart < 0) return "";
        int depth = 0, j = objStart;
        while (j < json.length()) {
            char c = json.charAt(j);
            if (c == '{') depth++;
            else if (c == '}') { if (--depth == 0) break; }
            j++;
        }
        return json.substring(objStart, Math.min(j + 1, json.length()));
    }


    static String jsonObject(String json, String key) {
        String search = "\"" + key + "\":{";
        int start = json.indexOf(search);
        if (start < 0) return "";
        int objStart = start + search.length() - 1;
        int depth = 0, j = objStart;
        while (j < json.length()) {
            char c = json.charAt(j);
            if (c == '{') depth++;
            else if (c == '}') { if (--depth == 0) break; }
            j++;
        }
        return json.substring(objStart, Math.min(j + 1, json.length()));
    }


    public static class KeyAuthException extends Exception {
        public KeyAuthException(String msg) { super(msg); }
    }
}

package rasty.auth;

import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.Click;

public class KeyAuthScreen extends Screen {

    private static final int COL_ACCENT  = 0x00E5FF;
    private static final int COL_TEXT    = 0xE8EBF2;
    private static final int COL_MUTED   = 0x5A6070;
    private static final int COL_SUB     = 0x3C4250;
    private static final int COL_PANEL   = 0x12151D;
    private static final int COL_BG2     = 0x111520;
    private static final int COL_BG      = 0x0D0F14;
    private static final int COL_OUTLINE = 0x1E2330;
    private static final int COL_DANGER  = 0xFF3355;
    private static final int COL_SUCCESS = 0x00FF88;

    private static final float FIXED_GUI_SCALE = 2.0f;
    private static final float OUTLINE_W       = 0.75f;

    private enum Tab { LOGIN, KEY }
    private Tab activeTab = Tab.LOGIN;

    private enum AuthState { IDLE, LOADING, SUCCESS, ERROR }
    private AuthState authState    = AuthState.IDLE;
    private String    statusMessage = "";

    private String usernameText = "";
    private String passwordText = "";

    private static final int MAX_PASSWORD = 256;
    private static final int MAX_KEY      = 256;

    private boolean fadingOut    = false;
    private float   fadeAlpha    = 1f;
    private boolean successFired = false;

    private float mx, my;

    private static final float PANEL_W = 224f;
    private static final float PANEL_H = 192f;

    private static final int   PARTICLE_COUNT        = 110;
    private static final float PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST = 55f;
    private static final float PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST = 70f;
    private static final float PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE= 0.06f;
    private static final float PARTICLE_SPEED        = 22f;
    private static final int   PARTICLE_SIZE         = 2;

    private float[] px, py, pvx, pvy, pbright;

    public KeyAuthScreen(Runnable onSuccess) {
        super(Text.literal("Auth"));
        this.onSuccess = onSuccess;
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        lastMs = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();

        int newSw = getFixedW(), newSh = getFixedH();

        if (ParticleState.hasState()) {
            float[] spx = ParticleState.getPx();
            px      = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(spx,                        spx.length);
            py      = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(ParticleState.getPy(),      spx.length);
            pvx     = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(ParticleState.getPvx(),     spx.length);
            pvy     = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(ParticleState.getPvy(),     spx.length);
            pbright = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(ParticleState.getPbright(), spx.length);
            if (lastKnownSw > 0 && lastKnownSh > 0
                    && (lastKnownSw != newSw || lastKnownSh != newSh)) {
                rescaleParticles(lastKnownSw, lastKnownSh, newSw, newSh);
            }
        } else {
            px      = new float[PARTICLE_COUNT];
            py      = new float[PARTICLE_COUNT];
            pvx     = new float[PARTICLE_COUNT];
            pvy     = new float[PARTICLE_COUNT];
            pbright = new float[PARTICLE_COUNT];
            java.util.Random rng = new java.util.Random();
            for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
                px[i]  = rng.nextFloat() * newSw;
                py[i]  = rng.nextFloat() * newSh;
                float angle = rng.nextFloat() * (float)(Math.PI * 2);
                float spd   = (0.3f + rng.nextFloat() * 0.7f) * PARTICLE_SPEED;
                pvx[i] = (float)(Math.cos(angle)) * spd;
                pvy[i] = (float)(Math.sin(angle)) * spd;
                pbright[i] = 0.2f + rng.nextFloat() * 0.5f;
            }
        }
        lastKnownSw = newSw;
        lastKnownSh = newSh;
    }

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        long now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        float dt = MathHelper.clamp((now - lastMs) / 1000f, 0.001f, 0.05f);
        lastMs = now;

        float scale = (float) client.getWindow().getScaleFactor();
        mx = (float) mouseX * scale / FIXED_GUI_SCALE;
        my = (float) mouseY * scale / FIXED_GUI_SCALE;

        updateAnimations(dt);

        Render2D.beginOverlay();

        int fw = getFixedW(), fh = getFixedH();

        if (px != null && (fw != lastKnownSw || fh != lastKnownSh)) {
            rescaleParticles(lastKnownSw, lastKnownSh, fw, fh);
            lastKnownSw = fw;
            lastKnownSh = fh;
        }

        Render2D.backgroundImage(bgAlpha, 1.04f);
        Render2D.rect(0, 0, fw, fh, withAlpha(0x060810, (int)(bgAlpha * 165)), 0f);

        if (px != null) {
            updateParticles(dt, mx, my, fw, fh);
            ParticleState.save(px, py, pvx, pvy, pbright);
            renderParticles(mx, my, bgAlpha);
        }

        if (panelAlpha > 0.01f) {
            renderPanel(fw, fh, panelAlpha, now);
        }

        Render2D.endOverlay();
    }

    private void renderPanel(int fw, int fh, float alpha, long now) {
        float cx   = fw / 2f;
        float cy   = fh / 2f;
        float panX = cx - PANEL_W / 2f;
        float panY = cy - PANEL_H / 2f;
        int   a    = (int)(alpha * 255);

        String warningText = "РђР’РўРћР РР—РђР¦РРЇ Р’Р«Р Р•Р—РђРќРђ РўРђРљ РљРђРљ Р­РўРћ РўР•РџР•Р Р¬ Р¤Р Р Р’Р•Р РЎРРЇ Р’РџРРЁР РџР РћРЎРўРћ Р РђРќР”РћРњ Р”РђРќРќР«Р•";
        float warnW = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(warningText, 6.5f);
        Fonts.BOLD.draw(warningText, cx - warnW / 2f, panY - 15f, 6.5f, withAlpha(COL_DANGER, a));

        int[] bg = {
                withAlpha(COL_PANEL, (int)(alpha * 145)),
                withAlpha(COL_BG2,   (int)(alpha * 145)),
                withAlpha(COL_BG,    (int)(alpha * 145)),
                withAlpha(COL_PANEL, (int)(alpha * 145))
        };
        Render2D.gradientRect(panX, panY, PANEL_W, PANEL_H, bg, 0f);
        Render2D.outline(panX, panY, PANEL_W, PANEL_H, OUTLINE_W,
                withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE, (int)(alpha * 70)), 0f);

        Render2D.rect(panX, panY, 2f, PANEL_H,
                withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 200)), 0f);

        float boldW = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth("RASTY", 22f);
        float subLW = Fonts.TEST.getWidth("CLIENT", 8f);
        float logoX = cx - (boldW + 5f + subLW) / 2f;
        float logoY = panY + 11f;
        Fonts.BOLD.draw("RASTY",  logoX, logoY, 22f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT, a));
        Fonts.TEST.draw("CLIENT", logoX + boldW + 5f, logoY + 9f, 8f,
                withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 200)));

        float sepY = logoY + Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(22f) + 4f;
        Render2D.rect(cx - 50f, sepY, 100f, 0.75f,
                withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 55)), 0f);

        float tabY  = sepY + 8f;
        float tabW  = (PANEL_W - 28f) / 2f - 2f;
        float tabH  = 14f;
        float tab1X = panX + 14f;
        float tab2X = tab1X + tabW + 4f;

        renderTab(tab1X, tabY, tabW, tabH, "LOGIN", activeTab == Tab.LOGIN, alpha);
        renderTab(tab2X, tabY, tabW, tabH, "KEY",   activeTab == Tab.KEY,   alpha);

        float contentY = tabY + tabH + 10f;
        float fieldX   = panX + 14f;
        float fieldW   = PANEL_W - 28f;

        if (activeTab == Tab.LOGIN) {
            renderLoginContent(fieldX, contentY, fieldW, alpha, now);
        } else {
            renderKeyContent(fieldX, contentY, fieldW, alpha, now);
        }

        if (!statusMessage.isEmpty() && authState != AuthState.LOADING) {
            int sc = switch (authState) {
                case ERROR   -> COL_DANGER;

        float crW = Fonts.TEST.getWidth(cr, 5f);

    }

    private void renderLoginContent(float x, float y, float w, float alpha, long now) {

    private void renderTab(float x, float y, float w, float h,
                           String label, boolean active, float alpha) {
        boolean hov = isOver(x, y, w, h) && !active;
        Render2D.rect(x, y, w, h,
                withAlpha(active ? COL_BG2 : COL_PANEL,
                        (int)(alpha * (active ? 160 : hov ? 100 : 60))), 0f);
        if (active) {
            Render2D.rect(x, y + h - 1.5f, w, 1.5f,
                    withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 200)), 0f);
        }
        Render2D.outline(x, y, w, h, OUTLINE_W,
                withAlpha(active ? COL_ACCENT : COL_OUTLINE,
                        (int)(alpha * (active ? 80 : 40))), 0f);
        float tw = Fonts.TEST.getWidth(label, 6f);
        float th = Fonts.TEST.getHeight(6f);
        int tc = active ? withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 230))
                : withAlpha(COL_MUTED,  (int)(alpha * (hov ? 190 : 130)));
        Fonts.TEST.draw(label, x + w / 2f - tw / 2f, y + h / 2f - th / 2f, 6f, tc);
    }

    private void renderField(float x, float y, float w, float h, float alpha,
                             String text, boolean focused, boolean masked, long now) {
        Render2D.rect(x, y, w, h, withAlpha(COL_BG, (int)(alpha * 160)), 0f);
        Render2D.rect(x, y + h - 1f, w, 1f,
                withAlpha(focused ? COL_ACCENT : COL_OUTLINE,
                        (int)(alpha * (focused ? 200 : 100))), 0f);
        Render2D.outline(x, y, w, h, OUTLINE_W,
                withAlpha(focused ? COL_ACCENT : COL_OUTLINE,
                        (int)(alpha * (focused ? 80 : 40))), 0f);

        boolean empty   = text.isEmpty();
        String  display = empty ? "..." : (masked ? "вЂў".repeat(text.length()) : text);
        int     tc      = empty ? withAlpha(COL_SUB,  (int)(alpha * 150))
                : withAlpha(COL_TEXT, (int)(alpha * 255));

        float maxTw  = w - 10f;
        String shown = display;
        while (shown.length() > 1 && Fonts.REGULARNEW.getWidth(shown, 6.5f) > maxTw) {
            shown = shown.substring(1);
        }
        Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(shown, x + 5f,
                y + h / 2f - Fonts.REGULARNEW.getHeight(6.5f) / 2f, 6.5f, tc);

        if (focused && !empty && (now / 500L) % 2 == 0) {
            float curX = x + 5f + Fonts.REGULARNEW.getWidth(shown, 6.5f) + 1f;
            if (curX < x + w - 3f) {
                Render2D.rect(curX, y + 4f, 0.5f, h - 8f,
                        withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 220)), 0f);
            }
        }
    }

    private void renderButton(float x, float y, float w, float h,

    private void updateAnimations(float dt) {
        if (!fadingOut) {
            bgAlpha    = lerpClamped(dt * 4f, bgAlpha,    1f);
            panelAlpha = lerpClamped(dt * 3f, panelAlpha, 1f);
        } else {
            fadeAlpha  -= dt * 2.5f;
            bgAlpha     = Math.max(0f, fadeAlpha);
            panelAlpha  = Math.max(0f, fadeAlpha);
            if (fadeAlpha <= 0f && !successFired && onSuccess != null) {
                successFired = true;
                onSuccess.run();
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(KeyInput input) {
        if (authState == AuthState.LOADING) return false;
        int key = input.key();

        if (key == 86 && (input.modifiers() & 2) != 0) {
            pasteFromClipboard();
            return true;
        }

        if (key == 65 && (input.modifiers() & 2) != 0) {
            switch (focusedField) {
                case 0 -> usernameText = "";
                case 1 -> passwordText = "";
                case 2 -> keyText = "";
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (key == 258) {
            if (activeTab == Tab.LOGIN) setFocus(focusedField == 0 ? 1 : 0);
            return true;
        }

        if (key == 257 || key == 335) {
            if (activeTab == Tab.LOGIN) doLogin();
            else                        doLicense();
            return true;
        }

        if (key == 259) {
            switch (focusedField) {
                case 0 -> { if (!usernameText.isEmpty()) usernameText = usernameText.substring(0, usernameText.length() - 1); }
                case 1 -> { if (!passwordText.isEmpty()) passwordText = passwordText.substring(0, passwordText.length() - 1); }
                case 2 -> { if (!keyText.isEmpty())      keyText      = keyText.substring(0, keyText.length() - 1); }
            }
            return true;
        }

        return super.keyPressed(input);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(CharInput input) {
        if (authState == AuthState.LOADING) return false;
        char c = (char) input.codepoint();
        if (c < 32) return false;

        switch (focusedField) {
            case 0 -> { if (usernameText.length() < MAX_USERNAME) usernameText += c; }
            case 1 -> { if (passwordText.length() < MAX_PASSWORD) passwordText += c; }
            case 2 -> { if (keyText.length()      < MAX_KEY)      keyText      += c; }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private void pasteFromClipboard() {
        try {
            String pasted = client.keyboard.getClipboard();
            if (pasted == null || pasted.isEmpty()) return;

            pasted = pasted.replace("\n", "").replace("\r", "").replace("\t", "");

            switch (focusedField) {
                case 0 -> usernameText = truncate(usernameText + pasted, MAX_USERNAME);
                case 1 -> passwordText = truncate(passwordText + pasted, MAX_PASSWORD);
                case 2 -> keyText      = truncate(keyText      + pasted, MAX_KEY);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            setStatus("РћС€РёР±РєР° Р±СѓС„РµСЂР°: " + e.getMessage(), AuthState.ERROR);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(Click click, boolean doubled) {
        if (click.button() != 0) return false;

        float scale = (float) client.getWindow().getScaleFactor();
        float fmx = (float) click.x() * scale / FIXED_GUI_SCALE;
        float fmy = (float) click.y() * scale / FIXED_GUI_SCALE;

        int fw = getFixedW(), fh = getFixedH();
        float cx   = fw / 2f;
        float panX = cx - PANEL_W / 2f;
        float panY = fh / 2f - PANEL_H / 2f;

        float sepY  = panY + 11f + Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(22f) + 4f;
        float tabY  = sepY + 8f;
        float tabW  = (PANEL_W - 28f) / 2f - 2f;
        float tabH  = 14f;
        float tab1X = panX + 14f;
        float tab2X = tab1X + tabW + 4f;

        if (hit(fmx, fmy, tab1X, tabY, tabW, tabH)) {
            if (activeTab != Tab.LOGIN) { activeTab = Tab.LOGIN; setFocus(0); clearStatus(); }
            return true;
        }
        if (hit(fmx, fmy, tab2X, tabY, tabW, tabH)) {
            if (activeTab != Tab.KEY) { activeTab = Tab.KEY; setFocus(2); clearStatus(); }
            return true;
        }

        float cY = tabY + tabH + 10f;
        float fX = panX + 14f;
        float fW = PANEL_W - 28f;

        if (activeTab == Tab.LOGIN) {
            if (hit(fmx, fmy, fX, cY + 8f,  fW, 16f)) { setFocus(0); return true; }
            if (hit(fmx, fmy, fX, cY + 41f, fW, 16f)) { setFocus(1); return true; }
            if (hit(fmx, fmy, fX, cY + 73f, fW, 16f)) { doLogin();   return true; }
            if (hit(fmx, fmy, fX, cY + 93f, fW, 13f)) { pasteFromClipboard(); return true; }
        } else {
            if (hit(fmx, fmy, fX, cY + 8f,  fW, 16f)) { setFocus(2); return true; }
            if (hit(fmx, fmy, fX, cY + 34f, fW, 16f)) { doLicense(); return true; }
            if (hit(fmx, fmy, fX, cY + 54f, fW, 13f)) { pasteFromClipboard(); return true; }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(click, doubled);
    }

    private void doLogin() {
        if (authState == AuthState.LOADING) return;
        String user = usernameText.trim();
        String name = user.isEmpty() ? "Р“РѕСЃС‚СЊ" : user;
        setStatus("Р”РѕР±СЂРѕ РїРѕР¶Р°Р»РѕРІР°С‚СЊ, " + name + "!", AuthState.SUCCESS);
        startFadeOutAfter(1400);
    }

    private void doLicense() {
        if (authState == AuthState.LOADING) return;
        setStatus("РљР»СЋС‡ РїСЂРёРЅСЏС‚!", AuthState.SUCCESS);
        startFadeOutAfter(1400);
    }

    private void startFadeOutAfter(long delayMs) {
        CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> {
            try { Thread.sleep(delayMs); } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
            MinecraftClient.getInstance().execute(() -> fadingOut = true);
        });
    }

    private void rescaleParticles(int oldSw, int oldSh, int newSw, int newSh) {
        if (oldSw <= 0 || oldSh <= 0) return;
        float scaleX = (float) newSw / oldSw;
        float scaleY = (float) newSh / oldSh;
        for (int i = 0; i < px.length; i++) {
            px[i]  *= scaleX;
            py[i]  *= scaleY;
            pvx[i] *= scaleX;
            pvy[i] *= scaleY;
        }
    }

    private void updateParticles(float dt, float mouseX, float mouseY, int sw, int sh) {
        for (int i = 0; i < px.length; i++) {
            float dx   = mouseX - px[i];
            float dy   = mouseY - py[i];
            float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            if (dist < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST && dist > 1f) {
                pvx[i] += (dx / dist) * PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE * dt * 60f;
                pvy[i] += (dy / dist) * PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE * dt * 60f;
            }
            float speed    = (float) Math.sqrt(pvx[i] * pvx[i] + pvy[i] * pvy[i]);
            float maxSpeed = PARTICLE_SPEED * 1.8f;
            if (speed > maxSpeed) { pvx[i] = pvx[i] / speed * maxSpeed; pvy[i] = pvy[i] / speed * maxSpeed; }
            px[i] += pvx[i] * dt;
            py[i] += pvy[i] * dt;
            if (px[i] < -5)      px[i] = sw + 5;
            if (px[i] > sw + 5)  px[i] = -5;
            if (py[i] < -5)      py[i] = sh + 5;
            if (py[i] > sh + 5)  py[i] = -5;
        }
    }

    private void renderParticles(float mouseX, float mouseY, float globalAlpha) {
        if (globalAlpha < 0.01f) return;
        int n = px.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                float dx   = px[j] - px[i];
                float dy   = py[j] - py[i];
                float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                if (dist < PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST && dist > 0.5f) {
                    float t     = 1f - dist / PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST;
                    float mdx1  = mouseX - px[i], mdy1 = mouseY - py[i];
                    float mdx2  = mouseX - px[j], mdy2 = mouseY - py[j];
                    float mouseDist = Math.min(
                            (float) Math.sqrt(mdx1 * mdx1 + mdy1 * mdy1),
                            (float) Math.sqrt(mdx2 * mdx2 + mdy2 * mdy2));
                    float mouseBoost = mouseDist < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST
                            ? 1f + (1f - mouseDist / PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST) * 2.5f : 1f;
                    int lineAlpha = MathHelper.clamp((int)(t * t * 120 * globalAlpha * mouseBoost), 0, 255);
                    int lineColor = (mouseDist < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST)
                            ? withAlpha(0x00E5FF, lineAlpha)
                            : withAlpha(0x2A3A4A, lineAlpha);
                    int steps  = Math.max(1, (int)(dist / 2f));
                    float sx   = dx / steps, sy = dy / steps;
                    for (int s = 0; s <= steps; s++)
                        Render2D.rect(px[i] + sx * s, py[i] + sy * s, 1f, 1f, lineColor, 0f);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float mdx  = mouseX - px[i], mdy = mouseY - py[i];
            float md   = (float) Math.sqrt(mdx * mdx + mdy * mdy);
            float glowT = md < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST ? 1f - md / PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST : 0f;
            int dotAlpha = MathHelper.clamp((int)((0.3f + pbright[i] * 0.5f + glowT * 0.4f) * 255 * globalAlpha), 0, 255);
            int dotColor;
            if (glowT > 0.05f) {
                int r = (int)(0x2A + glowT * (0x00 - 0x2A));
                int g = (int)(0x3A + glowT * (0xE5 - 0x3A));
                int b = (int)(0x4A + glowT * (0xFF - 0x4A));
                dotColor = withAlpha((r << 16) | (g << 8) | b, dotAlpha);
            } else {
                dotColor = withAlpha(0x4A5A7A, dotAlpha);
            }
            Render2D.rect(px[i] - PARTICLE_SIZE / 2f, py[i] - PARTICLE_SIZE / 2f,
                    PARTICLE_SIZE, PARTICLE_SIZE, dotColor, 0f);
        }
    }

    private void setFocus(int idx)  { focusedField = idx; }
    private void clearStatus()      { statusMessage = ""; authState = AuthState.IDLE; }
    private void setStatus(String msg, AuthState s) { statusMessage = msg; authState = s; }

    private boolean isOver(float x, float y, float w, float h) {
        return mx >= x && mx <= x + w && my >= y && my <= y + h;
    }
    private boolean hit(float px, float py, float x, float y, float w, float h) {
        return px >= x && px <= x + w && py >= y && py <= y + h;
    }

    private String trimToWidth(String text, float maxW, float size) {
        if (Fonts.TEST.getWidth(text, size) <= maxW) return text;
        String t = text;
        while (t.length() > 2 && Fonts.TEST.getWidth(t + "вЂ¦", size) > maxW)
            t = t.substring(0, t.length() - 1);
        return t + "вЂ¦";
    }

    private static String truncate(String s, int max) {
        return s.length() > max ? s.substring(0, max) : s;
    }

    private int getFixedW() {
        return (int) Math.ceil(client.getWindow().getFramebufferWidth()  / FIXED_GUI_SCALE);
    }
    private int getFixedH() {
        return (int) Math.ceil(client.getWindow().getFramebufferHeight() / FIXED_GUI_SCALE);
    }
    private static int withAlpha(int color, int alpha) {
        return (color & 0x00FFFFFF) | (MathHelper.clamp(alpha, 0, 255) << 24);
    }
    private static float lerpClamped(float t, float a, float b) {
        return a + (b - a) * MathHelper.clamp(t, 0f, 1f);
    }

    @Override public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc() { return false; }
    @Override public boolean shouldPause()       { return false; }
}

package rasty.bot;

import com.mojang.authlib.GameProfile;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.TitleScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.multiplayer.ConnectScreen;
import net.minecraft.network.ClientConnection;
import net.minecraft.client.network.ServerAddress;
import net.minecraft.client.network.ServerInfo;
import net.minecraft.client.session.Session;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.common.KeepAliveC2SPacket;
import rasty.accessor.ISessionAccessor;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

public class BotManager {

    public static class BotSession {
        public enum Status { CONNECTING, CONNECTED, DISCONNECTED }

        private final String username;
        private final String ip;
        private final int port;
        private Status status = Status.CONNECTING;

        public BotSession(String username, String address) {
            ServerAddress parsed = ServerAddress.parse(address);
            this.username = username;
            this.ip = parsed.getAddress();
            this.port = parsed.getPort();
        }

        public String getUsername() { return username; }
        public String getFullAddress() { return port != 25565 ? ip + ":" + port : ip; }
        public Status getStatus() { return status; }
        public void setStatus(Status s) { this.status = s; }

        public String getStatusColored() {
            return switch (status) {
                case CONNECTING -> "В§eРџРѕРґРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёРµ...";
                case CONNECTED -> "В§aРџРѕРґРєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅ";
                case DISCONNECTED -> "В§cРћС‚РєР»СЋС‡С‘РЅ";
            };
        }
    }

    private static BotManager instance;
    public static BotManager getInstance() {
        if (instance == null) instance = new BotManager();
        return instance;
    }

    private final List<BotSession> bots = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private BotSession activeBot = null;
    private Session originalSession = null;
    private String originalAddress = null;
    private boolean viewingBot = false;

    private final List<ClientConnection> frozenConnections = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    public boolean isSwitchingAccount = false;

    public boolean addBot(String username) {
        MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        String address;
        if (mc.getCurrentServerEntry() != null) {
            address = mc.getCurrentServerEntry().address;
        } else if (mc.isIntegratedServerRunning() && mc.getServer() != null) {
            address = "localhost:" + mc.getServer().getServerPort();
        } else {
            return false;
        }
        return addBot(username, address);
    }

    public boolean addBot(String username, String address) {
        MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (originalSession == null) {
            originalSession = mc.getSession();
            if (mc.getCurrentServerEntry() != null) {
                originalAddress = mc.getCurrentServerEntry().address;
            }
        }
        BotSession bot = new BotSession(username, address);
        bots.add(bot);
        switchToBot(bot);
        return true;
    }

    public void switchToBot(BotSession bot) {
        MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (originalSession == null) {
            originalSession = mc.getSession();
        }

        if (mc.getNetworkHandler() != null && mc.getNetworkHandler().getConnection() != null) {
            ClientConnection currentConn = mc.getNetworkHandler().getConnection();
            if (!frozenConnections.contains(currentConn)) {
                frozenConnections.add(currentConn);
            }
        }

        activeBot = bot;
        viewingBot = true;
        bot.setStatus(BotSession.Status.CONNECTING);
        isSwitchingAccount = true;

        UUID uuid = generateOfflineUUID(bot.getUsername());

        Session botSession;
        try {
            var constructor = Session.class.getDeclaredConstructors()[0];
            constructor.setAccessible(true);
            Object[] params = new Object[constructor.getParameterCount()];

            Class<?>[] types = constructor.getParameterTypes();
            for (int i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
                if (types[i] == String.class && i == 0) params[i] = bot.getUsername();
                else if (types[i] == UUID.class) params[i] = uuid;
                else if (types[i] == String.class) params[i] = "";
                else if (types[i] == Optional.class) params[i] = Optional.empty();
                else if (types[i] == GameProfile.class) params[i] = new GameProfile(uuid, bot.getUsername());
                else if (types[i].isEnum()) params[i] = types[i].getEnumConstants()[0];
                else params[i] = null;
            }
            botSession = (Session) constructor.newInstance(params);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            botSession = originalSession;
        }

        ((ISessionAccessor) mc).rasty_setSession(botSession);

        mc.execute(() -> {
            String addr = bot.getFullAddress();
            ConnectScreen.connect(
                    new TitleScreen(), mc,
                    ServerAddress.parse(addr),
                    new ServerInfo("bot_" + bot.getUsername(), addr, ServerInfo.ServerType.OTHER),
                    false, null
            );
            isSwitchingAccount = false;
        });
    }

    public boolean goBack() {
        if (!viewingBot || originalSession == null) return false;
        MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();

        if (mc.getNetworkHandler() != null && mc.getNetworkHandler().getConnection() != null) {
            ClientConnection currentConn = mc.getNetworkHandler().getConnection();
            if (!frozenConnections.contains(currentConn)) {
                frozenConnections.add(currentConn);
            }
        }

        if (activeBot != null) activeBot.setStatus(BotSession.Status.DISCONNECTED);
        activeBot = null;
        viewingBot = false;
        isSwitchingAccount = true;

        ((ISessionAccessor) mc).rasty_setSession(originalSession);
        String addr = originalAddress;
        mc.execute(() -> {
            if (addr != null) {
                ConnectScreen.connect(
                        new TitleScreen(), mc,
                        ServerAddress.parse(addr),
                        new ServerInfo("return", addr, ServerInfo.ServerType.OTHER),
                        false, null
                );
            } else {
                mc.setScreen(new TitleScreen());
            }
            isSwitchingAccount = false;
        });
        return true;
    }

    public List<BotSession> getBots() { return Collections.unmodifiableList(bots); }
    public BotSession getActiveBot() { return activeBot; }
    public boolean isViewingBot() { return viewingBot; }
    public Session getOriginalSession() { return originalSession; }

    public boolean removeBot(String username) {
        return bots.removeIf(b -> b.getUsername().equalsIgnoreCase(username));
    }

    public BotSession getBotByName(String username) {
        return bots.stream()
                .filter(b -> b.getUsername().equalsIgnoreCase(username))
                .findFirst().orElse(null);
    }

    private UUID generateOfflineUUID(String name) {
        try { return UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(("OfflinePlayer:" + name).getBytes("UTF-8")); }
        catch (Exception e) { return UUID.randomUUID(); }
    }

    public void tickFrozenConnections() {
        for (ClientConnection conn : frozenConnections) {
            if (conn.isOpen()) {
                conn.tick();
                conn.send(new KeepAliveC2SPacket(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            } else {
                frozenConnections.remove(conn);
            }
        }
    }
}

        drawDraggable(context, alpha);
    }

package rasty.client.draggables;

import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.Click;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.ChatScreen;
import rasty.Initialization;
import rasty.modules.impl.render.Hud;
import rasty.util.ColorUtil;
import rasty.util.animations.SweepAnim;
import rasty.util.config.impl.drag.DragConfig;
import rasty.util.render.Render2D;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public class Drag {

    private static final float OUTLINE_OFFSET = 3.0f;
    private static final float OUTLINE_THICKNESS = 1.0f;
    private static final int OUTLINE_COLOR = ColorUtil.rgba(255, 255, 255, 255);

    private static final Set<String> EXCLUDED_ELEMENTS = Set.of("Notifications", "Watermark", "Info");

    private static HudElement draggingElement;
    private static int startX, startY;
    private static final Map<HudElement, SweepAnim> sweepAnimations = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Map<HudElement, Boolean> wasHovered = new HashMap<>();

    public static void onDraw(DrawContext context, int rawMouseX, int rawMouseY, float delta, boolean isChatScreen) {
        HudManager hudManager = getHudManager();
        if (hudManager == null) return;

        Hud hud = Hud.getInstance();
        if (hud == null || !hud.isState()) return;

        MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        int mouseX = (int) (mc.mouse.getX() / 2.0);
        int mouseY = (int) (mc.mouse.getY() / 2.0);

        if (!isChatScreen) {
            if (draggingElement != null) {
                DragConfig.getInstance().save();
                draggingElement = null;
            }
            sweepAnimations.clear();
            wasHovered.clear();
        }

        if (isChatScreen && draggingElement != null) {
            draggingElement.setX(mouseX - startX);
            draggingElement.setY(mouseY - startY);
        }

        hudManager.render(context, delta, mouseX, mouseY);

        if (isChatScreen) {
            for (HudElement element : hudManager.getEnabledElements()) {
                if (!element.visible()) {
                    sweepAnimations.remove(element);
                    wasHovered.remove(element);
                    continue;
                }

                if (EXCLUDED_ELEMENTS.contains(element.getName())) {
                    continue;
                }

                boolean isHovered = isHovered(element, mouseX, mouseY);
                boolean previouslyHovered = wasHovered.getOrDefault(element, false);

                float rounding = element.getRoundingRadius();
                float offset = OUTLINE_OFFSET;
                float outlineX = element.getX() - offset;
                float outlineY = element.getY() - offset;
                float outlineWidth = element.getWidth() + offset * 2;
                float outlineHeight = element.getHeight() + offset * 2;
                float outlineRounding = Math.max(0, rounding + offset);

                SweepAnim anim = sweepAnimations.computeIfAbsent(element, e -> new SweepAnim(0.05f));

                if (isHovered && !previouslyHovered) {
                    anim.start();
                } else if (!isHovered && previouslyHovered) {
                    anim.reset();
                }

                wasHovered.put(element, isHovered);

                anim.update();
                float progress = anim.getProgress();

                if (isHovered || anim.isActive()) {
                    float baseAlpha = 0.3f;
                    Render2D.glowOutline(outlineX, outlineY, outlineWidth, outlineHeight,
                            OUTLINE_THICKNESS, OUTLINE_COLOR, outlineRounding, progress, baseAlpha);
                }

                if (!isHovered && anim.isCompleted()) {
                    sweepAnimations.remove(element);
                    wasHovered.remove(element);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void onMouseClick(Click click) {
        MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (!(mc.currentScreen instanceof ChatScreen)) return;

        if (click.button() == 0) {
            HudManager hudManager = getHudManager();
            if (hudManager == null) return;

            int mouseX = (int) (mc.mouse.getX() / 2.0);
            int mouseY = (int) (mc.mouse.getY() / 2.0);

            HudElement element = hudManager.getElementAt(mouseX, mouseY);
            if (element != null) {
                if (element instanceof AbstractHudElement abstractElement && abstractElement.isDraggable()) {
                    draggingElement = element;
                    startX = mouseX - element.getX();
                    startY = mouseY - element.getY();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void onMouseRelease(Click click) {
        if (click.button() == 0 && draggingElement != null) {
            DragConfig.getInstance().save();
            draggingElement = null;
        }
    }

    public static void resetDragging() {
        if (draggingElement != null) {
            DragConfig.getInstance().save();
            draggingElement = null;
        }
        sweepAnimations.clear();
        wasHovered.clear();
    }

    public static boolean isDragging() {
        return draggingElement != null;
    }

    private static boolean isHovered(HudElement element, double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = element.getX();
        int y = element.getY();
        int width = element.getWidth();
        int height = element.getHeight();
        return mouseX >= x && mouseX <= x + width &&
                mouseY >= y && mouseY <= y + height;
    }

    private static HudManager getHudManager() {
        if (Initialization.getInstance() == null) return null;
        if (Initialization.getInstance().getManager() == null) return null;
        return Initialization.getInstance().getManager().getHudManager();
    }

    public static void tick() {
        HudManager hudManager = getHudManager();
        if (hudManager != null) {
            hudManager.tick();
        }
    }
}

package rasty.client.draggables;

import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import rasty.events.impl.PacketEvent;
import rasty.modules.impl.render.Hud;
import rasty.screens.hud.*;
import rasty.util.config.impl.drag.DragConfig;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class HudManager {

    private final List<HudElement> elements = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean initialized = false;

    public HudManager() {
    }

    public void initElements() {
        if (initialized) return;

        register(new Watermark());
        register(new HotKeys());
        register(new Notifications());
        register(new test());
        register(new Potions());
        register(new CoolDowns());
        register(new TargetHud());
        register(new Info());
        register(new Staff());
        register(new Inventory());

        initialized = true;

        DragConfig.getInstance().load();
    }

    public void register(HudElement element) {
        elements.add(element);
    }

    public void onPacket(PacketEvent e) {
        for (HudElement element : elements) {
            element.onPacket(e);
        }
    }

    public void render(DrawContext context, float tickDelta, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        Hud hud = Hud.getInstance();
        if (hud == null || !hud.isState()) return;

        for (HudElement element : elements) {
            if (isElementEnabled(element)) {
                element.render(context, tickDelta);
            }
        }
    }

    public void tick() {
        for (HudElement element : elements) {
            if (isElementEnabled(element)) {
                element.tick();
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean isElementEnabled(HudElement element) {
        Hud hud = Hud.getInstance();
        if (hud == null || !hud.isState()) return false;

        String name = element.getName();
        return hud.interfaceSettings.isSelected(name);
    }

    public HudElement getElementAt(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        for (int i = elements.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            HudElement element = elements.get(i);
            if (isElementEnabled(element) && element.visible()) {
                if (mouseX >= element.getX() && mouseX <= element.getX() + element.getWidth() &&
                        mouseY >= element.getY() && mouseY <= element.getY() + element.getHeight()) {
                    return element;
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public boolean mouseClicked(double rawMouseX, double rawMouseY, int button) {
        MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        double mouseX = mc.mouse.getX() / 2.0;
        double mouseY = mc.mouse.getY() / 2.0;

        for (HudElement element : elements) {
            if (isElementEnabled(element)) {
                if (element.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void saveConfig() {
        DragConfig.getInstance().save();
    }

    public void loadConfig() {
        DragConfig.getInstance().load();
    }

    public List<HudElement> getElements() {
        return elements;
    }

    public List<HudElement> getEnabledElements() {
        List<HudElement> enabled = new ArrayList<>();
        for (HudElement element : elements) {
            if (isElementEnabled(element)) {
                enabled.add(element);
            }
        }
        return enabled;
    }

    public boolean isInitialized() {
        return initialized;
    }
}

package rasty.command;

import net.minecraft.text.MutableText;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.Formatting;
import rasty.util.string.chat.ChatMessage;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

/**
 *  В© 2026 Copyright Rastyclient
 *        All Rights Reserved В®

public abstract class Command {
    private final String name;
    private final String description;
    private final List<String> aliases;

    public Command(String name, String description, String... aliases) {
        this.name = name;
        this.description = description;
        this.aliases = Arrays.asList(aliases);
    }

    public abstract void execute(String label, String[] args);

    public Stream<String> tabComplete(String label, String[] args) {
        return Stream.empty();
    }

    public String getShortDesc() {
        return description;
    }

    public List<String> getLongDesc() {
        return Arrays.asList(
                description,
                "",
                "РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°РЅРёРµ:",
                "> " + name + " - " + description
        );
    }

    public boolean hiddenFromHelp() {
        return false;
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }

    public String getDescription() {
        return description;
    }

    public List<String> getAliases() {
        return aliases;
    }

    public List<String> getAllNames() {
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        names.add(name);
        names.addAll(aliases);
        return names;
    }

    public boolean matches(String input) {
        return name.equalsIgnoreCase(input) ||
                aliases.stream().anyMatch(alias -> alias.equalsIgnoreCase(input));
    }

    protected void logDirect(String message) {
        ChatMessage.brandmessage(message);
    }

    protected void logDirect(String message, Formatting formatting) {
        CommandManager manager = CommandManager.getInstance();
        if (formatting == Formatting.RED) {
            manager.sendError(message);
        } else if (formatting == Formatting.GREEN) {
            manager.sendSuccess(message);
        } else {
            manager.sendMessage(message);
        }
    }

    protected void logDirect(Text text) {
        ChatMessage.brandmessage(text.getString());
    }

    protected void logDirect(MutableText text) {
        ChatMessage.brandmessage(text.getString());
    }

    protected void logDirectRaw(Text text) {
        CommandManager.getInstance().sendRaw(text);
    }

    protected void logDirectRaw(MutableText text) {
        CommandManager.getInstance().sendRaw(text);
    }
}

package rasty.command;

import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.Formatting;
import rasty.command.impl.*;
import rasty.events.api.EventManager;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.ChatEvent;
import rasty.events.impl.TabCompleteEvent;
import rasty.util.config.impl.prefix.PrefixConfig;
import rasty.util.string.chat.ChatMessage;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

public class CommandManager {
    private static CommandManager instance;
    private final List<Command> commands;
    private String prefix;

    public CommandManager() {
        instance = this;
        this.commands = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
        this.prefix = PrefixConfig.getInstance().getPrefix();
    }

    public static CommandManager getInstance() {
        return instance;
    }

    public void init() {
        registerCommand(new HelpCommand());
        registerCommand(new ConfigCommand());
        registerCommand(new AutoBuyCommand());
        registerCommand(new FriendCommand());
        registerCommand(new MacroCommand());
        registerCommand(new BindCommand());
        registerCommand(new PrefixCommand());
        registerCommand(new WayCommand());
        registerCommand(new StaffCommand());
        registerCommand(new BlockESPCommand());
        registerCommand(new GpsCommand());
        registerCommand(new TpsCommand());
        registerCommand(new BotCommand());
        EventManager.register(this);
    }

    public void registerCommand(Command command) {
        commands.add(command);
    }

    public void unregisterCommand(Command command) {
        commands.remove(command);
    }

    public Command getCommand(String name) {
        return commands.stream()
                .filter(cmd -> cmd.matches(name))
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    public List<Command> getCommands() {
        return new ArrayList<>(commands);
    }

    public String getPrefix() {
        return prefix;
    }

    public void setPrefix(String prefix) {
        this.prefix = prefix;
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onChat(ChatEvent event) {
        String msg = event.getMessage();
        if (msg.startsWith(prefix)) {
            event.cancel();
            String commandStr = msg.substring(prefix.length());

            if (commandStr.trim().isEmpty()) {
                execute("help");
                return;
            }

            if (!execute(commandStr)) {
                sendError("РќРµРёР·РІРµСЃС‚РЅР°СЏ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґР°. РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓР№С‚Рµ " + prefix + "help РґР»СЏ СЃРїРёСЃРєР° РєРѕРјР°РЅРґ.");
            }
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTabComplete(TabCompleteEvent event) {
        String eventPrefix = event.prefix;

        if (!eventPrefix.startsWith(prefix)) {
            return;
        }

        String msg = eventPrefix.substring(prefix.length());
        Stream<String> stream = tabComplete(msg);

        String[] parts = msg.split(" ", -1);
        if (parts.length <= 1) {
            stream = stream.map(x -> prefix + x);
        }

        event.completions = stream.toArray(String[]::new);
    }

    public boolean execute(String input) {
        if (input == null || input.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return execute("help");
        }

        String[] parts = input.trim().split("\\s+", 2);
        String commandName = parts[0];
        String[] args = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].split("\\s+") : new String[0];

        Command command = getCommand(commandName);
        if (command != null) {
            try {
                command.execute(commandName, args);
                return true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                sendError("РћС€РёР±РєР° РїСЂРё РІС‹РїРѕР»РЅРµРЅРёРё РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹: " + e.getMessage());
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public Stream<String> tabComplete(String input) {
        if (input == null) {
            input = "";
        }

        String[] args = input.split("\\s+", -1);

        if (args.length <= 1) {
            String partial = args.length == 0 ? "" : args[0].toLowerCase();
            return getCommandSuggestions(partial);
        }

        String commandName = args[0];
        Command command = getCommand(commandName);

        if (command != null) {
            String[] subArgs = Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 1, args.length);
            return command.tabComplete(commandName, subArgs);
        }

        return Stream.empty();
    }

    private Stream<String> getCommandSuggestions(String partial) {
        if (partial.isEmpty()) {
            return commands.stream()
                    .map(Command::getName)
                    .sorted();
        }

        Set<String> suggestions = new LinkedHashSet<>();

        for (Command cmd : commands) {
            String mainName = cmd.getName();

            if (mainName.toLowerCase().startsWith(partial)) {
                suggestions.add(mainName);
            } else {
                for (String alias : cmd.getAliases()) {
                    if (alias.toLowerCase().startsWith(partial)) {
                        suggestions.add(alias);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return suggestions.stream().sorted();
    }

    public void sendMessage(String message) {
        ChatMessage.brandmessage(message);
    }

    public void sendSuccess(String message) {
        if (MinecraftClient.getInstance().player != null) {
            Text prefixText = ChatMessage.brandmessage();
            Text formattedMessage = prefixText.copy()
                    .append(Text.literal(" -> ").formatted(Formatting.DARK_GRAY))
                    .append(Text.literal(message).formatted(Formatting.GREEN));
            MinecraftClient.getInstance().player.sendMessage(formattedMessage, false);
        }
    }

    public void sendError(String message) {
        if (MinecraftClient.getInstance().player != null) {
            Text prefixText = ChatMessage.brandmessage();
            Text formattedMessage = prefixText.copy()
                    .append(Text.literal(" -> ").formatted(Formatting.DARK_GRAY))
                    .append(Text.literal(message).formatted(Formatting.RED));
            MinecraftClient.getInstance().player.sendMessage(formattedMessage, false);
        }
    }

    public void sendRaw(Text text) {
        if (MinecraftClient.getInstance().player != null) {
            MinecraftClient.getInstance().player.sendMessage(text, false);
        }
    }
}

package rasty.command.helpers;

import net.minecraft.text.ClickEvent;

/**
 *  В© 2026 Copyright Rastyclient

public class Paginator<T> {

    private final List<T> items;
    private final int itemsPerPage;
    private int currentPage;

    public Paginator(List<T> items) {
        this(items, 8);
    }

    public Paginator(List<T> items, int itemsPerPage) {
        this.items = items;
        this.itemsPerPage = itemsPerPage;
        this.currentPage = 1;
    }

    public int getTotalPages() {
        return Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil((double) items.size() / itemsPerPage));
    }

    public List<T> getCurrentPageItems() {
        int start = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
        int end = Math.min(start + itemsPerPage, items.size());
        return items.subList(start, end);
    }

    public void setPage(int page) {
        this.currentPage = Math.max(1, Math.min(page, getTotalPages()));
    }

    public void display(
            Runnable header,
            Function<T, MutableText> itemFormatter,
            String commandPrefix
    ) {
        CommandManager manager = CommandManager.getInstance();

        if (header != null) {
            header.run();
        }

        for (T item : getCurrentPageItems()) {
            MutableText formatted = itemFormatter.apply(item);
            manager.sendRaw(formatted);
        }

        if (getTotalPages() > 1) {
            displayNavigation(manager, commandPrefix);
        } else {
            manager.sendRaw(Text.literal(getLine()));
        }
    }

    private void displayNavigation(CommandManager manager, String commandPrefix) {
        manager.sendRaw(Text.literal(getLine()));

        MutableText navigation = Text.literal("");

        if (currentPage > 1) {
            MutableText prevButton = Text.literal("В§8[В§bв—„ РќР°Р·Р°РґВ§8]");
            String prevCommand = commandPrefix + " " + (currentPage - 1);
            prevButton.setStyle(prevButton.getStyle()
                    .withHoverEvent(new HoverEvent.ShowText(
                            Text.literal("В§7РЎС‚СЂР°РЅРёС†Р° " + (currentPage - 1))))
                    .withClickEvent(new ClickEvent.RunCommand(prevCommand)));
            navigation.append(prevButton);
        } else {
            navigation.append(Text.literal("В§8[В§7в—„ РќР°Р·Р°РґВ§8]"));
        }

        navigation.append(Text.literal(" В§7РЎС‚СЂР°РЅРёС†Р° В§b" + currentPage + "В§7/В§b" + getTotalPages() + " "));

        if (currentPage < getTotalPages()) {
            MutableText nextButton = Text.literal("В§8[В§bР’РїРµСЂС‘Рґ в–єВ§8]");
            String nextCommand = commandPrefix + " " + (currentPage + 1);
            nextButton.setStyle(nextButton.getStyle()
                    .withHoverEvent(new HoverEvent.ShowText(
                            Text.literal("В§7РЎС‚СЂР°РЅРёС†Р° " + (currentPage + 1))))
                    .withClickEvent(new ClickEvent.RunCommand(nextCommand)));
            navigation.append(nextButton);
        } else {
            navigation.append(Text.literal("В§8[В§7Р’РїРµСЂС‘Рґ в–єВ§8]"));
        }

        manager.sendRaw(navigation);
    }

    public static <T> void paginate(
            String[] args,
            Paginator<T> paginator,
            Runnable header,
            Function<T, MutableText> itemFormatter,
            String commandPrefix
    ) {
        if (args.length > 0) {
            try {
                int page = Integer.parseInt(args[0]);
                paginator.setPage(page);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
            }
        }

        paginator.display(header, itemFormatter, commandPrefix);
    }
}

package rasty.command.helpers;

import rasty.command.Command;
import rasty.command.CommandManager;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

/**
 *  В© 2026 Copyright Rastyclient
 *        All Rights Reserved В®
 */

public class TabCompleteHelper {
    private final List<String> completions;
    private String prefix = "";
    private boolean sorted = false;

    public TabCompleteHelper() {
        this.completions = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public TabCompleteHelper append(String... strings) {
        completions.addAll(Arrays.asList(strings));
        return this;
    }

    public TabCompleteHelper addCommands(CommandManager manager) {
        String filter = this.prefix.toLowerCase();

        for (Command cmd : manager.getCommands()) {
            String mainName = cmd.getName();

            if (filter.isEmpty()) {
                completions.add(mainName);
            } else if (mainName.toLowerCase().startsWith(filter)) {
                completions.add(mainName);
            } else {
                for (String alias : cmd.getAliases()) {
                    if (alias.toLowerCase().startsWith(filter)) {
                        completions.add(alias);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return this;
    }

    public TabCompleteHelper addCommands(List<Command> commands) {
        String filter = this.prefix.toLowerCase();

        for (Command cmd : commands) {
            String mainName = cmd.getName();

            if (filter.isEmpty()) {
                completions.add(mainName);
            } else if (mainName.toLowerCase().startsWith(filter)) {
                completions.add(mainName);
            } else {
                for (String alias : cmd.getAliases()) {
                    if (alias.toLowerCase().startsWith(filter)) {
                        completions.add(alias);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return this;
    }

    public TabCompleteHelper filterPrefix(String prefix) {
        this.prefix = prefix.toLowerCase();
        return this;
    }

    public TabCompleteHelper sortAlphabetically() {
        this.sorted = true;
        return this;
    }

    public TabCompleteHelper prepend(String... strings) {
        List<String> temp = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(strings));
        temp.addAll(completions);
        completions.clear();
        completions.addAll(temp);
        return this;
    }

    public Stream<String> stream() {
        Stream<String> stream = completions.stream()
                .filter(s -> s.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix));

        if (sorted) {
            stream = stream.sorted();
        }

        return stream;
    }

    public List<String> toList() {
        return stream().toList();
    }

    public String[] toArray() {
        return stream().toArray(String[]::new);
    }
}

                logDirect("В§7РџСЂРёРјРµСЂС‹:");
                logDirect("В§8> В§fblockesp add diamond_ore");
                logDirect("В§8> В§fblockesp add minecraft:ancient_debris");
                logDirectRaw(Text.literal(getLine()));
            }
        }
    }

    private void syncWithModule() {
        BlockESP module = getBlockESPModule();
        if (module != null) {
            module.getBlocksToHighlight().clear();
            module.getBlocksToHighlight().addAll(BlockESPConfig.getInstance().getBlocks());
        }
    }

    private BlockESP getBlockESPModule() {
        if (Initialization.getInstance() == null || Initialization.getInstance().getManager() == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return Initialization.getInstance().getManager().getModuleRepository().modules().stream()
                .filter(m -> m instanceof BlockESP)
                .map(m -> (BlockESP) m)
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    @Override
    public Stream<String> tabComplete(String label, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 1) {
            return new TabCompleteHelper()
                    .append("add", "remove", "list", "clear", "blocks")
                    .sortAlphabetically()
                    .filterPrefix(args[0])
                    .stream();
        }
        if (args.length == 2) {
            String action = args[0].toLowerCase();
            if (action.equals("add")) {
                return Registries.BLOCK.getIds().stream()
                        .map(Identifier::toString)
                        .filter(name -> name.toLowerCase().contains(args[1].toLowerCase()))
                        .limit(50);
            }
            if (action.equals("remove") || action.equals("del") || action.equals("delete")) {
                return new TabCompleteHelper()
                        .append(BlockESPConfig.getInstance().getBlockList().toArray(new String[0]))
                        .filterPrefix(args[1])
                        .stream();
            }
        }
        return Stream.empty();
    }

    @Override
    public String getShortDesc() {
        return "РЈРїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРёРµ Р±Р»РѕРєР°РјРё РґР»СЏ BlockESP";
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> getLongDesc() {
        return Arrays.asList(
                "РљРѕРјР°РЅРґР° РґР»СЏ СѓРїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРёСЏ СЃРїРёСЃРєРѕРј Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРІ BlockESP",
                "РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°РЅРёРµ:",
                "> blockesp add <block> - Р”РѕР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ Р±Р»РѕРє РІ СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє",
                "> blockesp remove <block> - РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ Р±Р»РѕРє РёР· СЃРїРёСЃРєР°",
                "> blockesp list - РџРѕРєР°Р·Р°С‚СЊ РґРѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅС‹Рµ Р±Р»РѕРєРё",

    }

    @Override
    public void execute(String label, String[] args) {
        BotManager mgr = BotManager.getInstance();
        String action  = args.length > 0 ? args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.US) : "help";

        switch (action) {
            case "add" -> {
                if (args.length < 2) {
                    logDirect("РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°РЅРёРµ: bot add <РЅРёРє> [ip:port]", Formatting.RED);
                    return;
                }
                String username = args[1];
                boolean ok = args.length >= 3
                        ? mgr.addBot(username, args[2])
                        : mgr.addBot(username);
                if (!ok) {
                    logDirect("РўС‹ РЅРµ РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРµ! РЈРєР°Р¶Рё Р°РґСЂРµСЃ: bot add <РЅРёРє> <ip>", Formatting.RED);
                    return;
                }
                logDirect("В§aРџРµСЂРµРєР»СЋС‡Р°СЋ СЌРєСЂР°РЅ РЅР° В§f" + username + "В§a (РњРµР№РЅ Р·Р°РјРѕСЂРѕР¶РµРЅ РІ РђР¤Рљ)", Formatting.GREEN);
            }
            case "back" -> {
                if (mgr.goBack()) logDirect("Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµРјСЃСЏ РЅР° РјРµР№РЅ Р°РєРєР°СѓРЅС‚...", Formatting.GREEN);
                else logDirect("РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ РІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚СЊСЃСЏ!", Formatting.RED);
            }
            case "list" -> {
                List<BotSession> bots = mgr.getBots();
                logDirectRaw(Text.literal(getLine()));
                logDirect("В§fВ§lРЎРџРРЎРћРљ Р‘РћРўРћР’ В§7(" + bots.size() + ")");
                logDirectRaw(Text.literal(getLine()));
                if (bots.isEmpty()) {
                    logDirect("В§7Р‘РѕС‚РѕРІ РЅРµС‚. Р”РѕР±Р°РІСЊ: В§fbot add <РЅРёРє>");
                } else {
                    for (BotSession bot : bots) {
                        boolean active = bot.equals(mgr.getActiveBot());
                        logDirect((active ? "В§aв–є " : "В§8в—Џ ")
                                + "В§f" + bot.getUsername()
                                + " В§8@ В§7" + bot.getFullAddress()
                                + " В§8[" + bot.getStatusColored() + "В§8]");
                    }
                }
                logDirectRaw(Text.literal(getLine()));
            }
            case "switch", "sw" -> {
                if (args.length < 2) { logDirect("РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°РЅРёРµ: bot switch <РЅРёРє>", Formatting.RED); return; }

                if (bot == null) { logDirect("Р‘РѕС‚ РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ!", Formatting.RED); return; }
                mgr.switchToBot(bot);
                logDirect("В§aРџРµСЂРµРєР»СЋС‡Р°РµРјСЃСЏ РЅР° В§f" + args[1] + "В§a...", Formatting.GREEN);
            }

                else logDirect("Р‘РѕС‚ В§f" + args[1] + " В§cРЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ!", Formatting.RED);
            }
            default -> {
                logDirectRaw(Text.literal(getLine()));
                logDirect("В§fВ§lРЈРџР РђР’Р›Р•РќРР• Р­РљР РђРќРђРњР");
                logDirect("В§7> bot add В§b<РЅРёРє> В§8[В§7ipВ§8] В§8- В§fРџРµСЂРµРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚СЊСЃСЏ РЅР° Р±РѕС‚Р° (Р±РµР· РєРёРєР°)");
                logDirect("В§7> bot switch В§b<РЅРёРє> В§8- В§fРџРµСЂРµРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚СЊСЃСЏ РЅР° РґСЂСѓРіРѕРіРѕ Р±РѕС‚Р°");
                logDirect("В§7> bot back В§8- В§fР’РµСЂРЅСѓС‚СЊСЃСЏ РЅР° РјРµР№РЅ");

                logDirect("В§7> bot remove В§b<РЅРёРє> В§8- В§fРЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ Р±РѕС‚Р°");

    @Override
    public Stream<String> tabComplete(String label, String[] args) {

    public List<String> getConfigs() {
        List<String> configs = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            Path configDir = ConfigPath.getConfigDirectory();
            if (Files.exists(configDir)) {
                Files.list(configDir)
                        .filter(path -> path.toString().endsWith(".json"))

                        .filter(path -> !path.getFileName().toString().equals("autoconfig.json"))
                        .forEach(path -> {
                            String name = path.getFileName().toString();
                            configs.add(name.substring(0, name.length() - 5));
                        });
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {}
        return configs;
    }

    public FriendCommand() {

    @Override
    public void execute(String label, String[] args) {
        CommandManager manager = CommandManager.getInstance();

        String arg = args.length > 0 ? args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.US) : "list";

        switch (arg) {
            case "add" -> {

                    return;
                }
                String name = args[1];
                if (FriendUtils.isFriend(name)) {
                    logDirect(String.format("РРіСЂРѕРє %s СѓР¶Рµ РІ СЃРїРёСЃРєРµ РґСЂСѓР·РµР№!", name), Formatting.RED);

                }
