package rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.target;

import net.minecraft.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import rasty.util.timer.StopWatch;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

import static rasty.IMinecraft.mc;

public class Vector {

    private static final Random random = new Random();
    private static final StopWatch pointTimer = new StopWatch();
    private static final StopWatch updateTimer = new StopWatch();
    private static List<Vec3d> cachedPoints = new ArrayList<>();
    private static int currentPointIndex = 0;

    public static Vec3d hitbox(Entity entity, float X, float Y, float Z, float WIDTH) {
        double wHalf = entity.getWidth() / WIDTH;
        double yExpand = MathHelper.clamp(entity.getEyeY() - entity.getY(), 0, entity.getHeight());
        double xExpand = MathHelper.clamp(mc.player.getX() - entity.getX(), -wHalf, wHalf);
        double zExpand = MathHelper.clamp(mc.player.getZ() - entity.getZ(), -wHalf, wHalf);

        return new Vec3d(
                entity.getX() + xExpand / X,
                entity.getY() + yExpand / Y,
                entity.getZ() + zExpand / Z
        );
    }

    public static Vec3d brain(Entity entity, float min, float max) {
        double distance = mc.player.getEntityPos().distanceTo(entity.getEntityPos());

        double normalizedDistance = MathHelper.clamp((distance - min) / (max - min), 0, 1);
        double heightFactor = normalizedDistance;

        double minHeight = 0.2;
        double maxHeight = 0.8;
        double targetHeight = minHeight + (maxHeight - minHeight) * heightFactor;

        double targetY = entity.getY() + (entity.getHeight() * targetHeight);

        return new Vec3d(
                entity.getX(),
                targetY,
                entity.getZ()
        );
    }

    public static Vec3d custom(Entity entity, int pointCount, float switchDelay) {
        if (updateTimer.every(1000) || cachedPoints.isEmpty()) {
            generateRandomPoints(entity, pointCount);
            currentPointIndex = 0;
            pointTimer.reset();
        }

        if (pointTimer.finished(switchDelay)) {
            currentPointIndex = (currentPointIndex + 1) % cachedPoints.size();
            pointTimer.reset();
        }

        if (cachedPoints.isEmpty()) {
            return entity.getEntityPos();
        }

        return cachedPoints.get(currentPointIndex);
    }

    private static void generateRandomPoints(Entity entity, int pointCount) {
        cachedPoints.clear();

        double width = entity.getWidth();
        double height = entity.getHeight();
        Vec3d entityPos = entity.getEntityPos();

        for (int i = 0; i < pointCount; i++) {
            double x = entityPos.x + (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * width;
            double y = entityPos.y + random.nextDouble() * height;
            double z = entityPos.z + (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * width;

            cachedPoints.add(new Vec3d(x, y, z));
        }
    }

    public static List<Vec3d> getAllCachedPoints() {
        return new ArrayList<>(cachedPoints);
    }

    public static int getCurrentPointIndex() {
        return currentPointIndex;
    }

    public static long getTimeSinceLastSwitch() {
        return pointTimer.elapsedTime();
    }

    public static void clearCache() {
        cachedPoints.clear();
        currentPointIndex = 0;
        pointTimer.reset();
        updateTimer.reset();
    }

    public static void forceUpdate(Entity entity, int pointCount) {
        generateRandomPoints(entity, pointCount);
        currentPointIndex = 0;
        pointTimer.reset();
        updateTimer.reset();
    }
}

    @Getter
    private LivingEntity target;
    public static LivingEntity lastTarget;

    private int ticksToAttack = 0;
    private float lastYaw = 0;
    private float lastPitch = 0;
    private float speedAcceleration = 0;
    private boolean back = false;
    private boolean isTurnaroundActive = false;

    private final StopWatch stopWatch = new StopWatch();

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        target = null;
        lastTarget = null;
        ticksToAttack = 0;
        speedAcceleration = 0;
        back = false;
        isTurnaroundActive = false;
    }

    private Vec3d getAuraRotationVec() {
        Angle current = AngleConnection.INSTANCE.getCurrentAngle();
        if (current != null) return current.toVector();
        return mc.player.getRotationVector();
    }

    @EventHandler
    private void onTick(TickEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;
        if (ticksToAttack > 0) ticksToAttack--;
        updateTarget();
        if (target == null) speedAcceleration = 0;
    }

    @EventHandler
    private void onRotationUpdate(RotationUpdateEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        if (e.getType() == rasty.events.api.types.EventType.PRE) {
            if (target == null) return;
            if (rotationBehavior.isSelected("РЎРЅР°РїС‹")) {
                boolean ready = mc.player.getAttackCooldownProgress(1.0f) >= 0.95f && ticksToAttack <= 1;
                if (!ready) return;
            }
            switch (rotation.getSelected()) {
                case "ReallyWorld" -> updateVanillaRotation(target);
                case "Sloth" -> updateSlothRotation(target);
                case "Wellmine" -> updateWellmineRotation(target);
                case "Assist" -> updateAssistRotation(target);
                case "NoRot" -> updateNoRotRotation(target);
                case "LonyGrief" -> updateLonyGriefRotation(target);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (e.getType() != rasty.events.api.types.EventType.POST) return;
        if (target == null) return;

        if (canStopSprinting()) mc.player.setSprinting(false);

        if (canAttack()) {
            lastTarget = target;
            mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(
                    new PlayerInputC2SPacket(new PlayerInput(false, false, false, false, false, false, false))
            );
            mc.interactionManager.attackEntity(mc.player, target);
            mc.player.swingHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);
            mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(
                    new PlayerInputC2SPacket(mc.player.input.playerInput)
            );
            ticksToAttack = 6;
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidEntity(Entity entity) {
        if (!entity.isAlive()) return false;
        if (entity instanceof ClientPlayerEntity) return false;
        if (entity instanceof ArmorStandEntity) return false;
        if (entity instanceof PlayerEntity p && p.getArmor() != 0 && !targets.isSelected("РРіСЂРѕРєРё")) return false;
        if (entity instanceof PlayerEntity p && p.getArmor() == 0 && !targets.isSelected("Р“РѕР»С‹Рµ")) return false;
        if ((entity instanceof HostileEntity || entity instanceof AmbientEntity) && !targets.isSelected("РњРѕРЅСЃС‚СЂС‹"))
            return false;
        if ((entity instanceof PassiveEntity || entity instanceof FishEntity) && !targets.isSelected("Р–РёРІРѕС‚РЅС‹Рµ"))
            return false;

        AntiBot antiBot = AntiBot.getInstance();
        if (entity instanceof PlayerEntity p && antiBot != null && antiBot.isBot(p)) return false;

        double maxDist = distance.getValue() + preRotation.getValue();
        if (mc.player.getEyePos().distanceTo(BestPointUtil.getNearestPoint(entity)) > maxDist) return false;

        return true;
    }

    private boolean cooldownIsReached(boolean toSprinting) {
        float threshold = toSprinting ? 0.75f : 0.9f;
        return mc.player.getAttackCooldownProgress(0.5f) >= threshold;
    }

    private boolean canCritical() {
        if (mc.player.isInLava() || mc.player.isClimbing()
                || mc.player.isSubmergedIn(net.minecraft.registry.tag.FluidTags.WATER)
                || mc.player.hasStatusEffect(net.minecraft.entity.effect.StatusEffects.LEVITATION)
                || mc.player.hasStatusEffect(net.minecraft.entity.effect.StatusEffects.SLOW_FALLING)
                || mc.player.isGliding() || mc.player.hasVehicle()
                || mc.player.getAbilities().flying) {
            return true;
        }
        if (onlySpace.isValue()) {
            return mc.player.fallDistance > 0.0F
                    && !mc.player.isOnGround()
                    && mc.player.getVelocity().y <= 0.0
                    && !mc.player.hasVehicle()
                    && !mc.player.getAbilities().flying;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public boolean canAttack() {
        if (target == null) return false;
        if (!cooldownIsReached(false)) return false;
        if (ticksToAttack > 0) return false;
        if (raycastCheck.isValue()) {
            if (!RaytraceUtil2.rayTrace(getAuraRotationVec(), distance.getValue(), target.getBoundingBox())) return false;
        }
        if (mc.player.getEyePos().distanceTo(BestPointUtil.getNearestPoint(target)) > (distance.getValue() - 0.2f))
            return false;
        return canCritical();
    }

    public boolean canStopSprinting() {
        if (target == null) return false;
        if (!cooldownIsReached(true)) return false;
        if (ticksToAttack > 1) return false;
        if (mc.player.isOnGround() && mc.player.fallDistance == 0f) return false;
        return true;
    }

    private void updateTarget() {
        LivingEntity best = null;
        double bestDot = -1;
        Vec3d eyePos = mc.player.getEyePos();
        Vec3d lookVec = mc.player.getRotationVec(1.0f);

        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (!(entity instanceof LivingEntity)) continue;
            if (!isValidEntity(entity)) continue;

            Vec3d targetVec = BestPointUtil.getNearestPoint(entity).subtract(eyePos).normalize();
            double dot = lookVec.dotProduct(targetVec);
            if (dot > bestDot) {
                bestDot = dot;
                best = (LivingEntity) entity;
            }
        }

        if (target == null || !isValidEntity(target)) {
            this.target = best;
        }
    }

    private Vec3d resolvePoint(LivingEntity target, Vec3d point, double range) {
        if (!smartAim.isValue() || target == null) return point;
        return BestPointUtil.getNearestVisiblePoint(target, point, range);
    }

    private Vec3d getCenter(LivingEntity target) {
        return target.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
    }

    private Angle toAngle(Vec3d point) {
        return MathAngle.fromVec3d(point.subtract(mc.player.getEyePos()));
    }

    private void applyRotation(Angle angle) {
        AngleConfig rc = new AngleConfig(new LinearConstructor(), true, false);
        AngleConnection.INSTANCE.rotateTo(
                new Angle.VecRotation(angle, angle.toVector()),
                target, 1, rc, TaskPriority.HIGH_IMPORTANCE_1, this
        );
        lastYaw = angle.getYaw();
        lastPitch = angle.getPitch();
    }

    private void applyRotationSmooth(Angle smoothRot) {
        AngleConfig rc = new AngleConfig(new LinearConstructor(), true, false);
        AngleConnection.INSTANCE.rotateTo(
                new Angle.VecRotation(smoothRot, smoothRot.toVector()),
                target, 1, rc, TaskPriority.HIGH_IMPORTANCE_1, this
        );
        lastYaw = smoothRot.getYaw();
        lastPitch = smoothRot.getPitch();
    }

    private void updateVanillaRotation(LivingEntity target) {
        Vec3d point = resolvePoint(target, BestPointUtil.getNearestPoint(target), distance.getValue());
        applyRotation(toAngle(point));
    }

    private void updateSlothRotation(LivingEntity target) {
        Vec3d targetPoint = resolvePoint(target, getCenter(target), 6);
        if (target.isGliding() && predictate.isValue() && !isTurnaroundActive) {
            targetPoint = PredictUtil.predict(target, predictValue.getValue());
        }

        Angle angle = toAngle(targetPoint);
        float targetYaw = angle.getYaw();
        float targetPitch = angle.getPitch();

        boolean isLooking = RaytraceUtil2.rayTrace(
                getAuraRotationVec(), 6,
                target.getBoundingBox().expand(-0.10, target.isGliding() ? -0.5 : -1.0, -0.10)
        );

        float randomFactor = (float) Math.random();
        float deltaYawAbs = Math.abs(MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - lastYaw));
        float accelBase = mc.player.isGliding() ? 0.0045f : 0.004f;
        float decelBase = 0.02f;
        float jitterMult = 0.7f;

        if (!isLooking && speedAcceleration <= 0.16f) {
            if (deltaYawAbs > 70) speedAcceleration += accelBase - (randomFactor * 0.0025f);
            else if (deltaYawAbs > 40) speedAcceleration += accelBase - (randomFactor * 0.0015f);
            else speedAcceleration += accelBase + (randomFactor * 0.0015f);
        } else {
            if (speedAcceleration >= -0.01f) {
                if (mc.player.isGliding()) {
                    speedAcceleration -= 0.01f;
                } else {
                    speedAcceleration -= (deltaYawAbs > 50) ? decelBase * 1.5f : decelBase;
                    if (mc.player.distanceTo(target) <= 1.5f) speedAcceleration -= 0.08f;
                }
            }
        }

        float deltaYaw = MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - lastYaw);
        float deltaPitch = targetPitch - lastPitch;
        float smooth = Math.max(speedAcceleration, 0);

        float newYaw = lastYaw + deltaYaw * Math.min(Math.max(smooth, 0), 1);
        float newPitch = lastPitch + deltaPitch * Math.min(Math.max(smooth / 2, 0), 1);

        if (deltaYawAbs > 25.0f) {
            float time = (mc.player.age + mc.getRenderTickCounter().getTickProgress(true)) * 0.15f;
            float ampBase = (1f - MathHelper.clamp(smooth, 0f, 1f)) * jitterMult;
            float jitterYaw = (float) (Math.sin(time * 1.7f) + (randomFactor * 0.2f)) * (0.35f * ampBase);
            float jitterPitch = (float) (Math.cos(time * 1.9f) + (randomFactor * 0.2f)) * (0.50f * ampBase);
            newYaw += mc.player.isGliding() ? jitterYaw / 4f : jitterYaw;
            newPitch += mc.player.isGliding() ? jitterPitch / 4f : jitterPitch;
        }

        float gcd = (float) MathUtils.computeGcd();
        newYaw -= (newYaw - lastYaw) % gcd;
        newPitch -= (newPitch - lastPitch) % gcd;

        applyRotationSmooth(new Angle(newYaw, newPitch));
    }

    private void updateNoRotRotation(LivingEntity target) {
        double time = System.nanoTime() * 1e-9;
        Angle angle = toAngle(target.getBoundingBox().getCenter().add(0, (float) Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 19)) / 2, 0));

        if (target.isGliding() && predictate.isValue() && !isTurnaroundActive) {
            angle = toAngle(PredictUtil.predict(target, predictValue.getValue() + 2.5f));
        }

        if (!RaytraceUtil2.rayTrace(getAuraRotationVec(), 999, target.getBoundingBox().expand(-0.2f))) {
            speedAcceleration += (float) Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 19)) / 666;
        } else {
            if (speedAcceleration >= 0.02f) speedAcceleration -= 0.02f;
        }

        float deltaYaw = MathHelper.wrapDegrees(angle.getYaw() - lastYaw);
        float deltaPitch = angle.getPitch() - lastPitch;
        float smooth = Math.min(Math.max(speedAcceleration, 0), 0.2f);

        float newYaw = lastYaw + deltaYaw * smooth;
        float newPitch = lastPitch + deltaPitch * (smooth / 3);

        float gcd = (float) MathUtils.computeGcd();
        newYaw -= (newYaw - lastYaw) % gcd;
        newPitch -= (newPitch - lastPitch) % gcd;

        applyRotationSmooth(new Angle(newYaw, newPitch));
    }

    private void updateLonyGriefRotation(LivingEntity target) {
        Vec3d point = target.isGliding() && predictate.isValue() && !isTurnaroundActive
                ? PredictUtil.predict(target, predictValue.getValue())
                : resolvePoint(target, BestPointUtil.getNearestPoint(target), 6);

        Angle angle = toAngle(point);
        float targetYaw = angle.getYaw();
        float targetPitch = angle.getPitch();

        if (!back) {
            float pon = mc.player.isGliding() ? 1.35f : 1f;
            speedAcceleration += (Math.abs(MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - lastYaw)) > 40 ? 0.005f / pon : 0.0038f / pon);
            boolean isLooking = RaytraceUtil2.rayTrace(getAuraRotationVec(), 6, target.getBoundingBox().expand(-0.2, -0.3, -0.2));
            if (speedAcceleration >= 0.16f / pon || isLooking) back = true;
        } else {
            if (speedAcceleration >= -0.01f) {
                speedAcceleration -= (Math.abs(MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - lastYaw)) > 60 ? 0.06f : 0.01f);
            }
            if (speedAcceleration <= -0.01f) back = false;
        }

        float deltaYaw = MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - lastYaw);
        float deltaPitch = targetPitch - lastPitch;
        float smooth = Math.max(speedAcceleration, 0);

        float newYaw = lastYaw + deltaYaw * Math.min(Math.max(smooth, 0), 1);
        float newPitch = lastPitch + deltaPitch * Math.min(Math.max(smooth / 2, 0), 1);

        float gcd = (float) MathUtils.computeGcd();
        newYaw -= (newYaw - lastYaw) % gcd;
        newPitch -= (newPitch - lastPitch) % gcd;

        applyRotationSmooth(new Angle(newYaw, newPitch));
    }

    private void updateWellmineRotation(LivingEntity target) {
        Vec3d vector = resolvePoint(target, getCenter(target), 6);
        if (target.isGliding() && predictate.isValue() && !isTurnaroundActive) {
            vector = PredictUtil.predict(target, predictValue.getValue());
        }

        Angle angle = toAngle(vector);
        float targetYaw = angle.getYaw();
        float targetPitch = angle.getPitch();

        if (!back) {
            if (speedAcceleration >= 1f) {
                speedAcceleration = 0;
            } else {
                if (mc.player.isGliding()) {
                    float diff = Math.abs(MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - mc.player.getYaw()));
                    speedAcceleration += (diff > 40 ? 0.0025f : 0.005f);
                } else {
                    speedAcceleration += 0.005f;
                }
            }
            if (speedAcceleration >= 0.18f || RaytraceUtil2.rayTrace(getAuraRotationVec(), 6, target.getBoundingBox().expand(-0.5, -1, -0.5))) {
                back = true;
            }
        } else {
            if (speedAcceleration >= -0.01f) {
                float diff = Math.abs(MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - mc.player.getYaw()));
                speedAcceleration -= (diff > 40 ? 0.04f : 0.01f);
            }
            if (speedAcceleration <= -0.01f) back = false;
        }

        float randomYaw = (float) java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextDouble(-0.75, 0.75);
        float randomPitch = (float) java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextDouble(-0.75, 0.75);

        targetYaw += randomYaw;
        targetPitch += randomPitch;

        float smoothVal = Math.min(Math.max(speedAcceleration, -1), 1);
        float changeYaw = MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - mc.player.getYaw()) * smoothVal;
        float changePitch = (targetPitch - mc.player.getPitch()) * (smoothVal / 2f);

        float newYaw = mc.player.getYaw() + changeYaw;
        float newPitch = MathHelper.clamp(mc.player.getPitch() + changePitch, -90, 90);

        applyRotationSmooth(new Angle(newYaw, newPitch));
    }

    private void updateAssistRotation(LivingEntity target) {
        if (target == null) return;

        Vec3d point = resolvePoint(target, BestPointUtil.getNearestPoint(target), 6);
        if (target.isGliding() && predictate.isValue() && !isTurnaroundActive) {
            point = PredictUtil.predict(target, predictValue.getValue());
        }

        Vec3d eyePos = mc.player.getEyePos();
        double deltaX = point.x - eyePos.x;
        double deltaY = point.y - eyePos.y;
        double deltaZ = point.z - eyePos.z;
        double dist = Math.sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaZ * deltaZ);

        float targetYaw = (float) (Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(deltaZ, deltaX)) - 90.0);
        float targetPitch = (float) (-Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(deltaY, dist)));

        float radius = assistRadius.getValue();
        boolean isAimed = RaytraceUtil2.rayTrace(getAuraRotationVec(), 6, target.getBoundingBox().expand(radius, radius, radius));

        float speed;
        if (isAimed) speed = assistSpeedAimed.getValue() * 0.25f;
        else if (mc.player.isOnGround()) speed = assistSpeedGround.getValue() * 0.25f;
        else speed = assistSpeedAir.getValue() * 0.25f;

        float cooldownMultiplier = (mc.player.getAttackCooldownProgress(0.5f) > 0.85f) ? 1.2f : 0.4f;
        speed *= cooldownMultiplier;

        if (!RaytraceUtil2.rayTrace(getAuraRotationVec(), 6, target.getBoundingBox().expand(radius + 0.1f, radius + 0.1f, radius + 0.1f))) {
            speedAcceleration += 0.0005f * cooldownMultiplier;
        } else if (speedAcceleration >= -0.01f) {
            speedAcceleration -= 0.0004f;
        }

        float smooth = Math.max(speedAcceleration, 0);
        speed += smooth + (float) ((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02);

        float yawDelta = MathHelper.wrapDegrees(targetYaw - lastYaw);
        float pitchDelta = targetPitch - lastPitch;

        float clampedYaw = MathHelper.clamp(yawDelta, -speed, speed);
        float clampedPitch = MathHelper.clamp(pitchDelta, -speed, speed);

        float newYaw = lastYaw + clampedYaw;
        float newPitch = MathHelper.clamp(lastPitch + clampedPitch, -89.9f, 89.9f);

        float gcd = (float) MathUtils.computeGcd();
        if (gcd > 0.0f) {
            newYaw = lastYaw + (float) Math.round((newYaw - lastYaw) / gcd) * gcd;
            newPitch = lastPitch + (float) Math.round((newPitch - lastPitch) / gcd) * gcd;
        }

        applyRotationSmooth(new Angle(newYaw, newPitch));
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

import net.minecraft.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.entity.decoration.EndCrystalEntity;
import net.minecraft.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.util.Hand;
import net.minecraft.util.hit.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.util.hit.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Box;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.TickEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.BooleanSetting;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SliderSettings;
import rasty.util.Instance;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public class AutoCrystal extends ModuleStructure {

    public static AutoCrystal getInstance() {
        return Instance.get(AutoCrystal.class);
    }

    private final BooleanSetting autoBreak = new BooleanSetting("Р’Р·СЂС‹РІ", "РђРІС‚РѕРјР°С‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРё РІР·СЂС‹РІР°С‚СЊ РєСЂРёСЃС‚Р°Р»Р»С‹")
            .setValue(true);

    private final SliderSettings range = new SliderSettings("Range", "Р”Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРёСЏ")
            .range(1.0f, 6.0f)
            .setValue(4.0f);

    private final SliderSettings breakDelay = new SliderSettings("Break Delay", "Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° РІР·СЂС‹РІР° (С‚РёРєРё)")
            .range(0f, 20f)
            .setValue(0f);

    private float rotationYaw;
    private float rotationPitch;
    private boolean rotating = false;
    private int breakTimer = 0;

    private final Set<BlockPos> placedOn = new HashSet<>();

    private boolean wasHoldingObsidian = false;
    private BlockPos watchedPos = null;

    public AutoCrystal() {
        super("AutoCrystal", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(autoBreak, range, breakDelay);
    }

    @Override
    public void activate() {
        placedOn.clear();
        rotating = false;
        breakTimer = 0;
        wasHoldingObsidian = false;
        watchedPos = null;
        rotationYaw = mc.player != null ? mc.player.getYaw() : 0f;
        rotationPitch = mc.player != null ? mc.player.getPitch() : 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        placedOn.clear();
        rotating = false;
        breakTimer = 0;
        wasHoldingObsidian = false;
        watchedPos = null;
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        if (autoBreak.isValue()) {
            EndCrystalEntity crystal = findAnyCrystal();
            if (crystal != null) {
                calcGrimRotations(crystal.getBoundingBox().getCenter());
                if (rotating) {
                    mc.player.setYaw(rotationYaw);
                    mc.player.setPitch(rotationPitch);
                }
                if (breakTimer >= breakDelay.getValue()) {
                    mc.interactionManager.attackEntity(mc.player, crystal);
                    mc.player.swingHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);
                    breakTimer = 0;
                } else {
                    breakTimer++;
                }
            }
        }

        boolean holdingObsidian = mc.player.getMainHandStack().isOf(Items.OBSIDIAN)
                || mc.player.getOffHandStack().isOf(Items.OBSIDIAN);

        if (holdingObsidian) {
            if (mc.crosshairTarget != null && mc.crosshairTarget.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
                BlockHitResult blockHit = (BlockHitResult) mc.crosshairTarget;
                watchedPos = blockHit.getBlockPos().offset(blockHit.getSide());
            }
        }

        if (wasHoldingObsidian && !holdingObsidian) {
            wasHoldingObsidian = false;
        }

        if (holdingObsidian && !wasHoldingObsidian) {
            wasHoldingObsidian = true;
        }

        if (watchedPos != null
                && mc.world.getBlockState(watchedPos).isOf(Blocks.OBSIDIAN)
                && !placedOn.contains(watchedPos)
                && canPlaceCrystal(watchedPos)) {

            Vec3d playerVec = new Vec3d(mc.player.getX(), mc.player.getY(), mc.player.getZ());
            if (playerVec.distanceTo(watchedPos.toCenterPos()) <= range.getValue()) {

                int prevSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();

                if (!hasCrystalInHand()) switchToCrystal();

                if (hasCrystalInHand()) {
                    Vec3d placeVec = watchedPos.toCenterPos().add(0, 1, 0);
                    calcGrimRotations(placeVec);
                    if (rotating) {
                        mc.player.setYaw(rotationYaw);
                        mc.player.setPitch(rotationPitch);
                    }

                    placeCrystal(watchedPos);
                    placedOn.add(watchedPos);
                    mc.player.getInventory().setSelectedSlot(prevSlot);
                }

                watchedPos = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private EndCrystalEntity findAnyCrystal() {
        EndCrystalEntity best = null;
        double closest = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (!(entity instanceof EndCrystalEntity crystal)) continue;
            if (!crystal.isAlive()) continue;
            double dist = mc.player.distanceTo(crystal);
            if (dist > range.getValue()) continue;
            if (dist < closest) {
                closest = dist;
                best = crystal;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private boolean canPlaceCrystal(BlockPos pos) {
        if (!mc.world.getBlockState(pos.up()).isAir()) return false;
        if (!mc.world.getBlockState(pos.up(2)).isAir()) return false;
        Box box = new Box(pos.up()).expand(0, 1, 0);
        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getOtherEntities(null, box)) {
            if (entity instanceof EndCrystalEntity) continue;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private void placeCrystal(BlockPos pos) {
        boolean offhand = mc.player.getOffHandStack().isOf(Items.END_CRYSTAL);
        boolean mainhand = mc.player.getMainHandStack().isOf(Items.END_CRYSTAL);
        if (!offhand && !mainhand) return;
        Hand hand = offhand ? Hand.OFF_HAND : Hand.MAIN_HAND;
        Vec3d hitVec = new Vec3d(pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 1.0, pos.getZ() + 0.5);
        BlockHitResult hitResult = new BlockHitResult(hitVec, Direction.UP, pos, false);
        mc.interactionManager.interactBlock(mc.player, hand, hitResult);
        mc.player.swingHand(hand);
    }

    private boolean hasCrystalInHand() {
        return mc.player.getOffHandStack().isOf(Items.END_CRYSTAL)
                || mc.player.getMainHandStack().isOf(Items.END_CRYSTAL);
    }

    private void switchToCrystal() {
        if (mc.player.getOffHandStack().isOf(Items.END_CRYSTAL)) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            if (mc.player.getInventory().getStack(i).isOf(Items.END_CRYSTAL)) {
                mc.player.getInventory().setSelectedSlot(i);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private void calcGrimRotations(Vec3d vec) {
        float yawDelta = MathHelper.wrapDegrees(
                (float) MathHelper.wrapDegrees(
                        Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(
                                vec.z - mc.player.getZ(),
                                vec.x - mc.player.getX()
                        )) - 90
                ) - rotationYaw
        );

        float pitchDelta = (float) (
                -Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(
                        vec.y - (mc.player.getY() + mc.player.getEyeHeight(mc.player.getPose())),
                        Math.sqrt(
                                Math.pow(vec.x - mc.player.getX(), 2) +
                                        Math.pow(vec.z - mc.player.getZ(), 2)
                        )
                ))
        ) - rotationPitch;

        float angleToRad = (float) Math.toRadians(27 * (mc.player.age % 30));
        yawDelta = (float) (yawDelta + Math.sin(angleToRad) * 3) + randomFloat(-1f, 1f);
        pitchDelta = pitchDelta + randomFloat(-0.6f, 0.6f);

        if (yawDelta > 180) yawDelta = yawDelta - 180;

        float clampedYawDelta = MathHelper.clamp(Math.abs(yawDelta), -180f, 180f);
        float clampedPitchDelta = MathHelper.clamp(pitchDelta, -45, 45);

        float newYaw = rotationYaw + (yawDelta > 0 ? clampedYawDelta : -clampedYawDelta);
        float newPitch = MathHelper.clamp(rotationPitch + clampedPitchDelta, -90.0F, 90.0F);

        double gcdFix = Math.pow(mc.options.getMouseSensitivity().getValue() * 0.6 + 0.2, 3.0) * 1.2;
        rotationYaw = (float) (newYaw - (newYaw - rotationYaw) % gcdFix);
        rotationPitch = (float) (newPitch - (newPitch - rotationPitch) % gcdFix);

        rotating = true;
    }

    private float randomFloat(float min, float max) {
        return min + (float) Math.random() * (max - min);
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

import antidaunleak.api.annotation.Native;
import lombok.AccessLevel;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.experimental.FieldDefaults;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.item.Items;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.TickEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.BooleanSetting;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SliderSettings;

@Getter
@FieldDefaults(level = AccessLevel.PRIVATE)
public class AutoGApple extends ModuleStructure {

    final SliderSettings healthThreshold = new SliderSettings("Р—РґРѕСЂРѕРІСЊРµ", "РџРѕСЂРѕРі Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІСЊСЏ РґР»СЏ РµРґС‹")
            .range(3.0f, 20.0f).setValue(16.0f);

    final BooleanSetting smartMode = new BooleanSetting("РЈРјРЅС‹Р№", "Р•СЃС‚СЊ РёР· С…РѕС‚Р±Р°СЂР°, РёРЅР°С‡Рµ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЃ Р»РµРІРѕР№ СЂСѓРєРё")
            .setValue(true);

    final BooleanSetting goldenHearts = new BooleanSetting("Р—РѕР»РѕС‚С‹Рµ СЃРµСЂРґС†Р°", "РЈС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°С‚СЊ absorption")
            .setValue(true);

    final BooleanSetting returnSlot = new BooleanSetting("Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°С‚СЊ СЃР»РѕС‚", "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°С‚СЊ РїСЂРµРґС‹РґСѓС‰РёР№ СЃР»РѕС‚ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РµРґС‹")
            .setValue(true);

    boolean isEating = false;
    int previousSlot = -1;

    public AutoGApple() {
        super("AutoGApple", "Auto GApple", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(healthThreshold, smartMode, goldenHearts, returnSlot);
    }

    @Override
    public void activate() {
        isEating = false;
        previousSlot = -1;
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        stopEating();
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        handleEating();
    }

    private void handleEating() {
        if (canEat()) {
            if (smartMode.isValue()) {
                if (!hasGappleInHand()) {
                    swapToGappleSlot();
                }
                startEating();
            } else {
                if (hasGappleInOffhand()) {
                    startEating();
                }
            }
        } else if (isEating && !shouldContinueEating()) {
            stopEating();
        }
    }

    private boolean hasGappleInHand() {
        ItemStack mainHand = mc.player.getMainHandStack();
        return mainHand.getItem() == Items.GOLDEN_APPLE;
    }

    private boolean canEat() {
        if (mc.player.isDead()) return false;
        if (mc.player.getItemCooldownManager().isCoolingDown(Items.GOLDEN_APPLE.getDefaultStack())) return false;

        if (smartMode.isValue()) {
            if (!hasGapple()) return false;
        } else {
            if (!hasGappleInOffhand()) return false;
        }

        float health = getEffectiveHealth();
        return health <= healthThreshold.getValue();
    }

    private boolean shouldContinueEating() {
        if (mc.player.isDead()) return false;
        if (!mc.player.isUsingItem()) return false;

        ItemStack usingItem = mc.player.getActiveItem();
        return usingItem.getItem() == Items.GOLDEN_APPLE;
    }

    private float getEffectiveHealth() {
        float health = mc.player.getHealth();
        if (goldenHearts.isValue()) {
            health += mc.player.getAbsorptionAmount();
        }
        return health;
    }

    private boolean hasGappleInOffhand() {
        ItemStack offhandStack = mc.player.getOffHandStack();
        return offhandStack.getItem() == Items.GOLDEN_APPLE;
    }

    private boolean hasGappleInHotbar() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            ItemStack stack = mc.player.getInventory().getStack(i);
            if (stack.getItem() == Items.GOLDEN_APPLE) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean hasGapple() {
        return hasGappleInOffhand() || hasGappleInHotbar();
    }

    private int findGappleInHotbar() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            ItemStack stack = mc.player.getInventory().getStack(i);
            if (stack.getItem() == Items.GOLDEN_APPLE) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void swapToGappleSlot() {
        int gappleSlot = findGappleInHotbar();
        if (gappleSlot == -1) return;

        int currentSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();

        if (currentSlot != gappleSlot) {
            if (previousSlot == -1 && returnSlot.isValue()) {
                previousSlot = currentSlot;
            }
            mc.player.getInventory().setSelectedSlot(gappleSlot);
        }
    }

    private void startEating() {
        if (!isEating && !mc.options.useKey.isPressed()) {
            mc.options.useKey.setPressed(true);
            isEating = true;
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void stopEating() {
        if (isEating) {
            mc.options.useKey.setPressed(false);
            isEating = false;

            if (previousSlot != -1 && returnSlot.isValue()) {
                mc.player.getInventory().setSelectedSlot(previousSlot);
                previousSlot = -1;
            }
        }
    }
}

            .value("Totem of Undying", "Player Head", "Golden Apple", "Shield")

    final BindSetting swapBind = new BindSetting("РљРЅРѕРїРєР° СЃРІР°РїР°", "РљРЅРѕРїРєР° РґР»СЏ РѕР±РјРµРЅР° РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚РѕРІ");

    final BooleanSetting swapRender = new BooleanSetting("РџРѕРєР°Р· СЃРІР°РїР°", "РЈРІРµРґРѕРјР»РµРЅРёРµ РїСЂРё СЃРІР°РїРµ")

    private boolean bypassActive   = false;

            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(handler.syncId, syncSlot, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);
            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(handler.syncId, 45,       0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);
            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(handler.syncId, syncSlot, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);


            if (wasSprinting) {
                mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(
                        new ClientCommandC2SPacket(mc.player, ClientCommandC2SPacket.Mode.START_SPRINTING)
                );
            }

            if (swapRender.isValue()) {
                ChatMessage.brandmessage("AutoSwap в†’ " + bypassItemName);
            }

            bypassSwapped = true;
            swapTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }


        if (bypassSwapped && System.currentTimeMillis() - swapTime >= 35L) {
            resetBypass();
        }
    }


    @EventHandler
    public void onKey(KeyEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;
        if (mc.currentScreen != null) return;
        if (!e.isKeyDown(swapBind.getKey())) return;
        if (bypassActive) return;


        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - lastKeyTime < 300L) return;
        lastKeyTime = now;

        triggerSwap();
    }


    @EventHandler
    public void onInput(InputEvent e) {

    }


    private void triggerSwap() {
        Item offHandItem = mc.player.getOffHandStack().getItem();
        Item first  = getItemByType(firstItem.getSelected());
        Item second = getItemByType(secondItem.getSelected());

        int slot = -1;
        String name = "";

        if (offHandItem == first) {

            slot = findBestSlot(second);
            name = secondItem.getSelected();
        } else if (offHandItem == second) {

            slot = findBestSlot(first);
            name = firstItem.getSelected();
        } else {

            slot = findBestSlot(first);
            name = firstItem.getSelected();
            if (slot == -1) {
                slot = findBestSlot(second);
                name = secondItem.getSelected();
            }
        }

        if (slot == -1) {
            if (swapRender.isValue()) {
                ChatMessage.brandmessage("AutoSwap в†’ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ!");
            }
            return;
        }


        bypassActive   = true;
        bypassSwapped  = false;
        bypassSlot     = slot;
        bypassItemName = name;
    }


    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private int findBestSlot(Item item) {
        if (item == null || item == Items.AIR) return -1;

        boolean needEnch = (item == Items.TOTEM_OF_UNDYING) && onlyEnchanted.isValue();

        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
            int from = (pass == 0) ? 0  : 9;
            int to   = (pass == 0) ? 8  : 35;

            int bestSlot       = -1;
            boolean bestEnch   = false;

            for (int i = from; i <= to; i++) {
                var stack = mc.player.getInventory().getStack(i);
                if (stack.isEmpty()) continue;
                if (stack.getItem() != item) continue;
                if (needEnch && !stack.hasEnchantments()) continue;

                boolean hasEnch = stack.hasEnchantments();

                if (bestSlot == -1 || (!bestEnch && hasEnch)) {
                    bestSlot = i;
                    bestEnch = hasEnch;
                }
            }

            if (bestSlot != -1) return bestSlot;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private void resetBypass() {
        bypassActive   = false;
        bypassSwapped  = false;
        bypassSlot     = -1;
        bypassItemName = "";
    }

    private Item getItemByType(String type) {
        return switch (type) {
            case "Totem of Undying" -> Items.TOTEM_OF_UNDYING;
            case "Player Head"      -> Items.PLAYER_HEAD;
            case "Golden Apple"     -> Items.GOLDEN_APPLE;
            case "Shield"           -> Items.SHIELD;
            default                 -> Items.AIR;
        };
    }


    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        resetBypass();
    }
}

    private float getEffectiveHealth() {
        float health = mc.player.getHealth();
        if (countAbsorption.isValue()) {
            health += mc.player.getAbsorptionAmount();
        }
        return health;
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public void onTick(TickEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        if (isEnhanced()) {
            tickEnhancedBypass();
            if (enhBypassActive) return;
        } else if (!isFKey()) {
            executor.tick();
            if (executor.isRunning()) return;
        }

        updateFallTracking();
        updatePlayerFallTracking();

        boolean needTotem = shouldEquipTotem();
        boolean hasTotemInOffhand = mc.player.getOffHandStack().getItem() == Items.TOTEM_OF_UNDYING;
        boolean hasEnchantedTotemInOffhand = hasTotemInOffhand && mc.player.getOffHandStack().hasEnchantments();

        float currentHealth = getEffectiveHealth();
        float threshold = healthThreshold.getValue();

        if (needTotem) {
            if (!hasTotemInOffhand) {
                equipTotem();
            } else if (options.isSelected("РЎРѕС…СЂР°РЅСЏС‚СЊ С‚Р°Р»РёСЃРјР°РЅС‹") && hasEnchantedTotemInOffhand) {
                Slot regularTotemSlot = findRegularTotemSlot();
                if (regularTotemSlot != null) {
                    swapToRegularTotem(regularTotemSlot);
                }
            }
        } else {
            dangerousFallingPlayer = null;
            dangerousElytraPlayer = null;

            if (savedSlotId != -1 && hasTotemInOffhand && options.isSelected("Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‚ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°") && currentHealth > threshold) {
                returnSavedItem();
            } else if (!hasTotemInOffhand) {
                savedSlotId = -1;
            }
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onInput(InputEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        if (isEnhanced() || isFKey()) return;

        if (noMovementStop.isValue()) return;
        if (executor.isBlocking()) {
            e.setDirectionalLow(false, false, false, false);
            e.setJumping(false);
            mc.player.setSprinting(false);
        }
    }

    private void startEnhancedBypass(int syncSlot) {
        if (enhBypassActive) return;
        enhBypassActive  = true;
        enhBypassSwapped = false;
        enhBypassSlot    = syncSlot;
    }

    private void tickEnhancedBypass() {
        if (!enhBypassActive) return;

        ScreenHandler handler = mc.player.playerScreenHandler;

        if (!enhBypassSwapped && enhBypassSlot != -1) {
            boolean wasSprinting = mc.player.isSprinting();
            if (wasSprinting) {
                mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(
                        new ClientCommandC2SPacket(mc.player, ClientCommandC2SPacket.Mode.STOP_SPRINTING)
                );
            }

            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(handler.syncId, enhBypassSlot, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);
            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(handler.syncId, 45,            0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);
            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(handler.syncId, enhBypassSlot, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);

            if (wasSprinting) {
                mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(
                        new ClientCommandC2SPacket(mc.player, ClientCommandC2SPacket.Mode.START_SPRINTING)
                );
            }

            enhBypassSwapped = true;
            enhSwapTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }

        if (enhBypassSwapped && System.currentTimeMillis() - enhSwapTime >= 35L) {
            resetEnhBypass();
        }
    }

    private void resetEnhBypass() {
        enhBypassActive  = false;
        enhBypassSwapped = false;
        enhBypassSlot    = -1;
    }

    private int toSyncSlot(int inventoryIndex) {
        return (inventoryIndex < 9) ? inventoryIndex + 36 : inventoryIndex;
    }

    private int findInventoryIndexForSlot(Slot slot) {
        int id = slot.id;
        if (id >= 36 && id <= 44) return id - 36;
        if (id >= 9  && id <= 35) return id;
        return -1;
    }

    private void updateFallTracking() {
        boolean isFalling = mc.player.getVelocity().y < -0.1
                && !mc.player.isOnGround()
                && !mc.player.isClimbing()
                && !mc.player.isTouchingWater()
                && !mc.player.isGliding();

        if (isFalling && !wasFalling) {
            fallStartY = (float) mc.player.getY();
        }

        if (mc.player.isOnGround() || mc.player.isTouchingWater() || mc.player.isClimbing()) {
            fallStartY = (float) mc.player.getY();
        }

        wasFalling = isFalling;
    }

    private void updatePlayerFallTracking() {
        if (mc.world == null) return;

        for (PlayerEntity player : mc.world.getPlayers()) {
            if (player == mc.player) continue;

            int id = player.getId();
            double currentY = player.getY();
            Double lastY = playerLastY.get(id);

            boolean isGoingDown = lastY != null && currentY < lastY - 0.01;
            boolean isOnGroundOrWater = player.isOnGround() || player.isTouchingWater() || player.isClimbing();

            if (isGoingDown && !isOnGroundOrWater && !player.isGliding()) {
                if (!playerFallStartY.containsKey(id)) {
                    playerFallStartY.put(id, lastY);
                }
            } else if (isOnGroundOrWater) {
                playerFallStartY.remove(id);
            }

            playerLastY.put(id, currentY);
        }

        playerLastY.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> {
            for (PlayerEntity player : mc.world.getPlayers()) {
                if (player.getId() == entry.getKey()) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        playerFallStartY.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> {
            for (PlayerEntity player : mc.world.getPlayers()) {
                if (player.getId() == entry.getKey()) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private boolean shouldEquipTotem() {
        float health = getEffectiveHealth();
        float threshold = healthThreshold.getValue();

        if (health <= threshold) return true;

        if (triggers.isSelected("Р­Р»РёС‚СЂР°") && mc.player.isGliding()) {
            if (health <= elytraHealth.getValue()) return true;
        }

        if (triggers.isSelected("РџР°РґРµРЅРёРµ")) {
            float fallDistance = fallStartY - (float) mc.player.getY();
            if (fallDistance >= fallHeight.getValue() && mc.player.getVelocity().y < -0.1) return true;
        }

        if (triggers.isSelected("РђРЅС‚Рё РІР°РЅС€РѕС‚") && checkOneshotDanger()) return true;
        if (triggers.isSelected("РљСЂРёСЃС‚Р°Р»Р»") && checkCrystalDanger()) return true;
        if (triggers.isSelected("Р”РёРЅР°РјРёС‚") && checkTntDanger()) return true;
        if (triggers.isSelected("Р’Р°РіРѕРЅРµС‚РєР°") && checkTntMinecartDanger()) return true;

        return false;
    }

    private boolean hasHeadInOffhand() {
        return mc.player.getOffHandStack().getItem() == Items.PLAYER_HEAD;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean checkCrystalDanger() {
        if (options.isSelected("РќРµ Р±СЂР°С‚СЊ РµСЃР»Рё С€Р°СЂ") && hasHeadInOffhand()) {
            if (getEffectiveHealth() > healthThreshold.getValue()) return false;
        }

        double distance = crystalDistance.getValue();
        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (entity instanceof EndCrystalEntity && mc.player.distanceTo(entity) <= distance) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private boolean checkOneshotDanger() {
        dangerousFallingPlayer = null;
        dangerousElytraPlayer = null;

        for (PlayerEntity player : mc.world.getPlayers()) {
            if (player == mc.player) continue;

            if (isFallingPlayerDangerous(player)) {
                dangerousFallingPlayer = player;
                return true;
            }

            if (checkElytraPlayer(player)) {
                dangerousElytraPlayer = player;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean isFallingPlayerDangerous(PlayerEntity player) {
        if (player == mc.player) return false;
        if (player.isGliding()) return false;

        Vec3d playerPos = mc.player.getEntityPos();
        double radius = 7;
        double height = 50;

        Box checkZone = new Box(
                playerPos.x - radius, playerPos.y, playerPos.z - radius,
                playerPos.x + radius, playerPos.y + height, playerPos.z + radius
        );

        if (!checkZone.intersects(player.getBoundingBox())) return false;
        if (player.getY() < mc.player.getY()) return false;

        Double fallStart = playerFallStartY.get(player.getId());
        if (fallStart == null) return false;

        return (fallStart - player.getY()) >= 3;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean checkElytraPlayer(PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!player.isGliding()) return false;

        double distance = mc.player.distanceTo(player);
        if (distance > 20) return false;

        Vec3d velocity = player.getVelocity();
        double speed = velocity.length();
        if (speed < 0.8) return false;

        Vec3d toMe = new Vec3d(
                mc.player.getX() - player.getX(),
                mc.player.getY() - player.getY(),
                mc.player.getZ() - player.getZ()
        ).normalize();

        Vec3d velocityNorm = velocity.normalize();
        double dot = velocityNorm.x * toMe.x + velocityNorm.y * toMe.y + velocityNorm.z * toMe.z;

        if (dot > 0.25) {
            double timeToReach = distance / speed;
            if (timeToReach < 2.5) return true;

            double predictedX = player.getX() + velocity.x * timeToReach;
            double predictedY = player.getY() + velocity.y * timeToReach;
            double predictedZ = player.getZ() + velocity.z * timeToReach;

            double predictedDist = Math.sqrt(
                    Math.pow(predictedX - mc.player.getX(), 2) +
                            Math.pow(predictedY - mc.player.getY(), 2) +
                            Math.pow(predictedZ - mc.player.getZ(), 2)
            );

            return predictedDist < 6;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean checkTntDanger() {
        double distance = tntDistance.getValue();
        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (entity instanceof TntEntity && mc.player.distanceTo(entity) <= distance) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean checkTntMinecartDanger() {
        double distance = tntMinecartDistance.getValue();
        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (entity instanceof TntMinecartEntity && mc.player.distanceTo(entity) <= distance) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void swapSlots(int slot) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.interactionManager == null) return;
        int syncId = mc.player.playerScreenHandler.syncId;
        mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, slot, 40, SlotActionType.SWAP, mc.player);
    }

    private boolean isScreenOpen() {
        return mc.currentScreen != null && !(mc.currentScreen instanceof ChatScreen);
    }

    private SwapSettings buildSwapSettings() {
        if (noMovementStop.isValue()) return SwapSettings.instant();
        return swapMode.isSelected("Instant") ? SwapSettings.instantWithStop() : SwapSettings.legit();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void equipTotem() {
        Slot totemSlot = findTotemSlot();
        if (totemSlot == null) return;

        boolean hasItemInOffhand = !mc.player.getOffHandStack().isEmpty()
                && mc.player.getOffHandStack().getItem() != Items.TOTEM_OF_UNDYING;

        if (hasItemInOffhand && savedSlotId == -1) {
            savedSlotId = totemSlot.id;
        }

        if (isEnhanced()) {
            int inventoryIndex = findInventoryIndexForSlot(totemSlot);
            if (inventoryIndex != -1) {
                startEnhancedBypass(toSyncSlot(inventoryIndex));
            }
        } else if (isFKey()) {
            swapSlots(totemSlot.id);
        } else if (isScreenOpen()) {
            swapSlots(totemSlot.id);
        } else {
            final int slotId = totemSlot.id;
            executor.execute(() -> swapSlots(slotId), buildSwapSettings());
        }
    }

    private void swapToRegularTotem(Slot regularTotemSlot) {
        if (regularTotemSlot == null) return;

        if (isEnhanced()) {
            int inventoryIndex = findInventoryIndexForSlot(regularTotemSlot);
            if (inventoryIndex != -1) {
                startEnhancedBypass(toSyncSlot(inventoryIndex));
            }
        } else if (isFKey()) {
            swapSlots(regularTotemSlot.id);
        } else if (isScreenOpen()) {
            swapSlots(regularTotemSlot.id);
        } else {
            final int slotId = regularTotemSlot.id;
            executor.execute(() -> swapSlots(slotId), buildSwapSettings());
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void returnSavedItem() {
        if (savedSlotId == -1) return;

        if (isEnhanced()) {
            int inventoryIndex = (savedSlotId >= 36 && savedSlotId <= 44) ? savedSlotId - 36 : savedSlotId;
            startEnhancedBypass(toSyncSlot(inventoryIndex));
            savedSlotId = -1;
        } else if (isFKey()) {
            swapSlots(savedSlotId);
            savedSlotId = -1;
        } else if (isScreenOpen()) {
            swapSlots(savedSlotId);
            savedSlotId = -1;
        } else {
            final int slotId = savedSlotId;
            executor.execute(() -> {
                swapSlots(slotId);
                savedSlotId = -1;
            }, buildSwapSettings());
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private Slot findTotemSlot() {
        if (mc.player == null) return null;
        Slot regular = findRegularTotemSlot();
        return regular != null ? regular : findAnyTotemSlot();
    }

    private Slot findRegularTotemSlot() {
        if (mc.player == null) return null;

        for (int i = 36; i <= 44; i++) {
            Slot slot = mc.player.playerScreenHandler.getSlot(i);
            if (slot != null && isRegularTotem(slot.getStack())) return slot;
        }
        for (int i = 9; i <= 35; i++) {
            Slot slot = mc.player.playerScreenHandler.getSlot(i);
            if (slot != null && isRegularTotem(slot.getStack())) return slot;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private Slot findAnyTotemSlot() {
        if (mc.player == null) return null;

        for (int i = 36; i <= 44; i++) {
            Slot slot = mc.player.playerScreenHandler.getSlot(i);
            if (slot != null && isTotem(slot.getStack())) return slot;
        }
        for (int i = 9; i <= 35; i++) {
            Slot slot = mc.player.playerScreenHandler.getSlot(i);
            if (slot != null && isTotem(slot.getStack())) return slot;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private boolean isTotem(ItemStack stack) {
        return !stack.isEmpty() && stack.getItem() == Items.TOTEM_OF_UNDYING;
    }

    private boolean isRegularTotem(ItemStack stack) {
        if (!isTotem(stack)) return false;
        if (options.isSelected("РЎРѕС…СЂР°РЅСЏС‚СЊ С‚Р°Р»РёСЃРјР°РЅС‹")) return !stack.hasEnchantments();
        return true;
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

import antidaunleak.api.annotation.Native;
import lombok.AccessLevel;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.experimental.FieldDefaults;
import net.minecraft.item.BowItem;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.play.PlayerActionC2SPacket;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.play.PlayerInteractItemC2SPacket;
import net.minecraft.util.Hand;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.TickEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.BooleanSetting;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SliderSettings;

@Getter
@FieldDefaults(level = AccessLevel.PRIVATE)
public class BowSpammer extends ModuleStructure {

    final SliderSettings delay = new SliderSettings("Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР°", "Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° РјРµР¶РґСѓ РІС‹СЃС‚СЂРµР»Р°РјРё")
            .range(2.2f, 5.0f).setValue(2.5f);
    final BooleanSetting rw = new BooleanSetting("RW", "РЈСЃРєРѕСЂСЏРµС‚ РІС‹СЃС‚СЂРµР»С‹ РґР»СЏ ReallyWorld")
            .setValue(true);

    public BowSpammer() {
        super("BowSpammer", "Bow Spammer", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(delay, rw);
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public void onTick(TickEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;
        if (mc.getNetworkHandler() == null || mc.interactionManager == null) return;

        if (!canShoot()) return;

        if (rw.isValue()) {
            mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(new PlayerActionC2SPacket(
                    PlayerActionC2SPacket.Action.RELEASE_USE_ITEM,
                    BlockPos.ORIGIN,
                    Direction.DOWN
            ));
            mc.player.stopUsingItem();
            mc.interactionManager.interactItem(mc.player, Hand.MAIN_HAND);
        } else {
            sendShootPackets();
            mc.player.stopUsingItem();
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean canShoot() {
        if (!(mc.player.getMainHandStack().getItem() instanceof BowItem)) return false;
        if (!mc.player.isUsingItem()) return false;
        return mc.player.getItemUseTime() >= delay.getValue();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void sendShootPackets() {
        mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(new PlayerActionC2SPacket(
                PlayerActionC2SPacket.Action.RELEASE_USE_ITEM,
                BlockPos.ORIGIN,
                Direction.DOWN
        ));

        mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(new PlayerInteractItemC2SPacket(
                Hand.MAIN_HAND,
                0,
                mc.player.getYaw(),
                mc.player.getPitch()
        ));
    }
}
