    private final BooleanSetting onlyRotateInRange = new BooleanSetting("РќР°РІРѕРґРёС‚СЊСЃСЏ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РІ Р·РѕРЅРµ СѓРґР°СЂР°", "РќР°РІРѕРґРёС‚СЊСЃСЏ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РµСЃР»Рё С†РµР»СЊ РІ Р·РѕРЅРµ СѓРґР°СЂР°")
            .setValue(false);

    private final BooleanSetting showTarget = new BooleanSetting("РџРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°С‚СЊ С†РµР»СЊ (ESP)", "РџРѕРґСЃРІРµС‚РєР° С‚РµРєСѓС‰РµР№ С†РµР»Рё С‡РµСЂРµР· ESP")
            .setValue(false);

    @NonFinal public static LivingEntity target;
    @NonFinal public        LivingEntity lastTarget;

    private final TargetFinder targetSelector = new TargetFinder();
    private final MultiPoint   pointFinder    = new MultiPoint();
    private final SecureRandom random         = new SecureRandom();

    private long  shieldBreakCooldownMs = 0;
    private float fovCircleAlpha        = 0f;

    private Vec3d cachedAimOffset   = Vec3d.ZERO;
    private Vec3d cachedRandomPoint = null;
    private long  aimOffsetTimer    = 0;
    private long  randomPointTimer  = 0;

    private float resolveSign      = 1f;
    private long  resolveSignTimer = 0;

    private long nextAttackTime = 0;
    private long targetLostTime = 0;

    public CustomAura() {
        super("CustomAura", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(
                targetType, targetPriority, targetLock, targetMinHp, targetMaxHp,
                ignoreInvisible, ignoreBlocking,

                attackRange, attackRangeRandom, lookRange, extraRange, attackFov, acquireFov,

                aimMode, aimPreTicks, returnDelay, returnSpeed,

                rotationStyle, rotSpeedMin, rotSpeedMax, rotSpeedAttack,
                rotSpeedOnHitbox, maxYawPerTick, maxPitchPerTick,

                aimPoint, aimPointY, aimPointRandomness, aimPointSwitchInterval, aimPointWidth,

                humanize, jitterMode, jitterYawAmount, jitterPitchAmount, jitterPeriod,
                jitterLayer2, jitterLayer2Scale, jitterLayer2Period,
                resolveYaw, resolvePitch, resolveRandomSign,

                onlyCrits, smartCrits, jumpSync, lowCeilCrit, webCrit, critRandomChance,

                cooldownThreshold, cooldownRandomness, hitboxExpand,
                throughWallsMode, mxReach, reachSpoofDistance,
                noAttackWhileEating, noAttackInWater,
                minAttackInterval, maxAttackInterval,

                packetShieldBreak, shieldBreakCooldown, waitForShieldBreak,

                moveFix, resetSprintMode, autoSprint, autoSprintRange,

                syncTps,

                antiBot, ignorePingZero, ignoreNoArmor,

                noAttackOnElytra, noAttackOnVehicle, onlyWithWeapon, onlyRotateInRange,

                showTarget
        );
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        AngleConnection.INSTANCE.startReturning();
        Initialization.getInstance().getManager()
                .getAttackPerpetrator().getAttackHandler().resetPendingState();
        target         = null;
        lastTarget     = null;
        nextAttackTime = 0;
        fovCircleAlpha = 0f;
    }

    @EventHandler
    private void onTick(TickEvent event) {
        if (!isState() || mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        if (autoSprint.isValue() && target != null && target.isAlive()) {
            float dist = mc.player.distanceTo(target);
            if (dist <= autoSprintRange.getValue() && !mc.player.isSprinting()) {
                mc.player.setSprinting(true);
            }
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onRotationUpdate(RotationUpdateEvent e) {
        switch (e.getType()) {
            case EventType.PRE -> {
                LivingEntity prev = target;
                target = updateTarget();

                if (prev != null && target == null) {
                    targetLostTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    Initialization.getInstance().getManager()
                            .getAttackPerpetrator().getAttackHandler().resetPendingState();
                }

                if (target != null) {
                    if (noAttackOnElytra.isValue() && mc.player.isGliding()) return;
                    if (noAttackOnVehicle.isValue() && mc.player.hasVehicle()) return;
                    if (onlyWithWeapon.isValue() && !isHoldingWeapon()) return;
                    if (onlyRotateInRange.isValue() && mc.player.distanceTo(target) > attackRange.getValue()) return;

                    StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable cfg = buildConfig();
                    if (shouldRotateThisTick(cfg)) {
                        rotateToTarget(cfg);
                        lastTarget = target;
                    }
                }
            }
            case EventType.POST -> {
                if (target != null) {
                    if (noAttackOnElytra.isValue() && mc.player.isGliding()) return;
                    if (noAttackOnVehicle.isValue() && mc.player.hasVehicle()) return;
                    if (onlyWithWeapon.isValue() && !isHoldingWeapon()) return;
                    if (noAttackInWater.isValue() && mc.player.isTouchingWater()) return;
                    if (waitForShieldBreak.isValue() && target.isBlocking()) return;

                    if (System.currentTimeMillis() < nextAttackTime) return;

                    if (throughWallsMode.isSelected("РЎРїСѓС„ РєРѕРїР°РЅРёСЏ")) {
                        performDigSpoof(buildConfig());
                    }

                    if (webCrit.isValue()) {
                        performWebCrit();
                    }

                    StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable cfg = buildConfig();

                    if (mxReach.isValue()) {
                        Vec3d originalPos = mc.player.getEntityPos();
                        performMXReach(cfg, originalPos);
                        Initialization.getInstance().getManager()
                                .getAttackPerpetrator().performAttack(cfg);
                        returnFromReach(originalPos);
                    } else {
                        Initialization.getInstance().getManager()
                                .getAttackPerpetrator().performAttack(cfg);
                    }

                    float minI = minAttackInterval.getValue();
                    float maxI = maxAttackInterval.getValue();
                    if (maxI > 0) {
                        long interval = (long)(minI + random.nextDouble() * (maxI - minI));
                        nextAttackTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + interval;
                    }

                    if (packetShieldBreak.isValue()
                            && target.isBlocking()
                            && System.currentTimeMillis() > shieldBreakCooldownMs) {
                        performPacketShieldBreak();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onRender(DrawEvent event) {
        float fov    = attackFov.getValue();
        float cx     = Render2D.getFixedScaledWidth()  / 2f;
        float cy     = Render2D.getFixedScaledHeight() / 2f;
        float a      = fovCircleAlpha;
        float radius = (fov / 360f) * 260f;

        Render2D.arc(cx, cy, radius + 2.5f, 2.5f, 360f, 0f,
                ColorUtil.applyAlpha(0xFFA03232, (int)(30 * a)));
        Render2D.arc(cx, cy, radius, 1.2f, 360f, 0f,
                ColorUtil.applyAlpha(0xFFD04545, (int)(200 * a)));
        Render2D.arc(cx, cy, radius - 0.5f, 0.4f, 360f, 0f,
                ColorUtil.applyAlpha(0xFFFF8080, (int)(70 * a)));
    }

    private boolean shouldRotateThisTick(StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable cfg) {
        StrikeManager ah = Initialization.getInstance().getManager()
                .getAttackPerpetrator().getAttackHandler();
        return switch (aimMode.getSelected()) {
            case "Р’СЃРµРіРґР°"              -> true;
            case "РЎРЅР°Рї"                -> ah.canAttack(cfg, 0);
            case "РўРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїРµСЂРµРґ СѓРґР°СЂРѕРј" -> ah.canAttack(cfg, (int) aimPreTicks.getValue());
            default                    -> true;
        };
    }

    private void rotateToTarget(StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable cfg) {
        AngleConnection ctrl = AngleConnection.INSTANCE;
        Angle.VecRotation rot = new Angle.VecRotation(cfg.getAngle(), cfg.getAngle().toVector());
        AngleConfig rc = buildAngleConfig();

        if (aimMode.isSelected("РЎРЅР°Рї")) {
            ctrl.clear();
            ctrl.rotateTo(rot, target, 0, rc, TaskPriority.HIGH_IMPORTANCE_1, this);
        } else {
            ctrl.rotateTo(rot, target, 1, rc, TaskPriority.HIGH_IMPORTANCE_1, this);
        }
    }

    public StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable buildConfig() {
        boolean ignoreWalls = !throughWallsMode.isSelected("РћС‚РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРѕ");

        float baseRange = attackRange.getValue()
                + (float)((random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2 * attackRangeRandom.getValue());

        if (mc.player.isGliding() && ElytraTarget.getInstance() != null
                && ElytraTarget.getInstance().isState()) {
            baseRange += ElytraTarget.getInstance().elytraFindRange.getValue();
        }

        Pair<Vec3d, Box> pointData = pointFinder.computeVector(
                target, baseRange,
                AngleConnection.INSTANCE.getRotation(),
                getSmoothMode().randomValue(),
                ignoreWalls);

        Vec3d computedPoint = applyAimPoint(pointData.getLeft());
        Box   hitbox        = pointData.getRight().expand(hitboxExpand.getValue());

        if (mc.player.isGliding() && target.isGliding()
                && ElytraTarget.getInstance() != null && ElytraTarget.getInstance().isState()) {
            Vec3d tv = target.getVelocity();
            float leadTicks = ElytraTarget.getInstance().elytraForward.getValue();
            if (tv.horizontalLength() > 0.35) {
                Vec3d pred = target.getEntityPos().add(tv.multiply(leadTicks));
                computedPoint = pred.add(0, target.getHeight() / 2, 0);
                hitbox = new Box(
                        pred.x - target.getWidth() / 2, pred.y,
                        pred.z - target.getWidth() / 2,
                        pred.x + target.getWidth() / 2,
                        pred.y + target.getHeight(),
                        pred.z + target.getWidth() / 2);
            }
        }

        Angle angle = MathAngle.fromVec3d(
                computedPoint.subtract(Objects.requireNonNull(mc.player).getEyePos()));

        return new CustomAttackConfig(
                target, angle, baseRange, ignoreWalls,
                shouldRequireCrit(), noAttackWhileEating.isValue(),
                hitbox, aimMode
        );
    }

    private boolean shouldRequireCrit() {
        if (!onlyCrits.isValue()) return false;
        float chance = critRandomChance.getValue() / 100f;
        return !(chance > 0 && random.nextFloat() < chance);
    }

    private Vec3d applyAimPoint(Vec3d basePoint) {
        if (target == null) return basePoint;
        Box box = target.getBoundingBox();
        Vec3d result;

        switch (aimPoint.getSelected()) {
            case "Р“РѕР»РѕРІР°" -> {
                result = Vector.hitbox(target, 1, 1.1f, 1, (float) aimPointWidth.getValue());
                result = new Vec3d(result.x, box.maxY - 0.1, result.z);
            }
            case "РќРѕРіРё" -> {
                result = Vector.hitbox(target, 1, 1.1f, 1, (float) aimPointWidth.getValue());
                result = new Vec3d(result.x, box.minY + 0.1, result.z);
            }
            case "РўРµР»Рѕ" -> {
                double ty = box.minY + box.getLengthY() * aimPointY.getValue();
                result = Vector.hitbox(target, 1, 1.1f, 1, (float) aimPointWidth.getValue());
                result = new Vec3d(result.x, ty, result.z);
            }
            case "РРЅС‚РµСЂРїРѕР»СЏС†РёСЏ" -> result = Vector.hitbox(target, 1, 1.1F, 1, 6);
            case "РЎР»СѓС‡Р°Р№РЅР°СЏ"    -> result = getRandomPoint(box);
            default             -> result = basePoint;
        }

        return addAimNoise(result);
    }

    private Vec3d getRandomPoint(Box box) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long interval = (long) aimPointSwitchInterval.getValue();

        if (cachedRandomPoint == null || now - randomPointTimer > interval) {
            double rx = MathHelper.clamp(random.nextGaussian() * 0.2, -0.45, 0.45);
            double ry = 0.05 + random.nextDouble() * 0.9;
            double rz = MathHelper.clamp(random.nextGaussian() * 0.2, -0.45, 0.45);
            cachedRandomPoint = new Vec3d(
                    box.getCenter().x + rx * box.getLengthX() / 2,
                    box.minY + ry * box.getLengthY(),
                    box.getCenter().z + rz * box.getLengthZ() / 2
            );
            randomPointTimer = now;
        }
        return cachedRandomPoint;
    }

    private Vec3d addAimNoise(Vec3d point) {
        if (aimPointRandomness.getValue() == 0f) return point;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - aimOffsetTimer > 200 + (long)(random.nextDouble() * 200)) {
            float r = aimPointRandomness.getValue();
            cachedAimOffset = new Vec3d(
                    (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2 * r,
                    (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2 * r,
                    (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2 * r
            );
            aimOffsetTimer = now;
        }
        return point.add(cachedAimOffset);
    }

    public RotateConstructor getSmoothMode() {
        if (mc.player.isGliding() && ElytraTarget.getInstance() != null
                && ElytraTarget.getInstance().isState())
            return new LinearConstructor();
        return switch (rotationStyle.getSelected()) {
            case "Snap"       -> new SnapAngle();
            case "Linear"     -> new LinearConstructor();
            case "Legit"      -> new LegitAngle();
            case "VonTime"    -> new FTAngle();
            case "SpookyTime" -> new SPAngle();
            default           -> new CustomRotation();
        };
    }

    public AngleConfig buildAngleConfig() {
        return new AngleConfig(getSmoothMode(),
                !moveFix.isSelected("РћС‚РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅР°"),
                moveFix.isSelected("РЎРІРѕР±РѕРґРЅР°СЏ"));
    }

    private LivingEntity updateTarget() {
        float fov   = target == null ? acquireFov.getValue() : attackFov.getValue();
        float range = attackRange.getValue() + 0.25F + lookRange.getValue() + extraRange.getValue();

        if (mc.player.isGliding() && ElytraTarget.getInstance() != null
                && ElytraTarget.getInstance().isState()) {
            range += ElytraTarget.getInstance().elytraFindRange.getValue();
        }

        boolean ignoreWalls = !throughWallsMode.isSelected("РћС‚РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРѕ");

        targetSelector.searchTargets(mc.world.getEntities(), range, fov, ignoreWalls);
        targetSelector.validateTarget(this::isValidTarget);

        LivingEntity found = targetSelector.getCurrentTarget();
        if (found == null) return null;

        return switch (targetPriority.getSelected()) {
            case "РќР°РёРјРµРЅСЊС€РµРµ HP", "РќР°РёР±РѕР»СЊС€РµРµ HP" -> findByHp();
            case "РЎР»СѓС‡Р°Р№РЅС‹Р№"  -> findRandom(range, fov);
            default           -> found;
        };
    }

    private boolean isValidTarget(LivingEntity e) {
        if (e == mc.player) return false;
        if (!e.isAlive() || e.getHealth() <= 0) return false;

        float hp = e.getHealth();
        if (hp < targetMinHp.getValue()) return false;
        if (hp > targetMaxHp.getValue()) return false;

        if (ignoreInvisible.isValue() && e.isInvisible()) return false;
        if (ignoreBlocking.isValue() && e.isBlocking()) return false;

        if (antiBot.isValue()) {
            if (e instanceof net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity player) {
                if (ignorePingZero.isValue()) {
                    var entry = mc.getNetworkHandler() != null
                            ? mc.getNetworkHandler().getPlayerListEntry(player.getUuid())
                            : null;
                    if (entry != null && entry.getLatency() == 0) return false;
                }
                if (ignoreNoArmor.isValue()) {
                    boolean hasArmor =
                            !player.getEquippedStack(net.minecraft.entity.EquipmentSlot.HEAD).isEmpty() ||
                                    !player.getEquippedStack(net.minecraft.entity.EquipmentSlot.CHEST).isEmpty() ||
                                    !player.getEquippedStack(net.minecraft.entity.EquipmentSlot.LEGS).isEmpty() ||
                                    !player.getEquippedStack(net.minecraft.entity.EquipmentSlot.FEET).isEmpty();
                    if (!hasArmor) return false;
                }
                if (AntiBot.getInstance().isBot(player)) return false;
            }
        }

        TargetFinder.EntityFilter filter = new TargetFinder.EntityFilter(targetType.getSelected());
        return filter.isValid(e);
    }

    private LivingEntity findByHp() {
        float range = attackRange.getValue() + 0.25F + lookRange.getValue() + extraRange.getValue();
        LivingEntity best = null;
        float bestHp = targetPriority.isSelected("РќР°РёРјРµРЅСЊС€РµРµ HP") ? Float.MAX_VALUE : -Float.MAX_VALUE;

        for (var entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (!(entity instanceof LivingEntity le)) continue;
            if (!isValidTarget(le)) continue;
            if (le.distanceTo(mc.player) > range) continue;
            float hp = le.getHealth();
            boolean better = targetPriority.isSelected("РќР°РёРјРµРЅСЊС€РµРµ HP") ? hp < bestHp : hp > bestHp;
            if (better) { bestHp = hp; best = le; }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private LivingEntity findRandom(float range, float fov) {
        List<LivingEntity> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
        for (var entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (!(entity instanceof LivingEntity le)) continue;
            if (!isValidTarget(le)) continue;
            if (le.distanceTo(mc.player) > range) continue;
            candidates.add(le);
        }
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return null;
        return candidates.get(random.nextInt(candidates.size()));
    }

    private boolean isHoldingWeapon() {
        if (mc.player == null) return false;
        var stack = mc.player.getMainHandStack();
        if (stack.isEmpty()) return false;
        String key = stack.getItem().getTranslationKey().toLowerCase();
        return key.contains("sword") || key.contains("axe") || key.contains("trident") || key.contains("mace");
    }

    public long getAdjustedTpsCooldown(long baseCooldown) {
        if (!syncTps.isValue()) return baseCooldown;

        TPSCalculate tpsCalc = TPSCalculate.getInstance();
        if (tpsCalc == null) return baseCooldown;

        float currentTps = MathHelper.clamp(tpsCalc.getTPS(), 0.1f, 20.0f);
        if (currentTps >= 20.0f) return baseCooldown;

        float multiplier       = 20.0f / currentTps;
        float additionalFactor = 1.0f + (20.0f - currentTps) * 0.05f;
        long adjusted          = (long)(baseCooldown * multiplier * additionalFactor);

        return Math.min(adjusted, 3000L);
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onInput(InputEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;
        if (event.getInput() == null) return;
        if (!isState()) return;
        if (target == null || !target.isAlive()) return;

        boolean w = mc.options.forwardKey.isPressed();
        boolean s = mc.options.backKey.isPressed();
        boolean a = mc.options.leftKey.isPressed();
        boolean d = mc.options.rightKey.isPressed();

        if (moveFix.isSelected("РўР°СЂРіРµС‚")) {
            Vec3d dir = new Vec3d(target.getX() - mc.player.getX(), 0,
                    target.getZ() - mc.player.getZ()).normalize();
            applyDirectional(event, dir);
            return;
        }

        if (moveFix.isSelected("РџСЂРµСЃР»РµРґРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ")) {
            if (!w && !s && !a && !d) return;
            Vec3d playerPos = mc.player.getEntityPos();
            Vec3d center    = target.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
            double rad      = Math.toRadians(target.getYaw());
            Vec3d fwdDir    = new Vec3d(-Math.sin(rad), 0, Math.cos(rad)).normalize();
            Vec3d rgtDir    = new Vec3d(-fwdDir.z, 0, fwdDir.x).normalize();
            Vec3d off = Vec3d.ZERO;
            if (w) off = off.add(fwdDir);
            if (s) off = off.add(fwdDir.multiply(-1.0));
            if (a) off = off.add(rgtDir.multiply(-1.0));
            if (d) off = off.add(rgtDir);
            Vec3d mt = off.lengthSquared() > 0
                    ? center.add(off.normalize().multiply(target.getWidth() / 2.0 + 0.1))
                    : center;
            applyDirectional(event, new Vec3d(mt.x - mc.player.getX(), 0, mt.z - mc.player.getZ()).normalize());
        }
    }

    private void applyDirectional(InputEvent event, Vec3d dir) {
        float yaw  = AngleConnection.INSTANCE.getRotation().getYaw();
        float ma   = (float) Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(dir.z, dir.x)) - 90F;
        float diff = MathHelper.wrapDegrees(ma - yaw);
        boolean fwd = false, bck = false, lft = false, rgt = false;
        if      (diff >= -22.5  && diff < 22.5)  { fwd = true; }
        else if (diff >= 22.5   && diff < 67.5)  { fwd = true; rgt = true; }
        else if (diff >= 67.5   && diff < 112.5) { rgt = true; }
        else if (diff >= 112.5  && diff < 157.5) { bck = true; rgt = true; }
        else if (diff >= -67.5  && diff < -22.5) { fwd = true; lft = true; }
        else if (diff >= -112.5 && diff < -67.5) { lft = true; }
        else if (diff >= -157.5 && diff < -112.5){ bck = true; lft = true; }
        else { bck = true; }
        event.setDirectionalLow(fwd, bck, lft, rgt);
    }

    private void performPacketShieldBreak() {
        if (mc.player == null || target == null) return;
        int prevSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();
        int axeSlot  = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            if (mc.player.getInventory().getStack(i).getItem() instanceof AxeItem) {
                axeSlot = i; break;
            }
        }
        if (axeSlot == -1 || axeSlot == prevSlot) return;
        mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket(axeSlot));
        mc.interactionManager.attackEntity(mc.player, target);
        mc.player.swingHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);
        mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket(prevSlot));
        shieldBreakCooldownMs = System.currentTimeMillis() + (long) shieldBreakCooldown.getValue();
        if (Notifications.getInstance() != null)
            Notifications.getInstance().notifyAttackPerformed();
    }

    private void performMXReach(StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable config, Vec3d originalPos) {
        Vec3d targetPos = config.getTarget().getEntityPos();
        Vec3d direction = targetPos.subtract(originalPos).normalize();

        float spoofDist = reachSpoofDistance.getValue();
        spoofDist += (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.2f;

        Vec3d spoofPos = targetPos.subtract(direction.multiply(spoofDist));

        double randX = (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.015;
        double randZ = (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.015;
        spoofPos = spoofPos.add(randX, 0, randZ);

        mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.Full(
                spoofPos.x, spoofPos.y, spoofPos.z,
                mc.player.getYaw(), mc.player.getPitch(),
                mc.player.isOnGround(), mc.player.horizontalCollision
        ));
    }

    private void returnFromReach(Vec3d originalPos) {
        double randX = (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.01;
        double randZ = (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.01;
        Vec3d returnPos = originalPos.add(randX, 0, randZ);

        mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.Full(
                returnPos.x, returnPos.y, returnPos.z,
                mc.player.getYaw(), mc.player.getPitch(),
                mc.player.isOnGround(), mc.player.horizontalCollision
        ));
    }

    private void performWebCrit() {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;
        if (mc.player.isOnGround()) return;
        if (mc.player.getVelocity().y >= 0) return;
        if (mc.world.getBlockState(mc.player.getBlockPos()).getBlock() != Blocks.COBWEB) return;

        double x     = mc.player.getX();
        double y     = mc.player.getY();
        double z     = mc.player.getZ();
        float  yaw   = mc.player.getYaw();
        float  pitch = mc.player.getPitch();
        boolean onGround            = mc.player.isOnGround();
        boolean horizontalCollision = mc.player.horizontalCollision;

        mc.player.fallDistance = 0.08f;

        mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.Full(
                x, y + 0.035, z, yaw, pitch, false, horizontalCollision));
        mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.Full(
                x, y, z, yaw, pitch, false, horizontalCollision));
        mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.Full(
                x, y + 0.011, z, yaw, pitch, false, horizontalCollision));
        mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.Full(
                x, y, z, yaw, pitch, onGround, horizontalCollision));
    }

    private void performDigSpoof(StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable config) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null || config.getTarget() == null) return;

        Vec3d eyePos    = mc.player.getEyePos();
        Vec3d targetPos = config.getTarget().getEyePos();
        Vec3d direction = targetPos.subtract(eyePos).normalize();

        double stepSize = 0.5;
        int maxSteps    = (int)(config.getMaximumRange() / stepSize) + 1;
        Vec3d current   = eyePos;

        for (int i = 0; i < maxSteps; i++) {
            current = current.add(direction.multiply(stepSize));
            BlockPos blockPos = BlockPos.ofFloored(current);

            if (mc.world.getBlockState(blockPos).isAir()) continue;

            Direction face = getBlockFaceTowards(eyePos, blockPos);

            mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerActionC2SPacket(
                    PlayerActionC2SPacket.Action.START_DESTROY_BLOCK,
                    blockPos, face, mc.player.age
            ));
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerActionC2SPacket(
                    PlayerActionC2SPacket.Action.ABORT_DESTROY_BLOCK,
                    blockPos, face, mc.player.age
            ));
            break;
        }
    }

    private Direction getBlockFaceTowards(Vec3d from, BlockPos blockPos) {
        double bx  = blockPos.getX() + 0.5;
        double by  = blockPos.getY() + 0.5;
        double bz  = blockPos.getZ() + 0.5;
        double dx  = from.x - bx;
        double dy  = from.y - by;
        double dz  = from.z - bz;
        double adx = Math.abs(dx);
        double ady = Math.abs(dy);
        double adz = Math.abs(dz);

        if (adx >= ady && adx >= adz)
            return dx > 0 ? Direction.EAST  : Direction.WEST;
        else if (ady >= adx && ady >= adz)
            return dy > 0 ? Direction.UP    : Direction.DOWN;
        else
            return dz > 0 ? Direction.SOUTH : Direction.NORTH;
    }

    public class CustomRotation extends RotateConstructor {
        private final SecureRandom rng = new SecureRandom();

        public CustomRotation() { super("Custom"); }

        @Override
        public Angle limitAngleChange(Angle currentAngle, Angle targetAngle,
                                      Vec3d vec3d, net.minecraft.entity.Entity entity) {
            StrikeManager ah = Initialization.getInstance().getManager()
                    .getAttackPerpetrator().getAttackHandler();
            boolean canAttack = entity != null && ah.canAttack(buildConfig(), 0);

            if (entity != null && canAttack) {
                targetAngle = MathAngle.calculateAngle(
                        Vector.hitbox(entity, 1, entity.isOnGround() ? 0.9F : 1.4F, 1, 2));
            }

            Angle delta = MathAngle.calculateDelta(currentAngle, targetAngle);
            float yawDelta   = delta.getYaw();
            float pitchDelta = delta.getPitch();
            float rotDiff    = (float) Math.hypot(Math.abs(yawDelta), Math.abs(pitchDelta));
            if (rotDiff == 0f) return new Angle(currentAngle.getYaw(), currentAngle.getPitch());

            boolean onHitbox = entity != null && !canAttack
                    && RaycastAngle.rayTrace(AngleConnection.INSTANCE.getRotation().toVector(),
                    4.0, entity.getBoundingBox());

            float speedMin    = rotSpeedMin.getValue();
            float speedMax    = rotSpeedMax.getValue();
            float speedAtk    = rotSpeedAttack.getValue();
            float speedHitbox = rotSpeedOnHitbox.getValue();

            float postSpeed = onHitbox ? speedHitbox : lerp(rng.nextFloat(), speedMin, speedMax);
            float speed = canAttack ? speedAtk : postSpeed;

            float lineYaw   = Math.abs(yawDelta / rotDiff) * 360f;
            float linePitch = Math.abs(pitchDelta / rotDiff) * 180f;

            lineYaw   = Math.min(lineYaw,   maxYawPerTick.getValue());
            linePitch = Math.min(linePitch, maxPitchPerTick.getValue());

            float jitY = 0, jitP = 0;
            if (humanize.isValue() && !canAttack) {
                boolean doJitter = switch (jitterMode.getSelected()) {
                    case "Р’СЃРµРіРґР°"       -> true;
                    case "РџСЂРё РґРІРёР¶РµРЅРёРё" -> rasty.util.move.MoveUtil.hasPlayerMovement();
                    default             -> false;
                };
                if (doJitter) {
                    long t = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    float p1 = jitterPeriod.getValue();
                    jitY = (float)(jitterYawAmount.getValue()   * Math.sin(t / p1));
                    jitP = (float)(jitterPitchAmount.getValue() * Math.cos(t / p1));

                    if (jitterLayer2.isValue()) {
                        float p2 = jitterLayer2Period.getValue();
                        float sc = jitterLayer2Scale.getValue();
                        jitY += (float)(jitterYawAmount.getValue()   * sc * Math.sin(t / p2 + 1.0));
                        jitP += (float)(jitterPitchAmount.getValue() * sc * Math.cos(t / p2 + 1.0));
                    }
                }
            }

            updateResolveSign();
            float res1 = 0, res2 = 0;
            if (humanize.isValue() && !canAttack) {
                res1 = resolveYaw.getValue()   * (resolveRandomSign.isValue() ? resolveSign : 1f);
                res2 = resolvePitch.getValue() * (resolveRandomSign.isValue() ? resolveSign : 1f);
            }

            if (!isState() || entity == null) {
                float sf = MathHelper.clamp(1f - rotDiff / 180f, 0.1f, 1f);
                speed = !ah.getAttackTimer().finished(550) ? 0.05f : 0.8f * sf;
                jitY = jitP = res1 = res2 = 0f;
            }

            float moveYaw   = MathHelper.clamp(yawDelta,   -lineYaw,   lineYaw)   + res1;
            float movePitch = MathHelper.clamp(pitchDelta, -linePitch, linePitch) + res2;

            Angle out = new Angle(currentAngle.getYaw(), currentAngle.getPitch());
            float s = lerp(rng.nextFloat(), speed, speed);
            out.setYaw  (MathHelper.lerp(s, currentAngle.getYaw(),   currentAngle.getYaw()   + moveYaw)   + jitY);
            out.setPitch(MathHelper.lerp(s, currentAngle.getPitch(), currentAngle.getPitch() + movePitch) + jitP);
            return out;
        }

        @Override public Vec3d randomValue() { return Vec3d.ZERO; }
        private float lerp(float t, float a, float b) { return a + t * (b - a); }
    }

    private void updateResolveSign() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - resolveSignTimer > 1000 + (long)(random.nextDouble() * 2000)) {
            resolveSign = random.nextBoolean() ? 1f : -1f;
            resolveSignTimer = now;
        }
    }

    public static class CustomAttackConfig extends StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable {
        public CustomAttackConfig(LivingEntity target, Angle angle, float maxRange,
                                  boolean ignoreWalls, boolean onlyCrit, boolean noEat,
                                  Box box, SelectSetting aimMode) {
            super(target, angle, maxRange, buildOpts(ignoreWalls, onlyCrit, noEat), aimMode, box);
        }
        private static List<String> buildOpts(boolean walls, boolean crit, boolean noEat) {
            List<String> l = new ArrayList<>();
            if (walls)  l.add("Р‘РёС‚СЊ СЃРєРІРѕР·СЊ СЃС‚РµРЅС‹");
            if (crit)   l.add("РўРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РєСЂРёС‚С‹");
            if (noEat)  l.add("РќРµ Р±РёС‚СЊ РµСЃР»Рё РµС€СЊ");
            return l;
        }
    }
}

    SliderSettings xzExpandSetting = new SliderSettings("Р Р°СЃС€РёСЂРµРЅРёРµ XZ", "РџРѕР·РІРѕР»СЏРµС‚ СЂР°СЃС€РёСЂРёС‚СЊ С…РёС‚Р±РѕРєСЃ РїРѕ РѕСЃСЏРј XZ")
            .setValue(0.2F).range(0.0F, 3.0F);

            .setValue(0.0F)
            .range(0.0F, 3.0F);

    BooleanSetting bypassSetting = new BooleanSetting("Bypass Mode", "Р Р°Р· РІ РІС‹Р±СЂР°РЅРЅРѕРµ РІСЂРµРјСЏ С…РёС‚Р±РѕРєСЃС‹ СЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІСЏС‚СЃСЏ СЃС‚Р°РЅРґР°СЂС‚РЅС‹РјРё")
            .setValue(false);

    SliderSettings activeDelay = new SliderSettings("Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° (СЃРµРє)", "Р Р°Р· РІ СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґ РІРєР»СЋС‡Р°С‚СЊ РґРµС„РѕР»С‚РЅС‹Р№ С…РёС‚Р±РѕРєСЃ")
            .setValue(3.0F).range(1.0F, 10.0F)
            .visible(bypassSetting::isValue);

    SliderSettings resetDuration = new SliderSettings("Р”Р»РёС‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ (СЃРµРє)", "РЎРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРё РґРµСЂР¶Р°С‚СЊ С…РёС‚Р±РѕРєСЃ РѕР±С‹С‡РЅС‹Рј")
            .setValue(0.5F).range(0.1F, 2.0F)
            .visible(bypassSetting::isValue);

    StopWatch timer = new StopWatch();

    public HitBoxModule() {
        super("HitBox", "Hit Box", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(xzExpandSetting, yExpandSetting, bypassSetting, activeDelay, resetDuration);
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onBoundingBoxControl(BoundingBoxControlEvent event) {
        if (event.getEntity() instanceof LivingEntity living) {


            if (bypassSetting.isValue()) {
                long delayMs = (long) (activeDelay.getValue() * 1000L);
                long durationMs = (long) (resetDuration.getValue() * 1000L);
                long totalCycle = delayMs + durationMs;


                if (System.currentTimeMillis() % totalCycle < durationMs) {

                    return;
                }
            }

            Box box = event.getBox();
            float xzExpand = xzExpandSetting.getValue();
            float yExpand = yExpandSetting.getValue();

            Box changedBox = new Box(
                    box.minX - xzExpand / 2.0f, box.minY - yExpand / 2.0f,
                    box.minZ - xzExpand / 2.0f, box.maxX + xzExpand / 2.0f,
                    box.maxY + yExpand / 2.0f, box.maxZ + xzExpand / 2.0f);

            if (living != mc.player && !FriendUtils.isFriend(living)) {
                event.setBox(changedBox);
            }
        }
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

import antidaunleak.api.annotation.Native;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.AttackEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SelectSetting;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SliderSettings;
import rasty.util.Instance;
import rasty.util.sounds.SoundManager;

import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

public class HitSound extends ModuleStructure {

    public static HitSound getInstance() {
        return Instance.get(HitSound.class);
    }

    private final SelectSetting soundType = new SelectSetting("РўРёРї Р·РІСѓРєР°", "Select sound type")
            .value("Moan", "Metallic", "Crime")
            .selected("Moan");

    private final SliderSettings volume = new SliderSettings("Р“СЂРѕРјРєРѕСЃС‚СЊ", "Set volume")
            .range(0.1f, 2.0f)
            .setValue(1.0f);

    public HitSound() {
        super("HitSound", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(soundType, volume);
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public void onAttack(AttackEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;
        if (!(event.getTarget() instanceof LivingEntity)) return;

        playSelectedSound();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void playSelectedSound() {
        float vol = volume.getValue();

        if (soundType.isSelected("Moan")) {
            playRandomMoan(vol, 1);
        }

        if (soundType.isSelected("Metallic")) {
            SoundManager.playSound(SoundManager.METALLIC, vol, 1);
        }

        if (soundType.isSelected("Crime")) {
            SoundManager.playSound(SoundManager.CRIME, vol, 1);
        }
    }

    private void playRandomMoan(float volume, float pitch) {
        int random = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(4);
        switch (random) {
            case 0 -> SoundManager.playSound(SoundManager.MOAN1, volume, pitch);
            case 1 -> SoundManager.playSound(SoundManager.MOAN2, volume, pitch);
            case 2 -> SoundManager.playSound(SoundManager.MOAN3, volume, pitch);
            case 3 -> SoundManager.playSound(SoundManager.MOAN4, volume, pitch);
        }
    }
}

            .value("Default", "ReallyWorld")

            .selected("Silent");

    final SliderSettings height = new SliderSettings("Р’С‹СЃРѕС‚Р°", "Р’С‹СЃРѕС‚Р° РїРѕР»С‘С‚Р° РЅР°Рґ С†РµР»СЊСЋ")
            .range(20.0f, 60.0f)
            .setValue(30.0f);

    final MultiSelectSetting targetType = new MultiSelectSetting("Р¦РµР»Рё", "РўРёРїС‹ С†РµР»РµР№")
            .value("РРіСЂРѕРєРё", "РњРѕР±С‹", "Р–РёРІРѕС‚РЅС‹Рµ")
            .selected("РРіСЂРѕРєРё");

    final BooleanSetting autoEquipChest = new BooleanSetting("РђРІС‚Рѕ-РЅР°РіСЂСѓРґРЅРёРє", "РћРґРµРІР°С‚СЊ РЅР°РіСЂСѓРґРЅРёРє РїСЂРё РІС‹РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёРё")

            .setValue(true);

    final FlightController flightController;

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean isSilentMode() {
        return modeSetting.getSelected().equals("Silent");
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean isReallyWorldMode() {
        return serverMode.getSelected().equals("ReallyWorld");
    }

    private SwapSettings buildSettings() {
        return isSilentMode() ? SwapSettings.instant() : SwapSettings.legit();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void updateHandlers() {
        stageHandler.setSilentMode(isSilentMode());
        stageHandler.setReallyWorldMode(isReallyWorldMode());
        stageHandler.setHeight(height.getValue());
        flightController.setPredictionEnabled(predictMovement.isValue());
        flightController.setHeight(height.getValue());
    }

    @Override
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public void activate() {
        stageHandler.reset();
        target = null;
        attackHandler.reset();
        armorSwapHandler.reset();
        fireworkHandler.reset();
        predictor.reset();
        fireworkTimer.reset();
    }

    @Override
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public void deactivate() {
        if (autoEquipChest.isValue() && mc.player != null) {
            equipChestplateOnDisable();
        }

        armorSwapHandler.forceRestore();
        fireworkHandler.forceRestore();
        target = null;
        targetFinder.releaseTarget();
        armorSwapHandler.reset();
        fireworkHandler.reset();
        predictor.reset();
        AngleConnection.INSTANCE.startReturning();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void equipChestplateOnDisable() {
        if (InventoryUtils.hasElytra()) {
            int slot = InventoryUtils.findChestArmorSlot();
            if (slot != -1) {
                int wrappedSlot = InventoryUtils.wrapSlot(slot);
                InventoryUtils.swap(wrappedSlot, 6);
                InventoryUtils.closeScreen();
            }
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public void onRotationUpdate(RotationUpdateEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        if (event.getType() == EventType.PRE) {
            updateHandlers();

            if (target == null || !target.isAlive()) {
                findTarget();
            }

            if (target == null) return;

            predictor.update(target);

            Stage currentStage = stageHandler.getStage();

            switch (currentStage) {
                case FLYING_UP -> {
                    if (InventoryUtils.hasElytra() && mc.player.isGliding()) {
                        Angle targetAngle = flightController.calculateAngle(target, currentStage);
                        rotateTo(targetAngle);
                    }
                }
                case TARGETTING, ATTACKING -> {
                    Angle targetAngle = flightController.calculateAngle(target, currentStage);
                    rotateTo(targetAngle);
                }
            }
        }

        if (event.getType() == EventType.POST) {
            handlePostRotation();
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void handlePostRotation() {
        if (attackHandler.isPendingAttack()) {
            attackHandler.performAttack(target);
            attackHandler.setPendingAttack(false);

            if (attackHandler.isShouldDisableAfterAttack()) {
                attackHandler.setShouldDisableAfterAttack(false);
                setState(false);
            }
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public void onTick(TickEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) {
            resetAllStates();
            return;
        }

        if (!isSilentMode()) {
            armorSwapHandler.processLoop();
            fireworkHandler.processLoop();
        }

        if (armorSwapHandler.isActive() || fireworkHandler.isActive()) {
            return;
        }

        if (target == null || !target.isAlive()) {
            return;
        }

        processStage();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void processStage() {
        boolean hasElytra = InventoryUtils.hasElytra();
        Stage currentStage = stageHandler.getStage();

        switch (currentStage) {
            case PREPARE -> stageHandler.handlePrepare(hasElytra);
            case FLYING_UP -> stageHandler.handleFlyingUp(target, hasElytra);
            case TARGETTING -> stageHandler.handleTargetting(target);
            case ATTACKING -> stageHandler.handleAttacking(target, hasElytra);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onInput(InputEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        if (armorSwapHandler.getMovement().isBlocked() || fireworkHandler.getMovement().isBlocked()) {
            event.setDirectionalLow(false, false, false, false);
            event.setJumping(false);
        }

        if (target != null && InventoryUtils.hasElytra() && stageHandler.getStage() == Stage.FLYING_UP) {
            if (mc.player.isOnGround()) {
                event.setJumping(true);
            } else if (!mc.player.isGliding() && !mc.player.getAbilities().flying) {
                event.setJumping(mc.player.age % 2 == 0);
            }
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void findTarget() {
        TargetFinder.EntityFilter filter = new TargetFinder.EntityFilter(targetType.getSelected());
        targetFinder.searchTargets(mc.world.getEntities(), 128.0f, 360, true);
        targetFinder.validateTarget(filter::isValid);
        target = targetFinder.getCurrentTarget();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void rotateTo(Angle angle) {
        AngleConfig config = new AngleConfig(new LinearConstructor(), true, false);
        Angle.VecRotation rotation = new Angle.VecRotation(angle, angle.toVector());
        AngleConnection.INSTANCE.rotateTo(rotation, target, 1, config, TaskPriority.HIGH_IMPORTANCE_1, this);
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void resetAllStates() {
        armorSwapHandler.reset();
        fireworkHandler.reset();
        attackHandler.reset();
        predictor.reset();
        target = null;
        stageHandler.reset();
    }
}

FILE: rastyclient-main\Rastyclient.cc\Rastyclient\src\main\java\rasty\modules\impl\combat\macetarget\armor\ArmorSwapHandler.java

package rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.armor;

import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.Setter;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.state.MaceState.SwapPhase;
import rasty.util.inventory.InventoryUtils;
import rasty.util.inventory.MovementController;
import rasty.util.inventory.SwapSettings;

@Getter
public class ArmorSwapHandler {

    private static final MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();

    private final MovementController movement = new MovementController();

    @Setter
    private SwapPhase phase = SwapPhase.IDLE;
    private int slot = -1;
    private long phaseStartTime = 0;
    private int currentDelay = 0;

    private final SwapSettingsProvider settingsProvider;

    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface SwapSettingsProvider {
        SwapSettings get();
    }

    public ArmorSwapHandler(SwapSettingsProvider settingsProvider) {
        this.settingsProvider = settingsProvider;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return phase != SwapPhase.IDLE;
    }

    public void startSwap(int slot, boolean isSilent) {
        if (isSilent) {
            swapSilent(slot);
        } else {
            startLegit(slot);
        }
    }

    private void swapSilent(int slot) {
        int wrappedSlot = InventoryUtils.wrapSlot(slot);
        InventoryUtils.swap(wrappedSlot, 6);
        InventoryUtils.closeScreen();
    }

    private void startLegit(int slot) {
        this.slot = slot;
        SwapSettings settings = settingsProvider.get();

        if (settings.shouldStopMovement()) {
            startPhase(SwapPhase.PRE_STOP, settings.randomPreStopDelay());
        } else {
            startPhase(SwapPhase.DO_SWAP, 0);
        }
    }

    public void processLoop() {
        if (phase == SwapPhase.IDLE) return;

        boolean continueProcessing = true;
        int iterations = 0;

        while (continueProcessing && iterations < 10) {
            iterations++;
            continueProcessing = processTick();
        }
    }

    private boolean processTick() {
        if (mc.player == null) {
            reset();
            return false;
        }

        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - phaseStartTime;
        SwapSettings settings = settingsProvider.get();

        switch (phase) {
            case PRE_STOP -> {
                if (elapsed >= currentDelay) {
                    movement.saveState();
                    movement.block();
                    if (settings.shouldStopSprint()) {
                        movement.stopSprint();
                    }
                    startPhase(SwapPhase.STOPPING, 0);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            case STOPPING -> {
                movement.block();
                if (settings.shouldStopSprint()) {
                    movement.stopSprint();
                }
                startPhase(SwapPhase.WAIT_STOP, settings.randomWaitStopDelay());
                return currentDelay == 0;
            }
            case WAIT_STOP -> {
                movement.block();
                boolean stopped = movement.isPlayerStopped(settings.getVelocityThreshold());
                boolean timeout = elapsed >= currentDelay;

                if (stopped || timeout) {
                    startPhase(SwapPhase.PRE_SWAP, settings.randomPreSwapDelay());
                    return currentDelay == 0;
                }
            }
            case PRE_SWAP -> {
                movement.block();
                if (elapsed >= currentDelay) {
                    startPhase(SwapPhase.DO_SWAP, 0);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            case DO_SWAP -> {
                int wrappedSlot = InventoryUtils.wrapSlot(slot);
                InventoryUtils.swap(wrappedSlot, 6);
                startPhase(SwapPhase.POST_SWAP, settings.randomPostSwapDelay());
                return currentDelay == 0;
            }
            case POST_SWAP -> {
                if (elapsed >= currentDelay) {
                    if (settings.shouldCloseInventory()) {
                        InventoryUtils.closeScreen();
                    }
                    startPhase(SwapPhase.RESUMING, settings.randomResumeDelay());
                    return currentDelay == 0;
                }
            }
            case RESUMING -> {
                if (elapsed >= currentDelay) {
                    movement.restoreFromCurrent();
                    reset();
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void startPhase(SwapPhase phase, int delay) {
        this.phase = phase;
        this.phaseStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.currentDelay = delay;
    }

    public void reset() {
        movement.reset();
        phase = SwapPhase.IDLE;
        slot = -1;
        phaseStartTime = 0;
        currentDelay = 0;
    }

    public void forceRestore() {
        if (movement.isBlocked()) {
            movement.restoreFromCurrent();
        }
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.armor;

import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.Setter;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.network.PendingUpdateManager;
import net.minecraft.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.Packet;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.play.PlayerInteractItemC2SPacket;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.play.UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket;
import net.minecraft.screen.slot.SlotActionType;
import net.minecraft.util.Hand;
import rasty.mixin.ClientWorldAccessor;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.Angle;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.AngleConnection;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.MathAngle;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.state.MaceState.FireworkPhase;
import rasty.util.inventory.InventoryUtils;
import rasty.util.inventory.MovementController;
import rasty.util.inventory.SwapSettings;

import java.util.function.IntFunction;

@Getter
public class FireworkHandler {

    private static final MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();

    private final MovementController movement = new MovementController();

    @Setter
    private FireworkPhase phase = FireworkPhase.IDLE;
    private int slot = -1;
    private int savedSlot = -1;
    private boolean fromInventory = false;
    private long phaseStartTime = 0;
    private int currentDelay = 0;

    private final SwapSettingsProvider settingsProvider;

    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface SwapSettingsProvider {
        SwapSettings get();
    }

    public FireworkHandler(SwapSettingsProvider settingsProvider) {
        this.settingsProvider = settingsProvider;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return phase != FireworkPhase.IDLE;
    }

    public void useFirework(boolean isSilent) {
        if (isSilent) {
            useSilent();
        } else {
            startLegit();
        }
    }

    private void useSilent() {
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        int hotbarSlot = InventoryUtils.findHotbarItem(Items.FIREWORK_ROCKET);
        if (hotbarSlot != -1) {
            int currentSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();

            if (hotbarSlot != currentSlot) {
                mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(new UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket(hotbarSlot));
            }

            Angle rotation = getRotation();
            sendSequencedPacket(sequence -> new PlayerInteractItemC2SPacket(
                    Hand.MAIN_HAND,
                    sequence,
                    rotation.getYaw(),
                    rotation.getPitch()
            ));

            if (hotbarSlot != currentSlot) {
                mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(new UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket(currentSlot));
            }
            return;
        }

        int invSlot = InventoryUtils.findItemInInventory(Items.FIREWORK_ROCKET);
        if (invSlot != -1) {
            int currentHotbarSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();
            int wrappedSlot = InventoryUtils.wrapSlot(invSlot);

            InventoryUtils.click(wrappedSlot, currentHotbarSlot, SlotActionType.SWAP);

            Angle rotation = getRotation();
            sendSequencedPacket(sequence -> new PlayerInteractItemC2SPacket(
                    Hand.MAIN_HAND,
                    sequence,
                    rotation.getYaw(),
                    rotation.getPitch()
            ));

            InventoryUtils.click(wrappedSlot, currentHotbarSlot, SlotActionType.SWAP);
            InventoryUtils.closeScreen();
        }
    }

    private void startLegit() {
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        savedSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();

        int hotbarSlot = InventoryUtils.findHotbarItem(Items.FIREWORK_ROCKET);
        if (hotbarSlot != -1) {
            slot = hotbarSlot;
            fromInventory = false;
            InventoryUtils.selectSlot(slot);
            startPhase(FireworkPhase.AWAIT_ITEM, 0);
            return;
        }

        int invSlot = InventoryUtils.findItemInInventory(Items.FIREWORK_ROCKET);
        if (invSlot != -1) {
            slot = invSlot;
            fromInventory = true;

            SwapSettings settings = settingsProvider.get();
            if (settings.shouldStopMovement()) {
                startPhase(FireworkPhase.PRE_STOP, settings.randomPreStopDelay());
            } else {
                startPhase(FireworkPhase.SWAP_TO_HAND, 0);
            }
        }
    }

    public void processLoop() {
        if (phase == FireworkPhase.IDLE) return;

        boolean continueProcessing = true;
        int iterations = 0;

        while (continueProcessing && iterations < 10) {
            iterations++;
            continueProcessing = processTick();
        }
    }

    private boolean processTick() {
        if (mc.player == null) {
            reset();
            return false;
        }

        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - phaseStartTime;
        SwapSettings settings = settingsProvider.get();

        switch (phase) {
            case PRE_STOP -> {
                if (elapsed >= currentDelay) {
                    movement.saveState();
                    movement.block();
                    if (settings.shouldStopSprint()) {
                        movement.stopSprint();
                    }
                    startPhase(FireworkPhase.STOPPING, 0);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            case STOPPING -> {
                movement.block();
                if (settings.shouldStopSprint()) {
                    movement.stopSprint();
                }
                startPhase(FireworkPhase.WAIT_STOP, settings.randomWaitStopDelay());
                return currentDelay == 0;
            }
            case WAIT_STOP -> {
                movement.block();
                boolean stopped = movement.isPlayerStopped(settings.getVelocityThreshold());
                boolean timeout = elapsed >= currentDelay;

                if (stopped || timeout) {
                    startPhase(FireworkPhase.PRE_SWAP, settings.randomPreSwapDelay());
                    return currentDelay == 0;
                }
            }
            case PRE_SWAP -> {
                movement.block();
                if (elapsed >= currentDelay) {
                    startPhase(FireworkPhase.SWAP_TO_HAND, 0);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            case SWAP_TO_HAND -> {
                int hotbarSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();
                InventoryUtils.click(slot, hotbarSlot, SlotActionType.SWAP);
                startPhase(FireworkPhase.AWAIT_ITEM, 0);
                return true;
            }
            case AWAIT_ITEM -> {
                if (mc.player.getMainHandStack().getItem() == Items.FIREWORK_ROCKET) {
                    startPhase(FireworkPhase.USE, 0);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            case USE -> {
                Angle rotation = getRotation();
                sendSequencedPacket(sequence -> new PlayerInteractItemC2SPacket(
                        Hand.MAIN_HAND,
                        sequence,
                        rotation.getYaw(),
                        rotation.getPitch()
                ));

                mc.player.swingHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);
                startPhase(FireworkPhase.POST_USE, settings.randomPostSwapDelay());
                return currentDelay == 0;
            }
            case POST_USE -> {
                if (elapsed >= currentDelay) {
                    if (fromInventory) {
                        startPhase(FireworkPhase.SWAP_BACK, 0);
                        return true;
                    } else {
                        InventoryUtils.selectSlot(savedSlot);
                        startPhase(FireworkPhase.RESUMING, settings.randomResumeDelay());
                        return currentDelay == 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            case SWAP_BACK -> {
                int hotbarSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();
                InventoryUtils.click(slot, hotbarSlot, SlotActionType.SWAP);
                InventoryUtils.selectSlot(savedSlot);
                if (settings.shouldCloseInventory()) {
                    InventoryUtils.closeScreen();
                }
                startPhase(FireworkPhase.RESUMING, settings.randomResumeDelay());
                return currentDelay == 0;
            }
            case RESUMING -> {
                if (elapsed >= currentDelay) {
                    movement.restoreFromCurrent();
                    reset();
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private Angle getRotation() {
        Angle rotation = AngleConnection.INSTANCE.getRotation();
        return rotation != null ? rotation : MathAngle.cameraAngle();
    }

    private void sendSequencedPacket(IntFunction<Packet<?>> packetCreator) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.getNetworkHandler() == null || mc.world == null) return;

        try {
            ClientWorldAccessor worldAccessor = (ClientWorldAccessor) mc.world;
            PendingUpdateManager pendingUpdateManager = worldAccessor.getPendingUpdateManager().incrementSequence();

            int sequence = pendingUpdateManager.getSequence();
            mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(packetCreator.apply(sequence));

            pendingUpdateManager.close();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(packetCreator.apply(0));
        }
    }

    private void startPhase(FireworkPhase phase, int delay) {
        this.phase = phase;
        this.phaseStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.currentDelay = delay;
    }

    public void reset() {
        movement.reset();
        phase = FireworkPhase.IDLE;
        slot = -1;
        savedSlot = -1;
        fromInventory = false;
        phaseStartTime = 0;
        currentDelay = 0;
    }

    public void forceRestore() {
        if (movement.isBlocked()) {
            movement.restoreFromCurrent();
        }
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.attack;

import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.Setter;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.play.UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket;
import net.minecraft.util.Hand;
import rasty.util.inventory.InventoryUtils;

@Getter
@Setter
public class AttackHandler {

    private static final MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();

    private boolean pendingAttack = false;
    private boolean shouldDisableAfterAttack = false;

    public void performAttack(LivingEntity target) {
        if (mc.player == null || target == null) return;

        int maceSlot = InventoryUtils.findHotbarItem(Items.MACE);
        int prevSlot = mc.player.getInventory().getSelectedSlot();

        if (maceSlot != -1 && maceSlot != prevSlot) {
            mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(new UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket(maceSlot));
        }

        mc.interactionManager.attackEntity(mc.player, target);
        mc.player.swingHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);

        if (maceSlot != -1 && maceSlot != prevSlot) {
            mc.getNetworkHandler().sendPacket(new UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket(prevSlot));
        }
    }

    public void reset() {
        pendingAttack = false;
        shouldDisableAfterAttack = false;
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.flight;

import lombok.Getter;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.Angle;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.MathAngle;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.prediction.TargetPredictor;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.state.MaceState.Stage;

@Getter
public class FlightController {

    private static final MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();

    private final TargetPredictor predictor;
    private boolean predictionEnabled = false;
    private float height = 30.0f;

    public FlightController(TargetPredictor predictor) {
        this.predictor = predictor;
    }

    public void setPredictionEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        this.predictionEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public void setHeight(float height) {
        this.height = height;
    }

    public Vec3d getTargetPosition(LivingEntity target, Stage stage) {
        if (target == null) {
            return Vec3d.ZERO;
        }

        if (predictionEnabled && predictor.isMoving()) {
            return predictor.getPredictedPosition(target, stage);
        }

        return target.getEyePos();
    }

    public Angle calculateAngle(LivingEntity target, Stage stage) {
        if (target == null || mc.player == null) {
            return MathAngle.cameraAngle();
        }

        Vec3d targetPos = getTargetPosition(target, stage);

        switch (stage) {
            case FLYING_UP -> {
                Vec3d flyTarget = targetPos.add(0, height, 0);
                return MathAngle.fromVec3d(flyTarget.subtract(mc.player.getEyePos()));
            }
            case TARGETTING, ATTACKING -> {
                return MathAngle.fromVec3d(targetPos.subtract(mc.player.getEyePos()));
            }
            default -> {
                return MathAngle.cameraAngle();
            }
        }
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.prediction;

import lombok.Getter;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.state.MaceState.Stage;

@Getter
public class TargetPredictor {

    private static final MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();

    private Vec3d lastPosition = null;
    private Vec3d velocity = Vec3d.ZERO;
    private Vec3d smoothedVelocity = Vec3d.ZERO;
    private long lastUpdateTime = 0;
    private int sampleCount = 0;

    private static final int MIN_SAMPLES = 2;
    private static final double SMOOTHING = 0.6;

    public void update(LivingEntity target) {
        if (target == null) {
            reset();
            return;
        }

        Vec3d currentPos = target.getEntityPos();
        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();

        if (lastPosition != null && lastUpdateTime > 0) {
            long deltaTime = currentTime - lastUpdateTime;
            if (deltaTime > 0 && deltaTime < 500) {
                velocity = currentPos.subtract(lastPosition);
                smoothedVelocity = smoothedVelocity.multiply(SMOOTHING).add(velocity.multiply(1 - SMOOTHING));
                sampleCount++;
            }
        }

        lastPosition = currentPos;
        lastUpdateTime = currentTime;
    }

    public Vec3d getPredictedPosition(LivingEntity target, Stage stage) {
        if (target == null || mc.player == null) {
            return Vec3d.ZERO;
        }

        Vec3d currentPos = target.getEntityPos();

        if (sampleCount < MIN_SAMPLES || smoothedVelocity.horizontalLengthSquared() < 0.0001) {
            return currentPos;
        }

        double distance = mc.player.distanceTo(target);
        double playerSpeed = mc.player.getVelocity().length();
        double targetSpeed = smoothedVelocity.horizontalLength();

        double ticksToReach;

        switch (stage) {
            case FLYING_UP -> {
                double heightDiff = Math.abs(mc.player.getY() - target.getY());
                ticksToReach = (heightDiff + distance) / Math.max(playerSpeed * 20, 1.0) * 1.2;
            }
            case TARGETTING -> {
                ticksToReach = distance / Math.max(playerSpeed * 20, 0.8);
            }
            case ATTACKING -> {
                ticksToReach = distance / Math.max(playerSpeed * 20, 1.5) * 0.8;
            }
            default -> {
                ticksToReach = distance / 2.0;
            }
        }

        ticksToReach = Math.min(ticksToReach, 40);

        double leadMultiplier = 1.0;
        if (targetSpeed > 0.2) {
            leadMultiplier = 1.3;
        }
        if (targetSpeed > 0.4) {
            leadMultiplier = 1.5;
        }

        Vec3d prediction = smoothedVelocity.multiply(ticksToReach * leadMultiplier);

        return currentPos.add(prediction);
    }

    public boolean isMoving() {
        return smoothedVelocity.horizontalLengthSquared() > 0.001;
    }

    public void reset() {
        lastPosition = null;
        velocity = Vec3d.ZERO;
        smoothedVelocity = Vec3d.ZERO;
        lastUpdateTime = 0;
        sampleCount = 0;
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.stage;

import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.Setter;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.armor.ArmorSwapHandler;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.armor.FireworkHandler;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.attack.AttackHandler;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.state.MaceState.Stage;
import rasty.util.inventory.InventoryUtils;
import rasty.util.timer.StopWatch;

@Getter
public class StageHandler {

    private static final MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();

    private final ArmorSwapHandler armorSwapHandler;
    private final FireworkHandler fireworkHandler;
    private final AttackHandler attackHandler;
    private final StopWatch fireworkTimer;

    @Setter
    private Stage stage = Stage.PREPARE;
    @Setter
    private boolean silentMode = true;
    @Setter
    private boolean reallyWorldMode = false;
    @Setter
    private float height = 30.0f;

    public StageHandler(ArmorSwapHandler armorSwapHandler, FireworkHandler fireworkHandler, 
                        AttackHandler attackHandler, StopWatch fireworkTimer) {
        this.armorSwapHandler = armorSwapHandler;
        this.fireworkHandler = fireworkHandler;
        this.attackHandler = attackHandler;
        this.fireworkTimer = fireworkTimer;
    }

    public void handlePrepare(boolean hasElytra) {
        if (!hasElytra) {
            int slot = InventoryUtils.findElytraSlot();
            if (slot != -1) {
                armorSwapHandler.startSwap(slot, silentMode);
            }
            return;
        }
        stage = Stage.FLYING_UP;
        fireworkTimer.reset();
    }

    public void handleFlyingUp(LivingEntity target, boolean hasElytra) {
        if (!hasElytra) {
            stage = Stage.PREPARE;
            return;
        }

        if (mc.player.isGliding() && fireworkTimer.finished(300)) {
            fireworkHandler.useFirework(silentMode);
            fireworkTimer.reset();
        }

        if (mc.player.getY() - target.getY() >= height) {
            stage = Stage.TARGETTING;
        }
    }

    public void handleTargetting(LivingEntity target) {
        float swapDistance = 12.0f;

        if (InventoryUtils.hasElytra() && mc.player.distanceTo(target) < swapDistance
                && !armorSwapHandler.isActive()) {
            int slot = InventoryUtils.findChestArmorSlot();
            if (slot != -1) {
                armorSwapHandler.startSwap(slot, silentMode);
            }
        }

        if (mc.player.distanceTo(target) < 16.0f) {
            stage = Stage.ATTACKING;
        }
    }

    public void handleAttacking(LivingEntity target, boolean hasElytra) {
        if (hasElytra && !armorSwapHandler.isActive()) {
            int slot = InventoryUtils.findChestArmorSlot();
            if (slot != -1) {
                armorSwapHandler.startSwap(slot, silentMode);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!hasElytra && !armorSwapHandler.isActive() && mc.player.distanceTo(target) < 5) {
            attackHandler.setPendingAttack(true);

            if (reallyWorldMode) {
                attackHandler.setShouldDisableAfterAttack(true);
            } else {
                stage = Stage.FLYING_UP;
                fireworkTimer.reset();
            }
        }
    }

    public void reset() {
        stage = Stage.PREPARE;
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat.macetarget.state;

public class MaceState {

    public enum Stage {
        PREPARE,
        FLYING_UP,
        TARGETTING,
        ATTACKING
    }

    public enum SwapPhase {
        IDLE, PRE_STOP, STOPPING, WAIT_STOP, PRE_SWAP, DO_SWAP, POST_SWAP, RESUMING
    }

    public enum FireworkPhase {
