package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

import antidaunleak.api.annotation.Native;
import net.minecraft.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.mob.MobEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.passive.AnimalEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.decoration.ArmorStandEntity;
import net.minecraft.item.BowItem;
import net.minecraft.item.CrossbowItem;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.item.TridentItem;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import net.minecraft.world.World;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.api.types.EventType;
import rasty.events.impl.RotationUpdateEvent;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.Angle;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.AngleConfig;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.AngleConnection;
import rasty.modules.impl.combat.aura.target.TargetFinder;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.MultiSelectSetting;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SliderSettings;
import rasty.util.math.MathUtils;
import rasty.util.math.TaskPriority;
import rasty.util.repository.friend.FriendUtils;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.stream.StreamSupport;

public class ProjectileHelper extends ModuleStructure {

    private final SliderSettings searchDistance = new SliderSettings("Р”РёСЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёСЏ РїРѕРёСЃРєР°", "Р Р°РґРёСѓСЃ РїРѕРёСЃРєР° С†РµР»Рё РІРѕРєСЂСѓРі РёРіСЂРѕРєР°")
            .setValue(16).range(5F, 64F);

    private final MultiSelectSetting targetType = new MultiSelectSetting("РўРёРї С‚Р°СЂРіРµС‚Р°", "Р¤РёР»СЊС‚СЂСѓРµС‚ С†РµР»Рё РїРѕ С‚РёРїСѓ")
            .value("Players", "Mobs", "Animals", "Armor Stand")
            .selected("Players", "Mobs", "Animals");

    private final TargetFinder targetFinder = new TargetFinder();
    private LivingEntity currentTarget;

    public ProjectileHelper() {
        super("ProjectileHelper", "Projectile Helper", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(searchDistance, targetType);
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public LivingEntity getTarget(World world, Iterable<Entity> entities) {
        List<Entity> entityList = StreamSupport.stream(entities.spliterator(), false).collect(Collectors.toList());

        List<LivingEntity> validTargets = entityList.stream()
                .filter(e -> e instanceof LivingEntity)
                .map(e -> (LivingEntity) e)
                .filter(this::isValidTarget)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        LivingEntity nearestTarget = null;
        double nearestDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        Vec3d playerPos = mc.player.getEntityPos();

        for (LivingEntity target : validTargets) {
            double distance = target.getEntityPos().distanceTo(playerPos);
            if (distance < nearestDistance && distance <= searchDistance.getValue()) {
                nearestDistance = distance;
                nearestTarget = target;
            }
        }

        currentTarget = nearestTarget;
        return currentTarget;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean isValidTarget(LivingEntity entity) {
        if (entity == null) return false;
        if (entity == mc.player) return false;
        if (!entity.isAlive()) return false;

        if (!targetType.isSelected("Players") && entity instanceof PlayerEntity) return false;
        if (!targetType.isSelected("Mobs") && entity instanceof MobEntity) return false;
        if (!targetType.isSelected("Animals") && entity instanceof AnimalEntity) return false;
        if (!targetType.isSelected("Armor Stand") && entity instanceof ArmorStandEntity) return false;
        return true;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public Vec3d getPredictedPosition(LivingEntity target, Vec3d shooterPos, float projectileSpeed, float gravity) {
        Vec3d targetPos = target.getEntityPos().add(0, target.getHeight() * 0.5, 0);
        Vec3d targetVelocity = target.getVelocity();
        Vec3d delta = targetPos.subtract(shooterPos);

        double a = projectileSpeed * projectileSpeed - targetVelocity.lengthSquared();
        double b = -2 * delta.dotProduct(targetVelocity);
        double c = -delta.lengthSquared();

        double t;
        double discriminant = b * b - 4 * a * c;
        if (discriminant > 0) {
            double t1 = (-b + Math.sqrt(discriminant)) / (2 * a);
            double t2 = (-b - Math.sqrt(discriminant)) / (2 * a);
            t = Math.max(t1, t2);
        } else {
            t = delta.length() / projectileSpeed;
        }

        Vec3d predicted = targetPos.add(targetVelocity.multiply(t));
        predicted = predicted.add(0, 0.5 * gravity * t * t, 0);

        return predicted;
    }

    private boolean isHoldingProjectile() {
        ItemStack main = mc.player.getMainHandStack();
        return main.getItem() instanceof BowItem || main.getItem() instanceof CrossbowItem || main.getItem() instanceof TridentItem;
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public void onRotationUpdate(RotationUpdateEvent e) {
        if (e.getType() != EventType.PRE) return;

        ItemStack stack = mc.player.getMainHandStack();

        if (!isValidWeaponState(stack)) {
            currentTarget = null;
            return;
        }

        updateTarget();

        if (currentTarget != null) {
            performAim();
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean isValidWeaponState(ItemStack stack) {
        boolean holdingBow = stack.getItem() instanceof BowItem;
        boolean holdingCrossbow = stack.getItem() instanceof CrossbowItem && ((CrossbowItem) stack.getItem()).isCharged(stack);
        boolean holdingTrident = stack.getItem() instanceof TridentItem;

        if (!holdingBow && !holdingCrossbow && !holdingTrident) {
            return false;
        }

        if (holdingBow && mc.player.getActiveItem() != stack) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void updateTarget() {
        if (currentTarget != null && !currentTarget.isAlive()) {
            currentTarget = null;
        }

        if (currentTarget == null) {
            currentTarget = getTarget(mc.world, mc.world.getEntities());
            if (currentTarget == mc.player) currentTarget = null;
        }

        if (FriendUtils.isFriend(currentTarget)) currentTarget = null;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void performAim() {
        Vec3d shooterPos = mc.player.getEntityPos()
                .add(0, mc.player.getEyeHeight(mc.player.getPose()), 0)
                .add(mc.player.getVelocity());

        float projectileSpeed = 6.0f;
        float gravity = 0.02f;

        Vec3d predictedPos = getPredictedPosition(currentTarget, shooterPos, projectileSpeed, gravity);

        double dx = predictedPos.x - shooterPos.x;
        double dy = predictedPos.y - shooterPos.y;
        double dz = predictedPos.z - shooterPos.z;
        double distanceXZ = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);

        float yaw = (float) Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(dz, dx)) - 90f + MathUtils.getRandom(-1, 1);
        float pitch = (float) -Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(dy, distanceXZ)) + MathUtils.getRandom(-1, 1);

        AngleConnection.INSTANCE.rotateTo(
                new Angle(yaw, pitch),
                AngleConfig.DEFAULT,
                TaskPriority.HIGH_IMPORTANCE_1,
                this
        );
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

import net.minecraft.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.decoration.ArmorStandEntity;

public class ShieldDesync extends ModuleStructure {

    public static ShieldDesync getInstance() {

    }

    private final SelectSetting mode = new SelectSetting("Р РµР¶РёРј", "Р РµР¶РёРј СЂР°Р±РѕС‚С‹ С‰РёС‚Р°")
            .value("Anti-Axe", "Spam", "Auto-Hold")
            .selected("Spam");

    private final MultiSelectSetting targetType = new MultiSelectSetting("РќР°СЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєР° С†РµР»РµР№", "РљРѕРіРѕ СѓС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°С‚СЊ")
            .value("РРіСЂРѕРєРё", "РњРѕР±С‹", "Р–РёРІРѕС‚РЅС‹Рµ", "Р”СЂСѓР·СЊСЏ", "РЎС‚РѕР№РєРё РґР»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅРё")
            .selected("РРіСЂРѕРєРё", "РњРѕР±С‹");

    private final SelectSetting targetPriority = new SelectSetting("РџСЂРёРѕСЂРёС‚РµС‚ С†РµР»Рё", "Р’С‹Р±РѕСЂ С†РµР»Рё")
            .value("Р”РёСЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёСЏ", "HP")
            .selected("Р”РёСЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёСЏ");

    private final SliderSettings range = new SliderSettings("Р”Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ", "Р Р°РґРёСѓСЃ Р°РєС‚РёРІР°С†РёРё (Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРІ)")
            .range(0f, 6f)
            .setValue(3.5f);

    private final SliderSettings spamDelayMin = new SliderSettings("Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° РјРёРЅ (РјСЃ)", "РњРёРЅРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅР°СЏ Р·Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° СЃРїР°РјР°")
            .range(50f, 1000f)
            .setValue(150f)
            .visible(() -> mode.isSelected("Spam"));

    private final SliderSettings spamDelayMax = new SliderSettings("Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° РјР°РєСЃ (РјСЃ)", "РњР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅР°СЏ Р·Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° СЃРїР°РјР°")
            .range(50f, 1500f)
            .setValue(400f)
            .visible(() -> mode.isSelected("Spam"));

    private final BooleanSetting pauseWhenUsingItem = new BooleanSetting(
            "РџР°СѓР·Р° РїСЂРё СЋР·Р°РЅРёРё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°",
            "РћС„С„Р°РµС‚ С‰РёС‚, РїРѕРєР° РёРіСЂРѕРє СЋР·Р°РµС‚ (РµРґСѓ, Р·РµР»СЊСЏ, Р»СѓРє)")
            .setValue(true);

    private final Random random = new Random();

    private boolean weControllingKey = false;
    private long    nextToggleMs  = 0;
    private boolean spamPressed   = false;
    private int axeGrace = 0;
    private static final int AXE_GRACE_TICKS = 8;

    public ShieldDesync() {
        super("ShieldDesync", "Р—Р°С‰РёС‚Р° С‰РёС‚Р° РѕС‚ С‚РѕРїРѕСЂР°", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(mode, targetType, targetPriority, range, spamDelayMin, spamDelayMax, pauseWhenUsingItem);
    }

    private void setShield(boolean press) {
        weControllingKey = press;
        mc.options.useKey.setPressed(press);
    }

    private void releaseControl() {
        if (weControllingKey) {
            mc.options.useKey.setPressed(false);
            weControllingKey = false;
        }
        spamPressed = false;
        axeGrace    = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        if (weControllingKey) {
            mc.options.useKey.setPressed(false);
            weControllingKey = false;
        }
        spamPressed = false;
        axeGrace    = 0;
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        if (!(mc.player.getOffHandStack().getItem() instanceof ShieldItem)) {
            releaseControl();
            return;
        }

        if (pauseWhenUsingItem.isValue()) {
            ItemStack main = mc.player.getMainHandStack();
            boolean mainNeedsUse = !main.isEmpty()
                    && !(main.getItem() instanceof ShieldItem)
                    && main.getUseAction() != UseAction.NONE;
            boolean playerIsUsing = mc.player.isUsingItem()
                    && !(mc.player.getActiveItem().getItem() instanceof ShieldItem);
            if (mainNeedsUse || playerIsUsing) {
                releaseControl();
                return;
            }
        }

        LivingEntity target = findTarget();
        if (target == null) {
            releaseControl();
            return;
        }

        if (entityHoldsAxe(target)) {
            axeGrace = AXE_GRACE_TICKS;
        } else if (axeGrace > 0) {
            axeGrace--;
        }
        boolean danger = axeGrace > 0;

        switch (mode.getSelected()) {

            case "Anti-Axe" -> {
                if (danger) {

                    setShield(false);
                } else {

                    weControllingKey = false;
                }
            }

            case "Spam" -> {
                if (danger) {
                    setShield(false);
                    spamPressed  = false;
                    nextToggleMs = System.currentTimeMillis() + 120L;
                    return;
                }

                long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                if (now >= nextToggleMs) {
                    spamPressed = !spamPressed;
                    float lo    = spamDelayMin.getValue();
                    float hi    = Math.max(lo + 10f, spamDelayMax.getValue());
                    long  delay = (long)(lo + random.nextFloat() * (hi - lo));
                    nextToggleMs = now + delay;
                    setShield(spamPressed);
                }
            }

            case "Auto-Hold" -> {
                if (danger) {
                    setShield(false);
                } else {
                    setShield(true);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private LivingEntity findTarget() {
        if (mc.world == null || mc.player == null) return null;

        LivingEntity best      = null;
        float        bestScore = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        float        maxRange  = range.getValue();

        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (!(entity instanceof LivingEntity living)) continue;
            if (living == mc.player)   continue;
            if (!living.isAlive())     continue;
            if (!isValidTarget(living)) continue;

            float dist = mc.player.distanceTo(living);
            if (dist > maxRange) continue;

            float score = targetPriority.isSelected("HP") ? living.getHealth() : dist;
            if (score < bestScore) {
                bestScore = score;
                best      = living;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private boolean isValidTarget(LivingEntity entity) {
        if (entity instanceof PlayerEntity player) {
            if (FriendUtils.isFriend(player)) return targetType.isSelected("Р”СЂСѓР·СЊСЏ");
            return targetType.isSelected("РРіСЂРѕРєРё");
        }
        if (entity instanceof ArmorStandEntity) return targetType.isSelected("РЎС‚РѕР№РєРё РґР»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅРё");
        if (entity instanceof AnimalEntity)     return targetType.isSelected("Р–РёРІРѕС‚РЅС‹Рµ");
        if (entity instanceof MobEntity)        return targetType.isSelected("РњРѕР±С‹");
        return false;
    }

    private boolean entityHoldsAxe(LivingEntity e) {
        return e.getMainHandStack().getItem() instanceof AxeItem
                || e.getOffHandStack().getItem() instanceof AxeItem;
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

import antidaunleak.api.annotation.Native;
import lombok.AccessLevel;
import lombok.experimental.FieldDefaults;
import lombok.experimental.NonFinal;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.AttackEvent;
import rasty.events.impl.TickEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;

@FieldDefaults(level = AccessLevel.PRIVATE, makeFinal = true)
public class ShiftTap extends ModuleStructure {

    @NonFinal
    long shiftTapEndTime = 0;
    @NonFinal
    boolean isModuleControllingSneak = false;
    @NonFinal
    int shiftTapDuration = 100;

    MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();

    public ShiftTap() {
        super("ShiftTap", "Shift Tap", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void startShiftTap() {
        shiftTapEndTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + 25;
        if (!isModuleControllingSneak) {
            mc.options.sneakKey.setPressed(true);
            isModuleControllingSneak = true;
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void stopShiftTap() {
        if (isModuleControllingSneak) {
            mc.options.sneakKey.setPressed(false);
            isModuleControllingSneak = false;
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public void onAttack(AttackEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null) {
            return;
        }
        startShiftTap();
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.player.isSpectator()) {
            stopShiftTap();
            return;
        }

        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (isModuleControllingSneak && currentTime > shiftTapEndTime) {
            stopShiftTap();
        }
    }
}

    final BooleanSetting randomizeDelay = new BooleanSetting("Р Р°РЅРґРѕРјРёР·Р°С†РёСЏ Р·Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєРё", "РЎР»СѓС‡Р°Р№РЅС‹Р№ СЂР°Р·Р±СЂРѕСЃ Р·Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєРё В±300РјСЃ")
            .setValue(false);

    final StopWatch delay = new StopWatch();

    private final Random random = new Random();
    private long currentDelay = 0L;

    public TapeMouse() {
        super("TapeMouse", "Tape Mouse", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(modeClick, delayForClick, backgroundMode, randomizeDelay);
        recalcDelay();
    }

    private void recalcDelay() {
        long base = (long) (delayForClick.getValue() * 300.0f);
        if (randomizeDelay.isValue()) {
            long offset = (long) (random.nextFloat() * 600L) - 300L;
            currentDelay = Math.max(50L, base + offset);
        } else {
            currentDelay = base;
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public void onTick(TickEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        boolean focused = mc.isWindowFocused();
        boolean screenOpen = mc.currentScreen != null;

        if (!backgroundMode.isValue()) {
            if (!focused || screenOpen) return;
        }

        if (!delay.finished(currentDelay)) return;

        if (backgroundMode.isValue() && (!focused || screenOpen)) {
            performBackgroundClick();
        } else {
            performForegroundClick();
        }

        recalcDelay();
        delay.reset();
    }

    private void performBackgroundClick() {
        if (modeClick.isSelected("Р›РµРІР°СЏ РєРЅРѕРїРєР°")) {
            if (mc.targetedEntity != null) {
                mc.interactionManager.attackEntity(mc.player, mc.targetedEntity);
                mc.player.swingHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);
            } else {
                mc.doAttack();
            }
        } else {
            mc.doItemUse();
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void performForegroundClick() {
        if (modeClick.isSelected("Р›РµРІР°СЏ РєРЅРѕРїРєР°")) {
            leftClick();
        } else {
            rightClick();
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void leftClick() {
        if (mc.interactionManager == null) return;
        if (mc.targetedEntity != null) {
            mc.interactionManager.attackEntity(mc.player, mc.targetedEntity);
            mc.player.swingHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);
        } else if (mc.crosshairTarget != null) {
            mc.doAttack();
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void rightClick() {
        if (mc.interactionManager == null) return;
        mc.doItemUse();
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

public class TargetPearl extends ModuleStructure {

    private final SliderSettings aimDelay = new SliderSettings("Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° РїСЂРёС†РµР»Р° РјСЃ",
            "РЎРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РјСЃ Р¶РґР°С‚СЊ РїРµСЂРµРґ Р±СЂРѕСЃРєРѕРј Р¶РµРјС‡СѓРіР°")
            .range(0f, 300f)
            .setValue(50f);

    private final SliderSettings minDistance = new SliderSettings("РњРёРЅ. РґРёСЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёСЏ Р¶РµРјС‡СѓРіР°",
            "РњРёРЅРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ СЂР°СЃСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ РґРѕ Р¶РµРјС‡СѓРіР° С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЂРµР°РіРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ")
            .range(3f, 20f)
            .setValue(5f);

    private final SliderSettings maxDistance = new SliderSettings("РњР°РєСЃ. РґРёСЃС‚Р°РЅС†РёСЏ Р¶РµРјС‡СѓРіР°",
            "РњР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ СЂР°СЃСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ РґРѕ Р¶РµРјС‡СѓРіР° С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЂРµР°РіРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ")
            .range(5f, 64f)
            .setValue(40f);

    private final BooleanSetting ignoreFriends = new BooleanSetting("РРіРЅРѕСЂРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ РґСЂСѓР·РµР№",
            "РќРµ РєРёРґР°С‚СЊ Р¶РµРјС‡СѓРіРё РЅР° РёРіСЂРѕРєРѕРІ РёР· СЃРїРёСЃРєР° РґСЂСѓР·РµР№")
            .setValue(true);

    private final BooleanSetting mirrorThrow = new BooleanSetting("Р—РµСЂРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ Р±СЂРѕСЃРѕРє",
            "РљРёРґР°С‚СЊ РїС‘СЂРєСѓ РІ С‚Сѓ Р¶Рµ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ РєСѓРґР° Р»РµС‚РёС‚ РїС‘СЂРєР° РІСЂР°РіР°")
            .setValue(false);

    private final Map<Integer, String> pearlOwners   = new HashMap<>();
    private final Set<Integer>         trackedPearls = new HashSet<>();

    private int     pearlsToThrow  = 0;
    private int     pearlsThrown   = 0;
    private Vec3d   targetPosition = null;
    private long    aimStartTime   = 0L;
    private float   targetYaw      = 0f;
    private float   targetPitch    = 0f;
    private int     lastThrowTick  = 0;
    public  boolean isThrowing     = false;

    public TargetPearl() {
        super("TargetPearl", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(aimDelay, minDistance, maxDistance, ignoreFriends, mirrorThrow);
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        resetState();
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onPacket(PacketEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;
        if (!(event.getPacket() instanceof EntitySpawnS2CPacket packet)) return;
        if (packet.getEntityType() != EntityType.ENDER_PEARL) return;

        int pearlId = packet.getEntityId();
        if (pearlOwners.containsKey(pearlId)) return;

        double spawnX = packet.getX();
        double spawnY = packet.getY();
        double spawnZ = packet.getZ();

        PlayerEntity closest = null;
        double closestDist = 9.0;

        for (PlayerEntity player : mc.world.getPlayers()) {
            if (player == mc.player) continue;
            double distSq = player.squaredDistanceTo(spawnX, spawnY, spawnZ);
            if (distSq < closestDist) {
                closestDist = distSq;
                closest = player;
            }
        }

        pearlOwners.put(pearlId, closest != null ? closest.getName().getString() : "");
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        cleanupDeadPearls();

        if (isOwnPearlActive()) { resetState(); return; }
        if (!hasPearlsInHotbar()) { resetState(); return; }

        int newPearls = countNewPearls();
        if (newPearls > 0) pearlsToThrow += newPearls;

        if (pearlsToThrow > pearlsThrown && !isThrowing && targetPosition == null && !isOwnPearlActive()) {
            EnderPearlEntity pearl = findValidPearl();
            if (pearl != null) prepareThrow(pearl);
        }

        if (targetPosition != null && System.currentTimeMillis() - aimStartTime >= (long) aimDelay.getValue()) {
            boolean thrown = throwPearl();
            if (thrown) {
                pearlsThrown++;
                lastThrowTick = mc.player.age;
            }
            resetAim();
        }
    }

    private void prepareThrow(EnderPearlEntity pearl) {
        if (!hasPearlsInHotbar()) return;

        Vec3d landingPos = simulatePearlLanding(pearl);
        if (landingPos == null) {
            pearlsThrown++;
            return;
        }

        double distSq = mc.player.squaredDistanceTo(landingPos.x, landingPos.y, landingPos.z);
        if (distSq < minDistance.getValue() * minDistance.getValue()) {
            pearlsThrown++;
            return;
        }

        float[] angles = findBestThrowAngles(landingPos);
        if (angles == null) {
            pearlsThrown++;
            return;
        }

        targetYaw      = angles[0];
        targetPitch    = angles[1];
        targetPosition = landingPos;
        aimStartTime   = System.currentTimeMillis();
        isThrowing     = true;
    }

    private Vec3d simulatePearlLanding(EnderPearlEntity pearl) {
        Vec3d pos    = new Vec3d(pearl.getX(), pearl.getY(), pearl.getZ());
        Vec3d motion = pearl.getVelocity();

        for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
            Vec3d nextPos = pos.add(motion);
            motion = new Vec3d(motion.x * 0.99, motion.y * 0.99 - 0.03, motion.z * 0.99);

            BlockHitResult blockHit = mc.world.raycast(new RaycastContext(
                    pos, nextPos,
                    RaycastContext.ShapeType.COLLIDER,
                    RaycastContext.FluidHandling.NONE,
                    mc.player));

            if (blockHit.getType() != HitResult.Type.MISS) {
                return blockHit.getPos();
            }

            Entity entityHit = getEntityOnPath(pos, nextPos, pearl);
            if (entityHit != null) {
                return null;
            }

            if (nextPos.y <= mc.world.getBottomY()) return nextPos;
            pos = nextPos;
        }
        return pos;
    }

    private Vec3d simulateOwnThrow(float yaw, float pitch, Vec3d startPos, Vec3d playerVelocity) {
        double yawRad   = Math.toRadians(yaw);
        double pitchRad = Math.toRadians(pitch);

        double vx = -Math.sin(yawRad) * Math.cos(pitchRad) * 1.5;
        double vy = -Math.sin(pitchRad) * 1.5;
        double vz =  Math.cos(yawRad)  * Math.cos(pitchRad) * 1.5;

        Vec3d pos = startPos;
        Vec3d vel = new Vec3d(vx + playerVelocity.x, vy + playerVelocity.y, vz + playerVelocity.z);

        for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
            Vec3d nextPos = pos.add(vel);
            vel = new Vec3d(vel.x * 0.99, vel.y * 0.99 - 0.03, vel.z * 0.99);

            BlockHitResult blockHit = mc.world.raycast(new RaycastContext(
                    pos, nextPos,
                    RaycastContext.ShapeType.COLLIDER,
                    RaycastContext.FluidHandling.NONE,
                    mc.player));

            if (blockHit.getType() != HitResult.Type.MISS) {
                return blockHit.getPos();
            }

            Entity entityHit = getEntityOnPath(pos, nextPos, null);
            if (entityHit != null) {
                return entityHit.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
            }

            if (nextPos.y <= mc.world.getBottomY()) return nextPos;
            pos = nextPos;
        }
        return pos;
    }

    private float[] findBestThrowAngles(Vec3d targetPos) {
        Vec3d eyePos   = mc.player.getEyePos();
        Vec3d velocity = mc.player.getVelocity();

        Vec3d dir = targetPos.subtract(eyePos);
        float yaw = (float) Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(-dir.x, dir.z));

        float bestPitch   = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        double bestDist   = Double.MAX_VALUE;

        // РіСЂСѓР±С‹Р№ РїСЂРѕС…РѕРґ СЃ С€Р°РіРѕРј 2В° С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅР°Р№С‚Рё Р·РѕРЅСѓ
        float roughBest = 0f;
        double roughDist = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        for (float pitch = -85f; pitch <= 85f; pitch += 2f) {
            Vec3d landing = simulateOwnThrow(yaw, pitch, eyePos, velocity);
            double dist = landing.squaredDistanceTo(targetPos);
            if (dist < roughDist) {
                roughDist = dist;
                roughBest = pitch;
            }
        }

        // С‚РѕС‡РЅС‹Р№ РїСЂРѕС…РѕРґ В±3В° РІРѕРєСЂСѓРі Р»СѓС‡С€РµРіРѕ РіСЂСѓР±РѕРіРѕ СЂРµР·СѓР»СЊС‚Р°С‚Р° СЃ С€Р°РіРѕРј 0.1В°
        for (float pitch = roughBest - 3f; pitch <= roughBest + 3f; pitch += 0.1f) {
            Vec3d landing = simulateOwnThrow(yaw, pitch, eyePos, velocity);
            double dist = landing.squaredDistanceTo(targetPos);
            if (dist < bestDist) {
                bestDist  = dist;
                bestPitch = pitch;
            }
        }

        if (bestPitch == Float.MAX_VALUE) return null;
        if (bestDist > 9.0) return null;

        return new float[]{yaw, bestPitch};
    }

    private Entity getEntityOnPath(Vec3d from, Vec3d to, Entity exclude) {
        if (mc.world == null) return null;
        Box searchBox = new Box(from, to).expand(0.3);
        Entity found = null;
        double minDist = Double.MAX_VALUE;

        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntitiesByClass(Entity.class, searchBox, e ->
                e != mc.player && e != exclude && e.isAlive() && !(e instanceof EnderPearlEntity))) {
            Optional<Vec3d> hit = entity.getBoundingBox().expand(0.3).raycast(from, to);
            if (hit.isPresent()) {
                double dist = from.squaredDistanceTo(hit.get());
                if (dist < minDist) {
                    minDist = dist;
                    found = entity;
                }
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    private void cleanupDeadPearls() {
        Set<Integer> existingIds = new HashSet<>();
        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (entity instanceof EnderPearlEntity) existingIds.add(entity.getId());
        }
        pearlOwners.keySet().removeIf(id -> !existingIds.contains(id));
        trackedPearls.removeIf(id -> !existingIds.contains(id));
    }

    private boolean isPearlFromFriend(EnderPearlEntity pearl) {
        if (!ignoreFriends.isValue()) return false;
        String ownerName = pearlOwners.get(pearl.getId());
        if (ownerName == null || ownerName.isEmpty()) return false;
        return FriendUtils.isFriend(ownerName);
    }

    private boolean isOwnPearlActive() {
        if (mc.player.age - lastThrowTick > 20) return false;
        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (entity instanceof EnderPearlEntity pearl) {
                String owner = pearlOwners.get(pearl.getId());
                if (owner != null && owner.isEmpty()) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean hasPearlsInHotbar() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            if (mc.player.getInventory().getStack(i).getItem() == Items.ENDER_PEARL) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private int countNewPearls() {
        int count = 0;
        double minDist = minDistance.getValue();
        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (!(entity instanceof EnderPearlEntity pearl)) continue;
            if (trackedPearls.contains(pearl.getId())) continue;
            String owner = pearlOwners.get(pearl.getId());
            if (owner != null && owner.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (isPearlFromFriend(pearl)) continue;
            if (mc.player.squaredDistanceTo(pearl) < minDist * minDist) continue;
            count++;
            trackedPearls.add(pearl.getId());
        }
        return count;
    }

    private EnderPearlEntity findValidPearl() {
        EnderPearlEntity closest = null;
        double closestDist = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        double minDist = minDistance.getValue();
        double maxDist = maxDistance.getValue();

        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (!(entity instanceof EnderPearlEntity pearl)) continue;
            String owner = pearlOwners.get(pearl.getId());
            if (owner != null && owner.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (isPearlFromFriend(pearl)) continue;
            double distSq = mc.player.squaredDistanceTo(pearl);
            if (distSq < minDist * minDist || distSq > maxDist * maxDist) continue;
            if (distSq < closestDist) {
                closestDist = distSq;
                closest = pearl;
            }
        }
        return closest;
    }

    private boolean throwPearl() {
        int pearlSlot = findPearlSlot();
        if (pearlSlot == -1) return false;

        int oldSlot = InventoryUtils.currentSlot();
        try {
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket(pearlSlot));
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.LookAndOnGround(
                    targetYaw, targetPitch, mc.player.isOnGround(), mc.player.horizontalCollision));
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(
                    new PlayerInteractItemC2SPacket(Hand.MAIN_HAND, 0, targetYaw, targetPitch));
            mc.player.swingHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);
        } finally {
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new UpdateSelectedSlotC2SPacket(oldSlot));
            isThrowing = false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private int findPearlSlot() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            if (mc.player.getInventory().getStack(i).getItem() == Items.ENDER_PEARL) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private void resetAim() {
        targetPosition = null;
        targetYaw      = 0f;
        targetPitch    = 0f;
    }

    private void resetState() {
        resetAim();
        pearlsToThrow = 0;
        pearlsThrown  = 0;
        trackedPearls.clear();
        pearlOwners.clear();
        isThrowing    = false;
    }
}

        settings(attackRange, targetType, attackSetting, sprintReset, smartCrits);
    }

    public static TriggerBot getInstance() {
        return Instance.get(TriggerBot.class);
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        target = null;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private LivingEntity updateTarget() {
        TargetFinder.EntityFilter filter = new TargetFinder.EntityFilter(targetType.getSelected());
        float range = attackRange.getValue() + RANGE_MARGIN;
        targetSelector.searchTargets(mc.world.getEntities(), range, 360, attackSetting.isSelected("Р‘РёС‚СЊ СЃРєРІРѕР·СЊ СЃС‚РµРЅС‹"));
        targetSelector.validateTarget(filter::isValid);
        return targetSelector.getCurrentTarget();
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public void onRotationUpdate(RotationUpdateEvent e) {
        if (PlayerInteractionHelper.nullCheck()) return;

        switch (e.getType()) {
            case EventType.PRE -> target = updateTarget();
            case EventType.POST -> {
                if (target != null) {
                    Initialization.getInstance().getManager().getAttackPerpetrator().performTriggerAttack(getConfig(), this);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable getConfig() {
        float baseRange = attackRange.getValue() + RANGE_MARGIN;

        Pair<Vec3d, Box> pointData = pointFinder.computeVector(
                target,
                baseRange,
                AngleConnection.INSTANCE.getRotation(),
                getSmoothMode().randomValue(),
                attackSetting.isSelected("Р‘РёС‚СЊ СЃРєРІРѕР·СЊ СЃС‚РµРЅС‹")
        );

        Vec3d computedPoint = pointData.getLeft();
        Box hitbox = pointData.getRight();

        Angle angle = MathAngle.fromVec3d(computedPoint.subtract(Objects.requireNonNull(mc.player).getEyePos()));

        return new StrikerConstructor.AttackPerpetratorConfigurable(
                target,
                angle,
                baseRange,
                attackSetting.getSelected(),
                null,
                hitbox
        );
    }

    public RotateConstructor getSmoothMode() {
        return new LinearConstructor();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public boolean isResetSprintLegit() {

    }

    }

package rasty.modules.impl.combat;

import antidaunleak.api.annotation.Native;
import lombok.AccessLevel;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.Setter;
import lombok.experimental.FieldDefaults;
import lombok.experimental.NonFinal;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.play.ClientCommandC2SPacket;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.play.PlayerActionC2SPacket;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.c2s.play.PlayerMoveC2SPacket;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.s2c.common.CommonPingS2CPacket;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.s2c.play.EntityVelocityUpdateS2CPacket;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.s2c.play.PlayerPositionLookS2CPacket;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.Formatting;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.PacketEvent;
import rasty.events.impl.TickEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SelectSetting;
import rasty.util.Instance;

@Setter
@Getter
@FieldDefaults(level = AccessLevel.PRIVATE, makeFinal = true)
public class Velocity extends ModuleStructure {
    public static Velocity getInstance() {
        return Instance.get(Velocity.class);
    }

    SelectSetting mode = new SelectSetting("Р РµР¶РёРј", "Р’С‹Р±РµСЂРёС‚Рµ СЂРµР¶РёРј СѓРјРµРЅСЊС€РµРЅРёСЏ РѕС‚РґР°С‡Рё")
            .value("NewGrim", "OldGrim", "Matrix", "Normal", "RW", "RW 2", "RW 3")
            .selected("RW 2");

    @NonFinal boolean flag;
    @NonFinal int grimTicks;
    @NonFinal int ccCooldown;
    @NonFinal Vec3d pendingVelocity;

    public Velocity() {
        super("Velocity", ModuleCategory.COMBAT);
        settings(mode);
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public void onPacket(PacketEvent e) {
        if (!state) return;
        if (e.getType() != PacketEvent.Type.RECEIVE) return;
        if (mc.player == null || mc.player.isTouchingWater() || mc.player.isSubmergedInWater() || mc.player.isInLava()) return;
        if (ccCooldown > 0) {
            ccCooldown--;
            return;
        }

        if (e.getPacket() instanceof EntityVelocityUpdateS2CPacket pac && pac.getEntityId() == mc.player.getId()) {
            handleVelocityPacket(e, pac);
        }

        handleAdditionalPackets(e);
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void handleVelocityPacket(PacketEvent e, EntityVelocityUpdateS2CPacket pac) {
        Vec3d velocity = pac.getVelocity();

        switch (mode.getSelected()) {
            case "Matrix" -> {
                if (!flag) {
                    e.setCancelled(true);
                    flag = true;
                } else {
                    flag = false;
                    e.setCancelled(true);
                    pendingVelocity = new Vec3d(velocity.x * -0.1, velocity.y, velocity.z * -0.1);
                }
            }
            case "Normal" -> e.setCancelled(true);
            case "OldGrim" -> {
                e.setCancelled(true);
                grimTicks = 6;
            }
            case "NewGrim" -> {
                e.setCancelled(true);
                flag = true;
            }
            case "RW" -> {
                e.setCancelled(true);
                mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.Full(
                        mc.player.getX(), mc.player.getY(), mc.player.getZ(),
                        mc.player.getYaw(), mc.player.getPitch(), mc.player.isOnGround(), false
                ));
            }
            case "RW 2" -> {
                e.setCancelled(true);
                mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new ClientCommandC2SPacket(mc.player, ClientCommandC2SPacket.Mode.STOP_SPRINTING));
                mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new ClientCommandC2SPacket(mc.player, ClientCommandC2SPacket.Mode.START_SPRINTING));
            }
            case "RW 3" -> {
                e.setCancelled(true);
                mc.player.setVelocity(0, mc.player.getVelocity().y, 0);
            }
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void handleAdditionalPackets(PacketEvent e) {
        if (mode.isSelected("OldGrim") && e.getPacket() instanceof CommonPingS2CPacket && grimTicks > 0) {
            e.setCancelled(true);
            grimTicks--;
        }

        if (e.getPacket() instanceof PlayerPositionLookS2CPacket && mode.isSelected("NewGrim")) {
            ccCooldown = 5;
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    public void onTick(TickEvent e) {
        if (!state || mc.player == null || mc.player.isTouchingWater() || mc.player.isSubmergedInWater()) return;

        if (mode.isSelected("Matrix")) {
            handleMatrixTick();
        }

        if (mode.isSelected("NewGrim") && flag) {
            handleNewGrimTick();
        }

        if (grimTicks > 0) {
            grimTicks--;
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void handleMatrixTick() {
        if (pendingVelocity != null) {
            mc.player.setVelocity(pendingVelocity);
            pendingVelocity = null;
        }

        if (mc.player.hurtTime > 0 && !mc.player.isOnGround()) {
            double yaw = mc.player.getYaw() * 0.017453292F;
            double speed = Math.sqrt(mc.player.getVelocity().x * mc.player.getVelocity().x + mc.player.getVelocity().z * mc.player.getVelocity().z);
            mc.player.setVelocity(-Math.sin(yaw) * speed, mc.player.getVelocity().y, Math.cos(yaw) * speed);
            mc.player.setSprinting(mc.player.age % 2 != 0);
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void handleNewGrimTick() {
        if (ccCooldown <= 0) {
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerMoveC2SPacket.Full(
                    mc.player.getX(), mc.player.getY(), mc.player.getZ(),
                    mc.player.getYaw(), mc.player.getPitch(), mc.player.isOnGround(), false
            ));
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendPacket(new PlayerActionC2SPacket(
                    PlayerActionC2SPacket.Action.STOP_DESTROY_BLOCK,
                    BlockPos.ofFloored(mc.player.getEntityPos()), Direction.DOWN
            ));
        }
        flag = false;
    }

    @Override
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public void activate() {
        super.activate();
        grimTicks = 0;
        flag = false;
        ccCooldown = 0;
        pendingVelocity = null;
        if (mc.player != null) {
            mc.player.sendMessage(Text.literal("Р”Р°РЅРЅР°СЏ С„СѓРЅРєС†РёСЏ Р±С‹Р»Р° СѓСЂРµР·Р°РЅР°! ")
                    .formatted(Formatting.RED, Formatting.BOLD)
                    .append(Text.literal("Р•СЃР»Рё С…РѕС‡РµС€СЊ РїСЂРѕС‡СѓРІСЃС‚РІРѕРІР°С‚СЊ РІСЃСЋ РјРѕС‰СЊ С‚Рѕ РіРµС‚Р°Р№ РїСЂРµРјРёСѓРј РІРµСЂСЃРёСЋ РЅР° СЃР°Р№С‚Рµ ").formatted(Formatting.YELLOW))
                    .append(Text.literal("rastyclient.cc").formatted(Formatting.AQUA)), false);
        }
    }

    @Override
    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public void deactivate() {
        super.deactivate();
        pendingVelocity = null;
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.misc;

import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.TickEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.BooleanSetting;
import rasty.util.math.MathUtils;

public class AntiAFK extends ModuleStructure {

    private final BooleanSetting randomCommands = new BooleanSetting("Р Р°РЅРґРѕРјРЅС‹Рµ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹", "РџРёСЃР°С‚СЊ РјСѓСЃРѕСЂ РІ С‡Р°С‚ СЂР°Р· РІ 1.5 РјРёРЅ").setValue(true);
    private final BooleanSetting jump = new BooleanSetting("РџСЂС‹Р¶РѕРє", "РџСЂС‹РіР°С‚СЊ СЂР°Р· РІ 58 СЃРµРєСѓРЅРґ").setValue(true);
    private final BooleanSetting rotate = new BooleanSetting("РџРѕРІРѕСЂРѕС‚ РіРѕР»РѕРІС‹", "РќРµРјРЅРѕРіРѕ РєСЂСѓС‚РёС‚СЊ РіРѕР»РѕРІРѕР№ РґР»СЏ РѕР±С…РѕРґР°").setValue(true);

    private long lastCommandTime;
    private long lastJumpTime;

    public AntiAFK() {
        super("AntiAFK", ModuleCategory.MISC);
        settings(randomCommands, jump, rotate);
    }

    public void onEnable() {
        lastCommandTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        lastJumpTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        if (randomCommands.isValue() && System.currentTimeMillis() - lastCommandTime > 90000) {

            String randomStr = "/afk-" + Integer.toHexString(MathUtils.getRandom(10000, 999999));
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendChatCommand(randomStr);


            lastCommandTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + MathUtils.getRandom(0, 5000);
        }


        if (jump.isValue() && System.currentTimeMillis() - lastJumpTime > 58000) {
            if (mc.player.isOnGround()) {
                mc.player.jump();
            }
            lastJumpTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + MathUtils.getRandom(0, 2000);
        }

        if (rotate.isValue() && mc.player.getVelocity().horizontalLength() < 0.01) {
            float yawRand = MathUtils.getRandom(-2.0f, 2.0f);
            float pitchRand = MathUtils.getRandom(-1.0f, 1.0f);

            mc.player.setYaw(mc.player.getYaw() + yawRand);
            mc.player.setPitch(MathUtils.clamp(mc.player.getPitch() + pitchRand, -90, 90));
        }
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.misc;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.ingame.BrewingStandScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.ingame.GenericContainerScreen;
import net.minecraft.component.DataComponentTypes;
import net.minecraft.component.type.PotionContentsComponent;
import net.minecraft.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.screen.BrewingStandScreenHandler;
import net.minecraft.screen.GenericContainerScreenHandler;
import net.minecraft.screen.slot.Slot;
import net.minecraft.screen.slot.SlotActionType;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.TickEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.BooleanSetting;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SliderSettings;
import rasty.util.timer.StopWatch;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Deque;

public class AutoBrewer extends ModuleStructure {


    private final BooleanSetting strengthSetting = new BooleanSetting(
            "Р—РµР»СЊРµ СЃРёР»С‹", "Р’Р°СЂРёС‚СЊ Р·РµР»СЊСЏ СЃРёР»С‹ II").setValue(true);

    private final BooleanSetting speedSetting = new BooleanSetting(
            "Р—РµР»СЊРµ СЃРєРѕСЂРѕСЃС‚Рё", "Р’Р°СЂРёС‚СЊ Р·РµР»СЊСЏ СЃРєРѕСЂРѕСЃС‚Рё II").setValue(false);

    private final BooleanSetting fireSetting = new BooleanSetting(
            "РћРіРЅРµСЃС‚РѕР№РєРѕСЃС‚СЊ", "Р’Р°СЂРёС‚СЊ РґР»РёС‚РµР»СЊРЅС‹Рµ Р·РµР»СЊСЏ РѕРіРЅРµСЃС‚РѕР№РєРѕСЃС‚Рё").setValue(false);

    private final SliderSettings delaySetting = new SliderSettings(
            "Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° (РјСЃ)", "Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° РјРµР¶РґСѓ РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРёСЏРјРё")
            .range(100f, 1000f).setValue(250f);


    private final Deque<Runnable> actionQueue = new ArrayDeque<>();


    private final StopWatch timer = new StopWatch();


    private boolean chestHandled   = false;
    private int     lastChestSyncId = -1;


    public AutoBrewer() {
        super("AutoBrew", "РђРІС‚РѕРјР°С‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРё РІР°СЂРёС‚ Р·РµР»СЊСЏ РІ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚РѕР№ Р·РµР»СЊРµРІР°СЂРєРµ", ModuleCategory.MISC);
        settings(strengthSetting, speedSetting, fireSetting, delaySetting);
    }


    @Override
    public void activate() {
        actionQueue.clear();
        chestHandled    = false;
        lastChestSyncId = -1;
        timer.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        actionQueue.clear();
    }


    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null || !isState()) return;
        if (!timer.finished(delaySetting.getInt())) return;


        if (!actionQueue.isEmpty()) {
            actionQueue.poll().run();
            timer.reset();
            return;
        }


        if (mc.currentScreen instanceof GenericContainerScreen
                && mc.player.currentScreenHandler instanceof GenericContainerScreenHandler chest) {

            if (chest.syncId != lastChestSyncId) {
                lastChestSyncId = chest.syncId;
                chestHandled    = false;
            }

            if (!chestHandled) {
                handleChest(chest);
                chestHandled = true;
            }
            return;
        }


        if (mc.currentScreen instanceof BrewingStandScreen
                && mc.player.currentScreenHandler instanceof BrewingStandScreenHandler brew) {
            handleBrewing(brew);
            return;
        }


        actionQueue.clear();
    }


    private void handleChest(GenericContainerScreenHandler chest) {
        int chestSize = chest.getRows() * 9;


        for (int i = chestSize; i < chest.slots.size(); i++) {
            if (!isAnyPotion(chest.slots.get(i).getStack())) continue;
            if (!hasFreeSlotInChest(chest, chestSize)) break;
            final int slot = i;
            actionQueue.add(() ->
                    mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(chest.syncId, slot, 0, SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE, mc.player));
        }


        int bottlesInInv = countWaterBottlesInInv(chest, chestSize);
        int need         = 9 - bottlesInInv;

        if (need > 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < chestSize && need > 0; i++) {
                ItemStack s = chest.slots.get(i).getStack();
                if (!isWaterBottle(s)) continue;

                int take = Math.min(need, s.getCount());
                final int srcSlot = i;
                final int toTake  = take;


                actionQueue.add(() -> pickExactN(chest, srcSlot, toTake, chestSize));
                need -= take;
            }
        }
    }


    private void pickExactN(GenericContainerScreenHandler chest, int srcSlot, int n, int chestSize) {

        mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(chest.syncId, srcSlot, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);


        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            int freeInv = findFreeInvSlot(chest, chestSize);
            if (freeInv == -1) break;
            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(chest.syncId, freeInv, 1, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);
        }


        mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(chest.syncId, srcSlot, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);
    }



    private void handleBrewing(BrewingStandScreenHandler brew) {


        if (brew.getSlot(4).getStack().isEmpty()) {
            int slot = findIngredient(brew, Items.BLAZE_POWDER);
            if (slot == -1) return;
            queueSwapOne(brew, slot, 4);
            return;
        }


        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (brew.getSlot(i).getStack().isEmpty()) {
                int slot = findWaterBottleInBrew(brew);
                if (slot == -1) return;
                queueQuickMove(brew, slot);
                return;
            }
        }


        if (!brew.getSlot(3).getStack().isEmpty()) return;

        if (isPotionType(brew, "water")) {
            placeIngredient(brew, Items.NETHER_WART, 3);
            return;
        }

        if (isPotionType(brew, "awkward")) {
            if (strengthSetting.isValue())        placeIngredient(brew, Items.BLAZE_POWDER, 3);
            else if (speedSetting.isValue())      placeIngredient(brew, Items.SUGAR, 3);
            else if (fireSetting.isValue())       placeIngredient(brew, Items.MAGMA_CREAM, 3);
            return;
        }

        if (isPotionType(brew, "strength") || isPotionType(brew, "swiftness")) {
            placeIngredient(brew, Items.GLOWSTONE_DUST, 3);
            return;
        }

        if (isPotionType(brew, "fire_resistance")) {
            placeIngredient(brew, Items.REDSTONE, 3);
            return;
        }


        if (isPotionType(brew, "strong_strength")
                || isPotionType(brew, "strong_swiftness")
                || isPotionType(brew, "long_fire_resistance")) {
            lootPotions(brew);
        }
    }

    private void placeIngredient(BrewingStandScreenHandler brew, Item item, int slot) {
        int invSlot = findIngredient(brew, item);
        if (invSlot == -1) return;
        queueSwapOne(brew, invSlot, slot);
    }



    private void queueQuickMove(BrewingStandScreenHandler h, int slot) {
        actionQueue.add(() ->
                mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(h.syncId, slot, 0, SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE, mc.player));
    }

    private void queueSwapOne(BrewingStandScreenHandler h, int src, int dst) {
        actionQueue.add(() -> mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(h.syncId, src, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player));
        actionQueue.add(() -> mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(h.syncId, dst, 1, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player));
        actionQueue.add(() -> mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(h.syncId, src, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player));
    }

    private void lootPotions(BrewingStandScreenHandler brew) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (!brew.getSlot(i).getStack().isEmpty()) {
                final int slot = i;
                actionQueue.add(() ->
                        mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(brew.syncId, slot, 0, SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE, mc.player));
            }
        }
    }


    private int countWaterBottlesInInv(GenericContainerScreenHandler chest, int chestSize) {
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = chestSize; i < chest.slots.size(); i++)
            if (isWaterBottle(chest.slots.get(i).getStack())) count++;
        return count;
    }

    private boolean hasFreeSlotInChest(GenericContainerScreenHandler chest, int chestSize) {
        for (int i = 0; i < chestSize; i++)
            if (chest.slots.get(i).getStack().isEmpty()) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private int findFreeInvSlot(GenericContainerScreenHandler chest, int chestSize) {
        for (int i = chestSize; i < chest.slots.size(); i++)
            if (chest.slots.get(i).getStack().isEmpty()) return i;
        return -1;
    }

    private int findIngredient(BrewingStandScreenHandler brew, Item item) {
        for (int i = 5; i < 41; i++)
            if (((Slot) brew.slots.get(i)).getStack().isOf(item)) return i;
        return -1;
    }

    private int findWaterBottleInBrew(BrewingStandScreenHandler brew) {
        for (int i = 5; i < 41; i++) {
            ItemStack s = ((Slot) brew.slots.get(i)).getStack();
            if (isWaterBottle(s)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }


    private boolean isPotionType(BrewingStandScreenHandler brew, String potionPath) {
        boolean found = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            ItemStack s = ((Slot) brew.slots.get(i)).getStack();
            if (s.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (!isPotionId(s, potionPath)) return false;
            found = true;
        }
        return found;
    }

    private boolean isPotionId(ItemStack s, String path) {
        if (s.isEmpty()) return false;
        PotionContentsComponent c = s.get(DataComponentTypes.POTION_CONTENTS);
        if (c == null || c.potion().isEmpty()) return false;
        return c.potion().get().getKey()
                .map(k -> k.getValue().getPath().equals(path))
                .orElse(false);
    }

    private boolean isWaterBottle(ItemStack s) {
        return isPotionId(s, "water");
    }

    private boolean isAnyPotion(ItemStack s) {
        return s.isOf(Items.POTION) || s.isOf(Items.SPLASH_POTION) || s.isOf(Items.LINGERING_POTION);
    }
}

            }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void handleInAuction(GenericContainerScreen screen) {
        if (!inAuction) {
            inAuction = true;
            sentItems.clear();
            boughtItems.clear();
            msg("В§aР’ Р°СѓРєС†РёРѕРЅРµ");

            if (mode.isSelected("РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏСЋС‰РёР№") && !notifiedEnter) {
                network.sendEnterAuction();
                notifiedEnter = true;
            }
        }

        if (mode.isSelected("РџРѕРєСѓРїР°СЋС‰РёР№")) {
            processBuyRequestsInstant(screen);

            if (updateTimer.hasTimeElapsed((long) updateDelay.getValue() - 200)) {
                int clientsInAuction = network.getClientsInAuctionCount();
                if (clientsInAuction > 0) {
                    network.sendUpdateCommand();
                }
                updateAuction(screen);
                updateTimer.resetCounter();
            }
        } else {
            if (pendingUpdate) {
                updateAuction(screen);
                pendingUpdate = false;
            }
            scanAndSendInstant(screen);
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private boolean isSuspiciousPriceScreen(String title, int slots) {
        if (title.contains("РїРѕРґРѕР·СЂРёС‚РµР»СЊРЅ")) return true;
        if (title.contains("РїРѕРґС‚РІРµСЂ")) return true;
        if (title.contains("suspicious")) return true;
        if (title.contains("confirm")) return true;

        if (slots == 63 || slots == 36) {
            if (!title.contains("Р°СѓРєС†РёРѕРЅ") && !title.contains("РїРѕРёСЃРє") && !title.contains("РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЊ")) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)

        mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, 1, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);

    private void updateAuction(GenericContainerScreen screen) {
        int syncId = screen.getScreenHandler().syncId;
        mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, 49, 0, SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE, mc.player);
    }

    private String generateLoreHash(ItemStack stack) {
        var lore = stack.get(DataComponentTypes.LORE);
        if (lore == null || lore.lines().isEmpty()) {
            return "nolore";
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int count = 0;
        for (Text line : lore.lines()) {
            if (count >= 3) break;
            String text = line.getString();
            if (!text.contains("$") && !text.contains("РџСЂoРґaРІeС†") && !text.contains("РСЃС‚eРєaeС‚") && !text.contains("РќР°Р¶РјРёС‚Рµ")) {
                sb.append(text.hashCode());
                count++;
            }
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void scanAndSendInstant(GenericContainerScreen screen) {
        if (!network.isConnected()) return;

        List<AutoBuyableItem> items = autoBuyManager.getEnabledItems();
        if (items.isEmpty()) return;

        for (int i = 0; i < 45 && i < screen.getScreenHandler().slots.size(); i++) {
            Slot slot = screen.getScreenHandler().slots.get(i);
            ItemStack stack = slot.getStack();
            if (stack.isEmpty()) continue;

            if (AuctionUtils.isArmorItem(stack) && AuctionUtils.hasThornsEnchantment(stack)) continue;

            int price = AuctionUtils.getPrice(stack);
            if (price <= 0) continue;

            String itemId = Registries.ITEM.getId(stack.getItem()).toString();
            String loreHash = generateLoreHash(stack);
            String key = itemId + "|" + price + "|" + stack.getCount() + "|" + loreHash;

            if (sentItems.contains(key)) continue;

            processItemForSending(stack, items, key, itemId, price, loreHash);
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void processItemForSending(ItemStack stack, List<AutoBuyableItem> items, String key, String itemId, int price, String loreHash) {
        for (AutoBuyableItem item : items) {
            int maxPrice = item.getSettings().getBuyBelow();
            int minQuantity = item.getSettings().isCanHaveQuantity() ? item.getSettings().getMinQuantity() : 1;

            if (price > maxPrice) continue;

            if (item.getSettings().isCanHaveQuantity()) {
                if (stack.getCount() < minQuantity) continue;
            }

            if (AuctionUtils.compareItem(stack, item.createItemStack())) {
                sentItems.add(key);
                String displayName = item.getDisplayName();
                network.sendBuyCommand(price, itemId, displayName, stack.getCount(), loreHash, maxPrice, minQuantity);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void processBuyRequestsInstant(GenericContainerScreen screen) {
        int syncId = screen.getScreenHandler().syncId;

        BuyRequest request;
        while ((request = network.pollBuyRequest()) != null) {
            String buyKey = request.itemId + "|" + request.price + "|" + request.count + "|" + request.loreHash;
            if (boughtItems.contains(buyKey)) {
                continue;
            }

            boolean found = tryExactMatch(screen, syncId, request, buyKey);

            if (!found) {
                tryFallbackMatch(screen, syncId, request, buyKey);
            }
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private boolean tryExactMatch(GenericContainerScreen screen, int syncId, BuyRequest request, String buyKey) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 45 && i < screen.getScreenHandler().slots.size(); i++) {
            Slot slot = screen.getScreenHandler().slots.get(i);
            ItemStack stack = slot.getStack();
            if (stack.isEmpty()) continue;

            String stackItemId = Registries.ITEM.getId(stack.getItem()).toString();
            if (!stackItemId.equals(request.itemId)) continue;

            int stackPrice = AuctionUtils.getPrice(stack);
            if (stackPrice != request.price) continue;

            if (stack.getCount() != request.count) continue;

            String stackLoreHash = generateLoreHash(stack);
            if (!stackLoreHash.equals(request.loreHash)) continue;

            if (AuctionUtils.isArmorItem(stack) && AuctionUtils.hasThornsEnchantment(stack)) continue;

            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, slot.id, 0, SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE, mc.player);
            boughtItems.add(buyKey);
            msg("В§aвљЎ РљРЈРџРР›: В§f" + request.displayName + " В§aР·Р° " + stackPrice + "$");
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private boolean tryFallbackMatch(GenericContainerScreen screen, int syncId, BuyRequest request, String buyKey) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 45 && i < screen.getScreenHandler().slots.size(); i++) {
            Slot slot = screen.getScreenHandler().slots.get(i);
            ItemStack stack = slot.getStack();
            if (stack.isEmpty()) continue;

            String stackItemId = Registries.ITEM.getId(stack.getItem()).toString();
            if (!stackItemId.equals(request.itemId)) continue;

            int stackPrice = AuctionUtils.getPrice(stack);
            if (stackPrice <= 0 || stackPrice > request.maxPrice) continue;

            if (stack.getCount() < request.minQuantity) continue;

            if (AuctionUtils.isArmorItem(stack) && AuctionUtils.hasThornsEnchantment(stack)) continue;

            String fallbackKey = stackItemId + "|" + stackPrice + "|" + stack.getCount() + "|" + generateLoreHash(stack);
            if (boughtItems.contains(fallbackKey)) continue;

            mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, slot.id, 0, SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE, mc.player);
            boughtItems.add(fallbackKey);
            boughtItems.add(buyKey);
            msg("В§aвљЎ РљРЈРџРР›: В§f" + request.displayName + " В§aР·Р° " + stackPrice + "$");
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void msg(String text) {
        if (notifications.isValue() && mc.player != null) {
        }
    }

    public NetworkManager getNetworkManager() {
        return network;
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    public boolean isFullyEnabled() {
        return isState() && autoBuyManager.isEnabled();
    }
}

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginUltra)
    private void handleDuelLogic() {
        List<String> players = getOnlinePlayers();

        double distance = Math.sqrt(
                Math.pow(lastPosX - mc.player.getX(), 2) +
                        Math.pow(lastPosY - mc.player.getY(), 2) +
                        Math.pow(lastPosZ - mc.player.getZ(), 2)
        );

        if (distance > 500) {
            setState(false);
            return;
        }

        lastPosX = mc.player.getX();
        lastPosY = mc.player.getY();
        lastPosZ = mc.player.getZ();

        if (counter2.hasTimeElapsed(800L * players.size())) {
            sent.clear();
            counter2.resetCounter();
        }

        for (String player : players) {
            if (!sent.contains(player) && !player.equals(mc.player.getGameProfile().name())) {
                if (counter.hasTimeElapsed((long) slowTime.getValue())) {
                    sendDuelRequest(player);
                    sent.add(player);
                    counter.resetCounter();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void sendDuelRequest(String player) {
        if (babki.isValue()) {
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendChatCommand("duel " + player + " " + money.getText());
        } else {
            mc.player.networkHandler.sendChatCommand("duel " + player);
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private void handleScreenInteraction() {
        if (mc.currentScreen != null && mc.player.currentScreenHandler instanceof ScreenHandler chest) {
            String title = mc.currentScreen.getTitle().getString();

            if (title.contains("Р’С‹Р±РѕСЂ РЅР°Р±РѕСЂР° (1/1)")) {
                if (counterChoice.hasTimeElapsed(150)) {
                    int slotID = getKitSlot();
                    if (slotID >= 0) {
                        mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(
                                mc.player.currentScreenHandler.syncId,
                                slotID,
                                0,
                                SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE,
                                mc.player
                        );
                    }
                    counterChoice.resetCounter();
                }
            } else if (title.contains("РќР°СЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєР° РїРѕРµРґРёРЅРєР°")) {
                if (counterTo.hasTimeElapsed(150)) {
                    mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(
                            chest.syncId,
                            0,
                            0,
                            SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE,
                            mc.player
                    );
                    counterTo.resetCounter();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Native(type = Native.Type.VMProtectBeginMutation)
    private int getKitSlot() {
        return switch (mode.getSelected()) {
            case "Р©РёС‚" -> 0;
            case "РЁРёРїС‹ 3" -> 1;
            case "Р›СѓРє" -> 2;
            case "РўРѕС‚РµРјС‹" -> 3;
            case "РќРѕРґРµР±Р°С„С„" -> 4;
            case "РЁР°СЂС‹" -> 5;
            case "РљР»Р°СЃСЃРёРє" -> 6;
            case "Р§РёС‚РµСЂСЃРєРёР№ СЂР°Р№" -> 7;
            case "РќРµР·РµСЂРёС‚РєР°" -> 8;
            default -> -1;
        };
    }

    private List<String> getOnlinePlayers() {
        return mc.player.networkHandler.getPlayerList().stream()
                .map(PlayerListEntry::getProfile)
                .map(GameProfile::name)
                .filter(profileName -> pattern.matcher(profileName).matches())
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.misc;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.ingame.HandledScreen;
import net.minecraft.screen.slot.Slot;
import net.minecraft.screen.slot.SlotActionType;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.TickEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.BooleanSetting;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.SliderSettings;
import rasty.util.Instance;

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.InputEvent;

public class AutoJoiner extends ModuleStructure {

    public static AutoJoiner getInstance() {
        return Instance.get(AutoJoiner.class);
    }

    private final SliderSettings targetSlot = new SliderSettings("РЎР»РѕС‚", "РќРѕРјРµСЂ СЃР»РѕС‚Р° РІ GUI")
            .range(0, 53)
            .setValue(20);

    private final SliderSettings clickDelay = new SliderSettings("Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° (РјСЃ)", "Р—Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєР° РјРµР¶РґСѓ РєР»РёРєР°РјРё")
            .range(50, 5000)
            .setValue(300);

    private final BooleanSetting autoDisable = new BooleanSetting("РђРІС‚Рѕ-РІС‹РєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёРµ", "Р’С‹РєР»СЋС‡РёС‚СЊСЃСЏ РїСЂРё РІС…РѕРґРµ РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ")
            .setValue(true);

    private final BooleanSetting backgroundClick = new BooleanSetting("РљР»РёРє РІ С„РѕРЅРµ", "РљР»РёРєР°С‚СЊ РґР°Р¶Рµ РµСЃР»Рё РѕРєРЅРѕ СЃРІС‘СЂРЅСѓС‚Рѕ")
            .setValue(true);

    private long lastClickTime = 0L;
    private boolean wasInHub = false;
    private Robot robot = null;

    public AutoJoiner() {
        super("AutoJoiner", "Auto Joiner", ModuleCategory.MISC);
        settings(targetSlot, clickDelay, autoDisable, backgroundClick);
        try {
            robot = new Robot();
        } catch (AWTException ignored) {}
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - lastClickTime < (long) clickDelay.getValue()) return;

        if (mc.currentScreen instanceof HandledScreen<?> screen) {
            wasInHub = true;

            var handler = screen.getScreenHandler();
            int slotIndex = targetSlot.getInt();

            if (slotIndex >= handler.slots.size()) return;

            Slot s = handler.slots.get(slotIndex);
            if (!s.hasStack()) return;

            if (mc.isWindowFocused()) {
                mc.interactionManager.clickSlot(handler.syncId, s.id, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, mc.player);
                lastClickTime = now;
            } else if (backgroundClick.isValue() && robot != null) {
                performBackgroundClick(s);
                lastClickTime = now;
            }

        } else if (wasInHub) {
            wasInHub = false;
            if (autoDisable.isValue()) setState(false);
        }
    }

    private void performBackgroundClick(Slot slot) {
        try {
            var window = mc.getWindow();
            int winX = (int) window.getX();
            int winY = (int) window.getY();
            double scaleFactor = window.getScaleFactor();
            int screenX = winX + (int) ((slot.x + 8) * scaleFactor);
            int screenY = winY + (int) ((slot.y + 8) * scaleFactor);
            robot.mouseMove(screenX, screenY);
            robot.mousePress(InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK);
            robot.delay(30);
            robot.mouseRelease(InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

            .setValue(10).range(5, 40).visible(() -> triggerSetting.isSelected("Players"));

        settings(leaveType, triggerSetting, distanceSetting);
    }
