        BOTH
    }

    private static final ParticleMode[] RANDOM_MODES = {
            ParticleMode.CUBES,
            ParticleMode.CROWN,
            ParticleMode.CUBE_BLAST,
            ParticleMode.DOLLAR,
            ParticleMode.HEART,
            ParticleMode.LIGHTNING,
            ParticleMode.LINE,
            ParticleMode.RHOMBUS,
            ParticleMode.SNOWFLAKE,
            ParticleMode.STAR,
            ParticleMode.STAR_ALT,
            ParticleMode.TRIANGLE
    };

    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_CROWN = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/crown.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_CUBE_BLAST = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/cubeblast1.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_DOLLAR = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/dollar.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_HEART = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/heart.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_LIGHTNING = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/lightning.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_LINE = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/line.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_RHOMBUS = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/rhombus.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_SNOWFLAKE = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/snowflake.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_STAR = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/star.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_STAR_ALT = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/star1.png");
    private static final Identifier TEXTURE_TRIANGLE = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/triangle.png");

    private static final Identifier GLOW_BLOOM = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/dashbloom.png");
    private static final Identifier GLOW_BLOOM_SAMPLE = Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/world/dashbloomsample.png");

    private double x, y, z;
    private double lastX, lastY, lastZ;
    private double velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ;
    private long start;
    private float phase;
    private int color;
    private float scale;
    private long lifeTimeMs;
    private float rotation;

    private Animation fadeInAnimation;
    private Animation fadeOutAnimation;
    private float cachedAlpha = 0.0F;
    private long lastAlphaUpdate = 0L;
    private boolean fadingOut = false;

    private float gravityStrength = 0.04f;
    private float velocityMultiplier = 0.98f;
    private boolean collidesWithWorld = true;

    private ParticleMode mode = ParticleMode.CUBES;
    private ParticleMode actualMode = ParticleMode.CUBES;
    private GlowMode glowMode = GlowMode.BOTH;
    private boolean spinning = true;

    public Particle3D(Vec3d pos, Vec3d velocity, int color, float scale, float maxAgeSeconds) {
        this.start = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.phase = (float) (Math.random() * 100.0);
        this.rotation = (float) (Math.random() * 360.0);
        this.x = pos.x;
        this.y = pos.y;
        this.z = pos.z;
        this.lastX = pos.x;
        this.lastY = pos.y;
        this.lastZ = pos.z;
        this.velocityX = velocity.x;
        this.velocityY = velocity.y;
        this.velocityZ = velocity.z;
        this.color = color;
        this.scale = scale;
        this.lifeTimeMs = (long) (maxAgeSeconds * 1000);

        this.fadeInAnimation = new EaseInOutQuad().setMs(150).setValue(1.0);
        this.fadeInAnimation.setDirection(Direction.FORWARDS);
        this.fadeOutAnimation = new EaseInOutQuad().setMs(250).setValue(1.0);
        this.fadeOutAnimation.setDirection(Direction.FORWARDS);
    }

    public Particle3D setGravity(float gravity) {
        this.gravityStrength = gravity;
        return this;
    }

    public Particle3D setVelocityMultiplier(float mult) {
        this.velocityMultiplier = mult;
        return this;
    }

    public Particle3D setCollision(boolean collision) {
        this.collidesWithWorld = collision;
        return this;
    }

    public Particle3D setMode(ParticleMode mode) {
        this.mode = mode;
        if (mode == ParticleMode.RANDOM) {
            this.actualMode = RANDOM_MODES[ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(RANDOM_MODES.length)];
        } else {
            this.actualMode = mode;
        }
        return this;
    }

    public Particle3D setGlowMode(GlowMode glowMode) {
        this.glowMode = glowMode;
        return this;
    }

    public Particle3D setSpinning(boolean spinning) {
        this.spinning = spinning;
        return this;
    }

    public void update() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();

        this.lastX = this.x;
        this.lastY = this.y;
        this.lastZ = this.z;

        this.velocityY -= gravityStrength;

        if (collidesWithWorld && mc.world != null) {
            if (this.isHit(this.x + this.velocityX, this.y, this.z)) {
                this.velocityX *= -0.8;
            } else {
                this.x += this.velocityX;
            }
            if (this.isHit(this.x, this.y + this.velocityY, this.z)) {
                this.velocityX *= 0.999;
                this.velocityZ *= 0.999;
                this.velocityY *= -0.7;
            } else {
                this.y += this.velocityY;
            }
            if (this.isHit(this.x, this.y, this.z + this.velocityZ)) {
                this.velocityZ *= -0.8;
            } else {
                this.z += this.velocityZ;
            }
        } else {
            this.x += this.velocityX;
            this.y += this.velocityY;
            this.z += this.velocityZ;
        }

        this.velocityX /= 0.999999;
        this.velocityZ /= 0.999999;

        if (spinning) {
            this.rotation += 2.0f;
        }

        if (!fadingOut && now - this.start > lifeTimeMs) {
            fadingOut = true;
            this.fadeOutAnimation.setDirection(Direction.BACKWARDS);
        }

        if (now - this.lastAlphaUpdate > 16L) {
            if (fadingOut) {
                this.cachedAlpha = this.fadeOutAnimation.getOutput().floatValue();
            } else {
                this.cachedAlpha = this.fadeInAnimation.getOutput().floatValue();
            }
            this.lastAlphaUpdate = now;
        }
    }

    private boolean isHit(double px, double py, double pz) {
        if (mc.world == null) return false;
        BlockPos pos = BlockPos.ofFloored(px, py, pz);
        return mc.world.getBlockState(pos).isFullCube(mc.world, pos);
    }

    public boolean isDead() {
        return fadingOut && this.cachedAlpha <= 0.0F;
    }

    public float getAlpha() {
        return this.cachedAlpha;
    }

    private Identifier getTexture() {
        return switch (actualMode) {
            case CROWN -> TEXTURE_CROWN;
            case CUBE_BLAST -> TEXTURE_CUBE_BLAST;
            case DOLLAR -> TEXTURE_DOLLAR;
            case HEART -> TEXTURE_HEART;
            case LIGHTNING -> TEXTURE_LIGHTNING;
            case LINE -> TEXTURE_LINE;
            case RHOMBUS -> TEXTURE_RHOMBUS;
            case SNOWFLAKE -> TEXTURE_SNOWFLAKE;
            case STAR -> TEXTURE_STAR;
            case STAR_ALT -> TEXTURE_STAR_ALT;
            case TRIANGLE -> TEXTURE_TRIANGLE;
            default -> null;
        };
    }

    public void render(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider immediate, float glowSize, float partialTicks) {
        float alpha = this.getAlpha();
        if (alpha <= 0.0F) return;

        Vec3d cameraPos = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getCameraPos();
        float cameraYaw = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getYaw();
        float cameraPitch = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getPitch();

        double interpX = MathHelper.lerp(partialTicks, this.lastX, this.x);
        double interpY = MathHelper.lerp(partialTicks, this.lastY, this.y);
        double interpZ = MathHelper.lerp(partialTicks, this.lastZ, this.z);

        float relX = (float) (interpX - cameraPos.x);
        float relY = (float) (interpY - cameraPos.y);
        float relZ = (float) (interpZ - cameraPos.z);

        if (actualMode == ParticleMode.CUBES) {
            renderCube(matrices, immediate, relX, relY, relZ, alpha, glowSize, cameraYaw, cameraPitch);
        } else {
            renderTextured(matrices, immediate, relX, relY, relZ, alpha, glowSize, cameraYaw, cameraPitch);
        }
    }

    private void renderCube(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider immediate,
                            float relX, float relY, float relZ, float alpha, float glowSize,
                            float cameraYaw, float cameraPitch) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        float rotationAnim = (float) (now % 9000L) / 9000.0F * 360.0F;

        float alpha02 = alpha * 0.2F;
        float alpha04 = alpha * 0.4F;
        int glowCol = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, alpha);
        float size = scale * 0.25f;
        float cubeGlow1 = size * glowSize;
        float cubeGlow2 = size * (glowSize / 3.0f);

        float rotY = rotationAnim + this.phase;
        float rotX = rotationAnim * 0.5F;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(relX, relY, relZ);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(rotY));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(rotX));
        Matrix4f mat = matrices.peek().getPositionMatrix();
        ParticleRenderer.drawCube(immediate.getBuffer(ParticleRenderer.getQuadsLayer()), mat, ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, alpha02), size);
        ParticleRenderer.drawLines(immediate.getBuffer(ParticleRenderer.getLinesLayer()), mat, ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, alpha04), size);
        matrices.pop();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(relX, relY, relZ);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-cameraYaw));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(cameraPitch));
        Matrix4f gMat = matrices.peek().getPositionMatrix();

        renderGlowEffect(immediate, gMat, glowCol, alpha, cubeGlow1, cubeGlow2);

        matrices.pop();
    }

    private void renderTextured(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider immediate,
                                float relX, float relY, float relZ, float alpha, float glowSize,
                                float cameraYaw, float cameraPitch) {
        Identifier texture = getTexture();
        if (texture == null) return;

        int glowCol = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, alpha);
        float size = scale * 0.5f;

        int r = (glowCol >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int g = (glowCol >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int b = glowCol & 0xFF;
        int a = (int) (255 * alpha);

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(relX, relY, relZ);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-cameraYaw));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(cameraPitch));

        if (spinning) {
            matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees(rotation));
        }

        Matrix4f mat = matrices.peek().getPositionMatrix();

        RenderLayer layer = ClientPipelines.WORLD_PARTICLES_GLOW.apply(texture);
        VertexConsumer buffer = immediate.getBuffer(layer);

        float half = size / 2.0f;
        buffer.vertex(mat, -half, -half, 0).texture(0, 0).color(r, g, b, a);
        buffer.vertex(mat, -half, half, 0).texture(0, 1).color(r, g, b, a);
        buffer.vertex(mat, half, half, 0).texture(1, 1).color(r, g, b, a);
        buffer.vertex(mat, half, -half, 0).texture(1, 0).color(r, g, b, a);

        matrices.pop();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(relX, relY, relZ);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-cameraYaw));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(cameraPitch));
        Matrix4f gMat = matrices.peek().getPositionMatrix();

        float glowSizePrimary = size * glowSize * 0.5f;
        float glowSizeSecondary = size * glowSize * 0.2f;
        renderGlowEffect(immediate, gMat, glowCol, alpha, glowSizePrimary, glowSizeSecondary);

        matrices.pop();
    }

    private void renderGlowEffect(VertexConsumerProvider immediate, Matrix4f matrix, int color, float alpha, float sizePrimary, float sizeSecondary) {
        switch (glowMode) {
            case BLOOM -> {
                RenderLayer layerBloom = ClientPipelines.WORLD_PARTICLES_GLOW.apply(GLOW_BLOOM);
                ParticleRenderer.drawGlow(immediate.getBuffer(layerBloom), matrix, color, (int) (80.0F * alpha), sizePrimary);
            }
            case BLOOM_SAMPLE -> {
                RenderLayer layerSample = ClientPipelines.WORLD_PARTICLES_GLOW.apply(GLOW_BLOOM_SAMPLE);
                ParticleRenderer.drawGlow(immediate.getBuffer(layerSample), matrix, color, (int) (140.0F * alpha), sizeSecondary);
            }
            case BOTH -> {
                RenderLayer layerBloom = ClientPipelines.WORLD_PARTICLES_GLOW.apply(GLOW_BLOOM);
                RenderLayer layerSample = ClientPipelines.WORLD_PARTICLES_GLOW.apply(GLOW_BLOOM_SAMPLE);
                ParticleRenderer.drawGlow(immediate.getBuffer(layerBloom), matrix, color, (int) (80.0F * alpha), sizePrimary);
                ParticleRenderer.drawGlow(immediate.getBuffer(layerSample), matrix, color, (int) (140.0F * alpha), sizeSecondary);
            }
        }
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.render.particles;

import lombok.Getter;
import net.minecraft.entity.Entity;

@Getter
public class TotemEmitter {

    private final Entity entity;
    private final int maxAge;
    private int age;

    public TotemEmitter(Entity entity, int maxAge) {
        this.entity = entity;
        this.maxAge = maxAge;
        this.age = 0;
    }

    public void tick() {
        age++;
    }

    public boolean isAlive() {
        return age < maxAge && entity != null && !entity.isRemoved();
    }

    public float getProgress() {
        return (float) age / maxAge;
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.render;

import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import org.joml.Matrix4f;
import org.joml.Quaternionf;
import org.joml.Vector3f;
import rasty.events.api.EventHandler;
import rasty.events.impl.WorldRenderEvent;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.modules.module.category.ModuleCategory;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.BooleanSetting;
import rasty.util.render.Render3D;
import rasty.util.repository.friend.FriendUtils;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class PenisESP extends ModuleStructure {

    private final BooleanSetting renderOthers = new BooleanSetting("РћС‚РѕР±СЂР°Р¶Р°С‚СЊ Сѓ РґСЂСѓРіРёС…", "РџРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°С‚СЊ ESP РЅР° РґСЂСѓРіРёС… РёРіСЂРѕРєР°С…");

    public PenisESP() {
        super("PenisESP", ModuleCategory.RENDER);
        settings(renderOthers);
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onWorldRender(WorldRenderEvent e) {
        if (mc.world == null || mc.player == null) return;

        float partialTicks = Render3D.lastTickDelta;
        MatrixStack matrices = new MatrixStack();

        List<LivingEntity> entities = mc.world.getPlayers().stream()
                .filter(LivingEntity::isAlive)
                .filter(ent -> ent.distanceTo(mc.player) <= 15.0f)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        for (LivingEntity entity : entities) {
            boolean isSelf = entity == mc.player;
            boolean isFriend = FriendUtils.isFriend(entity);

            if (!isSelf && !isFriend && !renderOthers.isValue()) {
                continue;
            }

            double x = entity.lastRenderX + (entity.getX() - entity.lastRenderX) * partialTicks;
            double y = entity.lastRenderY + (entity.getY() - entity.lastRenderY) * partialTicks + entity.getHeight() * 0.32;
            double z = entity.lastRenderZ + (entity.getZ() - entity.lastRenderZ) * partialTicks;

            matrices.push();
            matrices.translate(x, y, z);

            Quaternionf rot = new Quaternionf().rotateY((float) Math.toRadians(-entity.getYaw()));
            matrices.multiply(rot);

            int type = isSelf ? 0 : (isFriend ? 1 : 2);
            renderPenis(matrices, type);

            matrices.pop();
        }
    }

    private void renderPenis(MatrixStack matrices, int type) {
        float length = type == 0 ? 0.44f : (type == 1 ? 0.35f : 0.15f);
        float shaftRadius = type == 2 ? 0.04f : 0.11f;
        float ballRadius = type == 2 ? 0.05f : 0.16f;
        float ballOffset = type == 2 ? 0.05f : 0.14f;
        float tipRadius = type == 2 ? 0.045f : 0.12f;
        float tipOffset = type == 2 ? 0.01f : 0.03f;
        float baseZ = type == 2 ? 0.12f : 0.2f;

        int pinkColor = 0xFFFF66CC;
        int redColor = 0xFFFF0000;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0, 0.15, baseZ);
        matrices.multiply(new Quaternionf().rotateX((float)Math.toRadians(90)));
        renderWireCylinder(matrices, shaftRadius, length, 20, pinkColor);
        matrices.pop();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(-ballOffset, 0.15, baseZ);
        matrices.multiply(new Quaternionf().rotateX((float)Math.toRadians(90)));
        renderWireSphere(matrices, ballRadius, 10, 16, pinkColor);
        matrices.pop();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(ballOffset, 0.15, baseZ);
        matrices.multiply(new Quaternionf().rotateX((float)Math.toRadians(90)));
        renderWireSphere(matrices, ballRadius, 10, 16, pinkColor);
        matrices.pop();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0, 0.15, length + tipOffset + baseZ);
        matrices.multiply(new Quaternionf().rotateX((float)Math.toRadians(90)));
        renderWireSphere(matrices, tipRadius, 10, 16, redColor);
        matrices.pop();
    }

    private void drawTransformedLine(MatrixStack matrices, Vec3d p1, Vec3d p2, int color) {
        Matrix4f posMat = matrices.peek().getPositionMatrix();

        Vector3f v1 = new Vector3f((float) p1.x, (float) p1.y, (float) p1.z).mulPosition(posMat);
        Vector3f v2 = new Vector3f((float) p2.x, (float) p2.y, (float) p2.z).mulPosition(posMat);

        Render3D.drawLine(new Vec3d(v1.x, v1.y, v1.z), new Vec3d(v2.x, v2.y, v2.z), color, 1.5f, false);
    }

    private void renderWireCylinder(MatrixStack matrices, float radius, float height, int segments, int color) {
        for (int i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
            double theta1 = 2 * Math.PI * i / segments;
            double theta2 = 2 * Math.PI * (i + 1) / segments;

            float x1 = (float)(radius * Math.cos(theta1));
            float z1 = (float)(radius * Math.sin(theta1));
            float x2 = (float)(radius * Math.cos(theta2));
            float z2 = (float)(radius * Math.sin(theta2));

            Vec3d bottom1 = new Vec3d(x1, 0, z1);
            Vec3d bottom2 = new Vec3d(x2, 0, z2);
            Vec3d top1 = new Vec3d(x1, height, z1);
            Vec3d top2 = new Vec3d(x2, height, z2);

            drawTransformedLine(matrices, bottom1, bottom2, color);
            drawTransformedLine(matrices, top1, top2, color);
            drawTransformedLine(matrices, bottom1, top1, color);
        }
    }

    private void renderWireSphere(MatrixStack matrices, float radius, int latitudeSegments, int longitudeSegments, int color) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= latitudeSegments; i++) {
            double phi = Math.PI * i / latitudeSegments;
            double y = radius * Math.cos(phi);
            double rCircle = radius * Math.sin(phi);

            for (int j = 0; j < longitudeSegments; j++) {
                double theta1 = 2 * Math.PI * j / longitudeSegments;
                double theta2 = 2 * Math.PI * (j + 1) / longitudeSegments;

                float x1 = (float) (rCircle * Math.cos(theta1));
                float z1 = (float) (rCircle * Math.sin(theta1));
                float x2 = (float) (rCircle * Math.cos(theta2));
                float z2 = (float) (rCircle * Math.sin(theta2));

                drawTransformedLine(matrices, new Vec3d(x1, y, z1), new Vec3d(x2, y, z2), color);
            }
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < longitudeSegments; j++) {
            double theta = 2 * Math.PI * j / longitudeSegments;
            for (int i = 0; i < latitudeSegments; i++) {
                double phi1 = Math.PI * i / latitudeSegments;
                double phi2 = Math.PI * (i + 1) / latitudeSegments;

                float x1 = (float) (radius * Math.sin(phi1) * Math.cos(theta));
                float y1 = (float) (radius * Math.cos(phi1));
                float z1 = (float) (radius * Math.sin(phi1) * Math.sin(theta));

                float x2 = (float) (radius * Math.sin(phi2) * Math.cos(theta));
                float y2 = (float) (radius * Math.cos(phi2));
                float z2 = (float) (radius * Math.sin(phi2) * Math.sin(theta));

                drawTransformedLine(matrices, new Vec3d(x1, y1, z1), new Vec3d(x2, y2, z2), color);
            }
        }
    }
}

    private final BooleanSetting wallhack = new BooleanSetting("РЎРєРІРѕР·СЊ СЃС‚РµРЅС‹", "РљРѕР»СЊС†Рѕ РІРёРґРЅРѕ РґР°Р¶Рµ СЃРєРІРѕР·СЊ Р±Р»РѕРєРё")

    private float rotation = 0f;

    public PlayerRing() {
        super("PlayerRing", "3D РєРѕР»СЊС†Рѕ РІРѕРєСЂСѓРі РёРіСЂРѕРєР°", ModuleCategory.RENDER);
        settings(mode, color1, color2, radius, height, lineWidth, wallhack);
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        rotation = 0f;
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onWorldRender(WorldRenderEvent event) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        float delta = event.getPartialTicks();
        rotation += 0.8f * delta;
        if (rotation > 360f) rotation -= 360f;

        float r  = radius.getValue();
        float h  = height.getValue();
        float lw = lineWidth.getValue();
        int   c1 = color1.getColor();
        int   c2 = color2.getColor();
        boolean throughWalls = wallhack.isValue();

        double px = MathHelper.lerp(delta, mc.player.lastRenderX, mc.player.getX());
        double py = MathHelper.lerp(delta, mc.player.lastRenderY, mc.player.getY()) + 0.02;
        double pz = MathHelper.lerp(delta, mc.player.lastRenderZ, mc.player.getZ());

        Vec3d center = new Vec3d(px, py, pz);
        int segments = mode.isSelected("Circle") ? 64 : 8;
        double rotRad = Math.toRadians(rotation);

        renderRing(center, segments, rotRad, r, h, lw, c1, c2, throughWalls);
    }

    private void renderRing(Vec3d center, int segments, double rotRad,
                            float r, float h, float lw,
                            int c1, int c2, boolean noDepth) {
        for (int i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
            float t     = (float) i / segments;
            float tNext = (float) (i + 1) / segments;

            double angle1 = 2 * Math.PI * t     + rotRad;
            double angle2 = 2 * Math.PI * tNext + rotRad;

            float x1 = (float)(Math.cos(angle1) * r);
            float z1 = (float)(Math.sin(angle1) * r);
            float x2 = (float)(Math.cos(angle2) * r);
            float z2 = (float)(Math.sin(angle2) * r);

            float gradT     = (float)(0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(t     * Math.PI * 2));
            float gradTNext = (float)(0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(tNext * Math.PI * 2));

            int topColor     = ColorUtil.lerpColor(c1, c2, gradT);
            int topColorNext = ColorUtil.lerpColor(c1, c2, gradTNext);
            int botColor     = ColorUtil.multAlpha(topColor,     0f);
            int botColorNext = ColorUtil.multAlpha(topColorNext, 0f);

            Vec3d p1top = center.add(x1, 0,  z1);
            Vec3d p2top = center.add(x2, 0,  z2);
            Vec3d p1bot = center.add(x1, -h, z1);
            Vec3d p2bot = center.add(x2, -h, z2);

            int lineColor     = ColorUtil.multAlpha(topColor,     0.9f);
            int lineColorNext = ColorUtil.multAlpha(topColorNext, 0.9f);

            if (noDepth) {

                Render3D.drawGradientQuadNoDepth(p1top, p2top, p2bot, p1bot,
                        topColor, topColorNext, botColorNext, botColor);
                Render3D.drawGradientQuadNoDepth(p1bot, p2bot, p2top, p1top,
                        botColor, botColorNext, topColorNext, topColor);
                Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(p1top, p2top, lineColor, lineColorNext, lw);
            } else {

                Render3D.drawGradientQuad(p1top, p2top, p2bot, p1bot,
                        topColor, topColorNext, botColorNext, botColor, false);
                Render3D.drawGradientQuad(p1bot, p2bot, p2top, p1top,
                        botColor, botColorNext, topColorNext, topColor, false);
                Render3D.drawLineGradient(p1top, p2top, lineColor, lineColorNext, lw, false);
            }
        }
    }
}

    private static final int MAX_TRAIL = 64;


    private final Map<Integer, TrailData> trails = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();


    private final List<LandingLabel> pendingLabels = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());


    public ProjectileTracer() {
        super("ProjectileTracer", "РўСЂР°СЃСЃС‹ СЃРЅР°СЂСЏРґРѕРІ Рё РїСЂРµРґСЃРєР°Р·Р°РЅРёРµ Р±СЂРѕСЃРєР°", ModuleCategory.RENDER);
        settings(showEnderPearls, showArrows, showThrown, showPrediction,
                showDistance, showExplosionRadius, wallhack, onlyOwn,
                trailLength, pearlColor, arrowColor, thrownColor);
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        trails.clear();
        pendingLabels.clear();
    }


    @EventHandler
    public void onWorldRender(WorldRenderEvent event) {
        if (mc.world == null || mc.player == null) return;
        pendingLabels.clear();

        float delta = event.getPartialTicks();
        List<Integer> active = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Entity entity : mc.world.getEntities()) {
            if (!isTrackedProjectile(entity)) continue;
            if (onlyOwn.isValue() && !isOwnProjectile(entity)) continue;

            active.add(entity.getId());
            TrailData td = trails.computeIfAbsent(entity.getId(), k -> new TrailData());

            double ix = MathHelper.lerp(delta, entity.lastRenderX, entity.getX());
            double iy = MathHelper.lerp(delta, entity.lastRenderY, entity.getY());
            double iz = MathHelper.lerp(delta, entity.lastRenderZ, entity.getZ());
            Vec3d interp = new Vec3d(ix, iy, iz);


            if (td.points.isEmpty() || td.points.get(td.points.size() - 1).squaredDistanceTo(interp) > 0.01) {
                td.points.add(interp);
                if (td.points.size() > MAX_TRAIL) td.points.remove(0);
            }
            td.lastPos  = interp;
            td.velocity = entity.getVelocity();
            td.entity   = entity;

            renderProjectileTrail(entity, td);
        }


        trails.keySet().removeIf(id -> !active.contains(id));


        if (showPrediction.isValue()) {
            renderPrediction(delta);
        }
    }


    @EventHandler
    public void onDraw(DrawEvent event) {
        for (LandingLabel label : new ArrayList<>(pendingLabels)) {
            float[] screen = worldToScreen(label.worldPos());
            if (screen == null) continue;
            drawDistanceLabel(screen[0], screen[1], label.text(), label.color());
        }
    }


    private void renderProjectileTrail(Entity entity, TrailData td) {
        int     baseColor = getEntityColor(entity);
        int     len       = Math.max(2, (int) trailLength.getValue());
        boolean wh        = wallhack.isValue();

        List<Vec3d> pts  = td.points;
        int         size = pts.size();
        if (size < 2) return;

        int start = Math.max(0, size - len);


        for (int i = start; i < size - 1; i++) {
            float t  = (float)(i - start) / Math.max(1, size - 1 - start);
            int   c1 = ColorUtil.multAlpha(baseColor, t * 0.75f);
            int   c2 = ColorUtil.multAlpha(baseColor, Math.min(1f, t + 0.08f) * 0.75f);
            float w  = 0.8f + t * 1.4f;

            if (wh) Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(pts.get(i), pts.get(i + 1), c1, c2, w);
            else    Render3D.drawLineGradient(pts.get(i), pts.get(i + 1), c1, c2, w, false);
        }


        boolean isPotion = entity instanceof ThrownItemEntity te &&
                (te.getStack().getItem() instanceof SplashPotionItem ||
                        te.getStack().getItem() instanceof LingeringPotionItem);


        LandingResult land = simulateLanding(td.lastPos, td.velocity, getEntityGravity(entity));
        if (land != null) {
            drawLandingMarker(land.pos(), land.face(), baseColor, isPotion, wh);
        }
    }


    private void drawLandingMarker(Vec3d pos, Direction face, int color, boolean isPotion, boolean wh) {
        final float R   = 0.42f;
        final int   SEG = 36;

        int outerC = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, 0.95f);
        int glowC  = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, 0.20f);
        int crossC = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, 0.55f);


        for (int i = 0; i < SEG; i++) {
            Vec3d p1 = onFace(pos, face, R * 1.40f, 2 * Math.PI * i       / SEG, 0.012);
            Vec3d p2 = onFace(pos, face, R * 1.40f, 2 * Math.PI * (i + 1) / SEG, 0.012);
            if (wh) Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(p1, p2, glowC, glowC, 3.0f);
            else    Render3D.drawLineGradient(p1, p2, glowC, glowC, 3.0f, false);
        }


        for (int i = 0; i < SEG; i++) {
            Vec3d p1 = onFace(pos, face, R, 2 * Math.PI * i       / SEG, 0.022);
            Vec3d p2 = onFace(pos, face, R, 2 * Math.PI * (i + 1) / SEG, 0.022);
            if (wh) Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(p1, p2, outerC, outerC, 1.7f);
            else    Render3D.drawLineGradient(p1, p2, outerC, outerC, 1.7f, false);
        }


        float  cr = R * 0.65f;
        Vec3d ca = onFace(pos, face, cr,  0,             0.026);
        Vec3d cb = onFace(pos, face, cr,  Math.PI,       0.026);
        Vec3d cc = onFace(pos, face, cr,  Math.PI / 2,   0.026);
        Vec3d cd = onFace(pos, face, cr, -Math.PI / 2,   0.026);
        if (wh) {
            Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(ca, cb, crossC, crossC, 1.1f);
            Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(cc, cd, crossC, crossC, 1.1f);
        } else {
            Render3D.drawLineGradient(ca, cb, crossC, crossC, 1.1f, false);
            Render3D.drawLineGradient(cc, cd, crossC, crossC, 1.1f, false);
        }


        if (isPotion && showExplosionRadius.isValue()) {
            drawExplosionRadius(pos, face, color, 4.0f, wh);
        }


        if (showDistance.isValue() && mc.player != null) {
            double dist  = mc.player.getEntityPos().distanceTo(pos);
            String label = String.format("%.1f m", dist);
            pendingLabels.add(new LandingLabel(labelWorldPos(pos, face), label, color));
        }
    }


    private void drawExplosionRadius(Vec3d pos, Direction face, int color, float radius, boolean wh) {
        final int SEG   = 48;
        int       ringC = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, 0.50f);
        int       spokeStart = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, 0.20f);
        int       spokeEnd   = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, 0.04f);


        for (int i = 0; i < SEG; i++) {
            Vec3d p1 = onFace(pos, face, radius, 2 * Math.PI * i       / SEG, 0.03);
            Vec3d p2 = onFace(pos, face, radius, 2 * Math.PI * (i + 1) / SEG, 0.03);
            if (wh) Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(p1, p2, ringC, ringC, 1.0f);
            else    Render3D.drawLineGradient(p1, p2, ringC, ringC, 1.0f, false);
        }


        Vec3d center = onFace(pos, face, 0, 0, 0.026);
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Vec3d edge = onFace(pos, face, radius, 2 * Math.PI * i / 12, 0.03);
            if (wh) Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(center, edge, spokeStart, spokeEnd, 0.5f);
            else    Render3D.drawLineGradient(center, edge, spokeStart, spokeEnd, 0.5f, false);
        }
    }


    private void renderPrediction(float delta) {
        if (mc.player == null) return;
        ItemStack main = mc.player.getMainHandStack();
        ItemStack off  = mc.player.getOffHandStack();
        tryPredictItem(main, delta);
        if (main.isEmpty()) tryPredictItem(off, delta);
    }

    private void tryPredictItem(ItemStack stack, float delta) {
        if (stack.isEmpty()) return;
        Item  item    = stack.getItem();
        boolean wh    = wallhack.isValue();
        Vec3d eyePos  = mc.player.getCameraPosVec(delta);
        Vec3d look    = mc.player.getRotationVec(delta);

        if (item instanceof EnderPearlItem && showEnderPearls.isValue()) {

            drawPredictedPath(eyePos, look.multiply(1.5), 0.03, pearlColor.getColor(), false, wh);

        } else if (item instanceof SnowballItem && showThrown.isValue()) {
            drawPredictedPath(eyePos, look.multiply(1.5), 0.03, thrownColor.getColor(), false, wh);

        } else if (item instanceof EggItem && showThrown.isValue()) {
            drawPredictedPath(eyePos, look.multiply(1.5), 0.03, thrownColor.getColor(), false, wh);

        } else if ((item instanceof SplashPotionItem || item instanceof LingeringPotionItem) && showThrown.isValue()) {

            drawPredictedPath(eyePos, look.multiply(0.5), 0.05, thrownColor.getColor(), true, wh);

        } else if (item instanceof BowItem && showArrows.isValue()) {
            int useTime = mc.player.getItemUseTime();
            if (useTime < 3) return;
            float pull = BowItem.getPullProgress(useTime);
            if (pull <= 0.05f) return;

            drawPredictedPath(eyePos, look.multiply(pull * 3.0), 0.05, arrowColor.getColor(), false, wh);

        } else if (item instanceof CrossbowItem && showArrows.isValue()) {
            if (!CrossbowItem.isCharged(stack)) return;
            float speed = 3.15f;
            int   ac    = arrowColor.getColor();


            drawPredictedPath(eyePos, look.multiply(speed), 0.05, ac, false, wh);


            if (hasMultishot(stack)) {
                int sideColor = ColorUtil.multAlpha(ac, 0.60f);
                Vec3d left  = rotateAroundY(look, Math.toRadians(10)).multiply(speed);
                Vec3d right = rotateAroundY(look, Math.toRadians(-10)).multiply(speed);
                drawPredictedPath(eyePos, left,  0.05, sideColor, false, wh);
                drawPredictedPath(eyePos, right, 0.05, sideColor, false, wh);
            }

        } else if (item instanceof TridentItem && showThrown.isValue()) {
            drawPredictedPath(eyePos, look.multiply(2.5), 0.05, thrownColor.getColor(), false, wh);
        }
    }


    private void drawPredictedPath(Vec3d startPos, Vec3d startVel, double gravity,
                                   int color, boolean isPotion, boolean wh) {
        List<Vec3d>   pts  = new ArrayList<>();
        Vec3d         pos  = startPos;
        Vec3d         vel  = startVel;
        LandingResult land = null;

        for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
            pts.add(pos);
            Vec3d nextPos = pos.add(vel);

            if (mc.world != null) {
                BlockHitResult hit = mc.world.raycast(new RaycastContext(
                        pos, nextPos,
                        RaycastContext.ShapeType.COLLIDER,
                        RaycastContext.FluidHandling.NONE,
                        mc.player));
                if (hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
                    pts.add(hit.getPos());
                    land = new LandingResult(hit.getPos(), hit.getSide());
                    break;
                }
            }

            vel = new Vec3d(vel.x * 0.99, vel.y - gravity, vel.z * 0.99);
            pos = nextPos;
            if (i == 199) land = new LandingResult(pos, Direction.UP);
        }


        for (int i = 0; i < pts.size() - 1; i++) {
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                float t    = (float) i / Math.max(1, pts.size());
                int   segC = ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, 0.25f + t * 0.65f);
                float w    = 0.7f + t * 1.0f;
                if (wh) Render3D.drawLineGradientNoDepth(pts.get(i), pts.get(i + 1), segC, segC, w);
                else    Render3D.drawLineGradient(pts.get(i), pts.get(i + 1), segC, segC, w, false);
            }
        }

        if (land != null) {
            drawLandingMarker(land.pos(), land.face(), color, isPotion, wh);
        }
    }



    private LandingResult simulateLanding(Vec3d pos, Vec3d vel, double gravity) {
        if (mc.world == null) return null;
        for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
            Vec3d nextPos = pos.add(vel);
            BlockHitResult hit = mc.world.raycast(new RaycastContext(
                    pos, nextPos,
                    RaycastContext.ShapeType.COLLIDER,
                    RaycastContext.FluidHandling.NONE,
                    mc.player));
            if (hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
                return new LandingResult(hit.getPos(), hit.getSide());
            }
            vel = new Vec3d(vel.x * 0.99, vel.y - gravity, vel.z * 0.99);
            pos = nextPos;
        }
        return new LandingResult(pos, Direction.UP);
    }



    private void drawDistanceLabel(float sx, float sy, String text, int color) {
        float size = 5.0f;
        float tw   = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(text, size);
        float th   = Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(size);
        float px   = sx - tw / 2f - 3f;
        float py   = sy - th  - 1f;

        int r = (color >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int g = (color >>  8) & 0xFF;
        int b =  color        & 0xFF;

        Render2D.blur(px, py, tw + 6, th + 4, 6f, 2f, 0x00000000);
        Render2D.gradientRect(px, py, tw + 6, th + 4,
                new int[]{
                        new Color(10, 10, 10, 115).getRGB(),
                        new Color( 5,  5,  5, 135).getRGB(),
                        new Color(10, 10, 10, 115).getRGB(),
                        new Color( 5,  5,  5, 135).getRGB()
                }, 2.5f);
        Render2D.outline(px, py, tw + 6, th + 4, 0.3f, new Color(r, g, b, 160).getRGB(), 2.5f);
        Fonts.BOLD.draw(text, px + 3, py + 2, size, ColorUtil.multAlpha(color, 0.95f));
    }


    private Vec3d onFace(Vec3d center, Direction face, float radius, double angle, double surfaceOffset) {
        double cos = Math.cos(angle);
        double sin = Math.sin(angle);
        double ox  = face.getOffsetX() * surfaceOffset;
        double oy  = face.getOffsetY() * surfaceOffset;
        double oz  = face.getOffsetZ() * surfaceOffset;

        return switch (face) {
            case UP, DOWN ->
                    new Vec3d(center.x + ox + cos * radius, center.y + oy,             center.z + oz + sin * radius);
            case NORTH, SOUTH ->
                    new Vec3d(center.x + ox + cos * radius, center.y + oy + sin * radius, center.z + oz);
            case EAST, WEST ->
                    new Vec3d(center.x + ox,             center.y + oy + sin * radius, center.z + oz + cos * radius);
        };
    }


    private Vec3d labelWorldPos(Vec3d pos, Direction face) {
        return switch (face) {
            case UP    -> pos.add( 0.0,  0.65,  0.0);
            case DOWN  -> pos.add( 0.0, -0.65,  0.0);
            case NORTH -> pos.add( 0.0,  0.45, -0.55);
            case SOUTH -> pos.add( 0.0,  0.45,  0.55);
            case EAST  -> pos.add( 0.55, 0.45,  0.0);
            case WEST  -> pos.add(-0.55, 0.45,  0.0);
        };
    }


    private Vec3d rotateAroundY(Vec3d v, double angle) {
        double cos = Math.cos(angle);
        double sin = Math.sin(angle);
        return new Vec3d(v.x * cos + v.z * sin, v.y, -v.x * sin + v.z * cos);
    }


    private double getEntityGravity(Entity e) {
        if (e instanceof EnderPearlEntity)  return 0.03;
        if (e instanceof SnowballEntity)    return 0.03;
        if (e instanceof EggEntity)         return 0.03;
        return 0.05;
    }


    private boolean isTrackedProjectile(Entity e) {
        if (e instanceof EnderPearlEntity)                                          return showEnderPearls.isValue();
        if (e instanceof ArrowEntity || e instanceof SpectralArrowEntity
                || e instanceof TridentEntity)                                      return showArrows.isValue();
        if (e instanceof SnowballEntity || e instanceof EggEntity
                || e instanceof ThrownItemEntity)                                   return showThrown.isValue();
        return false;
    }


    private boolean isOwnProjectile(Entity e) {
        if (mc.player == null) return false;
        if (e instanceof ProjectileEntity pe) return pe.getOwner() == mc.player;
        return false;
    }

    private int getEntityColor(Entity e) {
        if (e instanceof EnderPearlEntity)                                          return pearlColor.getColor();
        if (e instanceof ArrowEntity || e instanceof SpectralArrowEntity
                || e instanceof TridentEntity)                                      return arrowColor.getColor();
        return thrownColor.getColor();
    }


    private boolean hasMultishot(ItemStack stack) {
        if (mc.world == null) return false;
        try {
            var enchants = stack.get(DataComponentTypes.ENCHANTMENTS);
            if (enchants == null) return false;
            var reg   = mc.world.getRegistryManager().getOrThrow(RegistryKeys.ENCHANTMENT);
            var entry = reg.getOptional(Enchantments.MULTISHOT);
            return entry.map(e -> enchants.getLevel(e) > 0).orElse(false);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return false;
        }
    }


    private float[] worldToScreen(Vec3d worldPos) {
        if (mc.getWindow() == null) return null;
        try {
            Vec3d cam = Render3D.lastCameraPos;
            org.joml.Vector4f p = new org.joml.Vector4f(
                    (float)(worldPos.x - cam.x),
                    (float)(worldPos.y - cam.y),
                    (float)(worldPos.z - cam.z), 1.0f);
            p.mul(Render3D.lastWorldSpaceMatrix).mul(Render3D.lastProjMat);
            if (p.w <= 0) return null;
            float nx = p.x / p.w, ny = p.y / p.w;
            if (nx < -1 || nx > 1 || ny < -1 || ny > 1) return null;
            float sw = Render2D.getFixedScaledWidth();
            float sh = Render2D.getFixedScaledHeight();
            return new float[]{ (nx + 1f) / 2f * sw, (1f - ny) / 2f * sh };
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return null;
        }
    }


    private record LandingResult(Vec3d pos, Direction face) {}


    private record LandingLabel(Vec3d worldPos, String text, int color) {}

    private static class TrailData {
        final List<Vec3d> points = new ArrayList<>();
        Vec3d  lastPos  = Vec3d.ZERO;
        Vec3d  velocity = Vec3d.ZERO;
        Entity entity   = null;
    }
}

    @EventHandler
    public void onHandAnimation(HandAnimationEvent e) {

        if (isMainHand) {
            MatrixStack matrix = e.getMatrices();
            float swingProgress = e.getSwingProgress();
            int i = mc.player.getMainArm().equals(Arm.RIGHT) ? 1 : -1;
            float sin1 = MathHelper.sin(swingProgress * swingProgress * (float) Math.PI);
            float sin2 = MathHelper.sin(MathHelper.sqrt(swingProgress) * (float) Math.PI);
            float sinSmooth = (float) (Math.sin(swingProgress * Math.PI) * 0.5F);
            float strength = hitStrengthSetting.getValue();

            if (onlyAura.isValue() ? Aura.getInstance().isState() && Aura.getInstance().target != null : true) {
                if (onlySwing.isValue() ? mc.player.handSwingTicks != 0 : true) {

                            matrix.translate(0.56F * i, -0.44F, -0.72F);
                            matrix.translate(0.0F, 0.33F * -0.6F, 0.0F);
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(45.0F * i));
                            float f = MathHelper.sin(swingProgress * swingProgress * (float) Math.PI);
                            float f2 = MathHelper.sin(MathHelper.sqrt(swingProgress) * (float) Math.PI);
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees(f2 * -20.0F * i * strength));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(f2 * -80.0F * strength));
                            matrix.translate(0.4F, 0.2F, 0.2F);
                            matrix.translate(-0.5F, 0.08F, 0.0F);
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(20.0F));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(-80.0F));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(20.0F));
                        }
                        case "Twist" -> {

                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(80 * i));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(sin2 * -90 * strength));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees((sin1 - sin2) * 60 * i * strength));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(-30));
                            matrix.translate(0, -0.1F, 0.05F);
                        }
                        case "Swipe" -> {
                            matrix.translate(0.56F * i, -0.32F, -0.72F);
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(70 * i));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees(-20 * i));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees((sin2 * sin1) * -5 * strength));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees((sin2 * sin1) * -120 * strength));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(-70));
                        }
                        case "Default" -> {

                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(45 * i));

                        }
                        case "Down" -> {

                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(-100));

                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees((float) i * sin2 * -20.0F * strength));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(sin2 * -80.0F * strength));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees((float) i * -45.0F));

                        }
                        case "Smooth 2" -> {

                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(sin2 * -80.0F * strength));
                            matrix.translate(0, -0.1, 0);
                        }
                        case "Power" -> {
                            matrix.translate(i * 0.56F, -0.32F, -0.72F);
                            matrix.translate((-sinSmooth * sinSmooth * sin1) * i * strength, 0, 0);
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(61 * i));

                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(-60));
                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(sinSmooth * -60 * strength));
                        }

                            matrix.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(35 * i));

                    }
                } else {
                    matrix.translate(i * 0.56F, -0.52F, -0.72F);
                }

package rasty.modules.impl.render;

import net.minecraft.client.render.VertexConsumer;

@FieldDefaults(level = AccessLevel.PRIVATE)

    public static TargetESP getInstance() { return instance; }

    Animation espAnim = new OutBack().setMs(300).setValue(1);
    StopWatch stopWatch = new StopWatch();

    SelectSetting mode = new SelectSetting("Р РµР¶РёРј", "РўРёРї TargetESP")
            .value("Rhomb", "Ghost", "Chain", "Crystals", "Circle").selected("Rhomb");

    SliderSettings crystalRotationSpeed = new SliderSettings("РЎРєРѕСЂРѕСЃС‚СЊ РІСЂР°С‰РµРЅРёСЏ РєСЂРёСЃС‚Р°Р»Р»РѕРІ",
            "РЎРєРѕСЂРѕСЃС‚СЊ РІСЂР°С‰РµРЅРёСЏ РєСЂРёСЃС‚Р°Р»Р»РѕРІ")
            .range(0.1f, 2.0f)
            .visible(() -> mode.isSelected("Crystals"));

    ColorSetting color1 = new ColorSetting("Р¦РІРµС‚ 1", "РџРµСЂРІС‹Р№ С†РІРµС‚ РіСЂР°РґРёРµРЅС‚Р°")
            .value(new java.awt.Color(70, 70, 82, 220).getRGB());
    ColorSetting color2 = new ColorSetting("Р¦РІРµС‚ 2", "Р’С‚РѕСЂРѕР№ С†РІРµС‚ РіСЂР°РґРёРµРЅС‚Р°")
            .value(new java.awt.Color(45, 45, 55, 195).getRGB());
    ColorSetting color3 = new ColorSetting("Р¦РІРµС‚ 3", "РўСЂРµС‚РёР№ С†РІРµС‚ (С‡Р°СЃС‚РёС†С‹ Ghost)")
            .value(new java.awt.Color(22, 22, 30, 170).getRGB())

    private Vec3d smoothedPos = null;
    private LivingEntity lastTarget = null;
    private float movingValue = 0;
    private float hurtProgress = 0;

    private Entity lastRenderedTarget = null;
    private final List<Crystal> crystalList = new ArrayList<>();
    private float rotationAngle = 0;

    private long lastFrameTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
    private static final float TARGET_FPS = 60f;
    private static final float TARGET_FRAME_TIME = 1000f / TARGET_FPS;

    public TargetESP() {
        super("TargetEsp", "Target Esp", ModuleCategory.RENDER);
        instance = this;
        crystalRotationSpeed.setValue(0.5f);
        settings(mode, crystalRotationSpeed, color1, color2, color3);
    }

    private float getDeltaTime() {
        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        float deltaMs = currentTime - lastFrameTime;
        lastFrameTime = currentTime;
        deltaMs = Math.max(1f, Math.min(deltaMs, 100f));
        return deltaMs / TARGET_FRAME_TIME;
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onRender3D(WorldRenderEvent e) {
        float deltaTime = getDeltaTime();
        LivingEntity target = null;
        if (Aura.getInstance() != null && Aura.getInstance().isState()) target = Aura.target;

        if (target == null) {
            smoothedPos = null; lastTarget = null;
            espAnim.setDirection(Direction.BACKWARDS);
            Render3D.resetCircleSmoothing(); return;
        }

        espAnim.setDirection(Direction.FORWARDS);
        float alpha = espAnim.getOutput().floatValue();
        if (alpha <= 0.01f) return;

        movingValue += 2f * deltaTime;
        if (movingValue > 360000) movingValue = 0;

        float hurtDecay = 0.1f * deltaTime;
        hurtProgress = target.hurtTime > 0 ? (float) target.hurtTime / 10f
                : Math.max(0, hurtProgress - hurtDecay);

        Render3D.updateTargetEsp(deltaTime);

        if (mode.isSelected("Circle")) {
            renderCircle(e.getStack(), target, alpha); return;
        }

        MatrixStack stack = e.getStack();
        VertexConsumerProvider.Immediate provider = mc.getBufferBuilders().getEntityVertexConsumers();
        Vec3d camPos = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getCameraPos();
        float partialTicks = e.getPartialTicks();
        Vec3d targetPos = target.getLerpedPos(partialTicks);

        if (lastTarget != target || smoothedPos == null) {
            smoothedPos = targetPos; lastTarget = target;
        } else {
            float sf = Math.min(1.0f, partialTicks * 1.5f);
            smoothedPos = new Vec3d(
                    smoothedPos.x + (targetPos.x - smoothedPos.x) * sf,
                    smoothedPos.y + (targetPos.y - smoothedPos.y) * sf,
                    smoothedPos.z + (targetPos.z - smoothedPos.z) * sf);
        }

        stack.push();
        stack.translate(smoothedPos.x - camPos.x, smoothedPos.y - camPos.y, smoothedPos.z - camPos.z);

        if (mode.isSelected("Rhomb"))        renderRhomb(stack, provider, target, alpha);
        else if (mode.isSelected("Ghost"))   renderGhost(stack, provider, target, alpha);
        else if (mode.isSelected("Chain"))   renderChain(stack, provider, target, alpha, deltaTime);
        else if (mode.isSelected("Crystals")) {
            if (crystalList.isEmpty() || lastRenderedTarget != target) {
                createCrystals(target); lastRenderedTarget = target;
            }
            renderCrystals(stack, provider, target, alpha, deltaTime);
        }

        provider.draw();
        stack.pop();
    }

    private void renderCircle(MatrixStack stack, LivingEntity target, float alpha) {
        int c1 = color1.getColor(), c2 = color2.getColor();
        if (hurtProgress > 0) {
            c1 = lerpColor(c1, 0xFFFF4444, hurtProgress);
            c2 = lerpColor(c2, 0xFFFF4444, hurtProgress);
        }
        Render3D.drawCircle(stack, target, alpha, hurtProgress, c1, c2);
    }

    private void renderChain(MatrixStack stack, VertexConsumerProvider provider, LivingEntity target,
                             float alpha, float deltaTime) {
        VertexConsumer consumer = provider.getBuffer(
                ClientPipelines.CHAIN_ESP.apply(Identifier.of("rasty", "images/world/chain.png")));

        float animValue = (System.currentTimeMillis() % 360000) / 1000f * 60f;
        float gradusX = (float)(20 * Math.min(1 + Math.sin(Math.toRadians(animValue)), 1));
        float gradusZ = (float)(20 * (Math.min(1 + Math.sin(Math.toRadians(animValue)), 2) - 1));
        float width = target.getWidth() * 3;
        int linksStep = 18, totalAngle = 720;
        float chainSizeVal = 8, down = 1.5f, chainScale = 0.5f;
        int alphaVal = MathHelper.clamp((int)(alpha * 128), 0, 128);

        int c1 = color1.getColor(), c2 = color2.getColor();
        if (hurtProgress > 0) {
            c1 = lerpColor(c1, 0xFFFF4444, hurtProgress);
            c2 = lerpColor(c2, 0xFFFF4444, hurtProgress);
        }
        int cc1 = withAlpha(c1, alphaVal), cc2 = withAlpha(c2, alphaVal);
        float rotVal = (System.currentTimeMillis() % 720000) / 1000f * 30f;

        for (int chain = 0; chain < 2; chain++) {
            float val = 1.2f - 0.5f * (chain == 0 ? 1.0f : 0.9f);
            stack.push();
            stack.translate(0, target.getHeight() / 2.0f, 0);
            stack.scale(chainScale, chainScale, chainScale);
            stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees(chain == 0 ? gradusX : -gradusX));
            stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(chain == 0 ? gradusZ : -gradusZ));
            float x = 0, y = -0.5f, z = 0;
            Matrix4f matrix = stack.peek().getPositionMatrix();
            int modif = linksStep / 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < totalAngle; i += modif) {
                float offX = (chain == 0 ? gradusX : -gradusX) / 100F;
                float offZ = (chain == 0 ? -gradusZ : gradusZ) / 100F;
                float prevSin = (float)(x + offX + Math.sin(Math.toRadians(i - modif + rotVal)) * width * val);
                float prevCos = (float)(z + offZ + Math.cos(Math.toRadians(i - modif + rotVal)) * width * val);
                float sin     = (float)(x + offX + Math.sin(Math.toRadians(i + rotVal)) * width * val);
                float cos     = (float)(z + offZ + Math.cos(Math.toRadians(i + rotVal)) * width * val);
                float u0 = 1f / 360f * (float)(i - modif) * chainSizeVal;
                float u1 = 1f / 360f * (float) i * chainSizeVal;
                consumer.vertex(matrix, prevSin, y, prevCos).texture(u0, 0).color(cc1);
                consumer.vertex(matrix, sin, y, cos).texture(u1, 0).color(cc1);
                consumer.vertex(matrix, sin, y + down, cos).texture(u1, 0.99f).color(cc2);
                consumer.vertex(matrix, prevSin, y + down, prevCos).texture(u0, 0.99f).color(cc2);
            }
            stack.pop();
        }
    }

    private void renderRhomb(MatrixStack stack, VertexConsumerProvider provider, LivingEntity target, float alpha) {
        VertexConsumer consumer = provider.getBuffer(
                ClientPipelines.ROMB_ESP.apply(Identifier.of("rasty", "images/world/cube.png")));
        Quaternionf camRot = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getRotation();
        stack.translate(0, target.getHeight() / 2f, 0);
        stack.multiply(camRot);
        float timeRot = (System.currentTimeMillis() % 6283) / 1000f;
        stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees((float) Math.sin(timeRot) * 360));
        float size = 0.5f;
        stack.scale(size, size, 1);
        int c1 = withAlpha(color1.getColor(), (int)(255 * alpha));
        int c2 = withAlpha(color2.getColor(), (int)(255 * alpha));
        Vector3f[] quad = { new Vector3f(-1,-1,0), new Vector3f(-1,1,0), new Vector3f(1,1,0), new Vector3f(1,-1,0) };
        var m = stack.peek();
        consumer.vertex(m, quad[0].x, quad[0].y, 0).texture(0,0).color(c2);
        consumer.vertex(m, quad[1].x, quad[1].y, 0).texture(0,1).color(c1);
        consumer.vertex(m, quad[2].x, quad[2].y, 0).texture(1,1).color(c2);
        consumer.vertex(m, quad[3].x, quad[3].y, 0).texture(1,0).color(c1);
    }

    private void renderGhost(MatrixStack stack, VertexConsumerProvider consumers, LivingEntity target, float alpha) {
        VertexConsumer consumer = consumers.getBuffer(
                ClientPipelines.GHOSTS_ESP.apply(Identifier.of("rasty", "images/particle/ghost-glow.png")));
        stack.translate(0, target.getHeight() * 0.5f, 0);
        particle(stack, consumer, (sin, cos) -> new Vec3d(sin,  cos,  -cos), alpha, 0);
        particle(stack, consumer, (sin, cos) -> new Vec3d(-sin, sin,  -cos), alpha, 1);
        particle(stack, consumer, (sin, cos) -> new Vec3d(-sin, -sin,  cos), alpha, 2);
    }

    private void particle(MatrixStack stack, VertexConsumer consumer, Transformation t, float alpha, int colorIdx) {
        double radius = 0.7f, distance = 11;
        float particleSize = 0.5f;
        int alphaFactor = 15;
        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis();
        int baseColor = switch (colorIdx) { case 0 -> color1.getColor(); case 1 -> color2.getColor(); default -> color3.getColor(); };

        for (int i = 0; i < 40 * alpha; i++) {
            stack.push();
            double angle = 0.15 * ((elapsed * 0.5) - (i * distance)) / 30.0;
            Vec3d trans = t.make(Math.sin(angle) * radius, Math.cos(angle) * radius);
            stack.translate(trans.x, trans.y, trans.z);
            stack.multiply(mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getRotation());
            stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees((elapsed * 0.1f) - (i * 10f)));
            stack.translate(particleSize / 2f, particleSize / 2f, 0);
            float x  = (float) i / 40f;
            int lerpedColor = lerpColor(baseColor, getNextColor(colorIdx), x);
            int cc1 = withAlpha(lerpedColor, (int)((255 - i * alphaFactor) * alpha));
            int cc2 = withAlpha(lerpedColor, (int)((255 - i * alphaFactor) * alpha));
            var m = stack.peek();
            consumer.vertex(m, 0,           -particleSize, 0).texture(0,0).color(cc2);
            consumer.vertex(m, -particleSize,-particleSize, 0).texture(0,1).color(cc1);
            consumer.vertex(m, -particleSize, 0,           0).texture(1,1).color(cc2);
            consumer.vertex(m, 0,            0,            0).texture(1,0).color(cc1);
            stack.pop();
        }
    }

    private void createCrystals(Entity target) {
        crystalList.clear();
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(0, 0.85, 0.8), new Vec3d(-49, 0, 40)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(0.2, 0.85, -0.675), new Vec3d(35, 0, -30)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(0.6, 1.35, 0.6), new Vec3d(-30, 0, 35)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(-0.74, 1.05, 0.4), new Vec3d(-25, 0, -30)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(0.74, 0.95, -0.4), new Vec3d(0, 0, 0)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(-0.475, 0.85, -0.375), new Vec3d(30, 0, -25)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(0, 1.35, -0.6), new Vec3d(45, 0, 0)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(0.85, 0.7, 0.1), new Vec3d(-30, 0, 30)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(-0.7, 1.35, -0.3), new Vec3d(0, 0, 0)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(-0.3, 1.35, 0.55), new Vec3d(0, 0, 0)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(-0.5, 0.7, 0.7), new Vec3d(0, 0, 0)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(0.5, 0.7, 0.7), new Vec3d(0, 0, 0)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(-0.7, 0.75, 0), new Vec3d(0, 0, 0)));
        crystalList.add(new Crystal(new Vec3d(-0.2, 0.65, -0.7), new Vec3d(0, 0, 0)));
    }

    private void renderCrystals(MatrixStack stack, VertexConsumerProvider provider, LivingEntity target,
                                float alpha, float deltaTime) {
        if (target == null || crystalList.isEmpty()) return;
        rotationAngle = (rotationAngle + crystalRotationSpeed.getValue() * deltaTime) % 360;
        stack.push();
        stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(rotationAngle));
        int baseColor = color1.getColor();
        if (hurtProgress > 0) baseColor = lerpColor(baseColor, 0xFFFF4444, hurtProgress);
        for (Crystal crystal : crystalList) crystal.render(stack, provider, alpha, baseColor);
        stack.pop();
    }

    private class Crystal {
        private final Vec3d position, rotation;
        private final float rotationSpeed;
        public Crystal(Vec3d pos, Vec3d rot) {
            this.position = pos; this.rotation = rot;
            this.rotationSpeed = 0.5f + (float)(Math.random() * 1.5f);
        }
        public void render(MatrixStack stack, VertexConsumerProvider provider, float alpha, int baseColor) {
            stack.push();
            stack.translate(position.x, position.y, position.z);
            float timeSeconds = (System.currentTimeMillis() % 31416) / 1000f;
            float pulsation   = 1.0f + (float)(Math.sin(timeSeconds * 2f) * 0.1f);
            stack.scale(pulsation, pulsation, pulsation);
            float selfRot = (System.currentTimeMillis() % 36000) / 100.0f * rotationSpeed;
            stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees((float) rotation.x));
            stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees((float) rotation.y + selfRot));
            stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees((float) rotation.z));
            float userAlpha = 0.3f;
            VertexConsumer filledConsumer = provider.getBuffer(ClientPipelines.CRYSTAL_FILLED);
            drawFilledCrystal(stack, filledConsumer, baseColor, userAlpha * 0.85f, alpha);
            VertexConsumer glowConsumer = provider.getBuffer(ClientPipelines.CRYSTAL_GLOW);
            stack.push(); stack.scale(1.15f, 1.15f, 1.15f);
            drawFilledCrystal(stack, glowConsumer, baseColor, userAlpha * 0.25f, alpha); stack.pop();
            stack.push(); stack.scale(1.3f, 1.3f, 1.3f);
            drawFilledCrystal(stack, glowConsumer, baseColor, userAlpha * 0.1f, alpha); stack.pop();
            drawBloomEffect(stack, provider, baseColor, alpha);
            stack.pop();
        }
        private void drawFilledCrystal(MatrixStack stack, VertexConsumer consumer, int baseColor,
                                       float alphaMultiplier, float anim) {
            float s = 0.05f, h_prism = s * 1.0f, h_pyramid = s * 1.5f;
            int numSides = 8;
            List<Vector3f> top = new ArrayList<>(), bot = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < numSides; i++) {
                float angle = (float)(2 * Math.PI * i / numSides);
                float x = (float)(s * Math.cos(angle)), z = (float)(s * Math.sin(angle));
                top.add(new Vector3f(x,  h_prism / 2, z));
                bot.add(new Vector3f(x, -h_prism / 2, z));
            }
            Vector3f vTop = new Vector3f(0,  h_prism / 2 + h_pyramid, 0);
            Vector3f vBot = new Vector3f(0, -h_prism / 2 - h_pyramid, 0);
            int finalAlpha  = (int)(alphaMultiplier * 255 * anim);
            int finalColor  = withAlpha(baseColor, finalAlpha);
            int darkerColor = withAlpha(darkenColor(baseColor, 0.7f), finalAlpha);
            int lighterColor = withAlpha(lightenColor(baseColor, 1.2f), finalAlpha);
            Matrix4f matrix = stack.peek().getPositionMatrix();
            for (int i = 0; i < numSides; i++) {
                drawQuadFilled(matrix, consumer, bot.get(i), bot.get((i+1)%numSides),
                        top.get((i+1)%numSides), top.get(i), (i%2==0) ? finalColor : darkerColor);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < numSides; i++)
                drawTriangleFilled(matrix, consumer, vTop, top.get((i+1)%numSides), top.get(i),
                        (i%2==0) ? lighterColor : finalColor);
            for (int i = 0; i < numSides; i++)
                drawTriangleFilled(matrix, consumer, vBot, bot.get(i), bot.get((i+1)%numSides),
                        (i%2==0) ? darkerColor : finalColor);
        }
        private void drawTriangleFilled(Matrix4f m, VertexConsumer c, Vector3f v1, Vector3f v2, Vector3f v3, int col) {
            c.vertex(m,v1.x,v1.y,v1.z).color(col); c.vertex(m,v2.x,v2.y,v2.z).color(col);
            c.vertex(m,v3.x,v3.y,v3.z).color(col); c.vertex(m,v3.x,v3.y,v3.z).color(col);
        }
        private void drawQuadFilled(Matrix4f m, VertexConsumer c, Vector3f v1, Vector3f v2, Vector3f v3, Vector3f v4, int col) {
            c.vertex(m,v1.x,v1.y,v1.z).color(col); c.vertex(m,v2.x,v2.y,v2.z).color(col);
            c.vertex(m,v3.x,v3.y,v3.z).color(col); c.vertex(m,v4.x,v4.y,v4.z).color(col);
        }
        private void drawBloomEffect(MatrixStack stack, VertexConsumerProvider provider, int baseColor, float anim) {
            VertexConsumer bloomConsumer = provider.getBuffer(
                    ClientPipelines.BLOOM_ESP.apply(Identifier.of("rasty", "images/particle/glow.png")));
            int bloomAlpha = (int)(0.3f * 60 * anim);
            int bloomColor = withAlpha(baseColor, bloomAlpha);
            float bloomSize = 0.05f * 15.0f;
            Quaternionf camRot = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getRotation();
            int segments = 6;
            for (int i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
                stack.push();
                stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(360f / segments * i));
                stack.multiply(camRot);
                Matrix4f matrix = stack.peek().getPositionMatrix();
                bloomConsumer.vertex(matrix,-bloomSize/2,-bloomSize/2,0).texture(0,1).color(bloomColor);
                bloomConsumer.vertex(matrix, bloomSize/2,-bloomSize/2,0).texture(1,1).color(bloomColor);
                bloomConsumer.vertex(matrix, bloomSize/2, bloomSize/2,0).texture(1,0).color(bloomColor);
                bloomConsumer.vertex(matrix,-bloomSize/2, bloomSize/2,0).texture(0,0).color(bloomColor);
                stack.pop();
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
                stack.push();
                stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(90));
                stack.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(360f / segments * i));
                stack.multiply(camRot);
                Matrix4f matrix = stack.peek().getPositionMatrix();
                bloomConsumer.vertex(matrix,-bloomSize/2,-bloomSize/2,0).texture(0,1).color(bloomColor);
                bloomConsumer.vertex(matrix, bloomSize/2,-bloomSize/2,0).texture(1,1).color(bloomColor);
                bloomConsumer.vertex(matrix, bloomSize/2, bloomSize/2,0).texture(1,0).color(bloomColor);
                bloomConsumer.vertex(matrix,-bloomSize/2, bloomSize/2,0).texture(0,0).color(bloomColor);
                stack.pop();
            }
        }
    }

    private int darkenColor(int color, float f) {
        int a=(color>>24)&0xFF, r=(int)(((color>>16)&0xFF)*f), g=(int)(((color>>8)&0xFF)*f), b=(int)((color&0xFF)*f);
        return (a<<24)|(r<<16)|(g<<8)|b;
    }
    private int lightenColor(int color, float f) {
        int a=(color>>24)&0xFF;
        int r=Math.min(255,(int)(((color>>16)&0xFF)*f)), g=Math.min(255,(int)(((color>>8)&0xFF)*f)), b=Math.min(255,(int)((color&0xFF)*f));
        return (a<<24)|(r<<16)|(g<<8)|b;
    }
    private int getNextColor(int colorIndex) {
        return switch (colorIndex) { case 0 -> color2.getColor(); case 1 -> color3.getColor(); default -> color1.getColor(); };
    }
    private int lerpColor(int c1, int c2, float t) {
        int a1=(c1>>24)&0xFF, r1=(c1>>16)&0xFF, g1=(c1>>8)&0xFF, b1=c1&0xFF;
        int a2=(c2>>24)&0xFF, r2=(c2>>16)&0xFF, g2=(c2>>8)&0xFF, b2=c2&0xFF;
        return (((int)(a1+(a2-a1)*t))<<24)|(((int)(r1+(r2-r1)*t))<<16)|(((int)(g1+(g2-g1)*t))<<8)|((int)(b1+(b2-b1)*t));
    }
    private int withAlpha(int color, int alpha) {
        alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, alpha));
        return (color & 0x00FFFFFF) | (alpha << 24);
    }

    @FunctionalInterface
    private interface Transformation { Vec3d make(double sin, double cos); }
}

    public void onHandOffset(HandOffsetEvent e) {
        Hand hand = e.getHand();
        if (hand.equals(Hand.MAIN_HAND) && e.getStack().getItem() instanceof CrossbowItem) return;

        MatrixStack matrix = e.getMatrices();

        if (hand.equals(Hand.MAIN_HAND)) {
            matrix.translate(mainHandXSetting.getValue(), mainHandYSetting.getValue(), mainHandZSetting.getValue());

            matrix.translate(offHandXSetting.getValue(), offHandYSetting.getValue(), offHandZSetting.getValue());
        }
    }

            .visible(() -> !randomColor.isValue());

    public WorldParticles() {
        super("WorldParticles", "Р›РµС‚Р°СЋС‰РёРµ С‡Р°СЃС‚РёС†С‹ РІ РјРёСЂРµ", ModuleCategory.RENDER);
        settings(mode, cubeCount, lifeTime, size, glowSize, physics, randomColor, whiteOnSpawn, whiteCenter, cubeColor);
    }

    @Override
    public void deactivate() {
        particles.clear();
        lastPlayerPos = Vec3d.ZERO;
        playerVelocity = Vec3d.ZERO;
        playerSpeed = 0;
    }

    private Particle.ParticleType getParticleType() {
        String selected = mode.getSelected();
        return switch (selected) {
            case "3D РљСѓР±С‹" -> Particle.ParticleType.CUBE_3D;
            case "РљРѕСЂРѕРЅР°" -> Particle.ParticleType.CROWN;
            case "РљСѓР±" -> Particle.ParticleType.CUBE_BLAST;
            case "Р”РѕР»Р»Р°СЂ" -> Particle.ParticleType.DOLLAR;
            case "РЎРµСЂРґС†Рµ" -> Particle.ParticleType.HEART;
            case "РњРѕР»РЅРёСЏ" -> Particle.ParticleType.LIGHTNING;
            case "Р›РёРЅРёСЏ" -> Particle.ParticleType.LINE;
            case "Р РѕРјР±" -> Particle.ParticleType.RHOMBUS;
            case "РЎРЅРµР¶РёРЅРєР°" -> Particle.ParticleType.SNOWFLAKE;
            case "Р—РІРµР·РґР°" -> Particle.ParticleType.STAR;
            case "Р—РІРµР·РґР° 2" -> Particle.ParticleType.STAR_ALT;
            case "РўСЂРµСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅРёРє" -> Particle.ParticleType.TRIANGLE;
            case "РЎРІРµС‡РµРЅРёРµ" -> Particle.ParticleType.GLOW;
            case "Р Р°РЅРґРѕРј" -> Particle.ParticleType.RANDOM;
            default -> Particle.ParticleType.CUBE_3D;
        };
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onTick(TickEvent e) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.world == null) return;

        Vec3d currentPos = mc.player.getEntityPos();

        if (lastPlayerPos != Vec3d.ZERO) {
            playerVelocity = currentPos.subtract(lastPlayerPos);
            playerSpeed = playerVelocity.horizontalLength();
        }
        lastPlayerPos = currentPos;

        double despawnDistSq = ParticleSpawner.getDespawnDistanceSquared();
        for (Particle p : particles) {
            if (!p.isFadingOut()) {
                double distSq = p.getHorizontalDistanceSquaredTo(currentPos);
                if (distSq > despawnDistSq) {
                    p.startFadeOut();
                }
            }
        }

        int actualDelay = ParticleSpawner.calculateSpawnDelay(playerSpeed);

        if (particles.size() < cubeCount.getValue() && timer.finished(actualDelay)) {
            int spawnCount = ParticleSpawner.calculateSpawnCount(playerSpeed, particles.size(), (int) cubeCount.getValue());
            long lifeTimeMs = (long) (lifeTime.getValue() * 1000);
            Particle.ParticleType type = getParticleType();

            for (int i = 0; i < spawnCount && particles.size() < cubeCount.getValue(); i++) {
                Particle particle = ParticleSpawner.createParticle(currentPos, playerVelocity, playerSpeed, lifeTimeMs, type);
                particle.setPhysics(physics.isValue());
                particle.setSize(size.getValue());
                particles.add(particle);
            }

            timer.reset();
        }
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onWorldRender(WorldRenderEvent e) {
        if (particles.isEmpty()) return;

        VertexConsumerProvider.Immediate immediate = mc.getBufferBuilders().getEntityVertexConsumers();
        MatrixStack matrices = e.getStack();
        Vec3d cameraPos = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getCameraPos();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        float cameraYaw = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getYaw();
        float cameraPitch = mc.gameRenderer.getCamera().getPitch();
        float rotation = (float) (now % 9000L) / 9000.0F * 360.0F;
        int baseColor = cubeColor.getColor();
        float glow = glowSize.getValue();
        boolean useRandomColor = randomColor.isValue();
        boolean useWhiteOnSpawn = whiteOnSpawn.isValue();
        boolean useWhiteCenter = whiteCenter.isValue();

        Iterator<Particle> iterator = particles.iterator();
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            Particle p = iterator.next();
            p.update(now);
            if (p.shouldRemove()) {
                iterator.remove();
            }
        }

        for (Particle p : particles) {
            double distSq = p.getDistanceSquaredTo(cameraPos);
            if (distSq < 150 * 150) {
                p.render(matrices, immediate, cameraPos, baseColor, rotation, cameraYaw, cameraPitch, glow, useRandomColor, useWhiteOnSpawn, useWhiteCenter);
            }
        }

        immediate.draw();
    }
}

package rasty.modules.impl.render.worldparticles;

import net.minecraft.client.render.RenderLayer;
