package rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.render;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.handler.ModuleAnimationHandler;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.handler.ModuleBindHandler;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.handler.ModuleScrollHandler;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.util.ModuleDisplayHelper;
import rasty.util.render.Render2D;
import rasty.util.render.shader.Scissor;
import rasty.util.render.font.Fonts;

import java.awt.*;
import java.util.List;

public class ModuleListRenderer {

    private static final float MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT = 20f;
    private static final float CORNER_RADIUS     = 6f;
    private static final float CORNER_INSET      = 3f;
    private static final float STATE_BALL_SIZE   = 3f;
    private static final float BIND_BOX_HEIGHT   = 9f;
    private static final float BIND_BOX_MIN_W    = 18f;
    private static final float BIND_BOX_PADDING  = 6f;
    private static final float BIND_WIDTH_SPEED  = 12f;

    private final ModuleAnimationHandler animationHandler;
    private final ModuleBindHandler      bindHandler;
    private final ModuleDisplayHelper    displayHelper;

    public ModuleListRenderer(ModuleAnimationHandler animationHandler,
                              ModuleBindHandler bindHandler,
                              ModuleDisplayHelper displayHelper) {
        this.animationHandler = animationHandler;
        this.bindHandler      = bindHandler;
        this.displayHelper    = displayHelper;
    }

    private int clamp(int value) {
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, value));
    }

    public void render(DrawContext context,
                       List<ModuleStructure> displayModules,
                       ModuleStructure selectedModule,
                       ModuleStructure bindingModule,
                       float x, float y, float width, float height,
                       float mouseX, float mouseY,
                       int guiScale, float alphaMultiplier,
                       ModuleAnimationHandler animHandler,
                       ModuleScrollHandler scrollHandler) {


        Render2D.blur(x, y, width, height, 15f, 5f, 0x00000000);
        Render2D.gradientRect(x, y, width, height,
                new int[]{
                        new Color(15, 15, 15, clamp((int)(90 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(),
                        new Color(8,  8,  8,  clamp((int)(110 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(),
                        new Color(15, 15, 15, clamp((int)(90 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(),
                        new Color(8,  8,  8,  clamp((int)(110 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB()
                }, CORNER_RADIUS);
        Render2D.outline(x, y, width, height, 0.35f,
                new Color(90, 90, 90, clamp((int)(180 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(), CORNER_RADIUS);

        float clipX = x + CORNER_INSET;
        float clipY = y + CORNER_INSET - 1.5f;
        float clipW = width  - CORNER_INSET * 2;
        float clipH = height - CORNER_INSET * 2 + 3f;

        Scissor.enable(clipX, clipY, clipW, clipH, guiScale);

        float itemY = y + CORNER_INSET + 2f + (float) scrollHandler.getModuleDisplayScroll();

        for (ModuleStructure module : displayModules) {
            float itemProgress  = animHandler.getModuleAnimations().getOrDefault(module, 1f);
            float alphaAnim     = animHandler.getModuleAlphaAnimations().getOrDefault(module, 1f);
            float combinedAlpha = itemProgress * alphaMultiplier * alphaAnim;

            if (combinedAlpha <= 0.01f) {
                itemY += MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT + 2f;
                continue;
            }
            if (itemY + MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT < y + CORNER_INSET || itemY > y + height - CORNER_INSET) {
                itemY += MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT + 2f;
                continue;
            }

            float hoverAnim    = animHandler.getHoverAnimations().getOrDefault(module, 0f);
            float stateAnim    = animHandler.getStateAnimations().getOrDefault(module, module.isState() ? 1f : 0f);
            float favoriteAnim = animHandler.getFavoriteAnimations().getOrDefault(module, 0f);
            boolean isSelected = (module == selectedModule);

            renderModuleRow(context, module, bindingModule, x, itemY, width,
                    combinedAlpha, hoverAnim, stateAnim, favoriteAnim, isSelected, animHandler);

            itemY += MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT + 2f;
        }

        Scissor.disable();

        renderScrollFade(clipX, clipY, clipW, clipH,
                scrollHandler.getModuleScrollTopFade()    * alphaMultiplier,
                scrollHandler.getModuleScrollBottomFade() * alphaMultiplier);
    }

    private void renderModuleRow(DrawContext context, ModuleStructure module, ModuleStructure bindingModule,
                                 float listX, float rowY, float listWidth,
                                 float combinedAlpha, float hoverAnim, float stateAnim, float favoriteAnim,
                                 boolean isSelected, ModuleAnimationHandler animHandler) {

        float rowX = listX + CORNER_INSET;
        float rowW = listWidth - CORNER_INSET * 2;

        int bgGray  = isSelected ? 80 : clamp((int)(55 + 30 * hoverAnim));
        int bgAlpha = isSelected
                ? clamp((int)(50 * combinedAlpha))
                : clamp((int)((20 + 25 * hoverAnim) * combinedAlpha));
        Render2D.rect(rowX, rowY, rowW, MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT,
                new Color(bgGray, bgGray, bgGray, bgAlpha).getRGB(), isSelected ? 4f : 5f);

        if (isSelected) {
            float pulse = (float)(Math.sin(animHandler.getSelectedPulseAnimation()) * 0.5 + 0.5);
            Render2D.outline(rowX, rowY, rowW, MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT, 0.5f,
                    new Color(130, 130, 130, clamp((int)((60 + 40 * pulse) * combinedAlpha))).getRGB(), 4f);
        } else if (hoverAnim > 0.01f) {
            Render2D.outline(rowX, rowY, rowW, MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT, 0.5f,
                    new Color(100, 100, 100, clamp((int)(50 * hoverAnim * combinedAlpha))).getRGB(), 5f);
        }

        if (stateAnim > 0.01f) {
            float ballX = rowX + 6f;
            float ballY = rowY + (MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT - STATE_BALL_SIZE) / 2f + 1f;
            Render2D.rect(ballX, ballY, STATE_BALL_SIZE, STATE_BALL_SIZE,
                    new Color(255, 255, 255, clamp((int)(200 * stateAnim * combinedAlpha))).getRGB(),
                    STATE_BALL_SIZE / 2f);
        }

        float stateOffset = stateAnim * 6f;

        int textGray  = clamp((int)(128 + 127 * stateAnim + 30 * hoverAnim));
        int textAlpha = clamp((int)((170 + 85 * stateAnim) * combinedAlpha));
        Fonts.BOLD.draw(module.getName(), rowX + 12f + stateOffset, rowY + (MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT - 6f) / 2f, 6f,
                new Color(textGray, textGray, textGray, textAlpha).getRGB());

        renderBindBox(module, bindingModule, rowX, rowY, rowW, MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT,
                1f, combinedAlpha, stateOffset, animHandler);

        float starX = rowX + rowW - 12f;
        float starY = rowY + (MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT - 8f) / 2f;
        int starR = clamp((int)(50 + (255 - 50) * favoriteAnim));
        int starG = clamp((int)(50 + (215 - 50) * favoriteAnim));
        int starB = clamp((int)(50 + (  0 - 50) * favoriteAnim));
        Fonts.GUI_ICONS.draw("D", starX, starY + 1f, 8f,
                new Color(starR, starG, starB,
                        clamp((int)((60 + 120 * favoriteAnim + 55 * hoverAnim) * combinedAlpha))).getRGB());

        float toggleX = rowX + rowW - 26f;
        float toggleY = rowY + (MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT - 7f) / 2f;
        float toggleW = 12f, toggleH = 7f;
        int toggleGreen = clamp((int)(80 * stateAnim));
        Render2D.rect(toggleX, toggleY, toggleW, toggleH,
                new Color(clamp((int)(50 * stateAnim)), toggleGreen, clamp((int)(50 * stateAnim)),
                        clamp((int)((20 + 35 * stateAnim) * combinedAlpha))).getRGB(), toggleH / 2f);
        Render2D.outline(toggleX, toggleY, toggleW, toggleH, 0.5f,
                new Color(80, 80, 80, clamp((int)(120 * combinedAlpha))).getRGB(), toggleH / 2f);
        float knobX    = toggleX + 1f + (toggleW - toggleH) * stateAnim;
        float knobSize = toggleH - 2f;
        Render2D.rect(knobX, toggleY + 1f, knobSize, knobSize,
                new Color(200, 200, 200, clamp((int)(230 * combinedAlpha))).getRGB(), knobSize / 2f);
    }

    private void renderBindBox(ModuleStructure module, ModuleStructure bindingModule,
                               float moduleX, float moduleY, float moduleWidth, float moduleHeight,
                               float scale, float combinedAlpha, float stateTextOffset,
                               ModuleAnimationHandler animHandler) {
        boolean isBinding = (module == bindingModule);
        int key = module.getKey();
        float bindAlpha = animHandler.getBindBoxAlphaAnimations().getOrDefault(module, 0f);

        if (bindAlpha <= 0.01f && !isBinding && (key == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UNKNOWN || key == -1)) return;

        String bindText   = isBinding ? "..." : bindHandler.getBindDisplayName(key);
        float textWidth   = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(bindText, 5 * scale);
        float targetWidth = Math.max(BIND_BOX_MIN_W, textWidth + BIND_BOX_PADDING * 2);
        float curWidth    = animHandler.getBindBoxWidthAnimations().getOrDefault(module, targetWidth);

        float wDiff = targetWidth - curWidth;
        if (Math.abs(wDiff) > 0.1f) {
            curWidth += wDiff * BIND_WIDTH_SPEED * 0.016f;
            animHandler.getBindBoxWidthAnimations().put(module, curWidth);
        } else {
            animHandler.getBindBoxWidthAnimations().put(module, targetWidth);
            curWidth = targetWidth;
        }

        float boxH   = BIND_BOX_HEIGHT * scale;
        float boxW   = curWidth * scale * bindAlpha;
        float nameW  = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(module.getName(), 6 * scale);
        float boxX   = moduleX + 12f + stateTextOffset + nameW + 2f;
        float boxY   = moduleY + (moduleHeight - boxH) / 2f + 0.5f;
        float fAlpha = combinedAlpha * bindAlpha;

        Render2D.rect(boxX + 3, boxY + 0.5f, boxW - 6, boxH,
                new Color(50, 50, 55, clamp((int)(30 * fAlpha))).getRGB(), 3f * scale);
        Render2D.outline(boxX + 3, boxY + 0.5f, boxW - 6, boxH, 0.5f,
                new Color(80, 80, 85, clamp((int)(60 * fAlpha))).getRGB(), 3f * scale);

        if (bindAlpha > 0.5f) {
            Fonts.BOLD.draw(bindText,
                    boxX + (boxW - textWidth) / 2f,
                    boxY + (boxH - 5f * scale) / 2f,
                    5 * scale,
                    new Color(140, 140, 145, clamp((int)(160 * fAlpha))).getRGB());
        }
    }

    private void renderScrollFade(float x, float y, float w, float h, float topFade, float bottomFade) {
        int size = 15, alpha = 80;
        if (topFade > 0.01f) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                Render2D.rect(x, y + i, w, 1,
                        new Color(20, 20, 20, clamp((int)(alpha * topFade * (1f - i / (float) size)))).getRGB(), 0f);
            }
        }
        if (bottomFade > 0.01f) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                Render2D.rect(x, y + h - size + i, w, 1,
                        new Color(20, 20, 20, clamp((int)(alpha * bottomFade * (i / (float) size)))).getRGB(), 0f);
            }
        }
    }


    private float clipTop(float listY)              { return listY + CORNER_INSET; }
    private float clipBottom(float listY, float h)  { return listY + h - CORNER_INSET; }

    public ModuleStructure getModuleAtPosition(List<ModuleStructure> displayModules,
                                               double mouseX, double mouseY,
                                               float listX, float listY,
                                               float listWidth, float listHeight,
                                               double scrollOffset, boolean isTransitioning) {
        if (isTransitioning) return null;


        float cTop    = clipTop(listY);
        float cBottom = clipBottom(listY, listHeight);
        if (mouseX < listX || mouseX > listX + listWidth) return null;
        if (mouseY < cTop  || mouseY > cBottom)           return null;

        float startY = listY + CORNER_INSET + 2f + (float) scrollOffset;

        for (ModuleStructure module : displayModules) {
            float rowTop    = startY;
            float rowBottom = startY + MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT;


            if (rowTop < cBottom && rowBottom > cTop) {
                if (mouseY >= rowTop && mouseY <= rowBottom) {
                    return module;
                }
            }

            startY += MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT + 2f;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public ModuleStructure getModuleForStarClick(List<ModuleStructure> displayModules,
                                                 double mouseX, double mouseY,
                                                 float listX, float listY,
                                                 float listWidth, float listHeight,
                                                 double scrollOffset,
                                                 ModuleDisplayHelper displayHelper,
                                                 boolean isTransitioning) {
        if (isTransitioning) return null;

        float cTop    = clipTop(listY);
        float cBottom = clipBottom(listY, listHeight);
        if (mouseY < cTop || mouseY > cBottom) return null;

        float rowX   = listX + CORNER_INSET;
        float rowW   = listWidth - CORNER_INSET * 2;
        float startY = listY + CORNER_INSET + 2f + (float) scrollOffset;

        for (ModuleStructure module : displayModules) {
            float rowTop    = startY;
            float rowBottom = startY + MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT;

            if (rowTop < cBottom && rowBottom > cTop) {
                if (mouseY >= rowTop && mouseY <= rowBottom) {
                    float starX = rowX + rowW - 12f;
                    if (mouseX >= starX && mouseX <= starX + 10f) return module;
                }
            }

            startY += MODULE_ROW_HEIGHT + 2f;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public boolean isStarClicked(List<ModuleStructure> displayModules,
                                 double mouseX, double mouseY,
                                 float listX, float listY,
                                 float listWidth, float listHeight,
                                 double scrollOffset,
                                 ModuleDisplayHelper displayHelper,
                                 boolean isTransitioning) {
        return getModuleForStarClick(displayModules, mouseX, mouseY,
                listX, listY, listWidth, listHeight,
                scrollOffset, displayHelper, isTransitioning) != null;
    }
}

package rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.render;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.handler.ModuleAnimationHandler;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.handler.ModuleScrollHandler;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.settingsrender.ColorComponent;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.settingsrender.MultiSelectComponent;
import rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.settingsrender.SelectComponent;
import rasty.util.interfaces.AbstractSettingComponent;
import rasty.util.render.Render2D;
import rasty.util.render.shader.Scissor;
import rasty.util.render.font.Fonts;

import java.awt.*;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class SettingsPanelRenderer {

    private static final float SETTINGS_PANEL_CORNER_RADIUS = 7f;
    private static final float CORNER_INSET = 3f;
    private static final int SETTING_HEIGHT = 16;
    private static final int SETTING_SPACING = 2;

    private final ModuleAnimationHandler animationHandler;

    public SettingsPanelRenderer(ModuleAnimationHandler animationHandler) {
        this.animationHandler = animationHandler;
    }

    private int c(int v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, v)); }

    public void render(DrawContext context, ModuleStructure selectedModule, List<AbstractSettingComponent> settingComponents,
                       float x, float y, float width, float height, float mouseX, float mouseY, float delta,
                       int guiScale, float alphaMultiplier, ModuleScrollHandler scrollHandler, ModuleAnimationHandler animHandler) {

        animHandler.updateSettingAnimations(settingComponents);
        animHandler.updateVisibilityAnimations(settingComponents);

        Render2D.blur(x, y, width, height, 15f, 5f, 0x00000000);
        Render2D.gradientRect(x, y, width, height,
                new int[]{
                        new Color(15, 15, 15, c((int)(90 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(),
                        new Color(8,  8,  8,  c((int)(110 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(),
                        new Color(15, 15, 15, c((int)(90 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(),
                        new Color(8,  8,  8,  c((int)(110 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB()
                }, SETTINGS_PANEL_CORNER_RADIUS);
        Render2D.outline(x, y, width, height, 0.35f,
                new Color(90, 90, 90, c((int)(180 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(), SETTINGS_PANEL_CORNER_RADIUS);

        if (selectedModule == null) {
            String text = "Select a module";
            float textSize = 6f;
            float textWidth = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(text, textSize);
            float textHeight = Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(textSize);
            float centerX = x + (width - textWidth) / 2f;
            float centerY = y + (height - textHeight) / 2f;
            Fonts.BOLD.draw(text, centerX, centerY, textSize, new Color(100, 100, 100, c((int)(150 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB());
            return;
        }

        Fonts.BOLD.draw(selectedModule.getName(), x + 8, y + 8, 7, new Color(255, 255, 255, c((int)(200 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB());
        String desc = selectedModule.getDescription();
        if (desc != null && !desc.isEmpty()) {
            Fonts.BOLD.draw(desc.length() > 52 ? desc.substring(0, 55) + "..." : desc, x + 15, y + 20, 5, new Color(128, 128, 128, c((int)(150 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB());
            Fonts.GUI_ICONS.draw("C", x + 8, y + 20, 6, new Color(128, 128, 128, c((int)(150 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB());
        }
        Render2D.rect(x + 8, y + 30, width - 16, 1.25f, new Color(90, 90, 90, c((int)(60 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB(), 10);

        float sideInset = CORNER_INSET;
        float bottomInset = CORNER_INSET + 3;

        float clipY = y + 31;
        float clipH = height - 26 - bottomInset;
        float clipX = x + sideInset;
        float clipW = width - sideInset * 2;

        Scissor.enable(clipX, clipY, clipW, clipH, guiScale);

        List<Float> finalYPositions = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Float> animatedHeights = new ArrayList<>();
        float posY = y + 38f + (float) scrollHandler.getSettingDisplayScroll();

        for (AbstractSettingComponent c : settingComponents) {
            float heightAnim = animHandler.getHeightAnimations().getOrDefault(c, c.getSetting().isVisible() ? 1f : 0f);

            if (heightAnim <= 0.001f) {
                finalYPositions.add(null);
                animatedHeights.add(0f);
                continue;
            }

            finalYPositions.add(posY);

            float baseHeight = getComponentBaseHeight(c);
            float layoutHeight = baseHeight * heightAnim;
            animatedHeights.add(layoutHeight);
            posY += layoutHeight + SETTING_SPACING * heightAnim;
        }

        float visibleTop = clipY;
        float visibleBottom = clipY + clipH;

        for (int i = 0; i < settingComponents.size(); i++) {
            AbstractSettingComponent c = settingComponents.get(i);
            Float startY = finalYPositions.get(i);

            if (startY == null) continue;

            float visAnim = animHandler.getVisibilityAnimations().getOrDefault(c, c.getSetting().isVisible() ? 1f : 0f);
            float heightAnim = animHandler.getHeightAnimations().getOrDefault(c, c.getSetting().isVisible() ? 1f : 0f);

            if (visAnim <= 0.001f && heightAnim <= 0.001f) continue;

            float animatedHeight = animatedHeights.get(i);
            float progress = animHandler.getSettingAnimations().getOrDefault(c, 1f);
            float componentAlpha = progress * visAnim * alphaMultiplier;

            c.position(x + 8, startY);
            c.size(width - 16f, SETTING_HEIGHT);
            c.setAlphaMultiplier(componentAlpha);

            if (startY + animatedHeight >= visibleTop && startY <= visibleBottom && componentAlpha > 0.01f) {
                float itemClipTop = Math.max(startY, visibleTop);
                float itemClipBottom = Math.min(startY + animatedHeight, visibleBottom);
                float itemClipHeight = itemClipBottom - itemClipTop;

                if (itemClipHeight > 0.5f) {
                    Scissor.enable(clipX, itemClipTop, clipW, itemClipHeight, guiScale);
                    context.getMatrices().pushMatrix();
                    c.render(context, (int) mouseX, (int) mouseY, delta);
                    context.getMatrices().popMatrix();
                    Scissor.disable();
                }
            }
        }

        Scissor.disable();

        boolean hasVisibleSettings = false;
        for (AbstractSettingComponent c : settingComponents) {
            float visAnim = animHandler.getVisibilityAnimations().getOrDefault(c, 0f);
            if (visAnim > 0.01f) {
                hasVisibleSettings = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!hasVisibleSettings) {
            String text = "This module doesn't have settings";
            float textSize = 6f;
            float textWidth = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(text, textSize);
            float textHeight = Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(textSize);
            float centerX = x + (width - textWidth) / 2f;
            float centerY = y + (height - textHeight) / 2f + 10f;
            Fonts.BOLD.draw(text, centerX, centerY, textSize, new Color(100, 100, 100, c((int)(150 * alphaMultiplier))).getRGB());
        }

        renderScrollFade(x + sideInset, clipY, width - sideInset * 2, clipH,
                scrollHandler.getSettingScrollTopFade() * alphaMultiplier,
                scrollHandler.getSettingScrollBottomFade() * alphaMultiplier, 60, 12);
    }

    public float calculateTotalHeight(List<AbstractSettingComponent> settingComponents, ModuleAnimationHandler animHandler) {
        float total = 0;
        for (AbstractSettingComponent c : settingComponents) {
            float heightAnim = animHandler.getHeightAnimations().getOrDefault(c, c.getSetting().isVisible() ? 1f : 0f);
            if (heightAnim <= 0.001f) continue;
            float baseHeight = getComponentBaseHeight(c);
            total += (baseHeight + SETTING_SPACING) * heightAnim;
        }
        return total;
    }

    private float getComponentBaseHeight(AbstractSettingComponent c) {
        if (c instanceof SelectComponent) return ((SelectComponent) c).getTotalHeight();
        if (c instanceof MultiSelectComponent) return ((MultiSelectComponent) c).getTotalHeight();
        if (c instanceof ColorComponent) return ((ColorComponent) c).getTotalHeight();
        return SETTING_HEIGHT;
    }

    private void renderScrollFade(float x, float y, float w, float h, float topFade, float bottomFade, int alpha, int size) {
        if (topFade > 0.01f) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                float fadeAlpha = alpha * topFade * (1f - i / (float) size);
                Render2D.rect(x, y + i, w, 1, new Color(12, 12, 12, c((int) fadeAlpha)).getRGB(), 0);
            }
        }
        if (bottomFade > 0.01f) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                float fadeAlpha = alpha * bottomFade * (i / (float) size);
                Render2D.rect(x, y + h - size + i, w, 1, new Color(12, 12, 12, c((int) fadeAlpha)).getRGB(), 0);
            }
        }
    }
}

package rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.module.util;

import rasty.modules.module.ModuleStructure;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

public class ModuleDisplayHelper {

    private final Set<ModuleStructure> modulesWithSettings = new HashSet<>();

    public void updateModulesWithSettings(List<ModuleStructure> displayModules) {
        modulesWithSettings.clear();
        for (ModuleStructure mod : displayModules) {
            if (hasModuleSettings(mod)) {
                modulesWithSettings.add(mod);
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean hasModuleSettings(ModuleStructure module) {
        if (module == null) return false;
        var settings = module.settings();
        return settings != null && !settings.isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean hasSettings(ModuleStructure module) {
        return modulesWithSettings.contains(module);
    }
}

package rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.settingsrender;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.ButtonSetting;
import rasty.util.interfaces.AbstractSettingComponent;
import rasty.util.render.Render2D;
import rasty.util.render.font.Fonts;

import java.awt.*;

public class ButtonComponent extends AbstractSettingComponent {
    private final ButtonSetting buttonSetting;
    private float pressAnimation = 0f;
    private float hoverAnimation = 0f;
    private float scaleAnimation = 1f;
    private float rippleAnimation = 0f;
    private float rippleX = 0f;
    private float rippleY = 0f;
    private boolean wasPressed = false;
    private boolean rippleActive = false;

    private long lastUpdateTime = System.currentTimeMillis();

    private static final float ANIMATION_SPEED = 8f;
    private static final float FAST_ANIMATION_SPEED = 12f;
    private static final float BUTTON_WIDTH = 65f;
    private static final float BUTTON_HEIGHT = 12f;

    public ButtonComponent(ButtonSetting setting) {
        super(setting);
        this.buttonSetting = setting;
    }

    private float getDeltaTime() {
        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        float deltaTime = Math.min((currentTime - lastUpdateTime) / 1000f, 0.1f);
        lastUpdateTime = currentTime;
        return deltaTime;
    }

    private float lerp(float current, float target, float speed) {
        float diff = target - current;
        if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.001f) {
            return target;
        }
        return current + diff * Math.min(speed, 1f);
    }

    private int clamp(int value) {
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, value));
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        float deltaTime = getDeltaTime();

        boolean hovered = isButtonHover(mouseX, mouseY);

        hoverAnimation = lerp(hoverAnimation, hovered ? 1f : 0f, deltaTime * ANIMATION_SPEED);

        float scaleTarget = wasPressed ? 0.95f : (hovered ? 1.02f : 1f);
        scaleAnimation = lerp(scaleAnimation, scaleTarget, deltaTime * FAST_ANIMATION_SPEED);

        pressAnimation = lerp(pressAnimation, wasPressed ? 1f : 0f, deltaTime * FAST_ANIMATION_SPEED);

        if (rippleActive) {
            rippleAnimation += deltaTime * 3f;
            if (rippleAnimation >= 1f) {
                rippleAnimation = 0f;
                rippleActive = false;
            }
        }

        if (pressAnimation < 0.05f && wasPressed) {
            wasPressed = false;
        }

        int iconAlpha = (int)(200 * alphaMultiplier);
        Fonts.GUI_ICONS.draw("U", x + 0.5f, y + height / 2 - 12f, 13, new Color(210, 210, 210, iconAlpha).getRGB());

        Fonts.BOLD.draw(buttonSetting.getName(), x + 9.5f, y + height / 2 - 7.5f, 6, applyAlpha(new Color(210, 210, 220, 200)).getRGB());

        String description = buttonSetting.getDescription();
        if (description != null && !description.isEmpty()) {
            Fonts.BOLD.draw(description, x + 0.5f, y + height / 2 + 0.5f, 5, applyAlpha(new Color(128, 128, 128, 128)).getRGB());
        }

        renderButton(mouseX, mouseY);
    }

    private void renderButton(int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        float buttonX = x + width - BUTTON_WIDTH - 2;
        float buttonY = y + height / 2 - BUTTON_HEIGHT / 2;

        float scaledWidth = BUTTON_WIDTH * scaleAnimation;
        float scaledHeight = BUTTON_HEIGHT * scaleAnimation;
        float scaledX = buttonX - (scaledWidth - BUTTON_WIDTH) / 2;
        float scaledY = buttonY - (scaledHeight - BUTTON_HEIGHT) / 2;

        float pressOffset = pressAnimation * 1f;
        scaledY += pressOffset;

        int bgAlpha = clamp((int)((30 + hoverAnimation * 20 + pressAnimation * 15) * alphaMultiplier));
        int bgGray = clamp((int)(35 + hoverAnimation * 15 + pressAnimation * 20));
        Color bgColor = new Color(bgGray, bgGray, bgGray, bgAlpha);

        Render2D.rect(scaledX, scaledY, scaledWidth, scaledHeight, bgColor.getRGB(), 4f);

        if (rippleActive && rippleAnimation > 0) {
            float currentRippleSize = 20 * rippleAnimation;
            float rippleAlpha = (1f - rippleAnimation) * 0.4f;

            int rippleAlphaInt = clamp((int)(255 * rippleAlpha * alphaMultiplier));

            float localRippleX = rippleX - scaledX;
            float localRippleY = rippleY - scaledY;

            Render2D.rect(
                    scaledX + localRippleX - currentRippleSize / 2,
                    scaledY + localRippleY - currentRippleSize / 2,
                    currentRippleSize, currentRippleSize,
                    new Color(200, 200, 210, rippleAlphaInt).getRGB(),
                    currentRippleSize / 2
            );
        }

        int outlineAlpha = clamp((int)((60 + hoverAnimation * 60 + pressAnimation * 40) * alphaMultiplier));
        int outlineGray = clamp((int)(80 + hoverAnimation * 40 + pressAnimation * 30));
        Color outlineColor = new Color(outlineGray, outlineGray, outlineGray, outlineAlpha);
        Render2D.outline(scaledX, scaledY, scaledWidth, scaledHeight, 0.5f, outlineColor.getRGB(), 4f);

        renderButtonContent(scaledX, scaledY, scaledWidth, scaledHeight);
    }

    private void renderButtonContent(float buttonX, float buttonY, float buttonWidth, float buttonHeight) {
        String buttonText = buttonSetting.getButtonName() != null ? buttonSetting.getButtonName() : "Run";

        float iconSize = 4f;
        float textWidth = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(buttonText, 5);
        float totalWidth = iconSize + 4f + textWidth;
        float startX = buttonX + (buttonWidth - totalWidth) / 2;

        float iconX = startX;
        float iconY = buttonY + buttonHeight / 2 - iconSize / 2;

        renderPlayIcon(iconX - 5, iconY, iconSize);

        float textX = startX + iconSize;
        float textY = buttonY + buttonHeight / 2 - 3f;

        int textAlpha = clamp((int)((180 + hoverAnimation * 50 + pressAnimation * 25) * alphaMultiplier));
        int textGray = clamp((int)(180 + hoverAnimation * 40 + pressAnimation * 30));
        Color textColor = new Color(textGray, textGray, textGray, textAlpha);

        Fonts.BOLD.draw(buttonText, textX, textY, 5, textColor.getRGB());
    }

    private void renderPlayIcon(float iconX, float iconY, float size) {
        int iconAlpha = clamp((int)((160 + hoverAnimation * 60 + pressAnimation * 35) * alphaMultiplier));
        int iconGray = clamp((int)(170 + hoverAnimation * 50 + pressAnimation * 30));
        Color iconColor = new Color(iconGray, iconGray, iconGray, iconAlpha);

        float triangleWidth = size * 0.8f;
        float triangleHeight = size;

        Render2D.rect(iconX, iconY, triangleWidth * 0.4f, triangleHeight, iconColor.getRGB(), 1f);

        float dotSize = size * 0.35f;
        float dotX = iconX + triangleWidth * 0.5f;
        float dotY = iconY + (triangleHeight - dotSize) / 2;
        Render2D.rect(dotX, dotY, dotSize, dotSize, iconColor.getRGB(), dotSize / 2);
    }

    private boolean isButtonHover(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        float buttonX = x + width - BUTTON_WIDTH - 2;
        float buttonY = y + height / 2 - BUTTON_HEIGHT / 2;
        return mouseX >= buttonX && mouseX <= buttonX + BUTTON_WIDTH &&
                mouseY >= buttonY && mouseY <= buttonY + BUTTON_HEIGHT;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (isButtonHover(mouseX, mouseY) && button == 0) {
            if (buttonSetting.getRunnable() != null) {
                buttonSetting.getRunnable().run();
            }
            wasPressed = true;
            pressAnimation = 1f;

            rippleActive = true;
            rippleAnimation = 0f;
            rippleX = (float) mouseX;
            rippleY = (float) mouseY;

            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isHover(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        return mouseX >= x && mouseX <= x + width && mouseY >= y && mouseY <= y + height;
    }
}

package rasty.screens.clickgui.impl.settingsrender;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;
import rasty.util.interfaces.AbstractSettingComponent;
import rasty.modules.module.setting.implement.BooleanSetting;
import rasty.util.render.Render2D;

import java.awt.*;

public class CheckboxComponent extends AbstractSettingComponent {
    private final BooleanSetting booleanSetting;


    private float checkAnimation = 0f;
    private float hoverAnimation = 0f;
    private float stretchAnimation = 0f;
    private float velocity = 0f;


    private boolean listening = false;
    private float bindHoverAnimation = 0f;
    private float listeningAnimation = 0f;
    private float pulseAnimation = 0f;


    private float descScrollOffset = 0f;
    private boolean descScrollingRight = true;
    private long descScrollPauseTime = 0;

    private long lastUpdateTime = System.currentTimeMillis();

    private static final float BOOL_BIND_WIDTH  = 22f;
    private static final float BOOL_BIND_HEIGHT = 10f;

    private static final long  SCROLL_PAUSE_DURATION    = 2000;
    private static final float SCROLL_PIXELS_PER_SECOND = 20f;
    private static final float DESC_PADDING             = 8f;

    public static final int SCROLL_UP_BIND   = 1000;
    public static final int SCROLL_DOWN_BIND = 1001;
    public static final int MIDDLE_MOUSE_BIND = 1002;

    public CheckboxComponent(BooleanSetting setting) {
        super(setting);
        this.booleanSetting = setting;
        this.checkAnimation = setting.isValue() ? 1f : 0f;
    }


    private float getDeltaTime() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        float dt = Math.min((now - lastUpdateTime) / 1000f, 0.1f);
        lastUpdateTime = now;
        return dt;
    }

    private float lerp(float current, float target, float speed) {
        float diff = target - current;
        if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.001f) return target;
        return current + diff * Math.min(speed, 1f);
    }


    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        float dt = getDeltaTime();

        boolean hovered     = isHover(mouseX, mouseY);
        boolean bindHovered = isBindBoxHover(mouseX, mouseY);

        hoverAnimation    = lerp(hoverAnimation,    hovered     ? 1f : 0f, dt * 8f);
        bindHoverAnimation = lerp(bindHoverAnimation, bindHovered ? 1f : 0f, dt * 8f);
        listeningAnimation = lerp(listeningAnimation, listening   ? 1f : 0f, dt * 12f);
        hoverAnimation    = clamp(hoverAnimation,    0f, 1f);
        bindHoverAnimation = clamp(bindHoverAnimation, 0f, 1f);
        listeningAnimation = clamp(listeningAnimation, 0f, 1f);

        if (listening) {
            pulseAnimation += dt * 4f;
            if (pulseAnimation > Math.PI * 2) pulseAnimation -= (float)(Math.PI * 2);
        } else {
            pulseAnimation = lerp(pulseAnimation, 0f, dt * 8f);
        }


        float target   = booleanSetting.isValue() ? 1f : 0f;
        float oldCheck = checkAnimation;

        checkAnimation += (target - checkAnimation) * 0.35f;
        if (Math.abs(target - checkAnimation) < 0.001f) checkAnimation = target;

        velocity = checkAnimation - oldCheck;

        float absVelocity   = Math.abs(velocity);
        float targetStretch = clamp(absVelocity * 30f, 0f, 1f);
        float stretchSpeed  = targetStretch > stretchAnimation ? 0.5f : 0.2f;
        stretchAnimation   += (targetStretch - stretchAnimation) * stretchSpeed;
        stretchAnimation    = clamp(stretchAnimation, 0f, 1f);


        int iconAlpha = (int)(200 * alphaMultiplier);
        Fonts.GUI_ICONS.draw("T", x + 0.5f, y + height / 2 - 11f, 11, new Color(210, 210, 210, iconAlpha).getRGB());
        Fonts.BOLD.draw(booleanSetting.getName(), x + 9.5f, y + height / 2 - 7.5f, 6, applyAlpha(new Color(210, 210, 220, 200)).getRGB());


        String description = booleanSetting.getDescription();
        if (description != null && !description.isEmpty()) {
            renderScrollingDescription(description, dt);
        }


        renderBindBox(mouseX, mouseY);


        float checkboxSize  = 10f;
        float checkboxWidth = checkboxSize + 6f;
        float checkboxX     = x + width - checkboxWidth - 2f;
        float checkboxY     = y + height / 2f - checkboxSize / 2f;

        Render2D.rect(checkboxX, checkboxY, checkboxWidth, checkboxSize, applyAlpha(new Color(55, 55, 55, 25)).getRGB(), 4f);

        int outlineAlpha = 60 + (int)(hoverAnimation * 40);
        Render2D.outline(checkboxX, checkboxY, checkboxWidth, checkboxSize, 0.5f, applyAlpha(new Color(155, 155, 155, outlineAlpha)).getRGB(), 4f);

        float knobBaseSize   = checkboxSize - 3f;
        float stretchExtra   = stretchAnimation * 4f;
        float knobWidth      = knobBaseSize + stretchExtra;
        float knobHeight     = knobBaseSize - stretchAnimation;
        float padding        = 1.5f;
        float travelDistance = checkboxWidth - knobBaseSize - padding * 2f;
        float knobBaseX      = checkboxX + padding;

        float stretchOffset;
        if (velocity > 0)      stretchOffset = -stretchExtra * 0.3f;
        else if (velocity < 0) stretchOffset =  stretchExtra * 0.3f;
        else                   stretchOffset = 0f;

        float knobX = knobBaseX + travelDistance * checkAnimation - stretchExtra * checkAnimation + stretchOffset;
        float knobY = checkboxY + (checkboxSize - knobHeight) / 2f;

        Color offColor  = new Color(59, 59, 59, 200);
        Color onColor   = new Color(159, 159, 159, 200);
        Color knobColor = lerpColor(offColor, onColor, checkAnimation);

        Render2D.rect(knobX, knobY, knobWidth, knobHeight, applyAlpha(knobColor).getRGB(), 4f);
    }

    // РєС‚Рѕ СЌС‚Рѕ С‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚ С‚РѕС‚ РїРёРґСЂ С†РёС‚Р°С‚Р° by king ra!sty 13.04.2026

    private void renderScrollingDescription(String description, float deltaTime) {
        float descY = y + height / 2 + 0.5f;

        float checkboxWidth = 16f;
        float bindBoxX      = x + width - checkboxWidth - 2f - BOOL_BIND_WIDTH - 3f;
        float availableWidth = bindBoxX - x - DESC_PADDING;

        float descWidth = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(description, 5);

        if (descWidth <= availableWidth) {
            descScrollOffset = 0;
            Fonts.BOLD.draw(description, x + 0.5f, descY, 5,
                    applyAlpha(new Color(128, 128, 128, 128)).getRGB());
        } else {
            updateDescScrollAnimation(deltaTime, descWidth, availableWidth);
            float maxScroll    = descWidth - availableWidth + 5;
            float currentScroll = descScrollOffset * maxScroll;
            Scissor.enable(x, descY - 2, availableWidth, 10, 2);
            Fonts.BOLD.draw(description, x + 0.5f - currentScroll, descY, 5,
                    applyAlpha(new Color(128, 128, 128, 128)).getRGB());
            Scissor.disable();
        }
    }

    private void updateDescScrollAnimation(float deltaTime, float textWidth, float availableWidth) {
        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (descScrollPauseTime > 0) {
            if (currentTime - descScrollPauseTime < SCROLL_PAUSE_DURATION) return;
            descScrollPauseTime = 0;
        }
        float scrollDistance = textWidth - availableWidth + 5;
        if (scrollDistance <= 0) { descScrollOffset = 0; return; }
        float scrollSpeed = SCROLL_PIXELS_PER_SECOND / scrollDistance;
        if (descScrollingRight) {
            descScrollOffset += deltaTime * scrollSpeed;
            if (descScrollOffset >= 1f) {
                descScrollOffset    = 1f;
                descScrollingRight  = false;
                descScrollPauseTime = currentTime;
            }
        } else {
            descScrollOffset -= deltaTime * scrollSpeed;
            if (descScrollOffset <= 0f) {
                descScrollOffset    = 0f;
                descScrollingRight  = true;
                descScrollPauseTime = currentTime;
            }
        }
    }


    private void renderBindBox(int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        float checkboxWidth = 16f;
        float bindBoxX = x + width - checkboxWidth - 2f - BOOL_BIND_WIDTH - 3f;
        float bindBoxY = y + height / 2f - BOOL_BIND_HEIGHT / 2f;

        Color bgColor;
        int bgAlpha = (int)(20 + bindHoverAnimation * 15 + listeningAnimation * 20);
        if (listening) {
            float pulse = (float)(Math.sin(pulseAnimation) * 0.15 + 0.85);
            bgColor = new Color(
                    (int)(60 + 40 * pulse),
                    (int)(80 + 40 * pulse),
                    (int)(120 + 35 * pulse),
                    (int)(bgAlpha * alphaMultiplier));
        } else if (booleanSetting.getKey() != GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UNKNOWN && booleanSetting.getKey() != -1) {
            bgColor = applyAlpha(new Color(40, 60, 50, bgAlpha));
        } else {
            bgColor = applyAlpha(new Color(40, 40, 45, bgAlpha));
        }
        Render2D.rect(bindBoxX, bindBoxY, BOOL_BIND_WIDTH, BOOL_BIND_HEIGHT, bgColor.getRGB(), 3f);

        Color outlineColor;
        float outlineAlpha;
        if (listening) {
            float pulse = (float)(Math.sin(pulseAnimation) * 0.3 + 0.7);
            outlineAlpha = 150 * pulse * listeningAnimation;
            outlineColor = new Color(120, 160, 220, (int)(outlineAlpha * alphaMultiplier));
        } else if (booleanSetting.getKey() != GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UNKNOWN && booleanSetting.getKey() != -1) {
            outlineAlpha = 80 + bindHoverAnimation * 40;
            outlineColor = new Color(100, 160, 120, (int)(outlineAlpha * alphaMultiplier));
        } else {
            outlineAlpha = 50 + bindHoverAnimation * 30;
            outlineColor = new Color(120, 120, 125, (int)(outlineAlpha * alphaMultiplier));
        }
        Render2D.outline(bindBoxX, bindBoxY, BOOL_BIND_WIDTH, BOOL_BIND_HEIGHT, 0.5f, outlineColor.getRGB(), 3f);

        String label = getBindLabel();
        Color textColor;
        if (listening) {
            float pulse = (float)(Math.sin(pulseAnimation * 2) * 0.2 + 0.8);
            textColor = new Color(180, 200, 240, (int)(200 * pulse * alphaMultiplier));
        } else if (booleanSetting.getKey() != GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UNKNOWN && booleanSetting.getKey() != -1) {
            textColor = new Color(140, 200, 150, (int)(200 * alphaMultiplier));
        } else {
            textColor = new Color(140, 140, 150, (int)(130 * alphaMultiplier));
        }

        float textY   = bindBoxY + BOOL_BIND_HEIGHT / 2f - 2.5f;
        float centerX = bindBoxX + BOOL_BIND_WIDTH / 2f;
        Fonts.BOLD.drawCentered(label, centerX, textY, 5, textColor.getRGB());
    }

    private String getBindLabel() {
        if (listening) return "...";
        int key = booleanSetting.getKey();
        if (key == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UNKNOWN || key == -1) return "None";
        if (key == SCROLL_UP_BIND)    return "ScrU";
        if (key == SCROLL_DOWN_BIND)  return "ScrD";
        if (key == MIDDLE_MOUSE_BIND) return "MMB";

        int type = booleanSetting.getType();
        if (type == 0) {
            return switch (key) {
                case GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT   -> "LMB";
                case GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT  -> "RMB";
                case GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE -> "MMB";
                default -> "M" + key;
            };
        }

        String keyName = GLFW.glfwGetKeyName(key, 0);
        if (keyName != null) return keyName.toUpperCase();

        return switch (key) {
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_LEFT_SHIFT    -> "LS";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_RIGHT_SHIFT   -> "RS";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_LEFT_CONTROL  -> "LC";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_RIGHT_CONTROL -> "RC";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_LEFT_ALT      -> "LA";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_RIGHT_ALT     -> "RA";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_SPACE         -> "Sp";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_TAB           -> "Tab";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_CAPS_LOCK     -> "Cap";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER         -> "Ent";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE     -> "Bk";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_DELETE        -> "Del";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F1            -> "F1";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F2            -> "F2";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F3            -> "F3";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F4            -> "F4";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F5            -> "F5";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F6            -> "F6";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F7            -> "F7";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F8            -> "F8";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F9            -> "F9";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F10           -> "F10";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F11           -> "F11";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F12           -> "F12";
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE        -> "Esc";
            default -> "K" + key;
        };
    }

    private boolean isBindBoxHover(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        float checkboxWidth = 16f;
        float bindBoxX = x + width - checkboxWidth - 2f - BOOL_BIND_WIDTH - 3f;
        float bindBoxY = y + height / 2f - BOOL_BIND_HEIGHT / 2f;
        return mouseX >= bindBoxX && mouseX <= bindBoxX + BOOL_BIND_WIDTH
                && mouseY >= bindBoxY && mouseY <= bindBoxY + BOOL_BIND_HEIGHT;
    }


    public boolean isListening() {
        return listening;
    }

    public void handleScrollBind(double vertical) {
        if (!listening) return;
        booleanSetting.setKey(vertical > 0 ? SCROLL_UP_BIND : SCROLL_DOWN_BIND);
        booleanSetting.setType(2);
        listening = false;
    }

    public void handleMiddleMouseBind() {
        if (!listening) return;
        booleanSetting.setKey(MIDDLE_MOUSE_BIND);
        booleanSetting.setType(2);
        listening = false;
    }


    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (isBindBoxHover(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            if (button == 1) {
                booleanSetting.setKey(GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UNKNOWN);
                booleanSetting.setType(1);
                listening = false;
                return true;
            } else if (listening) {
                booleanSetting.setKey(button);
                booleanSetting.setType(0);
                listening = false;
                return true;
            } else if (button == 0) {
                listening = true;
                return true;
            }
        }

        if (listening) {
            listening = false;
        }

        if (isHover(mouseX, mouseY) && button == 0) {
            booleanSetting.setValue(!booleanSetting.isValue());
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (!listening) return false;

        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
            listening = false;
            return true;
        }
        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_DELETE) {
            booleanSetting.setKey(GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UNKNOWN);
            booleanSetting.setType(1);
            listening = false;
            return true;
        }
        if (keyCode != GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UNKNOWN) {
            booleanSetting.setKey(keyCode);
            booleanSetting.setType(1);
            listening = false;
            return true;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {}

    @Override
    public boolean isHover(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        return mouseX >= x && mouseX <= x + width && mouseY >= y && mouseY <= y + height;
    }


    private Color lerpColor(Color a, Color b, float t) {
        int r  = (int)(a.getRed()   + (b.getRed()   - a.getRed())   * t);
        int g  = (int)(a.getGreen() + (b.getGreen() - a.getGreen()) * t);
        int bl = (int)(a.getBlue()  + (b.getBlue()  - a.getBlue())  * t);
        int al = (int)(a.getAlpha() + (b.getAlpha() - a.getAlpha()) * t);
        return new Color(clamp(r, 0, 255), clamp(g, 0, 255), clamp(bl, 0, 255), clamp(al, 0, 255));
    }

    private float clamp(float v, float min, float max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }
    private int   clamp(int   v, int   min, int   max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }
}
