package rasty.screens.loading;

import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.util.Util;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import rasty.auth.KeyAuthScreen;
import rasty.screens.menu.MainMenuScreen;
import rasty.util.render.Render2D;
import rasty.util.render.font.Fonts;

import java.awt.*;

public class Loading {

    private static Loading instance;

    private static final int COL_ACCENT      = 0x00E5FF;
    private static final int COL_TEXT        = 0xE8EBF2;
    private static final int COL_MUTED       = 0x5A6070;
    private static final int COL_SUB         = 0x3C4250;
    private static final int COL_PANEL       = 0x12151D;
    private static final int COL_OUTLINE     = 0x1E2330;

    private static final float FIXED_GUI_SCALE = 2.0f;


    private static final String[] LOADING_TEXTS = {
            "Loading",
            "Preparing",
            "Initializing",
            "Almost ready"
    };

    private static final long TEXT_DISPLAY_DURATION    = 2200L;
    private static final long TEXT_TRANSITION_DURATION = 400L;
    private static final long LAST_TEXT_HOLD_DURATION  = 2500L;


    private float pulseTime        = 0f;
    private float dotAnim          = 0f;
    private long  lastRenderTime   = 0L;
    private boolean initialized    = false;

    private int   currentTextIndex = 0;
    private float curOffY          = 0f;
    private float curAlpha         = 1f;
    private float nxtOffY          = -12f;
    private float nxtAlpha         = 0f;
    private long  lastTextChange   = 0L;
    private boolean isTransitioning= false;
    private long  transitionStart  = 0L;
    private boolean allTextsShown  = false;
    private long  lastTextShownTime= 0L;


    private float bgAlpha          = 0f;
    private float contentAlpha     = 0f;
    private boolean isFadingOut    = false;
    private boolean readyToClose   = false;
    private boolean resourcesLoaded= false;


    private boolean authScreenOpened = false;


    private float lineProgress     = 0f;
    private float targetProgress   = 0f;

    public Loading() {
        instance = this;
        long now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        lastTextChange = now;
    }

    public static Loading getInstance() {
        if (instance == null) instance = new Loading();
        return instance;
    }


    private int getFixedW() {
        MinecraftClient c = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (c == null || c.getWindow() == null) return 960;
        return (int) Math.ceil((double) c.getWindow().getFramebufferWidth() / FIXED_GUI_SCALE);
    }

    private int getFixedH() {
        MinecraftClient c = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (c == null || c.getWindow() == null) return 540;
        return (int) Math.ceil((double) c.getWindow().getFramebufferHeight() / FIXED_GUI_SCALE);
    }

    private int withAlpha(int color, int alpha) {
        return (color & 0x00FFFFFF) | (MathHelper.clamp(alpha, 0, 255) << 24);
    }

    private float easeOutCubic(float x) { return 1f - (float) Math.pow(1f - x, 3); }
    private float easeOutQuad(float x)  { return 1f - (1f - x) * (1f - x); }

    public void render(int width, int height, float opacity) {
        long now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();

        if (!initialized) {
            lastRenderTime = now;
            lastTextChange = now;
            initialized = true;
        }

        float dt = MathHelper.clamp((now - lastRenderTime) / 1000f, 0.001f, 0.1f);
        lastRenderTime = now;

        updateAnimations(dt, now);

        int fw = getFixedW(), fh = getFixedH();

        Render2D.beginOverlay();


        Render2D.backgroundImage(bgAlpha * opacity, 1.06f);


        int overlayA = (int)(bgAlpha * opacity * 160);
        Render2D.rect(0, 0, fw, fh, withAlpha(0x060810, overlayA), 0f);

        float ca = contentAlpha * opacity;
        if (ca > 0.01f) {
            renderContent(fw, fh, ca, now);
        }

        Render2D.endOverlay();
    }

    private void renderContent(int fw, int fh, float alpha, long now) {
        float cx = fw / 2f;
        float cy = fh / 2f;
        int   a  = (int)(alpha * 255);


        float logoX = cx - Fonts.BOLD.getWidth("RASTY", 28f) / 2f - (Fonts.TEST.getWidth("CLIENT", 9f) + 6f) / 2f;
        float logoY = cy - 28f;

        Fonts.BOLD.draw("RASTY", logoX, logoY, 28f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT, a));
        float subX = logoX + Fonts.BOLD.getWidth("RASTY", 28f) + 5f;
        Fonts.TEST.draw("CLIENT", subX, logoY + 11f, 9f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 200)));


        float lineW = 60f;
        float lineY = logoY + Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(28f) + 6f;
        Render2D.rect(cx - lineW / 2f, lineY, lineW, 1f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 80)), 0f);

        float textBaseY = lineY + 18f;
        float textSize  = 8f;

        if (curAlpha > 0.01f && currentTextIndex < LOADING_TEXTS.length) {
            String t  = LOADING_TEXTS[currentTextIndex];
            String td = addDots(t, now);
            float  tw = Fonts.REGULARNEW.getWidth(td, textSize);
            int    ta = (int)(alpha * curAlpha * 255);
            Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(td, cx - tw / 2f, textBaseY + curOffY, textSize,
                    withAlpha(COL_MUTED, ta));
        }

        if (isTransitioning && nxtAlpha > 0.01f) {
            int nextIdx = currentTextIndex + 1;
            if (nextIdx < LOADING_TEXTS.length) {
                String nt  = LOADING_TEXTS[nextIdx];
                float  ntw = Fonts.REGULARNEW.getWidth(nt, textSize);
                int    nta = (int)(alpha * nxtAlpha * 255);
                Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(nt, cx - ntw / 2f, textBaseY + nxtOffY, textSize,
                        withAlpha(COL_MUTED, nta));
            }
        }

        float barW = 120f;
        float barH = 1.5f;
        float barX = cx - barW / 2f;
        float barY = textBaseY + 18f;

        Render2D.rect(barX, barY, barW, barH, withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE, (int)(alpha * 80)), 0f);

        float filled = barW * lineProgress;
        if (filled > 0.5f) {
            Render2D.rect(barX, barY, filled, barH, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 160)), 0f);
        }

        String cr = "Rasty Client  В©  All Rights Reserved";
        float  crW = Fonts.TEST.getWidth(cr, 5f);
        Fonts.TEST.draw(cr, cx - crW / 2f, fh - 12f, 5f,
                withAlpha(COL_SUB, (int)(alpha * 150)));
    }

    private String addDots(String base, long now) {
        if (allTextsShown) return base;
        int dots = (int)((now / 400L) % 4);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(base);
        for (int i = 0; i < dots; i++) sb.append('.');
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private void updateAnimations(float dt, long now) {
        pulseTime += dt * 2f;
        dotAnim   += dt;


        bgAlpha      = MathHelper.lerp(dt * 4f, bgAlpha, 1f);
        if (bgAlpha > 0.99f) bgAlpha = 1f;

        if (!isFadingOut) {
            contentAlpha = MathHelper.lerp(dt * 3f, contentAlpha, 1f);
            if (contentAlpha > 0.99f) contentAlpha = 1f;
        } else {
            contentAlpha -= dt * 2.2f;
            if (contentAlpha <= 0f) { contentAlpha = 0f; readyToClose = true; }
        }


        if (lineProgress < targetProgress) {
            lineProgress = MathHelper.lerp(dt * 4f, lineProgress, targetProgress);
            if (lineProgress > targetProgress) lineProgress = targetProgress;
        }


        if (!isFadingOut) updateTextAnim(now);


        if (allTextsShown && resourcesLoaded && !isFadingOut) {
            if (now - lastTextShownTime >= LAST_TEXT_HOLD_DURATION) {
                isFadingOut = true;
            }
        }


        if (readyToClose && !authScreenOpened) {
            authScreenOpened = true;
            MinecraftClient mc = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
            if (mc != null) {
                mc.execute(() -> mc.setScreen(
                        new KeyAuthScreen(() -> mc.setScreen(new MainMenuScreen()))
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    private void updateTextAnim(long now) {
        if (allTextsShown) return;

        if (!isTransitioning) {
            if (currentTextIndex >= LOADING_TEXTS.length - 1) {
                if (!allTextsShown) { allTextsShown = true; lastTextShownTime = now; }
                return;
            }
            if (now - lastTextChange >= TEXT_DISPLAY_DURATION) {
                isTransitioning  = true;
                transitionStart  = now;
            }
        }

        if (isTransitioning) {
            float raw    = MathHelper.clamp((float)(now - transitionStart) / TEXT_TRANSITION_DURATION, 0f, 1f);
            float eased  = easeOutQuad(raw);

            curOffY  =  12f * eased;
            curAlpha = MathHelper.clamp(1f - eased * 1.5f, 0f, 1f);
            nxtOffY  = -10f * (1f - eased);
            nxtAlpha = MathHelper.clamp(eased * 1.3f, 0f, 1f);

            if (raw >= 1f) {
                isTransitioning = false;
                currentTextIndex++;
                curOffY  = 0f; curAlpha = 1f;
                nxtOffY  = -12f; nxtAlpha = 0f;
                lastTextChange = now;
                if (currentTextIndex >= LOADING_TEXTS.length - 1) {
                    allTextsShown = true; lastTextShownTime = now;
                }
            }
        }
    }


    public void markComplete() { resourcesLoaded = true; }

    public boolean isContentFadedOut() { return isFadingOut && contentAlpha <= 0.01f; }
    public boolean isReadyToClose()    { return readyToClose; }
    public boolean isComplete()        { return allTextsShown && resourcesLoaded; }
    public boolean isFadingOut()       { return isFadingOut; }
    public float   getContentAlpha()   { return contentAlpha; }

    public void setProgress(float progress) {
        this.targetProgress = MathHelper.clamp(progress, 0f, 1f);
    }
    public float getProgress() { return targetProgress; }

    public void reset() {
        pulseTime       = 0f;
        dotAnim         = 0f;
        lastRenderTime  = 0L;
        initialized     = false;
        currentTextIndex= 0;
        curOffY         = 0f; curAlpha = 1f;
        nxtOffY         = -12f; nxtAlpha = 0f;
        lastTextChange  = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        isTransitioning = false;
        transitionStart = 0L;
        allTextsShown   = false;
        lastTextShownTime = 0L;
        bgAlpha         = 0f;
        contentAlpha    = 0f;
        isFadingOut     = false;
        readyToClose    = false;
        resourcesLoaded = false;
        authScreenOpened= false;
        lineProgress    = 0f;
        targetProgress  = 0f;
    }

    public long getStartTime() { return Util.getMeasuringTimeMs(); }
}

            pvy[i]     = (float)(Math.sin(angle)) * spd;
            pbright[i] = 0.2f + rng.nextFloat() * 0.5f;
        }
    }

    private int getFixedScaledWidth() {
        return (int) Math.ceil((double) client.getWindow().getFramebufferWidth() / FIXED_GUI_SCALE);

    private float toFixedCoord(double coord) {

        return (float)(coord * currentScale / FIXED_GUI_SCALE);

    private void unlock() {
        if (!isUnlocked) {
            isUnlocked  = true;
            unlockTime  = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
            targetZoom  = ZOOM_NORMAL;
        }
    }

    private float getUnlockTextAlpha(long currentTime) {
        if (!isUnlocked) return 1f;
        long elapsed = currentTime - unlockTime;
        return 1f - MathHelper.clamp((float) elapsed / UNLOCK_FADE_DURATION, 0f, 1f);
    }

    private float getMenuProgress(long currentTime) {
        if (!isUnlocked) return 0f;
        long elapsed = currentTime - unlockTime - MENU_APPEAR_DELAY;
        if (elapsed < 0) return 0f;
        return MathHelper.clamp((float) elapsed / MENU_APPEAR_DURATION, 0f, 1f);
    }

    private float easeOutCubic(float x) { return 1f - (float) Math.pow(1f - x, 3); }
    private float easeInCubic(float x)  { return x * x * x; }
    private float easeOutQuart(float x) { return 1f - (float) Math.pow(1f - x, 4); }

    private void switchToView(View view) {
        if (currentView != view && transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.NONE) {
            targetView       = view;
            transitionPhase  = TransitionPhase.FADE_OUT;
            transitionStart  = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        }
    }

    private void updateTransition(long currentTime) {
        if (transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.NONE) return;
        long elapsed = currentTime - transitionStart;
        if (transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.FADE_OUT) {
            if (elapsed >= VIEW_FADE_OUT_DURATION) {
                currentView     = targetView;
                transitionPhase = TransitionPhase.FADE_IN;
                transitionStart = currentTime;
            }
        } else if (transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.FADE_IN) {
            if (elapsed >= VIEW_FADE_IN_DURATION) {
                transitionPhase = TransitionPhase.NONE;
            }
        }
    }

    private float getViewAlpha(View view, long currentTime) {
        if (currentView == view && transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.NONE) return 1f;
        if (currentView != view && transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.NONE) return 0f;

        long  elapsed = currentTime - transitionStart;
        float t;

        if (transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.FADE_OUT) {
            t = MathHelper.clamp((float) elapsed / VIEW_FADE_OUT_DURATION, 0f, 1f);
            return currentView == view ? 1f - easeInCubic(t) : 0f;
        } else {
            t = MathHelper.clamp((float) elapsed / VIEW_FADE_IN_DURATION, 0f, 1f);
            return currentView == view ? easeOutCubic(t) : 0f;
        }
    }

    private void drawBackground(float zoom) {
        int sw = getFixedScaledWidth();
        int sh = getFixedScaledHeight();
        float zw = sw * zoom, zh = sh * zoom;
        float ox = (sw - zw) / 2f, oy = (sh - zh) / 2f;
        int[] colors = {0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF};
        float[] radii = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        Initialization.getInstance().getManager().getRenderCore().getTexturePipeline()
                .drawTexture(BACKGROUND_TEXTURE, ox, oy, zw, zh, 0, 0, 1, 1, colors, radii, 1f);
    }

    private void rescaleParticles(int oldSw, int oldSh, int newSw, int newSh) {
        if (oldSw <= 0 || oldSh <= 0) return;
        float scaleX = (float) newSw / oldSw;
        float scaleY = (float) newSh / oldSh;
        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
            px[i]  *= scaleX;
            py[i]  *= scaleY;
            pvx[i] *= scaleX;
            pvy[i] *= scaleY;
        }
    }

    private void updateParticles(float dt, float mouseX, float mouseY, int sw, int sh) {
        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
            float dx = mouseX - px[i];
            float dy = mouseY - py[i];
            float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            if (dist < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST && dist > 1f) {
                pvx[i] += (dx / dist) * PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE * dt * 60f;
                pvy[i] += (dy / dist) * PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE * dt * 60f;
            }


            float speed = (float) Math.sqrt(pvx[i] * pvx[i] + pvy[i] * pvy[i]);
            float maxSpeed = PARTICLE_SPEED * 1.8f;
            if (speed > maxSpeed) {
                pvx[i] = pvx[i] / speed * maxSpeed;
                pvy[i] = pvy[i] / speed * maxSpeed;
            }


            px[i] += pvx[i] * dt;
            py[i] += pvy[i] * dt;


            if (px[i] < -5) px[i] = sw + 5;
            if (px[i] > sw + 5) px[i] = -5;
            if (py[i] < -5) py[i] = sh + 5;
            if (py[i] > sh + 5) py[i] = -5;
        }
    }

    private void renderParticles(float mouseX, float mouseY, float globalAlpha) {
        if (globalAlpha < 0.01f) return;


        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < PARTICLE_COUNT; j++) {
                float dx = px[j] - px[i];
                float dy = py[j] - py[i];
                float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                if (dist < PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST && dist > 0.5f) {
                    float t = 1f - dist / PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST;

                    float mdx1 = mouseX - px[i], mdy1 = mouseY - py[i];
                    float mdx2 = mouseX - px[j], mdy2 = mouseY - py[j];
                    float mouseDist = Math.min(
                            (float) Math.sqrt(mdx1 * mdx1 + mdy1 * mdy1),
                            (float) Math.sqrt(mdx2 * mdx2 + mdy2 * mdy2)
                    );
                    float mouseBoost = mouseDist < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST
                            ? 1f + (1f - mouseDist / PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST) * 2.5f
                            : 1f;

                    int lineAlpha = (int)(t * t * 120 * globalAlpha * mouseBoost);
                    lineAlpha = MathHelper.clamp(lineAlpha, 0, 255);

                    int lineColor = (mouseDist < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST)
                            ? withAlpha(0x00E5FF, lineAlpha)
                            : withAlpha(0x2A3A4A, lineAlpha);


                    int steps = Math.max(1, (int)(dist / 2f));
                    float stepX = dx / steps;
                    float stepY = dy / steps;
                    for (int s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
                        float lx = px[i] + stepX * s;
                        float ly = py[i] + stepY * s;
                        Render2D.rect(lx, ly, 1f, 1f, lineColor, 0f);
                    }
                }
            }
        }


        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {

            float mdx = mouseX - px[i], mdy = mouseY - py[i];
            float md  = (float) Math.sqrt(mdx * mdx + mdy * mdy);
            float glowT = md < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST ? 1f - md / PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST : 0f;

            int dotAlpha = (int)((0.3f + pbright[i] * 0.5f + glowT * 0.4f) * 255 * globalAlpha);
            dotAlpha = MathHelper.clamp(dotAlpha, 0, 255);

            int dotColor;
            if (glowT > 0.05f) {

                int r = (int)(0x2A + glowT * (0x00 - 0x2A));
                int g = (int)(0x3A + glowT * (0xE5 - 0x3A));
                int b = (int)(0x4A + glowT * (0xFF - 0x4A));
                dotColor = withAlpha((r << 16) | (g << 8) | b, dotAlpha);
            } else {
                dotColor = withAlpha(0x4A5A7A, dotAlpha);
            }

            Render2D.rect(px[i] - PARTICLE_SIZE / 2f, py[i] - PARTICLE_SIZE / 2f,
                    PARTICLE_SIZE, PARTICLE_SIZE, dotColor, 0f);
        }
    }


    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        long currentTime = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();

        if (!initialized) {
            screenStartTime = currentTime;
            lastRenderTime  = currentTime;
            initialized     = true;

            int sw = getFixedScaledWidth(), sh = getFixedScaledHeight();
            Random rng = new Random();
            for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
                px[i] = rng.nextFloat() * sw;
                py[i] = rng.nextFloat() * sh;
            }
            lastKnownSw = sw;
            lastKnownSh = sh;
        }

        float dt = MathHelper.clamp((currentTime - lastRenderTime) / 1000f, 0f, 0.1f);
        lastRenderTime = currentTime;

        int fixedWidth  = getFixedScaledWidth();
        int fixedHeight = getFixedScaledHeight();

        if (fixedWidth != lastKnownSw || fixedHeight != lastKnownSh) {
            rescaleParticles(lastKnownSw, lastKnownSh, fixedWidth, fixedHeight);
            lastKnownSw = fixedWidth;
            lastKnownSh = fixedHeight;
        }

        updateTransition(currentTime);

        unlockTextPulse += dt * 2.8f;
        currentZoom = MathHelper.lerp(dt * ZOOM_SPEED, currentZoom, targetZoom);

        float scrollDiff = targetScrollOffset - scrollOffset;
        scrollOffset += scrollDiff * Math.min(1f, dt * 12f);
        if (Math.abs(scrollDiff) < 0.1f) scrollOffset = targetScrollOffset;

        float unlockTextAlpha = getUnlockTextAlpha(currentTime);
        float menuProgress    = easeOutQuart(getMenuProgress(currentTime));
        float mainAlpha       = getViewAlpha(View.MAIN_MENU, currentTime);
        float altAlpha        = getViewAlpha(View.ALT_SCREEN, currentTime);

        if (!welcomeSoundPlayed && menuProgress > 0.1f) {
            SoundManager.playSoundDirect(SoundManager.WELCOME, 1.0f, 1.0f);
            welcomeSoundPlayed = true;
        }

        float scaledMouseX = toFixedCoord(mouseX);
        float scaledMouseY = toFixedCoord(mouseY);

        boolean canInteractMain = currentView == View.MAIN_MENU && transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.NONE && menuProgress > 0.8f;
        hoveredButton = canInteractMain ? getHoveredButton(scaledMouseX, scaledMouseY, fixedWidth, fixedHeight) : -1;
        updateButtonAnimations(dt);
        updateParticles(dt, scaledMouseX, scaledMouseY, fixedWidth, fixedHeight);

        ParticleState.save(px, py, pvx, pvy, pbright);

        Render2D.beginOverlay();

        drawBackground(currentZoom);

        float particleAlpha = MathHelper.clamp(menuProgress * 1.5f, 0f, 1f);
        renderParticles(scaledMouseX, scaledMouseY, particleAlpha);

        if (mainAlpha > 0.01f) {
            float divX  = fixedWidth * DIVIDER_X_RATIO;
            float lineH = fixedHeight * 0.55f;
            float lineY = (fixedHeight - lineH) / 2f;
            int divAlpha = (int)(mainAlpha * menuProgress * 60);
            Render2D.rect(divX, lineY, 1, lineH, withAlpha(0x00E5FF, divAlpha), 0f);
        }

        if (mainAlpha > 0.01f) {
            renderMainMenuContent(fixedWidth, fixedHeight, scaledMouseX, scaledMouseY, menuProgress, mainAlpha, unlockTextAlpha, currentTime);
        }

        if (altAlpha > 0.01f) {
            renderAltScreenContent(fixedWidth, fixedHeight, scaledMouseX, scaledMouseY, altAlpha, currentTime);
        }

        if (isUnlocked) {
            Render2D.blur(scaledMouseX, scaledMouseY, 1, 1, BLUR_RADIUS, 1, new Color(128, 128, 128, 0).getRGB());
        }

        Fonts.TEST.draw("Rasty Client  В©  All Rights Reserved",
                fixedWidth - Fonts.TEST.getWidth("Rasty Client  В©  All Rights Reserved", 5f) - 8f,
                fixedHeight - 9f, 5f, withAlpha(0x3C4250, 180));

        Render2D.endOverlay();
    }

    private void renderMainMenuContent(int sw, int sh, float mx, float my,
                                       float menuProgress, float alpha,
                                       float unlockTextAlpha, long currentTime) {
        if (unlockTextAlpha > 0.01f && !isUnlocked) {
            renderUnlockText(unlockTextAlpha, sw, sh);
        }

        if (menuProgress > 0.01f) {
            renderTimeBlock(alpha * menuProgress, sw, sh, menuProgress);
            renderButtonColumn(mx, my, alpha * menuProgress, sw, sh, menuProgress);
            renderModLabel(alpha * menuProgress, sw, sh, menuProgress);
        }
    }

    private void renderUnlockText(float opacity, int sw, int sh) {
        if (opacity < 0.01f) return;
        float cx = sw / 2f, cy = sh / 2f;
        int alpha = (int)(opacity * 255);
        int colorSub   = withAlpha(0x00E5FF, (int)(alpha * 0.65f));
        int colorArrow = withAlpha(0x00E5FF, alpha);

        String sub  = "вЂ” PRESS ANY KEY вЂ”";
        float  subW = Fonts.REGULARNEW.getWidth(sub, 7f);
        Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(sub, cx - subW / 2f, cy - 12f, 7f, colorSub);

        float  bounce = (float) Math.sin(unlockTextPulse * 0.8f) * 2.5f;
        String arrow  = "в–ј";
        float  arrowW = Fonts.REGULARNEW.getWidth(arrow, 11f);
        Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(arrow, cx - arrowW / 2f, cy + 8f + bounce, 11f, colorArrow);
    }

    private void renderTimeBlock(float opacity, int sw, int sh, float menuProgress) {
        if (opacity < 0.01f) return;

        float cx = sw * TIME_BLOCK_X_RATIO;
        float cy = sh * TIME_BLOCK_Y_RATIO;

        float slideX = (1f - menuProgress) * -50f;

        String timeStr = LocalTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HH:mm"));
        float timeSize = 56f;
        float timeH    = Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(timeSize);
        float timeW    = Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(timeStr, timeSize);

        int accentAlpha = (int)(opacity * 180);
        Render2D.rect(cx + slideX, cy - timeH / 2f - 14f, 32f, 2f,
                withAlpha(0x00E5FF, accentAlpha), 1f);

        int timeAlpha = (int)(opacity * 255);
        Fonts.BOLD.draw(timeStr, cx + slideX, cy - timeH / 2f, timeSize,
                withAlpha(COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, timeAlpha));

        String dateStr = java.time.LocalDate.now()
                .format(java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("EEEE, MMMM d", java.util.Locale.ENGLISH));
        float dateSize = 10f;
        int dateAlpha  = (int)(opacity * 160);
        Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(dateStr, cx + slideX,
                cy + timeH / 2f + 7f, dateSize,
                withAlpha(COL_TEXT_MUTED, dateAlpha));

        if (client != null && client.getSession() != null) {
            String user = client.getSession().getUsername();
            if (user != null && !user.isEmpty()) {
                float userSize = 9f;
                int userAlpha  = (int)(opacity * 120);
                Fonts.TEST.draw("// " + user, cx + slideX,
                        cy + timeH / 2f + 23f, userSize,
                        withAlpha(COL_TEXT_SUB, userAlpha));
            }
        }
    }

    private void renderModLabel(float opacity, int sw, int sh, float menuProgress) {
        if (opacity < 0.01f) return;
        float slideY = (1f - menuProgress) * -20f;
        float x = 14f, y = 14f + slideY;

        String label = "RASTY";
        float  lSize = 18f;
        int    la    = (int)(opacity * 255);
        Fonts.BOLD.draw(label, x, y, lSize, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, la));

        float subX = x + Fonts.BOLD.getWidth(label, lSize) + 5f;
        Fonts.TEST.draw("CLIENT", subX, y + 7f, 7f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(opacity * 180)));
    }

    private void renderButtonColumn(float mx, float my, float opacity, int sw, int sh, float menuProgress) {
        if (opacity < 0.01f) return;

        float colX = sw * BTN_COL_X_RATIO;
        float colY = sh * BTN_COL_Y_RATIO;

        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            float btnDelay   = i * 0.10f;
            float btnProg    = MathHelper.clamp((menuProgress - btnDelay) / 0.8f, 0f, 1f);
            float easedProg  = easeOutCubic(btnProg);
            float slideX     = (1f - easedProg) * 60f;
            float bx         = colX + slideX;
            float by         = colY + i * (BTN_HEIGHT + BTN_SPACING);
            float btnOpacity = opacity * easedProg;

            renderSideButton(i, bx, by, BTN_WIDTH, BTN_HEIGHT, btnOpacity);
        }
    }

    private void renderSideButton(int index, float x, float y, float w, float h, float opacity) {
        if (opacity < 0.01f) return;

        float hover = buttonHoverProgress[index];
        float scale = buttonScales[index];

        float scaledH   = h * scale;
        float scaledW   = w * (1f + hover * 0.03f);
        float dy        = (h - scaledH) / 2f;

        boolean isDanger = index == 4;

        int bgAlpha = (int)(opacity * (80 + hover * 60));
        int panelBg = isDanger
                ? withAlpha(mix(COL_PANEL_BG, 0x1A0008, exitButtonRedProg), bgAlpha)
                : withAlpha(COL_PANEL_BG, bgAlpha);
        Render2D.gradientRect(x, y + dy, scaledW, scaledH,
                new int[]{panelBg, panelBg, panelBg, panelBg}, 3f);

        int barAlpha = (int)(opacity * (100 + hover * 155));
        int barColor = isDanger ? withAlpha(COL_DANGER, barAlpha) : withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, barAlpha);
        Render2D.rect(x, y + dy, 2f, scaledH, barColor, 1f);

        int outlineAlpha = (int)(opacity * (40 + hover * 120));
        int outlineColor = isDanger
                ? withAlpha(COL_DANGER, outlineAlpha)
                : withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE_HOVER, outlineAlpha);
        Render2D.outline(x, y + dy, scaledW, scaledH, OUTLINE_THICKNESS, outlineColor, 3f);

        float iconSize  = 13f;
        String icon     = BUTTON_ICONS[index];
        int iconAlpha   = (int)(opacity * (150 + hover * 105));
        int iconColor   = isDanger ? withAlpha(COL_DANGER, iconAlpha) : withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, iconAlpha);
        float iconY     = y + dy + scaledH / 2f - Fonts.MAINMENUSCREEN.getHeight(iconSize) / 2f;
        Fonts.MAINMENUSCREEN.draw(icon, x + 10f, iconY, iconSize, iconColor);

        float labelSize = 9.5f;
        String label    = BUTTON_LABELS[index];
        int labelAlpha  = (int)(opacity * (180 + hover * 75));
        int labelColor  = isDanger
                ? withAlpha(mix(COL_TEXT_MUTED, COL_DANGER, exitButtonRedProg), labelAlpha)
                : withAlpha(COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, labelAlpha);
        float labelY    = y + dy + scaledH / 2f - Fonts.REGULARNEW.getHeight(labelSize) / 2f;
        Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(label, x + 28f, labelY, labelSize, labelColor);

        if (hover > 0.1f) {
            int shimmerAlpha = (int)(hover * opacity * 80);
            int shimmer = isDanger ? withAlpha(COL_DANGER, shimmerAlpha) : withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, shimmerAlpha);
            Render2D.rect(x + scaledW - 1f, y + dy, 1f, scaledH, shimmer, 0f);
        }
    }

    private int getHoveredButton(float mx, float my, int sw, int sh) {
        float colX = sw * BTN_COL_X_RATIO;
        float colY = sh * BTN_COL_Y_RATIO;

        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            float bx = colX;
            float by = colY + i * (BTN_HEIGHT + BTN_SPACING);
            if (mx >= bx && mx <= bx + BTN_WIDTH && my >= by && my <= by + BTN_HEIGHT) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private void updateButtonAnimations(float dt) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            float targetHover = (hoveredButton == i) ? 1f : 0f;
            buttonHoverProgress[i] = MathHelper.lerp(dt * 11f, buttonHoverProgress[i], targetHover);
            float targetScale = (hoveredButton == i) ? 1.04f : 1f;
            buttonScales[i] = MathHelper.lerp(dt * 13f, buttonScales[i], targetScale);
        }
        float targetRed = (hoveredButton == 4) ? 1f : 0f;
        exitButtonRedProg = MathHelper.lerp(dt * 9f, exitButtonRedProg, targetRed);
    }

    private void renderAltScreenContent(int sw, int sh, float mx, float my, float alpha, long currentTime) {
        float totalW  = LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH + GAP + RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH;
        float totalH  = LEFT_PANEL_TOP_HEIGHT + GAP + LEFT_PANEL_BOTTOM_HEIGHT;
        float cx      = sw / 2f;
        float cy      = sh / 2f;
        float startX  = cx - totalW / 2f;
        float startY  = cy - totalH / 2f;

        float lpOffX = (1f - alpha) * -SLIDE_DISTANCE;
        if (alpha > 0.01f) {
            accountRenderer.renderLeftPanelTop(
                    startX + lpOffX, startY,
                    LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH, LEFT_PANEL_TOP_HEIGHT,
                    alpha, nicknameText, nicknameFieldFocused,
                    mx - lpOffX, my, currentTime);
        }

        float lpBOffY = (1f - alpha) * SLIDE_DISTANCE;
        if (alpha > 0.01f) {

            String activeName = (client != null && client.getSession() != null)
                    ? client.getSession().getUsername()
                    : accountConfig.getActiveAccountName();
            if (activeName == null || activeName.isEmpty())
                activeName = accountConfig.getActiveAccountName();
            accountRenderer.renderLeftPanelBottom(
                    startX, startY + LEFT_PANEL_TOP_HEIGHT + GAP + lpBOffY,
                    LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH, LEFT_PANEL_BOTTOM_HEIGHT,
                    alpha,
                    activeName,
                    accountConfig.getActiveAccountDate(),
                    accountConfig.getActiveAccountSkin());
        }

        float rpOffX = (1f - alpha) * SLIDE_DISTANCE;
        float rpX    = startX + LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH + GAP;
        if (alpha > 0.01f) {
            List<AccountEntry> sorted = accountConfig.getSortedAccounts();
            accountRenderer.renderRightPanel(
                    rpX + rpOffX, startY,
                    RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH, RIGHT_PANEL_HEIGHT,
                    alpha, sorted, scrollOffset,
                    mx - rpOffX, my, 1f, (int) FIXED_GUI_SCALE);
        }


        float hintAlpha = alpha * 0.45f;
        int ha = (int)(hintAlpha * 255);
        Fonts.TEST.draw("ESC вЂ” BACK", startX + lpOffX, startY - 11f, 6.5f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_MUTED, ha));


        Fonts.BOLD.draw("RASTY", 14f, 14f, 18f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, (int)(alpha * 255)));
        Fonts.TEST.draw("CLIENT", 14f + Fonts.BOLD.getWidth("RASTY", 18f) + 5f, 14f + 7f, 7f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 180)));


        Fonts.TEST.draw("// ACCOUNT MANAGER",
                rpX + rpOffX, startY - 11f, 6.5f,
                withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(alpha * 120)));
    }


    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(Click click, boolean doubled) {
        if (transitionPhase != TransitionPhase.NONE) return false;

        float mx = toFixedCoord(click.x());
        float my = toFixedCoord(click.y());

        if (currentView == View.MAIN_MENU) {
            if (!isUnlocked) { unlock(); return true; }
            if (click.button() == 0 && hoveredButton >= 0) {
                handleMainMenuButtonClick(hoveredButton);
                return true;
            }
        } else if (currentView == View.ALT_SCREEN) {
            return handleAltScreenClick(mx, my, click);
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(click, doubled);
    }

    private void handleMainMenuButtonClick(int index) {
        switch (index) {
            case 0 -> client.setScreen(new SelectWorldScreen(this));
            case 1 -> {
                Screen s = client.options.skipMultiplayerWarning
                        ? new MultiplayerScreen(this)
                        : new MultiplayerWarningScreen(this);
                client.setScreen(s);
            }
            case 2 -> switchToView(View.ALT_SCREEN);
            case 3 -> client.setScreen(new OptionsScreen(this, client.options));
            case 4 -> client.scheduleStop();
        }
    }

    private boolean handleAltScreenClick(float mx, float my, Click click) {
        int sw = getFixedScaledWidth(), sh = getFixedScaledHeight();
        float totalW = LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH + GAP + RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH;
        float totalH = LEFT_PANEL_TOP_HEIGHT + GAP + LEFT_PANEL_BOTTOM_HEIGHT;
        float startX = sw / 2f - totalW / 2f;
        float startY = sh / 2f - totalH / 2f;


        float lpX = startX, lpY = startY;

        float fieldX = lpX + LP_FIELD_X_OFF;
        float fieldY = lpY + LP_FIELD_Y_OFF;
        float fieldW = LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH - LP_FIELD_X_OFF * 2 - LP_ADD_SZ - LP_ADD_GAP;

        if (accountRenderer.isMouseOver(mx, my, fieldX, fieldY, fieldW, LP_FIELD_H)) {
            nicknameFieldFocused = true;
            return true;
        } else {
            nicknameFieldFocused = false;
        }

        float addBtnX = fieldX + fieldW + LP_ADD_GAP;
        if (accountRenderer.isMouseOver(mx, my, addBtnX, fieldY, LP_ADD_SZ, LP_ADD_SZ)) {
            if (!nicknameText.isEmpty()) { addAccount(nicknameText); nicknameText = ""; }
            return true;
        }

        float randomY = fieldY + LP_FIELD_H + LP_RANDOM_DY;
        if (accountRenderer.isMouseOver(mx, my, lpX + LP_FIELD_X_OFF, randomY, LP_BTN_W, LP_BTN_H)) {
            addAccount(generateRandomNickname()); nicknameText = ""; return true;
        }

        float clearY = randomY + LP_BTN_H + LP_CLEAR_DY;
        if (accountRenderer.isMouseOver(mx, my, lpX + LP_FIELD_X_OFF, clearY, LP_BTN_W, LP_BTN_H)) {
            accountConfig.clearAllAccounts(); targetScrollOffset = 0; scrollOffset = 0; return true;
        }

        float rpX    = startX + LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH + GAP;
        float listX  = rpX + RP_LIST_X_OFF;
        float listY  = startY + RP_LIST_Y_OFF;
        float listW  = RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH - RP_LIST_X_OFF * 2;
        float listH  = RIGHT_PANEL_HEIGHT - RP_LIST_Y_OFF - RP_LIST_X_OFF;

        if (!accountRenderer.isMouseOver(mx, my, listX, listY, listW, listH)) return false;

        float cW = (listW - RP_CARD_GAP) / 2f;
        List<AccountEntry> sorted = accountConfig.getSortedAccounts();

        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.size(); i++) {
            int col = i % 2, row = i / 2;
            float cardX = listX + col * (cW + RP_CARD_GAP);
            float cardY = listY + row * (RP_CARD_H + RP_CARD_GAP) - scrollOffset;

            if (cardY + RP_CARD_H < listY || cardY > listY + listH) continue;

            float btnY = cardY + RP_CARD_H - RP_BTN_SZ - RP_BTN_Y_OFF;
            float pinX = cardX + cW - RP_BTN_SZ * 2 - 8;
            float delX = cardX + cW - RP_BTN_SZ - 5;

            boolean pinVisible = btnY >= listY - 1 && btnY + RP_BTN_SZ <= listY + listH + 1;

            if (pinVisible && accountRenderer.isMouseOver(mx, my, pinX, btnY, RP_BTN_SZ, RP_BTN_SZ)) {
                AccountEntry e = sorted.get(i);
                e.togglePinned();
                if (e.isPinned()) setActiveAccount(e);
                accountConfig.save();
                return true;
            }
            if (pinVisible && accountRenderer.isMouseOver(mx, my, delX, btnY, RP_BTN_SZ, RP_BTN_SZ)) {
                accountConfig.removeAccountByIndex(i);
                return true;
            }
            if (accountRenderer.isMouseOver(mx, my, cardX, Math.max(cardY, listY), cW, RP_CARD_H)) {
                setActiveAccount(sorted.get(i));
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mx, double my, double hAmount, double vAmount) {
        if (currentView != View.ALT_SCREEN || transitionPhase != TransitionPhase.NONE) return false;

        float smx = toFixedCoord(mx), smy = toFixedCoord(my);
        int sw = getFixedScaledWidth(), sh = getFixedScaledHeight();
        float totalW = LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH + GAP + RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH;
        float totalH = LEFT_PANEL_TOP_HEIGHT + GAP + LEFT_PANEL_BOTTOM_HEIGHT;
        float rpX = sw / 2f - totalW / 2f + LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH + GAP;
        float rpY = sh / 2f - totalH / 2f;

        if (accountRenderer.isMouseOver(smx, smy, rpX, rpY, RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH, RIGHT_PANEL_HEIGHT)) {
            float listH  = RIGHT_PANEL_HEIGHT - RP_LIST_Y_OFF - RP_LIST_X_OFF;
            int   rows   = (int) Math.ceil(accountConfig.getSortedAccounts().size() / 2.0);
            float maxScroll = Math.max(0, rows * (RP_CARD_H + RP_CARD_GAP) - RP_CARD_GAP - listH);
            targetScrollOffset -= (float) vAmount * 25;
            targetScrollOffset  = MathHelper.clamp(targetScrollOffset, 0, maxScroll);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mx, my, hAmount, vAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(KeyInput input) {
        if (transitionPhase != TransitionPhase.NONE) return false;

        if (currentView == View.MAIN_MENU) {
            if (!isUnlocked) { unlock(); return true; }
        } else if (currentView == View.ALT_SCREEN) {
            if (nicknameFieldFocused) {
                int key = input.key();

                if (key == 86 && (input.modifiers() & 2) != 0) {
                    String pasted = client.keyboard.getClipboard();
                    if (pasted != null && !pasted.isEmpty()) {
                        pasted = pasted.replace("\n", "").replace("\r", "").replace("\t", "");
                        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(nicknameText);
                        for (char c : pasted.toCharArray()) {
                            if (sb.length() >= 16) break;
                            if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '_') sb.append(c);
                        }
                        nicknameText = sb.toString();
                    }
                    return true;
                }

                if (key == 259) {
                    if (!nicknameText.isEmpty()) nicknameText = nicknameText.substring(0, nicknameText.length() - 1);
                    return true;
                }
                if (key == 256) { nicknameFieldFocused = false; return true; }
                if (key == 257 || key == 335) {
                    if (!nicknameText.isEmpty()) { addAccount(nicknameText); nicknameText = ""; }
                    nicknameFieldFocused = false;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            if (input.key() == 256) {
                switchToView(View.MAIN_MENU);
                accountConfig.save();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return super.keyPressed(input);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(CharInput input) {
        if (currentView == View.ALT_SCREEN && nicknameFieldFocused && transitionPhase == TransitionPhase.NONE) {
            int cp = input.codepoint();
            if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(cp) || cp == '_') {
                if (nicknameText.length() < 16) nicknameText += Character.toString(cp);
                return true;
            }
        }
        return super.charTyped(input);
    }

    private void setActiveAccount(AccountEntry account) {
        accountConfig.setActiveAccount(account.getName(), account.getDate(), account.getSkin());
        SessionChanger.changeUsername(account.getName());
    }

    private void addAccount(String nickname) {
        String date = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm"));
        AccountEntry entry = new AccountEntry(nickname, date, null);
        accountConfig.addAccount(entry);
        setActiveAccount(entry);
        SessionChanger.changeUsername(nickname);
    }

    private String generateRandomNickname() {
        Random rng = new Random();
        char[] vowels     = {'a','e','i','o','u'};
        char[] consonants = {'b','c','d','f','g','h','j','k','l','m','n','p','r','s','t','v','w','x','y','z'};
        List<AccountEntry> existing = accountConfig.getAccounts();
        String result = null;
        int attempts  = 0;
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();

        do {
            sb.setLength(0);
            int len   = 6 + rng.nextInt(5);
            boolean sv = rng.nextBoolean();
            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                sb.append((i % 2 == 0)
                        ? (sv ? vowels[rng.nextInt(vowels.length)] : consonants[rng.nextInt(consonants.length)])
                        : (sv ? consonants[rng.nextInt(consonants.length)] : vowels[rng.nextInt(vowels.length)]));
            }
            if (rng.nextInt(100) < 30) sb.append(rng.nextInt(100));
            String candidate = Character.toUpperCase(sb.charAt(0)) + sb.substring(1);
            attempts++;
            boolean exists = existing.stream().anyMatch(e -> e.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(candidate));
            if (!exists) { result = candidate; break; }
        } while (attempts < 10);

        if (result == null) result = Character.toUpperCase(sb.charAt(0)) + sb.substring(1) + (System.currentTimeMillis() % 1000);
        return result;
    }

    private Identifier getSkinTexturePath(SkinTextures skin) {
        if (skin == null || skin.body() == null) return STEVE_SKIN;
        try { return skin.body().texturePath(); } catch (Exception e) { return STEVE_SKIN; }
    }

    private Identifier getLocalPlayerSkin() {
        if (client == null || client.player == null || client.player.networkHandler == null) return STEVE_SKIN;
        try {
            PlayerListEntry e = client.player.networkHandler.getPlayerListEntry(client.player.getUuid());
            if (e != null) return getSkinTexturePath(e.getSkinTextures());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return STEVE_SKIN;
    }

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        drawBackground(currentZoom);
    }

    @Override public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc() { return false; }
    @Override public boolean shouldPause()       { return false; }

    private int withAlpha(int color, int alpha) {
        return (color & 0x00FFFFFF) | (MathHelper.clamp(alpha, 0, 255) << 24);
    }

    private int mix(int colorA, int colorB, float t) {
        int ar = (colorA >> 16) & 0xFF, ag = (colorA >> 8) & 0xFF, ab = colorA & 0xFF;
        int br = (colorB >> 16) & 0xFF, bg = (colorB >> 8) & 0xFF, bb = colorB & 0xFF;
        int r = (int)(ar + (br - ar) * t);
        int g = (int)(ag + (bg - ag) * t);
        int b = (int)(ab + (bb - ab) * t);
        return (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }
}

package rasty.screens.menu;


public final class ParticleState {

    private static float[] px;
    private static float[] py;
    private static float[] pvx;
    private static float[] pvy;
    private static float[] pbright;
    private static boolean hasState = false;

    private ParticleState() {}

    public static void save(float[] px, float[] py,
                            float[] pvx, float[] pvy,
                            float[] pbright) {
        int n = px.length;
        if (ParticleState.px == null || ParticleState.px.length != n) {
            ParticleState.px     = new float[n];
            ParticleState.py     = new float[n];
            ParticleState.pvx    = new float[n];
            ParticleState.pvy    = new float[n];
            ParticleState.pbright= new float[n];
        }
        System.arraycopy(px,     0, ParticleState.px,     0, n);
        System.arraycopy(py,     0, ParticleState.py,     0, n);
        System.arraycopy(pvx,    0, ParticleState.pvx,    0, n);
        System.arraycopy(pvy,    0, ParticleState.pvy,    0, n);
        System.arraycopy(pbright,0, ParticleState.pbright,0, n);
        hasState = true;
    }

    public static boolean hasState() { return hasState; }

    public static float[] getPx()     { return px; }
    public static float[] getPy()     { return py; }
    public static float[] getPvx()    { return pvx; }
    public static float[] getPvy()    { return pvy; }
    public static float[] getPbright(){ return pbright; }
}

    private void initVfp() {
        if (vfpChecked) return;
        vfpChecked = true;

        try {
            Class<?> loaderClass = Class.forName("net.fabricmc.loader.api.FabricLoader");
            java.lang.reflect.Method getInstance = loaderClass.getMethod("getInstance");
            Object loader = getInstance.invoke(null);
            java.lang.reflect.Method isLoaded = loaderClass.getMethod("isModLoaded", String.class);
            vfpAvailable = (boolean) isLoaded.invoke(loader, "viafabricplus");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            vfpAvailable = false;
        }
    }


    private void openVfpScreen() {

        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.impl.GlobalVersionScreen")) return;
        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.impl.ProtocolVersionScreen")) return;
        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.impl.ProtocolSelectionScreen")) return;
        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.impl.ChangeProtocolScreen")) return;
        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.impl.VersionSelectionScreen")) return;
        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.impl.SelectProtocolScreen")) return;
        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.impl.MainScreen")) return;

        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.ProtocolSelectionScreen")) return;
        if (tryOpenVfpScreen("com.viaversion.viafabricplus.screen.ChangeProtocolScreen")) return;

        if (tryOpenVfpScreenByScan()) return;

        if (tryPressVfpButtonFromVanilla()) return;

        openVfpError();
    }

    private boolean tryOpenVfpScreen(String className) {

        if (className.contains("PerServer")) return false;
        try {
            Class<?> cls = Class.forName(className);
            if (!Screen.class.isAssignableFrom(cls)) return false;
            if (java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isAbstract(cls.getModifiers())) return false;
            Screen screen = null;

            try { screen = (Screen) cls.getConstructor(Screen.class).newInstance(this); }
            catch (NoSuchMethodException ignored) {}

            if (screen == null) {
                try { screen = (Screen) cls.getConstructor().newInstance(); }
                catch (NoSuchMethodException ignored) {}
            }

            if (screen == null) {
                for (java.lang.reflect.Constructor<?> c : cls.getConstructors()) {
                    Class<?>[] p = c.getParameterTypes();
                    if (p.length >= 1 && Screen.class.isAssignableFrom(p[0])) {
                        Object[] args = new Object[p.length];
                        args[0] = this;
                        screen = (Screen) c.newInstance(args);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (screen != null) { client.setScreen(screen); return true; }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return false;
    }


    private boolean tryOpenVfpScreenByScan() {
        try {
            Class<?> loaderClass = Class.forName("net.fabricmc.loader.api.FabricLoader");
            Object loader = loaderClass.getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
            java.util.Optional<?> containerOpt = (java.util.Optional<?>)
                    loaderClass.getMethod("getModContainer", String.class)
                            .invoke(loader, "viafabricplus");
            if (containerOpt.isEmpty()) return false;
            Object container = containerOpt.get();
            Object rootPaths = container.getClass().getMethod("getRootPaths").invoke(container);
            java.util.List<?> paths = (java.util.List<?>) rootPaths;
            if (paths.isEmpty()) return false;
            java.nio.file.Path jarRoot = (java.nio.file.Path) paths.get(0);

            java.util.List<String> candidates = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            java.nio.file.Files.walk(jarRoot)
                    .filter(p -> {
                        String s = p.toString();
                        return s.contains("screen") && s.endsWith(".class")
                                && !s.contains("PerServer")
                                && !s.contains("$");
                    })
                    .forEach(p -> {
                        String rel = jarRoot.relativize(p).toString()
                                .replace("\\", "/").replace("/", ".");
                        candidates.add(rel.substring(0, rel.length() - 6));
                    });

            ClassLoader cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
            for (String className : candidates) {
                try {
                    Class<?> cls = Class.forName(className, false, cl);
                    if (!Screen.class.isAssignableFrom(cls)) continue;
                    if (java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isAbstract(cls.getModifiers())) continue;
                    String name = cls.getSimpleName().toLowerCase();

                    if (!name.contains("protocol") && !name.contains("version")
                            && !name.contains("global") && !name.contains("change")
                            && !name.contains("select")) continue;
                    if (tryOpenVfpScreen(className)) return true;
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return false;
    }


    private boolean tryPressVfpButtonFromVanilla() {
        try {
            VanillaMultiplayerFlag.skipRedirect = true;
            MultiplayerScreen vanilla = new MultiplayerScreen(this);
            java.lang.reflect.Method initMethod = net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.Screen.class
                    .getDeclaredMethod("init", net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient.class,
                            int.class, int.class);
            initMethod.setAccessible(true);
            initMethod.invoke(vanilla, client,
                    client.getWindow().getScaledWidth(),
                    client.getWindow().getScaledHeight());
            for (net.minecraft.client.gui.Element e : vanilla.children()) {
                if (!(e instanceof net.minecraft.client.gui.widget.ButtonWidget btn)) continue;
                if (btn.getMessage().getString().toLowerCase().contains("via")) {
                    java.lang.reflect.Method press =
                            net.minecraft.client.gui.widget.PressableWidget.class
                                    .getDeclaredMethod("onPress");
                    press.setAccessible(true);
                    press.invoke(btn);
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return false;
    }


    private void openVfpError() {

    private int getFixedW() {

    private float toFixed(double coord) {

    private float easeOutCubic(float x) { return 1f - (float) Math.pow(1f - x, 3); }
    private float easeOutQuart(float x) { return 1f - (float) Math.pow(1f - x, 4); }
    private float getAppearProgress(long now) {
        long elapsed = now - openTime - APPEAR_DELAY;
        if (elapsed < 0) return 0f;
        return easeOutQuart(MathHelper.clamp((float) elapsed / APPEAR_DURATION, 0f, 1f));
    }

    private float getPanelStartX(int sw) {
        return sw / 2f - (BTN_PANEL_W + GAP + SRV_PANEL_W) / 2f;
    }
    private float getPanelStartY(int sh) { return sh / 2f - SRV_PANEL_H / 2f; }
    private float getSrvPanelX(int sw)   { return getPanelStartX(sw) + BTN_PANEL_W + GAP; }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        long now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();

        if (!initialized) {
            openTime = lastRenderTime = now;
            initialized = true;
            if (ParticleState.hasState()) {
                int c = Math.min(PARTICLE_COUNT, ParticleState.getPx().length);
                for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
                    px[i] = ParticleState.getPx()[i]; py[i] = ParticleState.getPy()[i];
                    pvx[i] = ParticleState.getPvx()[i]; pvy[i] = ParticleState.getPvy()[i];
                    pbright[i] = ParticleState.getPbright()[i];
                }
            } else if (!particlesPreloaded) {
                int sw = getFixedW(), sh = getFixedH();
                Random rng = new Random();
                for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
                    px[i] = rng.nextFloat() * sw; py[i] = rng.nextFloat() * sh;
                }
            }
        }

        float dt = MathHelper.clamp((now - lastRenderTime) / 1000f, 0f, 0.1f);
        lastRenderTime = now;
        float prog = getAppearProgress(now);
        currentZoom = MathHelper.lerp(dt * ZOOM_SPEED, currentZoom, ZOOM_NORMAL);
        scrollOffset += (targetScroll - scrollOffset) * Math.min(1f, dt * 12f);

        float mx = toFixed(mouseX), my = toFixed(mouseY);
        int   sw = getFixedW(),    sh = getFixedH();

        updateParticles(dt, mx, my, sw, sh);
        updateHover(mx, my, sw, sh, prog);
        updateButtonAnimations(dt);

        Render2D.beginOverlay();
        drawBackground(currentZoom, sw, sh);
        renderParticles(mx, my, MathHelper.clamp(prog * 1.5f, 0f, 1f));
        if (prog > 0.01f) {
            renderLeftPanel(sw, sh, mx, my, prog, now);
            renderServerPanel(sw, sh, mx, my, prog, now);
        }
        if (dcPopupOpen)         renderDcPopup(sw, sh, mx, my, now);
        if (addPopupOpen)        renderAddPopup(sw, sh, mx, my, now);
        if (vfpErrorPopupOpen)   renderVfpErrorPopup(sw, sh, now);
        renderModLabel(sw);
        Fonts.TEST.draw("Rasty Client  В©  All Rights Reserved",
                sw - Fonts.TEST.getWidth("Rasty Client  В©  All Rights Reserved", 5f) - 8f,
                sh - 9f, 5f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_SUB, (int)(prog * 180)));
        Render2D.blur(mx, my, 1, 1, 15f, 1, new Color(128, 128, 128, 0).getRGB());
        Render2D.endOverlay();
    }

    private void drawBackground(float zoom, int sw, int sh) {
        float zw = sw * zoom, zh = sh * zoom;
        float ox = (sw - zw) / 2f, oy = (sh - zh) / 2f;
        int[] colors = {0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF};
        float[] radii = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        Initialization.getInstance().getManager().getRenderCore().getTexturePipeline()
                .drawTexture(BACKGROUND_TEXTURE, ox, oy, zw, zh, 0, 0, 1, 1, colors, radii, 1f);
    }

    private void updateParticles(float dt, float mx, float my, int sw, int sh) {
        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
            float dx = mx - px[i], dy = my - py[i];
            float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            if (dist < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST && dist > 1f) {
                pvx[i] += (dx / dist) * PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE * dt * 60f;
                pvy[i] += (dy / dist) * PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE * dt * 60f;
            }
            float speed = (float) Math.sqrt(pvx[i] * pvx[i] + pvy[i] * pvy[i]);
            float maxSpeed = PARTICLE_SPEED * 1.8f;
            if (speed > maxSpeed) { pvx[i] = pvx[i] / speed * maxSpeed; pvy[i] = pvy[i] / speed * maxSpeed; }
            px[i] += pvx[i] * dt; py[i] += pvy[i] * dt;
            if (px[i] < -5) px[i] = sw + 5; if (px[i] > sw + 5) px[i] = -5;
            if (py[i] < -5) py[i] = sh + 5; if (py[i] > sh + 5) py[i] = -5;
        }
    }

    private void renderParticles(float mx, float my, float alpha) {
        if (alpha < 0.01f) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < PARTICLE_COUNT; j++) {
                float dx = px[j]-px[i], dy = py[j]-py[i];
                float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
                if (dist < PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST && dist > 0.5f) {
                    float t = 1f - dist / PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST;
                    float md1 = (float) Math.sqrt((mx-px[i])*(mx-px[i])+(my-py[i])*(my-py[i]));
                    float md2 = (float) Math.sqrt((mx-px[j])*(mx-px[j])+(my-py[j])*(my-py[j]));
                    float md = Math.min(md1, md2);
                    float boost = md < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST ? 1f + (1f - md/PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST) * 2f : 1f;
                    int la = MathHelper.clamp((int)(t*t*100*alpha*boost), 0, 255);
                    int lc = md < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST ? withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, la) : withAlpha(0x2A3A4A, la);
                    int steps = Math.max(1, (int)(dist / 2f));
                    float sx = dx/steps, sy = dy/steps;
                    for (int s = 0; s <= steps; s++) Render2D.rect(px[i]+sx*s, py[i]+sy*s, 1f, 1f, lc, 0f);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
            float mdx = mx-px[i], mdy = my-py[i];
            float md = (float) Math.sqrt(mdx*mdx+mdy*mdy);
            float g = md < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST ? 1f - md/PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST : 0f;
            int da = MathHelper.clamp((int)((0.3f+pbright[i]*0.5f+g*0.4f)*255*alpha), 0, 255);
            int dc;
            if (g > 0.05f) {
                int r=(int)(0x2A+g*(0x00-0x2A)), gg=(int)(0x3A+g*(0xE5-0x3A)), b=(int)(0x4A+g*(0xFF-0x4A));
                dc = withAlpha((r<<16)|(gg<<8)|b, da);
            } else dc = withAlpha(0x4A5A7A, da);
            Render2D.rect(px[i]-PARTICLE_SIZE/2f, py[i]-PARTICLE_SIZE/2f, PARTICLE_SIZE, PARTICLE_SIZE, dc, 0f);
        }
    }

    private void renderModLabel(int sw) {
        float x = 14f, y = 14f;
        Fonts.BOLD.draw("RASTY", x, y, 18f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, 255));
        Fonts.TEST.draw("CLIENT", x + Fonts.BOLD.getWidth("RASTY", 18f) + 5f,
                y + 7f, 7f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, 180));
    }

    private void renderLeftPanel(int sw, int sh, float mx, float my, float prog, long now) {
        float slideX = (1f - prog) * -40f;
        float px0 = getPanelStartX(sw) + slideX;
        float y   = getPanelStartY(sh);

        drawPanel(px0, y, BTN_PANEL_W, BTN_PANEL_H, prog, COL_ACCENT);
        Fonts.TEST.draw("MULTIPLAYER", px0+10, y+8, 6.5f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(prog*220)));
        Render2D.rect(px0+10, y+19, BTN_PANEL_W-20, 1f, withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE, (int)(prog*40)), 0f);

        float btnW = BTN_PANEL_W - 20f, btnH = 17f, btnGap = 3f, btnY = y + 26f;
        for (int i = 0; i < BTN_COUNT; i++) {
            if (i == 5 || i == 7)
                Render2D.rect(px0+10, btnY-2, btnW, 1f, withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE, (int)(prog*40)), 0f);
            renderActionButton(i, px0+10, btnY, btnW, btnH, prog, mx - slideX, my, now);
            btnY += btnH + btnGap;
        }
    }

    private void renderActionButton(int index, float x, float y, float w, float h,
                                    float alpha, float mx, float my, long now) {
        float hov = btnHover[index], scl = btnScale[index];
        float scaledH = h * scl, dy = (h - scaledH) / 2f;
        float scaledW = w * (1f + hov * 0.02f);
        int accent = BTN_ACCENTS[index] & 0x00FFFFFF;
        boolean isDanger = index == 4;
        boolean isVia    = index == 6;

        int bgA = (int)(alpha * (70 + hov * 60));
        int bg  = isDanger
                ? withAlpha(mix(COL_PANEL_BG, 0x1A0008, exitRedProg(index)), bgA)
                : withAlpha(COL_PANEL_BG, bgA);
        Render2D.gradientRect(x, y+dy, scaledW, scaledH, new int[]{bg,bg,bg,bg}, 2f);
        Render2D.rect(x, y+dy, 2f, scaledH, withAlpha(accent, (int)(alpha*(90+hov*165))), 1f);
        Render2D.outline(x, y+dy, scaledW, scaledH, OUTLINE_T, withAlpha(accent, (int)(alpha*(30+hov*110))), 2f);

        float iconSz = 11f;
        Fonts.MAINMENUSCREEN.draw(BTN_ICONS[index], x+7f,
                y+dy+scaledH/2f - Fonts.MAINMENUSCREEN.getHeight(iconSz)/2f,
                iconSz, withAlpha(accent, (int)(alpha*(140+hov*115))));

        float lblSz = 7.5f;
        int lblC = isDanger
                ? withAlpha(mix(COL_TEXT_MUTED, COL_DANGER, exitRedProg(index)), (int)(alpha*(160+hov*95)))
                : withAlpha(COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, (int)(alpha*(160+hov*95)));
        Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(BTN_LABELS[index], x+22f,
                y+dy+scaledH/2f - Fonts.REGULARNEW.getHeight(lblSz)/2f, lblSz, lblC);

        if (hov > 0.1f)
            Render2D.rect(x+scaledW-1f, y+dy, 1f, scaledH,
                    withAlpha(accent, (int)(hov*alpha*70)), 0f);
    }

    private float exitRedProg(int index) { return index == 4 ? exitRedProg : 0f; }

    private void renderServerPanel(int sw, int sh, float mx, float my, float prog, long now) {
        float slideX = (1f - prog) * 40f;
        float px0 = getSrvPanelX(sw) + slideX;
        float y   = getPanelStartY(sh);

        drawPanel(px0, y, SRV_PANEL_W, SRV_PANEL_H, prog, COL_ACCENT);
        Fonts.TEST.draw("SERVER LIST", px0+10, y+8, 6.5f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(prog*220)));
        String cntStr = serverList.size() + " servers";
        Fonts.TEST.draw(cntStr, px0 + SRV_PANEL_W - Fonts.TEST.getWidth(cntStr, 5.5f) - 10,
                y+9, 5.5f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_MUTED, (int)(prog*130)));
        Render2D.rect(px0+10, y+19, SRV_PANEL_W-20, 1f, withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE, (int)(prog*40)), 0f);

        float listH = SRV_PANEL_H - LIST_Y_OFF - 10;
        float listX = px0 + LIST_X_OFF;
        float listY = y + LIST_Y_OFF;
        float listW = SRV_PANEL_W - LIST_X_OFF * 2;

        Scissor.enable(listX * FIXED_GUI_SCALE, listY * FIXED_GUI_SCALE,
                listW * FIXED_GUI_SCALE, listH * FIXED_GUI_SCALE, 1f);
        for (int i = 0; i < serverList.size(); i++) {
            float cardY = listY + i * (CARD_H + CARD_GAP) - scrollOffset;
            if (cardY + CARD_H < listY - 5 || cardY > listY + listH + 5) continue;
            renderServerCard(listX, cardY, listW, CARD_H,
                    serverList.get(i), i, alpha(prog), mx - slideX, my, listY, listH);
        }
        Scissor.disable();

        if (serverList.size() == 0)
            Fonts.TEST.draw("No servers added yet",
                    px0 + SRV_PANEL_W/2f - Fonts.TEST.getWidth("No servers added yet", 6f)/2f,
                    y + LIST_Y_OFF + listH/2f - 3f, 6f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_MUTED, (int)(prog*100)));
    }

    private void renderServerCard(float x, float y, float w, float h, ServerInfo info, int index,
                                  int alpha, float mx, float my, float listY, float listH) {
        boolean inBounds = my >= listY && my <= listY + listH;
        boolean hov = isOver(mx, my, x, y, w, h) && inBounds;
        boolean sel = index == selectedIndex;

        Render2D.rect(x, y, w, h, withAlpha(hov || sel ? COL_PANEL_BG2 : COL_PANEL,
                (int)((alpha/255f)*(hov||sel?170:110))), 0f);
        Render2D.rect(x, y, 2f, h, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT,
                (int)((alpha/255f)*(sel?220:hov?150:50))), 0f);
        Render2D.outline(x, y, w, h, OUTLINE_T,
                withAlpha(sel?COL_ACCENT:COL_OUTLINE, (int)((alpha/255f)*(sel?100:hov?70:35))), 0f);

        float faceX = x+8, faceY = y+(h-28f)/2f;
        Render2D.rect(faceX, faceY, 28f, 28f, withAlpha(COL_PANEL_BG2, alpha), 2f);
        Render2D.outline(faceX, faceY, 28f, 28f, OUTLINE_T, withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE, alpha), 2f);
        String init = (info.name != null && !info.name.isEmpty())
                ? String.valueOf(info.name.charAt(0)).toUpperCase() : "?";
        Fonts.BOLD.drawCentered(init, faceX+14f, faceY+14f - Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(10f)/2f,
                10f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, alpha));

        float tX = faceX + 28f + 8f;
        String name = info.name != null ? info.name : "Unknown";
        while (Fonts.TEST.getWidth(name, 7.5f) > w - 60 && name.length() > 2)
            name = name.substring(0, name.length()-1);
        if (!name.equals(info.name != null ? info.name : "Unknown")) name += "..";
        Fonts.TEST.draw(name, tX, y+9f, 7.5f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, alpha));
        Fonts.TEST.draw(info.address != null ? info.address : "", tX, y+20f, 5.5f,
                withAlpha(COL_TEXT_MUTED, (int)(alpha*0.7f)));
        Fonts.TEST.draw("...", tX, y+30f, 5f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_SUB, (int)(alpha*0.6f)));
    }

    private void renderField(float x, float y, float w, float h, float a,
                             String text, boolean focused, String placeholder, long now) {
        Render2D.rect(x, y, w, h, withAlpha(COL_PANEL_BG, (int)(a*150)), 0f);
        Render2D.rect(x, y+h-1f, w, 1f,
                withAlpha(focused?COL_ACCENT:COL_OUTLINE, (int)(a*(focused?200:100))), 0f);
        Render2D.outline(x, y, w, h, OUTLINE_T,
                withAlpha(focused?COL_ACCENT:COL_OUTLINE, (int)(a*60)), 0f);
        boolean empty = text.isEmpty() && !focused;
        Fonts.TEST.draw(empty ? placeholder : text, x+5, y+5f, 5.5f,
                withAlpha(empty?COL_TEXT_SUB:COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, (int)(a*(empty?200:255))));
        if (focused && (now/500)%2==0) {
            float cx = x+5 + Fonts.TEST.getWidth(text, 5.5f);
            Render2D.rect(cx+1, y+3, 0.5f, h-6, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(a*220)), 0f);
        }
    }

        Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(label,
                x+w/2f - Fonts.REGULARNEW.getWidth(label,lblSz)/2f + 2f,
                y+h/2f - Fonts.REGULARNEW.getHeight(lblSz)/2f,
                lblSz, withAlpha(COL_TEXT_PRIMARY, (int)(a*(hov?255:200))));
    }

    private void drawPanel(float x, float y, float w, float h, float a, int accent) {
        Render2D.rect(x, y, w, h, withAlpha(COL_PANEL, (int)(a*140)), 0f);
        Render2D.rect(x, y, 2f, h, withAlpha(accent, (int)(a*200)), 0f);
        Render2D.outline(x, y, w, h, OUTLINE_T, withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE, (int)(a*70)), 0f);
    }

    private void updateHover(float mx, float my, int sw, int sh, float prog) {
        if (prog < 0.5f || dcPopupOpen || addPopupOpen) { hoveredBtn = -1; return; }
        float slideX = (1f - prog) * -40f;
        float bx = getPanelStartX(sw) + slideX + 10f;
        float by = getPanelStartY(sh) + 26f;
        float btnH = 17f, btnGap = 3f;
        hoveredBtn = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < BTN_COUNT; i++) {
            if (isOver(mx, my, bx, by, BTN_PANEL_W-20f, btnH)) { hoveredBtn = i; break; }
            by += btnH + btnGap;
        }
    }

    private void updateButtonAnimations(float dt) {
        for (int i = 0; i < BTN_COUNT; i++) {
            btnHover[i] = MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f, btnHover[i], hoveredBtn==i?1f:0f);
            btnScale[i] = MathHelper.lerp(dt*13f, btnScale[i], hoveredBtn==i?1.04f:1f);
        }
        exitRedProg = MathHelper.lerp(dt*9f, exitRedProg, hoveredBtn==4?1f:0f);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(net.minecraft.client.gui.Click click, boolean doubled) {
        float mx = toFixed(click.x()), my = toFixed(click.y());
        int   sw = getFixedW(), sh = getFixedH();
        long  now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();

        if (dcPopupOpen) {
            float pw=220f, ph=80f, px0=sw/2f-pw/2f, py0=sh/2f-ph/2f;
            float btnX=px0+pw/2f-35f, btnY=py0+ph-24f;
            if (isOver(mx,my,px0+10,py0+30,pw-20,16f)) { dcFocused=true; return true; }
            if (isOver(mx,my,btnX,btnY,70f,16f)) { connectDirect(); return true; }
            if (!isOver(mx,my,px0,py0,pw,ph)) dcPopupOpen=false;
            return true;
        }

        if (addPopupOpen) {
            float pw=230f, ph=100f, px0=sw/2f-pw/2f, py0=sh/2f-ph/2f;
            float btnX=px0+pw/2f-35f, btnY=py0+ph-21f;
            if (isOver(mx,my,px0+10,py0+34,pw-20,16f)) { addNameFocused=true; return true; }
            if (isOver(mx,my,px0+10,py0+63,pw-20,16f)) { addNameFocused=false; return true; }
            if (isOver(mx,my,btnX,btnY,70f,16f)) { commitAddEdit(); return true; }
            if (!isOver(mx,my,px0,py0,pw,ph)) addPopupOpen=false;
            return true;
        }

        if (vfpErrorPopupOpen) {
            vfpErrorPopupOpen = false;
            return true;
        }

        float prog   = getAppearProgress(now);
        float slideX = (1f - prog) * 40f;
        float listX  = getSrvPanelX(sw) + slideX + LIST_X_OFF;
        float listY  = getPanelStartY(sh) + LIST_Y_OFF;
        float listW  = SRV_PANEL_W - LIST_X_OFF * 2;
        float listH  = SRV_PANEL_H - LIST_Y_OFF - 10;

        if (isOver(mx, my, listX, listY, listW, listH)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < serverList.size(); i++) {
                float cardY = listY + i*(CARD_H+CARD_GAP) - scrollOffset;
                if (isOver(mx, my, listX, cardY, listW, CARD_H)) {
                    if (selectedIndex==i && doubled) connectSelected();
                    else selectedIndex = i;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        if (hoveredBtn >= 0) { handleButtonClick(hoveredBtn, now); return true; }
        return super.mouseClicked(click, doubled);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mx, double my, double hA, double vA) {
        float smx = toFixed(mx), smy = toFixed(my);
        int sw = getFixedW(), sh = getFixedH();
        long now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        float prog = getAppearProgress(now);
        float slideX = (1f-prog)*40f;
        if (isOver(smx, smy, getSrvPanelX(sw)+slideX, getPanelStartY(sh), SRV_PANEL_W, SRV_PANEL_H)) {
            float listH  = SRV_PANEL_H - LIST_Y_OFF - 10;
            float totalH = serverList.size()*(CARD_H+CARD_GAP) - CARD_GAP;
            targetScroll = MathHelper.clamp(targetScroll-(float)vA*25, 0, Math.max(0,totalH-listH));
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mx, my, hA, vA);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(KeyInput input) {
        int key = input.key();
        if (vfpErrorPopupOpen) { if (key==256) vfpErrorPopupOpen=false; return true; }
        if (dcPopupOpen) {
            if (key==256) { dcPopupOpen=false; return true; }
            if (key==257||key==335) { connectDirect(); return true; }
            if (key==259 && !dcAddress.isEmpty()) { dcAddress=dcAddress.substring(0,dcAddress.length()-1); return true; }
            return true;
        }
        if (addPopupOpen) {
            if (key==256) { addPopupOpen=false; return true; }
            if (key==258) { addNameFocused=!addNameFocused; return true; }
            if (key==257||key==335) { commitAddEdit(); return true; }
            if (key==259) {
                if (addNameFocused) { if (!addName.isEmpty()) addName=addName.substring(0,addName.length()-1); }
                else { if (!addAddress.isEmpty()) addAddress=addAddress.substring(0,addAddress.length()-1); }
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (key==256) { client.setScreen(parentScreen); return true; }
        if ((key==257||key==335) && selectedIndex>=0) { connectSelected(); return true; }
        if (key==265 && selectedIndex>0) { selectedIndex--; return true; }
        if (key==264 && selectedIndex<serverList.size()-1) { selectedIndex++; return true; }
        return super.keyPressed(input);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(CharInput input) {
        char c = (char) input.codepoint();
        if (dcPopupOpen && dcFocused && c>=32 && dcAddress.length()<128) { dcAddress+=c; return true; }
        if (addPopupOpen && c>=32) {
            if (addNameFocused && addName.length()<64) addName+=c;
            else if (!addNameFocused && addAddress.length()<128) addAddress+=c;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(input);
    }

    private void handleButtonClick(int index, long now) {
        switch (index) {
            case 0 -> connectSelected();
            case 1 -> { dcAddress=""; dcFocused=true; dcPopupOpen=true; dcPopupTime=now; }
            case 2 -> openAddPopup(false, now);
            case 3 -> { if (selectedIndex>=0) openAddPopup(true, now); }
            case 4 -> deleteSelected();
            case 5 -> client.setScreen(new GuiProxy(this));
            case 6 -> {
                if (vfpAvailable) openVfpScreen();
                else openVfpError();
            }
            case 7 -> openVanillaMultiplayer();
            case 8 -> client.setScreen(parentScreen);
        }
    }

    private void connectSelected() {
        if (selectedIndex<0||selectedIndex>=serverList.size()) return;
        ServerInfo info = serverList.get(selectedIndex);
        ConnectScreen.connect(this, client, ServerAddress.parse(info.address), info, false, null);
    }

    private void connectDirect() {
        if (dcAddress.isEmpty()) return;
        dcPopupOpen = false;
        ServerInfo info = new ServerInfo("Direct Connect", dcAddress, ServerInfo.ServerType.OTHER);
        ConnectScreen.connect(this, client, ServerAddress.parse(dcAddress), info, false, null);
    }

    private void openAddPopup(boolean edit, long now) {
        editMode=edit; addPopupOpen=true; addPopupTime=now; addNameFocused=true;
        if (edit && selectedIndex>=0 && selectedIndex<serverList.size()) {
            ServerInfo info = serverList.get(selectedIndex);
            addName    = info.name    != null ? info.name    : "";
            addAddress = info.address != null ? info.address : "";
        } else { addName=""; addAddress=""; }
    }

    private void commitAddEdit() {
        if (addName.isEmpty()||addAddress.isEmpty()) return;
        if (editMode && selectedIndex>=0 && selectedIndex<serverList.size()) {
            ServerInfo info = serverList.get(selectedIndex);
            info.name=addName; info.address=addAddress; serverList.saveFile();
        } else {
            serverList.add(new ServerInfo(addName, addAddress, ServerInfo.ServerType.OTHER), false);
            serverList.saveFile();
        }
        addPopupOpen=false;
    }

    private void deleteSelected() {
        if (selectedIndex<0||selectedIndex>=serverList.size()) return;
        serverList.remove(serverList.get(selectedIndex)); serverList.saveFile();
        if (selectedIndex>=serverList.size()) selectedIndex=serverList.size()-1;
    }

    private void openVanillaMultiplayer() {
        VanillaMultiplayerFlag.skipRedirect = true;
        client.setScreen(new MultiplayerScreen(parentScreen));
    }

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        drawBackground(currentZoom, getFixedW(), getFixedH());
    }

    @Override public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc() { return false; }
    @Override public boolean shouldPause()       { return false; }

    private boolean isOver(float mx, float my, float x, float y, float w, float h) {
        return mx>=x && mx<=x+w && my>=y && my<=y+h;
    }
    private int alpha(float f) { return MathHelper.clamp((int)(f*255), 0, 255); }
    private int withAlpha(int color, int alpha) {
        return (color&0x00FFFFFF)|(MathHelper.clamp(alpha,0,255)<<24);
    }
    private int mix(int a, int b, float t) {
        int ar=(a>>16)&0xFF, ag=(a>>8)&0xFF, ab=a&0xFF;
        int br=(b>>16)&0xFF, bg=(b>>8)&0xFF, bb=b&0xFF;
        return ((int)(ar+(br-ar)*t)<<16)|((int)(ag+(bg-ag)*t)<<8)|(int)(ab+(bb-ab)*t);
    }
}

    public CustomCreateWorldScreen(Screen parent) {
        super(Text.literal("Create World"));
        this.parentScreen = parent;

    private int getFixedW() { return (int)Math.ceil((double)client.getWindow().getFramebufferWidth() / FIXED_GUI_SCALE); }
    private int getFixedH() { return (int)Math.ceil((double)client.getWindow().getFramebufferHeight() / FIXED_GUI_SCALE); }
