    private float easeOutQuart(float x) { return 1f - (float)Math.pow(1f - x, 4); }
    private float getAppearProg(long now) {
        long e = now - openTime - 40L;
        return e < 0 ? 0f : easeOutQuart(MathHelper.clamp((float)e / APPEAR_DUR, 0f, 1f));
    }


    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        long now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        if (!initialized) {
            openTime = now; lastRender = now; initialized = true;
            int sw = getFixedW(), sh = getFixedH(); Random rng = new Random();
            for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) { px[i] = rng.nextFloat()*sw; py[i] = rng.nextFloat()*sh; }
        }
        float dt = MathHelper.clamp((now - lastRender) / 1000f, 0f, 0.1f);
        lastRender = now;
        float prog = getAppearProg(now);
        currentZoom = MathHelper.lerp(dt * 2.5f, currentZoom, 1.0f);

        int sw = getFixedW(), sh = getFixedH();
        float mx = toFixed(mouseX), my = toFixed(mouseY);
        float panX = sw / 2f - PANEL_W / 2f;
        float panY = sh / 2f - PANEL_H / 2f;

        updateParticles(dt, mx, my, sw, sh);
        updateHover(mx, my, panX, panY, prog, now);
        updateAnimations(dt);

        Render2D.beginOverlay();
        drawBackground(currentZoom, sw, sh);
        renderParticles(mx, my, MathHelper.clamp(prog * 1.5f, 0f, 1f));

        if (prog > 0.01f) {
            renderPanel(panX, panY, mx, my, prog, now);
        }


        float slideY = (1f - prog) * -20f;
        Fonts.BOLD.draw("RASTY", 14f, 14f + slideY, 18f, withAlpha(COL_TEXT, (int)(prog * 255)));
        Fonts.TEST.draw("CLIENT", 14f + Fonts.BOLD.getWidth("RASTY", 18f) + 5f, 14f + slideY + 7f, 7f, withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, (int)(prog * 180)));

        Render2D.blur(mx, my, 1, 1, 15f, 1, new Color(128, 128, 128, 0).getRGB());
        Render2D.endOverlay();
    }

    private void drawPanel(float x, float y, float w, float h, float alpha, int accent) {
        Render2D.blur(x, y, w, h, BLUR_R, 0f, withAlpha(0x060810, (int)(alpha * 70)));
        int bgA = (int)(alpha * 130);
        int[] bg = {withAlpha(COL_PANEL, bgA), withAlpha(COL_PANEL_BG2, bgA), withAlpha(COL_PANEL_BG, bgA), withAlpha(COL_PANEL, bgA)};
        Render2D.gradientRect(x, y, w, h, bg, 0f);
        Render2D.rect(x, y, 2f, h, withAlpha(accent & 0x00FFFFFF, (int)(alpha * 200)), 0f);
        Render2D.outline(x, y, w, h, OUTLINE_T, withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE, (int)(alpha * 70)), 0f);
    }


    private void drawBackground(float zoom, int sw, int sh) {
        float zw = sw * zoom, zh = sh * zoom, ox = (sw - zw) / 2f, oy = (sh - zh) / 2f;
        int[] c = {0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF}; float[] r = {0,0,0,0};
        Initialization.getInstance().getManager().getRenderCore().getTexturePipeline()
                .drawTexture(Identifier.of("rasty", "textures/menu/backmenu.png"), ox, oy, zw, zh, 0, 0, 1, 1, c, r, 1f);
    }

    private void updateParticles(float dt, float mx, float my, int sw, int sh) {
        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
            float dx = mx - px[i], dy = my - py[i], d = (float)Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
            if (d < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST && d > 1f) { pvx[i]+=(dx/d)*PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE*dt*60f; pvy[i]+=(dy/d)*PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE*dt*60f; }
            float sp = (float)Math.sqrt(pvx[i]*pvx[i]+pvy[i]*pvy[i]), maxSp = PARTICLE_SPEED * 1.8f;
            if (sp > maxSp) { pvx[i]=pvx[i]/sp*maxSp; pvy[i]=pvy[i]/sp*maxSp; }
            px[i]+=pvx[i]*dt; py[i]+=pvy[i]*dt;
            if (px[i]<-5) px[i]=sw+5; if (px[i]>sw+5) px[i]=-5;
            if (py[i]<-5) py[i]=sh+5; if (py[i]>sh+5) py[i]=-5;
        }
    }

    private void renderParticles(float mx, float my, float alpha) {
        if (alpha < 0.01f) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) for (int j = i+1; j < PARTICLE_COUNT; j++) {
            float dx = px[j]-px[i], dy = py[j]-py[i], dist = (float)Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
            if (dist < PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST && dist > 0.5f) {
                float t  = 1f - dist / PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST;
                float md = Math.min((float)Math.sqrt((mx-px[i])*(mx-px[i])+(my-py[i])*(my-py[i])),
                                    (float)Math.sqrt((mx-px[j])*(mx-px[j])+(my-py[j])*(my-py[j])));
                float boost = md < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST ? 1f+(1f-md/PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST)*2f : 1f;
                int la = MathHelper.clamp((int)(t*t*90*alpha*boost), 0, 255);
                int lc = md < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST ? withAlpha(COL_ACCENT, la) : withAlpha(0x2A3A4A, la);
                int steps = Math.max(1, (int)(dist/2f)); float sx = dx/steps, sy = dy/steps;
                for (int s = 0; s <= steps; s++) Render2D.rect(px[i]+sx*s, py[i]+sy*s, 1f, 1f, lc, 0f);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
            float mdx = mx-px[i], mdy = my-py[i], md = (float)Math.sqrt(mdx*mdx+mdy*mdy);
            float g = md < PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST ? 1f - md/PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST : 0f;
            int da = MathHelper.clamp((int)((0.3f+pbright[i]*0.5f+g*0.4f)*255*alpha), 0, 255);
            int dc; if (g > 0.05f) { int rr=(int)(0x2A+g*(0x00-0x2A)),gg=(int)(0x3A+g*(0xE5-0x3A)),bb=(int)(0x4A+g*(0xFF-0x4A)); dc=withAlpha((rr<<16)|(gg<<8)|bb,da); } else dc=withAlpha(0x4A5A7A,da);
            Render2D.rect(px[i]-PARTICLE_SIZE/2f, py[i]-PARTICLE_SIZE/2f, PARTICLE_SIZE, PARTICLE_SIZE, dc, 0f);
        }
    }


    private void updateHover(float mx, float my, float px2, float py2, float prog, long now) {
        if (prog < 0.4f) { hoveredTab=-1; hoverCreate=false; hoverCancel=false; return; }
        float slideY = (1f-prog)*25f, ry = py2 + slideY;
        float fx = px2 + 10f, fw = PANEL_W - 20f;
        float tabW = (fw - 9f) / 4f;


        float curY = ry + 26f + 8f + FIELD_H + 6f + 8f + FIELD_H + 8f + 8f + 8f;

        hoveredTab = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            float tx = fx + i * (tabW + 3f);
            if (isOver(mx, my, tx, curY, tabW, 14f)) { hoveredTab = i; break; }
        }

        float btnW = (PANEL_W - 24f) / 2f;
        float btnH = 17f, btnY = py2 + PANEL_H - btnH - 10f + slideY;
        hoverCreate = isOver(mx, my, px2 + 10, btnY, btnW, btnH);
        hoverCancel = isOver(mx, my, px2 + 14 + btnW, btnY, btnW, btnH);


        float tfy = curY + 14f + 4f;
        float tw = (fw - 6f) / 2f;
        hovHardcore = isOver(mx, my, fx,     tfy,    tw, 13f);
        hovCheats   = isOver(mx, my, fx+tw+6f, tfy,  tw, 13f);
        hovStruct   = isOver(mx, my, fx,     tfy+16f, tw, 13f);
        hovBonus    = isOver(mx, my, fx+tw+6f, tfy+16f, tw, 13f);
    }

    private void updateAnimations(float dt) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            tabHover[i] = MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f, tabHover[i], hoveredTab==i ? 1f : 0f);
        createHover  = MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f, createHover,  hoverCreate  ? 1f : 0f);
        cancelHover  = MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f, cancelHover,  hoverCancel  ? 1f : 0f);
        hardcoreHov  = MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f, hardcoreHov,  hovHardcore  ? 1f : 0f);
        cheatsHov    = MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f, cheatsHov,    hovCheats    ? 1f : 0f);
        structHov    = MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f, structHov,    hovStruct    ? 1f : 0f);
        bonusHov     = MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f, bonusHov,     hovBonus     ? 1f : 0f);
    }


    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(Click click, boolean doubled) {
        float mx = toFixed(click.x()), my = toFixed(click.y());
        long  now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        int   sw  = getFixedW(), sh  = getFixedH();
        float prog = getAppearProg(now);
        float slideY = (1f - prog) * 25f;
        float panX = sw / 2f - PANEL_W / 2f;
        float panY = sh / 2f - PANEL_H / 2f + slideY;
        float fx = panX + 10f, fw = PANEL_W - 20f;


        float nameFieldY = panY + 26f + 8f;
        if (isOver(mx, my, fx, nameFieldY, fw, FIELD_H)) { focusedField = 1; cursorBlink = now; return true; }


        float seedFieldY = nameFieldY + FIELD_H + 6f + 8f;
        if (isOver(mx, my, fx, seedFieldY, fw, FIELD_H)) { focusedField = 2; cursorBlink = now; return true; }


        float tabsY = seedFieldY + FIELD_H + 8f + 8f + 8f;
        float tabW  = (fw - 9f) / 4f;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            float tx = fx + i * (tabW + 3f);
            if (isOver(mx, my, tx, tabsY, tabW, 14f)) {
                selectedMode = i;
                if (i == 1) hardcore = false;
                focusedField = 0;
                return true;
            }
        }


        float tfy = tabsY + 14f + 4f;
        float tw   = (fw - 6f) / 2f;
        if (isOver(mx, my, fx,       tfy,     tw, 13f)) { hardcore   = !hardcore;   if (hardcore) selectedMode = 0; focusedField=0; return true; }
        if (isOver(mx, my, fx+tw+6f, tfy,     tw, 13f)) { cheats     = !cheats;     focusedField=0; return true; }
        if (isOver(mx, my, fx,       tfy+16f, tw, 13f)) { structures = !structures; focusedField=0; return true; }
        if (isOver(mx, my, fx+tw+6f, tfy+16f, tw, 13f)) { bonusChest = !bonusChest; focusedField=0; return true; }


        float btnW = (PANEL_W - 24f) / 2f, btnH = 17f;
        float btnY = sh / 2f - PANEL_H / 2f + PANEL_H - btnH - 10f + slideY;
        if (isOver(mx, my, panX + 10, btnY, btnW, btnH)) { createWorld(); return true; }
        if (isOver(mx, my, panX + 14 + btnW, btnY, btnW, btnH)) { client.setScreen(parentScreen); return true; }


        focusedField = 0;
        return super.mouseClicked(click, doubled);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(KeyInput input) {
        int key = input.key();
        if (key == 256) {
            if (focusedField != 0) { focusedField = 0; return true; }
            client.setScreen(parentScreen); return true;
        }
        if (key == 257 || key == 335) {
            if (focusedField == 1) { focusedField = 2; cursorBlink = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs(); return true; }
            if (focusedField == 2) { createWorld(); return true; }
        }
        if (key == 259) {
            if (focusedField == 1 && !worldName.isEmpty())
                worldName = worldName.substring(0, worldName.length() - 1);
            if (focusedField == 2 && !seed.isEmpty())
                seed = seed.substring(0, seed.length() - 1);
            cursorBlink = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
            return true;
        }
        if (key == 9) {
            focusedField = focusedField == 1 ? 2 : 1;
            cursorBlink = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(input);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(CharInput input) {
        int cp = input.codepoint();
        if (focusedField == 1) {
            if (worldName.length() < 32) { worldName += Character.toString(cp); cursorBlink = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs(); }
            return true;
        }
        if (focusedField == 2) {
            if (seed.length() < 20) { seed += Character.toString(cp); cursorBlink = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs(); }
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(input);
    }


    private void createWorld() {
        if (worldName.trim().isEmpty()) { worldName = "New World"; return; }


        try {

            for (java.lang.reflect.Method m : CreateWorldScreen.class.getMethods()) {
                if (!m.getName().equals("create")) continue;
                Class<?>[] p = m.getParameterTypes();
                Object[] args = new Object[p.length];
                for (int i = 0; i < p.length; i++) {
                    if (p[i].isAssignableFrom(MinecraftClient.class)) args[i] = client;
                    else if (p[i].isAssignableFrom(Screen.class))     args[i] = parentScreen;
                    else args[i] = null;
                }
                m.invoke(null, args);
                return;
            }
        } catch (Exception e) { e.printStackTrace(); }


        client.setScreen(parentScreen);
    }


    @Override public void renderBackground(DrawContext ctx, int mx, int my, float d) { drawBackground(currentZoom, getFixedW(), getFixedH()); }
    @Override public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc() { return false; }
    @Override public boolean shouldPause()      { return false; }

    private boolean isOver(float mx, float my, float x, float y, float w, float h) { return mx>=x&&mx<=x+w&&my>=y&&my<=y+h; }
    private int withAlpha(int c, int a) { return (c & 0x00FFFFFF) | (MathHelper.clamp(a, 0, 255) << 24); }
}

    public CustomSingleplayerScreen(Screen parent) {

            pvx[i] = (float)Math.cos(angle)*spd;

    private void loadWorlds() {
        worlds.clear();
        try {
            LevelStorage storage = client.getLevelStorage();

            Object levelList = storage.getClass().getMethod("getLevelList").invoke(storage);
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            List<Object> saves = (List<Object>) levelList.getClass().getMethod("levels").invoke(levelList);
            SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm");

            if (saves.isEmpty()) {
                System.out.println("[Rastyclient] saves list is EMPTY вЂ” РїР°РїРєР° saves РїСѓСЃС‚Р°СЏ РёР»Рё getLevelList РІРµСЂРЅСѓР» РїСѓСЃС‚Рѕ");
                return;
            }

            Object first = saves.get(0);
            System.out.println("[Rastyclient] LevelSave class: " + first.getClass().getName());
            System.out.println("[Rastyclient] === METHODS ===");
            for (java.lang.reflect.Method m : first.getClass().getMethods()) {
                if (m.getDeclaringClass() == Object.class) continue;
                System.out.println("  " + m.getReturnType().getSimpleName() + " " + m.getName() + "()");
            }
            System.out.println("[Rastyclient] === FIELDS ===");
            for (java.lang.reflect.Field f : first.getClass().getDeclaredFields()) {
                System.out.println("  " + f.getType().getSimpleName() + " " + f.getName());
            }

            try {
                Object[] comps = (Object[]) first.getClass().getMethod("getRecordComponents").invoke(null);
                System.out.println("[Rastyclient] === RECORD COMPONENTS ===");
                if (comps != null) for (Object c : comps) {
                    System.out.println("  " + c);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            java.io.File savesDir = storage.getSavesDirectory().toFile();
            saves.sort((a, b) -> {
                long ta = getWorldFolderTime(a, savesDir);
                long tb = getWorldFolderTime(b, savesDir);
                return Long.compare(tb, ta);
            });

            for (Object s : saves) {
                String levelName   = saveGetName(s, savesDir);
                long   time        = getWorldFolderTime(s, savesDir);
                String lastPlayed  = time > 0 ? sdf.format(new Date(time)) : "Unknown";
                String displayName = saveGetDisplayName(s, levelName);
                String gameMode    = saveGetGameMode(s);
                boolean hardcore   = saveGetHardcore(s);
                boolean cheats     = saveGetCheats(s);
                worlds.add(new WorldEntry(levelName, displayName, lastPlayed, gameMode, hardcore, cheats));
                System.out.println("[Rastyclient] Loaded world: " + levelName + " / " + displayName);
            }
            System.out.println("[Rastyclient] Total worlds loaded: " + worlds.size());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[Rastyclient] loadWorlds EXCEPTION: " + e.getClass().getName() + ": " + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    private String saveGetName(Object s, java.io.File savesDir) {
        for (String n : new String[]{"getName", "getLevelName", "name"}) {
            try {
                Object r = s.getClass().getMethod(n).invoke(s);
                if (r instanceof String str && !str.isEmpty()) return str;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        for (String n : new String[]{"getRootPath", "getDirectory", "getPath", "path", "rootPath"}) {
            try {
                Object r = s.getClass().getMethod(n).invoke(s);
                if (r == null) continue;
                String cls = r.getClass().getName();
                if (cls.contains("Path")) {
                    Object fileName = r.getClass().getMethod("getFileName").invoke(r);
                    if (fileName != null) return fileName.toString();
                }
                if (r instanceof java.io.File f) return f.getName();
                if (r instanceof String str && !str.isEmpty()) return str;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field f : s.getClass().getDeclaredFields()) {
            f.setAccessible(true);
            try {
                Object v = f.get(s);
                if (v instanceof String str && !str.isEmpty()) return str;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return "world_" + s.hashCode();
    }

    private long getWorldFolderTime(Object s, java.io.File savesDir) {

        for (String n : new String[]{"getLastPlayed", "lastModified", "getLastModified", "getLastSaved"}) {
            try {
                Object r = s.getClass().getMethod(n).invoke(s);
                if (r instanceof Long l && l > 0) return l;
                if (r instanceof Long l) return l;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }

        try {
            String name = saveGetName(s, savesDir);
            java.io.File dir = new java.io.File(savesDir, name);
            if (dir.exists()) return dir.lastModified();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return 0L;
    }

    private String saveGetDisplayName(Object s, String fallback) {
        for (String n : new String[]{"getDisplayName", "getVersionName", "getWorldName"}) {
            try {
                Object r = s.getClass().getMethod(n).invoke(s);
                if (r instanceof Text t) return t.getString();
                if (r instanceof String str && !str.isEmpty()) return str;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    private String saveGetGameMode(Object s) {
        for (String mn : new String[]{"getGameMode", "getDefaultGameMode", "getGameType"}) {
            try {
                Object gm = s.getClass().getMethod(mn).invoke(s);
                if (gm == null) continue;
                for (String m2 : new String[]{"getId", "getName", "getTranslatableName"}) {
                    try { return (String) gm.getClass().getMethod(m2).invoke(gm); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                try { return gm.getClass().getMethod("name").invoke(gm).toString().toLowerCase(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return "survival";
    }

    private boolean saveGetHardcore(Object s) {
        for (String n : new String[]{"isHardcore", "hardcore"}) {
            try { return (boolean) s.getClass().getMethod(n).invoke(s); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean saveGetCheats(Object s) {
        for (String n : new String[]{"hasCheats", "areCommandsAllowed", "cheatsEnabled", "allowsCommands"}) {
            try { return (boolean) s.getClass().getMethod(n).invoke(s); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return false;
    }

    private int getFixedW() { return (int)Math.ceil((double)client.getWindow().getFramebufferWidth()/FIXED_GUI_SCALE); }
    private int getFixedH() { return (int)Math.ceil((double)client.getWindow().getFramebufferHeight()/FIXED_GUI_SCALE); }
    private float toFixed(double c) { return (float)(c*(float)client.getWindow().getScaleFactor()/FIXED_GUI_SCALE); }

    private float getStartX(int sw) { return sw/2f-(BTN_PANEL_W+GAP+WORLD_PANEL_W)/2f; }
    private float getStartY(int sh) { return sh/2f-BTN_PANEL_H/2f; }
    private float getWorldPanelX(int sw) { return getStartX(sw)+BTN_PANEL_W+GAP; }

    private float easeOutQuart(float x) { return 1f-(float)Math.pow(1f-x,4); }
    private float getAppearProg(long now) {
        long e = now-openTime-60L;
        return e<0?0f:easeOutQuart(MathHelper.clamp((float)e/APPEAR_DUR,0f,1f));
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        long now = Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        if (!initialized) {
            openTime=now; lastRender=now; initialized=true;
            if (ParticleState.hasState()) {

                int copyCount = Math.min(PARTICLE_COUNT, ParticleState.getPx().length);
                for (int i = 0; i < copyCount; i++) {
                    px[i]      = ParticleState.getPx()[i];
                    py[i]      = ParticleState.getPy()[i];
                    pvx[i]     = ParticleState.getPvx()[i];
                    pvy[i]     = ParticleState.getPvy()[i];
                    pbright[i] = ParticleState.getPbright()[i];
                }
            } else if (!particlesPreloaded) {
                int sw=getFixedW(),sh=getFixedH(); Random rng=new Random();
                for(int i=0;i<PARTICLE_COUNT;i++){px[i]=rng.nextFloat()*sw;py[i]=rng.nextFloat()*sh;}
            }
        }
        float dt=MathHelper.clamp((now-lastRender)/1000f,0f,0.1f); lastRender=now;
        float prog=getAppearProg(now);
        currentZoom=MathHelper.lerp(dt*2.5f,currentZoom,1.0f);
        scrollOffset+=(targetScroll-scrollOffset)*Math.min(1f,dt*12f);

        int sw=getFixedW(),sh=getFixedH();
        float mx=toFixed(mouseX),my=toFixed(mouseY);

        updateParticles(dt,mx,my,sw,sh);
        updateHover(mx,my,sw,sh,prog);
        updateButtonAnimations(dt);

        if(deleteConfirmOpen){
            float pw=180f,ph=70f,cpx=sw/2f-pw/2f,cpy=sh/2f-ph/2f;
            float btnW=65f,btnH=16f,gap6=6f,btnStartX=cpx+pw/2f-(btnW*2+gap6)/2f,btnY=cpy+ph-btnH-7f;
            confirmHovered=-1;
            if(isOver(mx,my,btnStartX,btnY,btnW,btnH))confirmHovered=0;
            if(isOver(mx,my,btnStartX+btnW+gap6,btnY,btnW,btnH))confirmHovered=1;
            for(int i=0;i<2;i++)confirmHover[i]=MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f,confirmHover[i],confirmHovered==i?1f:0f);
        }

        Render2D.beginOverlay();
        drawBackground(currentZoom,sw,sh);
        renderParticles(mx,my,MathHelper.clamp(prog*1.5f,0f,1f));
        if(prog>0.01f){renderBtnPanel(sw,sh,mx,my,prog);renderWorldPanel(sw,sh,mx,my,prog,now);}
        if(deleteConfirmOpen) renderDeleteConfirm(sw,sh,now);

        Fonts.BOLD.draw("RASTY",14f,14f,18f,withAlpha(COL_TEXT,(int)(prog*255)));
        Fonts.TEST.draw("CLIENT",14f+Fonts.BOLD.getWidth("RASTY",18f)+5f,14f+7f,7f,withAlpha(COL_ACCENT,(int)(prog*180)));
        String cr="Rasty Client  В©  All Rights Reserved";
        Fonts.TEST.draw(cr,sw-Fonts.TEST.getWidth(cr,5f)-8f,sh-9f,5f,withAlpha(COL_SUB,(int)(prog*180)));

        Render2D.blur(mx,my,1,1,BLUR_R,1,new Color(128,128,128,0).getRGB());
        Render2D.endOverlay();
    }

    private void drawBackground(float zoom,int sw,int sh){
        float zw=sw*zoom,zh=sh*zoom,ox=(sw-zw)/2f,oy=(sh-zh)/2f;
        int[]c={0xFFFFFFFF,0xFFFFFFFF,0xFFFFFFFF,0xFFFFFFFF};float[]r={0,0,0,0};
        Initialization.getInstance().getManager().getRenderCore().getTexturePipeline()
                .drawTexture(Identifier.of("rasty","textures/menu/backmenu.png"),ox,oy,zw,zh,0,0,1,1,c,r,1f);
    }

    private void updateParticles(float dt,float mx,float my,int sw,int sh){
        for(int i=0;i<PARTICLE_COUNT;i++){
            float dx=mx-px[i],dy=my-py[i],d=(float)Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
            if(d<PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST&&d>1f){pvx[i]+=(dx/d)*PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE*dt*60f;pvy[i]+=(dy/d)*PARTICLE_ATTRACT_FORCE*dt*60f;}
            float sp=(float)Math.sqrt(pvx[i]*pvx[i]+pvy[i]*pvy[i]),maxSp=PARTICLE_SPEED*1.8f;
            if(sp>maxSp){pvx[i]=pvx[i]/sp*maxSp;pvy[i]=pvy[i]/sp*maxSp;}
            px[i]+=pvx[i]*dt;py[i]+=pvy[i]*dt;
            if(px[i]<-5)px[i]=sw+5;if(px[i]>sw+5)px[i]=-5;
            if(py[i]<-5)py[i]=sh+5;if(py[i]>sh+5)py[i]=-5;
        }
    }

    private void renderParticles(float mx,float my,float alpha){
        if(alpha<0.01f)return;
        for(int i=0;i<PARTICLE_COUNT;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<PARTICLE_COUNT;j++){
            float dx=px[j]-px[i],dy=py[j]-py[i],dist=(float)Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
            if(dist<PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST&&dist>0.5f){
                float t=1f-dist/PARTICLE_CONNECT_DIST;
                float md=Math.min((float)Math.sqrt((mx-px[i])*(mx-px[i])+(my-py[i])*(my-py[i])),(float)Math.sqrt((mx-px[j])*(mx-px[j])+(my-py[j])*(my-py[j])));
                float boost=md<PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST?1f+(1f-md/PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST)*2f:1f;
                int la=MathHelper.clamp((int)(t*t*95*alpha*boost),0,255);
                int lc=md<PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST?withAlpha(COL_ACCENT,la):withAlpha(0x2A3A4A,la);
                int steps=Math.max(1,(int)(dist/2f));float sx=dx/steps,sy=dy/steps;
                for(int s=0;s<=steps;s++)Render2D.rect(px[i]+sx*s,py[i]+sy*s,1f,1f,lc,0f);
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<PARTICLE_COUNT;i++){
            float mdx=mx-px[i],mdy=my-py[i],md=(float)Math.sqrt(mdx*mdx+mdy*mdy);
            float g=md<PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST?1f-md/PARTICLE_ATTRACT_DIST:0f;
            int da=MathHelper.clamp((int)((0.3f+pbright[i]*0.5f+g*0.4f)*255*alpha),0,255);
            int dc;if(g>0.05f){int r=(int)(0x2A+g*(0x00-0x2A)),gg=(int)(0x3A+g*(0xE5-0x3A)),b=(int)(0x4A+g*(0xFF-0x4A));dc=withAlpha((r<<16)|(gg<<8)|b,da);}else dc=withAlpha(0x4A5A7A,da);
            Render2D.rect(px[i]-PARTICLE_SIZE/2f,py[i]-PARTICLE_SIZE/2f,PARTICLE_SIZE,PARTICLE_SIZE,dc,0f);
        }
    }

    private void renderBtnPanel(int sw,int sh,float mx,float my,float prog){
        float x=getStartX(sw),y=getStartY(sh),slideX=(1f-prog)*-40f,rx=x+slideX;
        drawPanel(rx,y,BTN_PANEL_W,BTN_PANEL_H,prog,COL_ACCENT);

        Render2D.rect(rx+10,y+19,BTN_PANEL_W-20,1f,withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE,(int)(prog*40)),0f);
        float btnW=BTN_PANEL_W-20f,btnH=18f,btnGap=4f,btnY=y+26f;
        for(int i=0;i<5;i++){
            if(i==3)Render2D.rect(rx+10,btnY-2,btnW,1f,withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE,(int)(prog*40)),0f);
            renderSideButton(i,rx+10,btnY,btnW,btnH,prog,mx-slideX,my);
            btnY+=btnH+btnGap;
        }
    }

    private void renderSideButton(int idx,float x,float y,float w,float h,float alpha,float mx,float my){
        float hov=btnHover[idx],scl=btnScale[idx],scaledH=h*scl,scaledW=w*(1f+hov*0.02f),dy=(h-scaledH)/2f;
        int accent=BTN_COLS[idx]&0x00FFFFFF;boolean isDanger=idx==3;
        int bgA=(int)(alpha*(70+hov*60));
        int bg=isDanger?withAlpha(mix(COL_PANEL_BG,0x1A0008,exitRedProg(idx)),bgA):withAlpha(COL_PANEL_BG,bgA);
        Render2D.gradientRect(x,y+dy,scaledW,scaledH,new int[]{bg,bg,bg,bg},2f);
        Render2D.rect(x,y+dy,2f,scaledH,withAlpha(accent,(int)(alpha*(90+hov*165))),1f);
        Render2D.outline(x,y+dy,scaledW,scaledH,OUTLINE_T,withAlpha(accent,(int)(alpha*(30+hov*110))),2f);
        float iconSz=11f,iconY=y+dy+scaledH/2f-Fonts.MAINMENUSCREEN.getHeight(iconSz)/2f;
        Fonts.MAINMENUSCREEN.draw(BTN_ICONS[idx],x+7f,iconY,iconSz,withAlpha(accent,(int)(alpha*(140+hov*115))));
        float lblSz=7.5f,lblY=y+dy+scaledH/2f-Fonts.REGULARNEW.getHeight(lblSz)/2f;
        int lblA=(int)(alpha*(160+hov*95));
        int lblC=isDanger?withAlpha(mix(COL_MUTED,COL_DANGER,exitRedProg(idx)),lblA):withAlpha(COL_TEXT,lblA);
        Fonts.REGULARNEW.draw(BTN_LABELS[idx],x+22f,lblY,lblSz,lblC);
        if(hov>0.1f)Render2D.rect(x+scaledW-1f,y+dy,1f,scaledH,withAlpha(accent,(int)(hov*alpha*70)),0f);
    }

    private float exitRedProg(int idx){return idx==3?exitRedProg:0f;}

    private void renderWorldPanel(int sw,int sh,float mx,float my,float prog,long now){
        float x=getWorldPanelX(sw),y=getStartY(sh),slideX=(1f-prog)*40f,rx=x+slideX;
        drawPanel(rx,y,WORLD_PANEL_W,WORLD_PANEL_H,prog,COL_ACCENT);
        Fonts.TEST.draw("WORLDS",rx+10,y+8,6.5f,withAlpha(COL_ACCENT,(int)(prog*220)));
        String cntStr=worlds.size()+" worlds";
        Fonts.TEST.draw(cntStr,rx+WORLD_PANEL_W-Fonts.TEST.getWidth(cntStr,5.5f)-10,y+9,5.5f,withAlpha(COL_MUTED,(int)(prog*130)));
        Render2D.rect(rx+10,y+19,WORLD_PANEL_W-20,1f,withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE,(int)(prog*40)),0f);

        float listX=rx+LIST_X_OFF,listY=y+LIST_Y_OFF,listW=WORLD_PANEL_W-LIST_X_OFF*2,listH=WORLD_PANEL_H-LIST_Y_OFF-10;
        Scissor.enable(listX*FIXED_GUI_SCALE,listY*FIXED_GUI_SCALE,listW*FIXED_GUI_SCALE,listH*FIXED_GUI_SCALE,1f);
        for(int i=0;i<worlds.size();i++){
            float cardY=listY+i*(CARD_H+CARD_GAP)-scrollOffset;
            if(cardY+CARD_H<listY-5||cardY>listY+listH+5)continue;
            renderWorldCard(listX,cardY,listW,CARD_H,worlds.get(i),i,prog,mx-slideX,my,listY,listH);
        }
        Scissor.disable();
        if(worlds.isEmpty()){String msg="No worlds found";Fonts.TEST.draw(msg,rx+WORLD_PANEL_W/2f-Fonts.TEST.getWidth(msg,6f)/2f,y+WORLD_PANEL_H/2f-3,6f,withAlpha(COL_MUTED,(int)(prog*100)));}
    }

    private void renderWorldCard(float x,float y,float w,float h,WorldEntry world,int idx,
                                 float alpha,float mx,float my,float listY,float listH){
        boolean inB=my>=listY&&my<=listY+listH,hov=isOver(mx,my,x,y,w,h)&&inB,selected=idx==selectedWorld;
        int bgA=(int)(alpha*(hov||selected?170:110));
        Render2D.rect(x,y,w,h,withAlpha(hov||selected?COL_PANEL_BG2:COL_PANEL,bgA),0f);
        int barC=world.hardcore?withAlpha(COL_DANGER,(int)(alpha*(selected?220:hov?150:50))):withAlpha(COL_ACCENT,(int)(alpha*(selected?220:hov?150:50)));
        Render2D.rect(x,y,2f,h,barC,0f);
        Render2D.outline(x,y,w,h,OUTLINE_T,withAlpha(selected?(world.hardcore?COL_DANGER:COL_ACCENT):COL_OUTLINE,(int)(alpha*(selected?100:hov?70:35))),0f);

        float faceX=x+8,faceY=y+(h-30f)/2f;
        Render2D.rect(faceX,faceY,30f,30f,withAlpha(COL_PANEL_BG2,(int)(alpha*255)),2f);
        Render2D.outline(faceX,faceY,30f,30f,OUTLINE_T,withAlpha(COL_OUTLINE,(int)(alpha*255)),2f);
        String letter=world.displayName!=null&&!world.displayName.isEmpty()?String.valueOf(world.displayName.charAt(0)).toUpperCase():"?";
        Fonts.BOLD.drawCentered(letter,faceX+15f,faceY+15f-Fonts.BOLD.getHeight(10f)/2f,10f,world.hardcore?withAlpha(COL_DANGER,(int)(alpha*255)):withAlpha(COL_ACCENT,(int)(alpha*200)));

        float tX=faceX+30f+8f,maxNW=w-55f;
        String name=world.displayName!=null?world.displayName:world.levelName;
        if(Fonts.TEST.getWidth(name,7.5f)>maxNW){while(Fonts.TEST.getWidth(name+"..",7.5f)>maxNW&&name.length()>2)name=name.substring(0,name.length()-1);name+="..";}
        int ta=(int)(alpha*255);
        Fonts.TEST.draw(name,tX,y+8,7.5f,withAlpha(COL_TEXT,ta));
        Fonts.TEST.draw(world.levelName,tX,y+18,5f,withAlpha(COL_MUTED,(int)(alpha*160)));
        Fonts.TEST.draw(world.lastPlayed,tX,y+27,5f,withAlpha(COL_MUTED,(int)(alpha*130)));

        float tagX=tX,tagY=y+38;
        tagX=renderTag(tagX,tagY,capitalize(world.gameMode),COL_ACCENT,alpha);
        if(world.hardcore)tagX=renderTag(tagX+3,tagY,"HARDCORE",COL_DANGER,alpha);
        if(world.cheats)renderTag(tagX+3,tagY,"CHEATS",COL_GOLD,alpha);
    }

    private float renderTag(float x,float y,String label,int color,float alpha){
        float sz=5f,tw=Fonts.TEST.getWidth(label,sz),ph=7f,pw=tw+6f;
        Render2D.rect(x,y,pw,ph,withAlpha(color,(int)(alpha*80)),1f);
        Render2D.outline(x,y,pw,ph,0.5f,withAlpha(color,(int)(alpha*120)),1f);
        Fonts.TEST.draw(label,x+3,y+1,sz,withAlpha(color,(int)(alpha*220)));
        return x+pw;
    }

    private String capitalize(String s){if(s==null||s.isEmpty())return"SURVIVAL";return s.substring(0,1).toUpperCase()+s.substring(1);}

        drawPanel(cpx,cpy,pw,ph,ppE,COL_DANGER);

            Fonts.TEST.draw("\""+worlds.get(selectedWorld).displayName+"\"",cpx+10,cpy+24,6f,withAlpha(COL_TEXT,(int)(ppE*200)));

    private void updateHover(float mx,float my,int sw,int sh,float prog){
        if(prog<0.5f||deleteConfirmOpen){hoveredBtn=-1;return;}
        float x=getStartX(sw),y=getStartY(sh),slideX=(1f-prog)*-40f,rx=x+slideX;
        float btnH=18f,btnGap=4f,btnY=y+26f; hoveredBtn=-1;
        for(int i=0;i<5;i++){if(isOver(mx,my,rx+10,btnY,BTN_PANEL_W-20f,btnH)){hoveredBtn=i;break;}btnY+=btnH+btnGap;}
    }

    private void updateButtonAnimations(float dt){
        for(int i=0;i<5;i++){
            btnHover[i]=MathHelper.lerp(dt*11f,btnHover[i],hoveredBtn==i?1f:0f);
            btnScale[i]=MathHelper.lerp(dt*13f,btnScale[i],hoveredBtn==i?1.04f:1f);
        }
        exitRedProg=MathHelper.lerp(dt*9f,exitRedProg,hoveredBtn==3?1f:0f);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(Click click, boolean doubled) {
        float mx=toFixed(click.x()),my=toFixed(click.y()); int sw=getFixedW(),sh=getFixedH();
        long now=Util.getMeasuringTimeMs();
        if(deleteConfirmOpen){
            float pw=180f,ph=70f,cpx=sw/2f-pw/2f,cpy=sh/2f-ph/2f;
            float btnW=65f,btnH=16f,gap6=6f,btnStartX=cpx+pw/2f-(btnW*2+gap6)/2f,btnY=cpy+ph-btnH-7f;
            if(isOver(mx,my,btnStartX,btnY,btnW,btnH)){executeDelete();return true;}
            if(isOver(mx,my,btnStartX+btnW+gap6,btnY,btnW,btnH)){deleteConfirmOpen=false;return true;}
            if(!isOver(mx,my,cpx,cpy,pw,ph))deleteConfirmOpen=false;
            return true;
        }
        float prog=getAppearProg(now),slideX=(1f-prog)*40f,rx=getWorldPanelX(sw)+slideX;
        float listX=rx+LIST_X_OFF,listY=getStartY(sh)+LIST_Y_OFF,listW=WORLD_PANEL_W-LIST_X_OFF*2,listH=WORLD_PANEL_H-LIST_Y_OFF-10;
        if(isOver(mx,my,listX,listY,listW,listH))
            for(int i=0;i<worlds.size();i++){float cardY=listY+i*(CARD_H+CARD_GAP)-scrollOffset;if(isOver(mx,my,listX,cardY,listW,CARD_H)){if(selectedWorld==i&&doubled)playWorld(i);else selectedWorld=i;return true;}}
        if(hoveredBtn>=0){handleButtonClick(hoveredBtn,now);return true;}
        return super.mouseClicked(click,doubled);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mx,double my,double hA,double vA){
        float smx=toFixed(mx),smy=toFixed(my); int sw=getFixedW(),sh=getFixedH();
        float prog=getAppearProg(Util.getMeasuringTimeMs()),rx=getWorldPanelX(sw)+(1f-prog)*40f,y=getStartY(sh);
        if(isOver(smx,smy,rx,y,WORLD_PANEL_W,WORLD_PANEL_H)){
            float listH=WORLD_PANEL_H-LIST_Y_OFF-10,totalH=worlds.size()*(CARD_H+CARD_GAP)-CARD_GAP,maxScroll=Math.max(0,totalH-listH);
            targetScroll=MathHelper.clamp(targetScroll-(float)vA*28,0,maxScroll);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mx,my,hA,vA);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(KeyInput input){
        int key=input.key();
        if(deleteConfirmOpen){if(key==256){deleteConfirmOpen=false;return true;}return true;}
        if(key==256){client.setScreen(parentScreen);return true;}
        if((key==257||key==335)&&selectedWorld>=0){playWorld(selectedWorld);return true;}
        if(key==265&&selectedWorld>0){selectedWorld--;return true;}
        if(key==264&&selectedWorld<worlds.size()-1){selectedWorld++;return true;}
        return super.keyPressed(input);
    }

    private void handleButtonClick(int idx,long now){
        switch(idx){
            case 0 -> { if(selectedWorld>=0) playWorld(selectedWorld); }
            case 1 -> openCreateWorldScreen();
            case 2 -> { /* Edit world вЂ” TODO */ }
            case 3 -> { if(selectedWorld>=0){ deleteConfirmOpen=true; deleteConfirmTime=now; } }
            case 4 -> client.setScreen(parentScreen);
        }
    }

    private void openCreateWorldScreen() {

        System.out.println("[Rastyclient] === CreateWorldScreen methods ===");
        for (java.lang.reflect.Method m : net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.world.CreateWorldScreen.class.getMethods()) {
            if (m.getDeclaringClass() == Object.class) continue;
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.append(java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(m.getModifiers()) ? "static " : "");
            sb.append(m.getReturnType().getSimpleName()).append(" ").append(m.getName()).append("(");
            Class<?>[] p = m.getParameterTypes();
            for (int i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { if (i > 0) sb.append(", "); sb.append(p[i].getSimpleName()); }
            sb.append(")");
            System.out.println("  " + sb);
        }


        try {
            net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.world.CreateWorldScreen.create(client, () -> {}, null, null, null);
            return;
        } catch (NoSuchMethodError | Exception e1) {
            System.out.println("[Rastyclient] create(MC, Runnable, ...) failed: " + e1);
        }


        try {
            for (java.lang.reflect.Method m : net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.world.CreateWorldScreen.class.getDeclaredMethods()) {
                if (!java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(m.getModifiers())) continue;
                m.setAccessible(true);
                Class<?>[] p = m.getParameterTypes();

                if (p.length >= 2
                        && p[0].isAssignableFrom(MinecraftClient.class)
                        && Runnable.class.isAssignableFrom(p[1])) {
                    Object[] args = new Object[p.length];
                    args[0] = client;
                    args[1] = (Runnable) () -> {};

                    try {
                        m.invoke(null, args);
                        System.out.println("[Rastyclient] Opened via " + m.getName() + " args=" + p.length);
                        return;
                    } catch (Exception ex) {
                        System.out.println("[Rastyclient] " + m.getName() + " with nulls failed: " + ex.getCause());
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e2) {
            System.out.println("[Rastyclient] reflection loop failed: " + e2);
        }

        System.err.println("[Rastyclient] openCreateWorldScreen: РІСЃРµ РІР°СЂРёР°РЅС‚С‹ РїСЂРѕРІР°Р»РёР»РёСЃСЊ!");
    }


    private void playWorld(int idx){
        if(idx<0||idx>=worlds.size())return;
        String levelName=worlds.get(idx).levelName;

        try {
            Object loader = client.createIntegratedServerLoader();

            for (java.lang.reflect.Method m : loader.getClass().getMethods()) {
                if (!m.getName().equals("start")) continue;
                Class<?>[] p = m.getParameterTypes();

                if (p.length == 2 && Screen.class.isAssignableFrom(p[0]) && p[1] == String.class) {
                    m.invoke(loader, this, levelName); return;
                }
                if (p.length == 2 && p[0] == String.class && p[1] == Runnable.class) {
                    m.invoke(loader, levelName, (Runnable)()-> {}); return;
                }
                if (p.length == 1 && p[0] == String.class) {
                    m.invoke(loader, levelName); return;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        System.err.println("[Rastyclient] playWorld: РЅРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ РЅР°Р№С‚Рё РјРµС‚РѕРґ start() РґР»СЏ Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєРё РјРёСЂР°: " + levelName);
    }

    private void executeDelete(){
        if(selectedWorld<0||selectedWorld>=worlds.size()){deleteConfirmOpen=false;return;}
        String levelName=worlds.get(selectedWorld).levelName;
        deleteConfirmOpen=false;
        try {
            LevelStorage storage=client.getLevelStorage();
            try(LevelStorage.Session session=storage.createSession(levelName)){
                session.deleteSessionLock();
            }
        } catch(Exception e){
            try {
                java.io.File dir=new java.io.File(client.getLevelStorage().getSavesDirectory().toFile(),levelName);
                deleteDir(dir);
            } catch(Exception e2){ e2.printStackTrace(); }
        }
        worlds.remove(selectedWorld);
        if(selectedWorld>=worlds.size())selectedWorld=worlds.size()-1;
    }

    private void deleteDir(java.io.File d){
        if(d==null||!d.exists())return;
        java.io.File[]files=d.listFiles();
        if(files!=null)for(java.io.File f:files)if(f.isDirectory())deleteDir(f);else f.delete();
        d.delete();
    }

    @Override public void renderBackground(DrawContext ctx,int mx,int my,float d){ drawBackground(currentZoom,getFixedW(),getFixedH()); }
    @Override public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc(){ return false; }
    @Override public boolean shouldPause(){ return false; }

    private boolean isOver(float mx,float my,float x,float y,float w,float h){ return mx>=x&&mx<=x+w&&my>=y&&my<=y+h; }
    private int withAlpha(int c,int a){ return (c&0x00FFFFFF)|(MathHelper.clamp(a,0,255)<<24); }
    private int mix(int a,int b,float t){ int ar=(a>>16)&0xFF,ag=(a>>8)&0xFF,ab=a&0xFF,br=(b>>16)&0xFF,bg=(b>>8)&0xFF,bb=b&0xFF; return((int)(ar+(br-ar)*t)<<16)|((int)(ag+(bg-ag)*t)<<8)|(int)(ab+(bb-ab)*t); }
}

package rasty.util.animations;

import lombok.Setter;
import lombok.experimental.Accessors;
import rasty.util.timer.TimerUtil;

@Setter
@Accessors(chain = true)
public class Animation implements AnimationCalculation {
    public final TimerUtil counter = new TimerUtil();
    protected int ms;
    protected double value;
    protected Direction direction = Direction.FORWARDS;

    public void reset() {
        counter.resetCounter();
    }

    public void update() {
    }

    public boolean isDone() {
        return counter.isReached(ms);
    }

    public boolean isFinished(Direction direction) {
        return this.direction == direction && isDone();
    }

    public Direction getDirection() {
        return this.direction;
    }

    public void setDirection(Direction direction) {
        if (this.direction != direction) {
            this.direction = direction;
            adjustTimer();
        }
    }

    public boolean isDirection(Direction direction) {
        return this.direction == direction;
    }

    private void adjustTimer() {
        counter.setTime(
                System.currentTimeMillis() - ((long) ms - Math.min(ms, counter.getTime()))
        );
    }

    public Double getOutput() {
        double time = (1 - calculation(counter.getTime())) * value;

        return direction == Direction.FORWARDS
                ? endValue()
                : isDone() ? 0.0 : time;
    }

    protected double endValue() {
        return isDone()
                ? value
                : calculation(counter.getTime()) * value;
    }
}

package rasty.util.animations;


public class Decelerate extends Animation {

    @Override
    public double calculation(double value) {
        double x = value / ms;
        return 1 - (x - 1) * (x - 1);
    }
}

package rasty.util.animations;

import lombok.experimental.UtilityClass;

@UtilityClass
public class Easings {
    public final Easing LINEAR = (value) -> value;
    public final Easing QUAD_OUT = (value) -> 1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - value, 2);
    public final Easing CUBIC_OUT = (value) -> 1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - value, 3);
    public final Easing EXPO_IN = (value) -> value == 0 ? 0 : Math.pow(2.0, 10.0 * value - 10.0);
    public final Easing EXPO_OUT = (value) -> value == 1 ? 1 : 1.0 - Math.pow(2.0, -10.0 * value);
    public final Easing EXPO_IN_OUT = (value) -> {
        if (value == 0 || value == 1) return value;
        return value < 0.5
                ? Math.pow(2.0, 20.0 * value - 10.0) / 2.0
                : (2.0 - Math.pow(2.0, -20.0 * value + 10.0)) / 2.0;
    };
    public final Easing SINE_OUT = (value) -> Math.sin(value * Math.PI / 2.0);
    public final Easing BACK_OUT = (value) -> {
        double c1 = 1.70158;
        double c3 = c1 + 1;
        return 1.0 + c3 * Math.pow(value - 1.0, 3.0) + c1 * Math.pow(value - 1.0, 2.0);
    };
}

package rasty.util.animations;

import lombok.Getter;

@Getter
public class FadeAnimation {
    private final long duration;
    private long startTime;
    private boolean forwards = true;
    private double value = 0.0;
    private Easing easing = Easings.EXPO_OUT;

    public FadeAnimation(long durationMs) {
        this.duration = durationMs;
        this.startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
    }

    public FadeAnimation(long durationMs, Easing easing) {
        this.duration = durationMs;
        this.startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.easing = easing;
    }

    public void switchDirection(boolean forwards) {
        if (this.forwards != forwards) {
            long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
            long remaining = duration - Math.min(elapsed, duration);
            this.startTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - remaining;
            this.forwards = forwards;
        }
    }

    public void setDirection(boolean forwards) {
        this.forwards = forwards;
    }

    public void reset() {
        this.startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.value = forwards ? 0.0 : 1.0;
    }

    public float get() {
        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
        double progress = Math.min((double) elapsed / duration, 1.0);
        double easedProgress = easing.ease(progress);

        if (forwards) {
            value = easedProgress;
        } else {
            value = 1.0 - easedProgress;
        }

        return (float) Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
    }

    public boolean isDone() {
        return System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime >= duration;
    }

    public boolean isFullyHidden() {
        return isDone() && !forwards;
    }

    public boolean isFullyVisible() {
        return isDone() && forwards;
    }
}

package rasty.util.animations;

import lombok.Setter;
import lombok.experimental.Accessors;
import rasty.util.timer.TimerUtil;

@Setter
@Accessors(chain = true)
public class GuiAnimation {
    public final TimerUtil counter = new TimerUtil();
    protected int ms = 250;
    protected double value = 1.0;
    protected Direction direction = Direction.FORWARDS;

    public GuiAnimation reset() {
        counter.resetCounter();
        return this;
    }

    public boolean isDone() {
        return counter.isReached(ms);
    }

    public boolean isFinished(Direction direction) {
        return this.direction == direction && isDone();
    }

    public Direction getDirection() {
        return this.direction;
    }

    public GuiAnimation setDirection(Direction direction) {
        if (this.direction != direction) {
            this.direction = direction;
        }
        return this;
    }

    public Double getOutput() {
        double progress = Math.min(1.0, (double) counter.getTime() / ms);
        double eased = easeOutQuart(progress);

        if (direction == Direction.FORWARDS) {
            return eased * value;
        } else {
            return (1.0 - eased) * value;
        }
    }

    private double easeOutQuart(double x) {
        return 1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - x, 4);
    }
}

package rasty.util.animations;

import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.Setter;

@Getter
public class SmoothAnimation {
    private long start;
    private double duration;
    private double fromValue;
    private double toValue;
    @Setter
    private double value;
    private double prevValue;
    private Easing easing = Easings.EXPO_OUT;
    private boolean finished = false;

    public SmoothAnimation run(double valueTo, double durationSeconds) {
        return this.run(valueTo, durationSeconds, Easings.EXPO_OUT, false);
    }

    public SmoothAnimation run(double valueTo, double durationSeconds, Easing easing) {
        return this.run(valueTo, durationSeconds, easing, false);
    }

    public SmoothAnimation run(double valueTo, double durationSeconds, boolean safe) {
        return this.run(valueTo, durationSeconds, Easings.EXPO_OUT, safe);
    }

    public SmoothAnimation run(double valueTo, double durationSeconds, Easing easing, boolean safe) {
        if (this.check(safe, valueTo)) {
            return this;
        }
        this.easing = easing;
        this.start = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.duration = durationSeconds * 1000.0;
        this.fromValue = this.value;
        this.toValue = valueTo;
        this.finished = this.fromValue == this.toValue;
        return this;
    }

    public boolean update() {
        this.prevValue = this.value;
        boolean alive = this.isAlive();

        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - this.start > this.duration / 1.5) {
            this.finished = this.fromValue == this.toValue;
        }

        if (alive) {
            double part = Math.min(1.0, Math.max(0.0, this.calculatePart()));
            this.value = this.interpolate(this.fromValue, this.toValue, this.easing.ease(part));
        } else {
            this.start = 0L;
            this.value = this.toValue;
        }

        return alive;
    }

    public boolean isAlive() {
        return !this.isFinished();
    }

    public boolean isFinished() {
        return this.calculatePart() >= 1.0;
    }

    public double calculatePart() {
        if (duration <= 0) return 1.0;
        return (double) (System.currentTimeMillis() - this.start) / this.duration;
    }

    public boolean check(boolean safe, double valueTo) {
        return safe && this.isAlive() && (valueTo == this.fromValue || valueTo == this.toValue || valueTo == this.value);
    }

    public double interpolate(double start, double end, double pct) {
        return start + (end - start) * pct;
    }

    public float get() {
        return (float) this.value;
    }

    public float getPrev() {
        return (float) this.prevValue;
    }

    public void set(double value) {
        this.run(value, 0.0001);
        this.update();
        this.value = value;
    }
}

package rasty.util.animations;

public class SweepAnim {

    private float progress;
    private final float duration;
    private boolean completed;
    private boolean active;
    private long startTime;

    public SweepAnim(float durationSeconds) {
        this.progress = 0.0f;
        this.duration = durationSeconds * 1000f;
        this.completed = false;
        this.active = false;
        this.startTime = 0;
    }

    public void start() {
        if (!active && !completed) {
            progress = 0.0f;
            completed = false;
            active = true;
            startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
    }

    public void reset() {
        progress = 0.0f;
        completed = false;
        active = false;
        startTime = 0;
    }

    public void update() {
        if (!active) return;

        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
        progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1.0f);

        if (progress >= 1.0f) {
            progress = 1.0f;
            completed = true;
            active = false;
        }
    }

    public float getProgress() {
        return progress;
    }

    public boolean isCompleted() {
        return completed;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return active;
    }

    public boolean isFinished() {
        return completed && !active;
    }
}

package rasty.util.aura2;

import lombok.experimental.UtilityClass;
import net.minecraft.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.util.hit.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Box;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import net.minecraft.world.RaycastContext;
import rasty.IMinecraft;

@UtilityClass
public class BestPointUtil implements IMinecraft {

    public Vec3d getNearestPoint(Entity entity) {
        Box box = entity.getBoundingBox();
        double step = 0.1;
        Vec3d best = null;
        double closest = Double.MAX_VALUE;

        for (double x = box.minX; x <= box.maxX; x += step) {
            for (double y = box.minY; y <= box.maxY; y += step) {
                for (double z = box.minZ; z <= box.maxZ; z += step) {
                    Vec3d sample = new Vec3d(x, y, z);
                    double dist = mc.player.getEyePos().distanceTo(sample);
                    if (dist < closest) {
                        closest = dist;
                        best = sample;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return best != null ? best : entity.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
    }

    public Vec3d getNearestVisiblePoint(Entity entity, Vec3d fallback, double range) {
        Box box = entity.getBoundingBox();
        double step = 0.2;
        Vec3d best = null;
        double closest = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        Vec3d eye = mc.player.getEyePos();

        for (double x = box.minX; x <= box.maxX; x += step) {
            for (double y = box.minY; y <= box.maxY; y += step) {
                for (double z = box.minZ; z <= box.maxZ; z += step) {
                    Vec3d sample = new Vec3d(x, y, z);
                    double dist = eye.distanceTo(sample);
                    if (dist < closest && dist <= range) {
                        HitResult hit = mc.world.raycast(new RaycastContext(
                                eye, sample,
                                RaycastContext.ShapeType.COLLIDER,
                                RaycastContext.FluidHandling.NONE,
                                mc.player));
                        if (hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.MISS) {
                            closest = dist;
                            best = sample;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return best != null ? best : fallback;
    }
}

package rasty.util.aura2;

import lombok.experimental.UtilityClass;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.effect.StatusEffects;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import rasty.IMinecraft;

@UtilityClass
public class PredictUtil implements IMinecraft {

    public static Vec3d predict(LivingEntity target, double ticksAhead) {
        double dx = target.getX() - target.lastX;
        double dy = target.getY() - target.lastY;
        double dz = target.getZ() - target.lastZ;

        if (Math.hypot(dx, dz) * 20 <= 1 && Math.abs(dy) <= 1) {
            return target.getEntityPos().add(0, target.getHeight() / 2.0, 0);
        }

        float prevPitch = target.lastPitch;
        float prevYaw   = target.lastYaw;
        float curPitch  = target.getPitch();
        float curYaw    = target.getYaw();

        float extraPitch = curPitch + (curPitch - prevPitch);
        float extraYaw   = curYaw   + (curYaw   - prevYaw);

        Vec3d delta = new Vec3d(dx, dy, dz);
        Vec3d forward = Vec3d.fromPolar(extraPitch, extraYaw)
                .multiply(delta.length() * ticksAhead);

        Vec3d vec3d = target.getRotationVector(extraPitch, extraYaw);

        float f = extraPitch * 0.017453292F;
        double d = Math.sqrt(vec3d.x * vec3d.x + vec3d.z * vec3d.z);
        double e = forward.horizontalLength();
        boolean bl = target.getVelocity().y <= 0.0;
        double g = bl && target.hasStatusEffect(StatusEffects.SLOW_FALLING)
                ? Math.min(target.getFinalGravity(), 0.01)
                : target.getFinalGravity();
        double h = MathHelper.square(Math.cos((double) f));

        forward = forward.add(0.0, g * (-1.0 + h * 0.75), 0.0);

        double i;
        if (forward.y < 0.0 && d > 0.0) {
            i = forward.y * -0.1 * h;
            forward = forward.add(vec3d.x * i / d, i, vec3d.z * i / d);
        }

        if (f < 0.0F && d > 0.0) {
            i = e * (-MathHelper.sin(f)) * 0.04;
            forward = forward.add(-vec3d.x * i / d, i * 2.2f, -vec3d.z * i / d);
        }

        if (d > 0.0) {
            forward = forward.add(
                    (vec3d.x / d * e - forward.x) * 0.1,
                    0.0,
                    (vec3d.z / d * e - forward.z) * 0.1
            );
        }

        return target.getEntityPos().add(forward);
    }
}

package rasty.util.aura2;

import net.minecraft.util.math.Vec3d;
import net.minecraft.world.RaycastContext;
import rasty.IMinecraft;

@UtilityClass
public class RaytraceUtil2 implements IMinecraft {

    public boolean rayTrace(Vec3d clientVec, double range, Box box) {
        Vec3d cameraVec = mc.player.getEyePos();

                || box.raycast(cameraVec, cameraVec.add(clientVec.multiply(range))).isPresent();

package rasty.util.color;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.chars.Char2IntArrayMap;
import lombok.EqualsAndHashCode;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.experimental.UtilityClass;
import net.minecraft.util.math.ColorHelper;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import org.joml.Vector4i;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11;
import rasty.util.math.MathUtils;

import java.awt.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

@Getter
@UtilityClass
public class ColorAssist {
    public static int colorForRectsCustom$() {
        return new Color(91, 63, 212,255).getRGB();
    }
    public static int colorForRectsBlack$() {
        return new Color(26, 26, 26,255).getRGB();
    }
    public static int colorForTextWhite$() {
        return new Color(255,255,255,255).getRGB();
    }
    public static int colorForTextCustom$() {
        return  new Color(130, 100, 210,255).getRGB();
    }
    public static final int green = new Color(64, 255, 64).getRGB();
    public static final int yellow = new Color(255, 255, 64).getRGB();
    public static final int orange = new Color(255, 128, 32).getRGB();
    public static final int red = new Color(255, 64, 64).getRGB();

    private final long CACHE_EXPIRATION_TIME = 60 * 1000;
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<ColorKey, CacheEntry> colorCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ScheduledExecutorService cacheCleaner = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1);
    private final DelayQueue<CacheEntry> cleanupQueue = new DelayQueue<>();

    static {
        cacheCleaner.scheduleWithFixedDelay(() -> {
            CacheEntry entry = cleanupQueue.poll();
            while (entry != null) {
                if (entry.isExpired()) {
                    colorCache.remove(entry.getKey());
                }
                entry = cleanupQueue.poll();
            }
        }, 0, 1, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    }

    public int red(int c) {return (c >> 16) & 0xFF;}

    public int green(int c) {
        return (c >> 8) & 0xFF;
    }

    public int blue(int c) {
        return c & 0xFF;
    }

    public int alpha(int c) {
        return (c >> 24) & 0xFF;
    }

    public float redf(int c) {
        return red(c) / 255.0f;
    }

    public float greenf(int c) {
        return green(c) / 255.0f;
    }

    public float bluef(int c) {
        return blue(c) / 255.0f;
    }

    public float alphaf(int c) {
        return alpha(c) / 255.0f;
    }

    public int[] getRGB(int c) {
        return new int[]{red(c), green(c), blue(c)};
    }

    public int getColor(int brightness, int alpha) {
        return getColor(brightness, brightness, brightness, alpha);
    }

    public int getColor(int brightness, float alpha) {
        return getColor(brightness, Math.round(alpha * 255));
    }

    public int getColor(int brightness) {
        return getColor(brightness, brightness, brightness);
    }

    public static int applyOpacity(int hex, float opacity) {
        return ColorHelper.getArgb((int) (ColorHelper.getAlpha(hex) * (opacity / 255)), ColorHelper.getRed(hex), ColorHelper.getGreen(hex), ColorHelper.getBlue(hex));
    }

    public static int calculateHuyDegrees(int divisor, int offset) {
        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long calculatedValue = (currentTime / divisor + offset) % 360L;
        return (int) calculatedValue;
    }

    public static int reAlphaInt(final int color, final int alpha) {
        return (Math.clamp(alpha, 0, 255) << 24) | (color & 16777215);
    }

    public static int astolfo(int speed, int index, float saturation, float brightness, float alpha) {
        float hueStep = 360.0f / 4.0f;
        float basaHuy = (float) calculateHuyDegrees(speed, index);
        float huy = (basaHuy + index * hueStep) % 360.0f;

        huy = huy / 360.0f;

        saturation = Math.clamp(saturation, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        brightness = Math.clamp(brightness, 0.0f, 1.0f);

        int rgb = Color.HSBtoRGB(huy, saturation, brightness);
        int Ialpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (int) (alpha * 255.0F)));

        return reAlphaInt(rgb, Ialpha);
    }

    public static int toColor(String hexColor) {
        int argb = Integer.parseInt(hexColor.substring(1), 16);
        return setAlpha(argb, 255);
    }

    public static int setAlpha(int color, int alpha) {
        return (color & 0x00ffffff) | (alpha << 24);
    }

    public static int interpolateColor(int color1, int color2, float amount) {
        amount = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, amount));

        int red1 = getRed(color1);
        int green1 = getGreen(color1);
        int blue1 = getBlue(color1);
        int alpha1 = getAlpha(color1);

        int red2 = getRed(color2);
        int green2 = getGreen(color2);
        int blue2 = getBlue(color2);
        int alpha2 = getAlpha(color2);

        int interpolatedRed = interpolateInt(red1, red2, amount);
        int interpolatedGreen = interpolateInt(green1, green2, amount);
        int interpolatedBlue = interpolateInt(blue1, blue2, amount);
        int interpolatedAlpha = interpolateInt(alpha1, alpha2, amount);

        return (interpolatedAlpha << 24) | (interpolatedRed << 16) | (interpolatedGreen << 8) | interpolatedBlue;
    }

    public static Double interpolateD(double oldValue, double newValue, double interpolationValue) {
        return (oldValue + (newValue - oldValue) * interpolationValue);
    }

    public static int interpolateInt(int oldValue, int newValue, double interpolationValue) {
        return interpolateD(oldValue, newValue, (float) interpolationValue).intValue();
    }

    public static int getRed(final int hex) {
        return hex >> 16 & 255;

    public int overCol(int color1, int color2, float percent01) {
        final float percent = MathHelper.clamp(percent01, 0F, 1F);
        return getColor(
                MathHelper.lerp(percent, red(color1), red(color2)),
                MathHelper.lerp(percent, green(color1), green(color2)),
                MathHelper.lerp(percent, blue(color1), blue(color2)),
                MathHelper.lerp(percent, alpha(color1), alpha(color2))
        );

        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {

    public static float[] rgba(final int color) {
        return new float[]{
                (color >> 16 & 0xFF) / 255f,
                (color >> 8 & 0xFF) / 255f,
                (color & 0xFF) / 255f,
                (color >> 24 & 0xFF) / 255f
        };
    }

    public static int interpolate(int start, int end, float value) {
        float[] startColor = rgba(start);
        float[] endColor = rgba(end);

        return rgba((int) MathUtils.interpolate(startColor[0] * 255, endColor[0] * 255, value),
                (int) MathUtils.interpolate(startColor[1] * 255, endColor[1] * 255, value),
                (int) MathUtils.interpolate(startColor[2] * 255, endColor[2] * 255, value),
                (int) MathUtils.interpolate(startColor[3] * 255, endColor[3] * 255, value));
    }

    public int getColor(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha) {
        ColorKey key = new ColorKey(red, green, blue, alpha);
        CacheEntry cacheEntry = colorCache.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> {
            CacheEntry newEntry = new CacheEntry(k, computeColor(red, green, blue, alpha), CACHE_EXPIRATION_TIME);
            cleanupQueue.offer(newEntry);
            return newEntry;
        });
        return cacheEntry.getColor();
    }

    public int getColor(int red, int green, int blue) {
        return getColor(red, green, blue, 255);
    }

    private int computeColor(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha) {
        return ((MathHelper.clamp(alpha, 0, 255) << 24) |
                (MathHelper.clamp(red, 0, 255) << 16) |
                (MathHelper.clamp(green, 0, 255) << 8) |
                MathHelper.clamp(blue, 0, 255));
    }

    private String generateKey(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha) {
        return red + "," + green + "," + blue + "," + alpha;
    }

    public String formatting(int color) {
        return "вЏЏ" + color + "вЏЏ";
    }

    @Getter
    @RequiredArgsConstructor
    @EqualsAndHashCode
    private static class ColorKey {
        final int red, green, blue, alpha;
    }

    @Getter
    private static class CacheEntry implements Delayed {
        private final ColorKey key;
        private final int color;
        private final long expirationTime;

        CacheEntry(ColorKey key, int color, long ttl) {
            this.key = key;
            this.color = color;
            this.expirationTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + ttl;
        }

        @Override
        public long getDelay(TimeUnit unit) {
            long delay = expirationTime - System.currentTimeMillis();
            return unit.convert(delay, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Delayed other) {
            if (other instanceof CacheEntry) {
                return Long.compare(this.expirationTime, ((CacheEntry) other).expirationTime);
            }
            return 0;
        }

        public boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() > expirationTime;
        }

    }

}

    public static int applyAlpha(int color, int alpha) {
        int r = (color >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int g = (color >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int b = color & 0xFF;
        int originalAlpha = (color >> 24) & 0xFF;
        int newAlpha = (originalAlpha * alpha) / 255;
        return (newAlpha << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }

    public static int astolfo(int speed, int index, float saturation, float brightness, float alpha) {
        float hueStep = 360.0f / 4.0f;
        float basaHuy = (float) MathUtilHuyDegrees(speed, index);
        float huy = (basaHuy + index * hueStep) % 360.0f;

        huy = huy / 360.0f;

        saturation = Math.clamp(saturation, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        brightness = Math.clamp(brightness, 0.0f, 1.0f);

        int rgb = Color.HSBtoRGB(huy, saturation, brightness);
        int Ialpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (int) (alpha * 255.0F)));

        return reAlphaInt(rgb, Ialpha);
    }

    public static int gradient(int start, int end, int index, int speed) {
        int angle = (int) ((System.currentTimeMillis() / speed + index) % 360);
        angle = (angle > 180 ? 360 - angle : angle) + 180;
        int color = interpolate(start, end, Math.clamp(angle / 180f - 1, 0, 1));
        float[] hs = rgba(color);
        float[] hsb = Color.RGBtoHSB((int) (hs[0] * 255), (int) (hs[1] * 255), (int) (hs[2] * 255), null);

        hsb[1] *= 1.5F;
        hsb[1] = Math.min(hsb[1], 1.0f);

        return Color.HSBtoRGB(hsb[0], hsb[1], hsb[2]);
    }

    public static int gradient(int speed, int index, int... colors) {
        int angle = (int) ((System.currentTimeMillis() / speed + index) % 360);
        angle = (angle > 180 ? 360 - angle : angle) + 180;
        int colorIndex = (int) (angle / 360f * colors.length);
        if (colorIndex == colors.length) {
            colorIndex--;
        }
        int color1 = colors[colorIndex];
        int color2 = colors[colorIndex == colors.length - 1 ? 0 : colorIndex + 1];
        return interpolate(color1, color2, angle / 360f * colors.length - colorIndex);
    }


    public static int interpolateColor(int color1, int color2, float amount) {
        amount = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, amount));

        int red1 = getRed(color1);
        int green1 = getGreen(color1);
        int blue1 = getBlue(color1);
        int alpha1 = getAlpha(color1);

        int red2 = getRed(color2);
        int green2 = getGreen(color2);
        int blue2 = getBlue(color2);
        int alpha2 = getAlpha(color2);

        int interpolatedRed = interpolateInt(red1, red2, amount);
        int interpolatedGreen = interpolateInt(green1, green2, amount);
        int interpolatedBlue = interpolateInt(blue1, blue2, amount);
        int interpolatedAlpha = interpolateInt(alpha1, alpha2, amount);

        return (interpolatedAlpha << 24) | (interpolatedRed << 16) | (interpolatedGreen << 8) | interpolatedBlue;
    }

    public static Double interpolateD(double oldValue, double newValue, double interpolationValue) {
        return (oldValue + (newValue - oldValue) * interpolationValue);
    }

    public static int interpolateInt(int oldValue, int newValue, double interpolationValue) {
        return interpolateD(oldValue, newValue, (float) interpolationValue).intValue();
    }

    public int lerpColor(int c1, int c2, float t) {
        int a1 = (c1 >> 24) & 0xFF;
        int r1 = (c1 >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int g1 = (c1 >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int b1 = c1 & 0xFF;

        int a2 = (c2 >> 24) & 0xFF;
        int r2 = (c2 >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int g2 = (c2 >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int b2 = c2 & 0xFF;

        int a = (int) (a1 + (a2 - a1) * t);
        int r = (int) (r1 + (r2 - r1) * t);
        int g = (int) (g1 + (g2 - g1) * t);
        int b = (int) (b1 + (b2 - b1) * t);

        return (a << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }

    public int darkenColor(int color, float factor) {

        int r = (int) (((color >> 16) & 0xFF) * factor);
        int g = (int) (((color >> 8) & 0xFF) * factor);
        int b = (int) ((color & 0xFF) * factor);

    }

    public int lightenColor(int color, float factor) {

        int r = Math.min(255, (int) (((color >> 16) & 0xFF) * factor));
        int g = Math.min(255, (int) (((color >> 8) & 0xFF) * factor));
        int b = Math.min(255, (int) ((color & 0xFF) * factor));
        return (a << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;

    public static int hsvToRgb(float h, float s, float v) {
        float c = v * s;
        float x = c * (1 - Math.abs((h * 6) % 2 - 1));
        float m = v - c;

        float r, g, b;
        if (h < 1f/6f) { r = c; g = x; b = 0; }
        else if (h < 2f/6f) { r = x; g = c; b = 0; }
        else if (h < 3f/6f) { r = 0; g = c; b = x; }
        else if (h < 4f/6f) { r = 0; g = x; b = c; }
        else if (h < 5f/6f) { r = x; g = 0; b = c; }
        else { r = c; g = 0; b = x; }

        int ri = (int)((r + m) * 255);
        int gi = (int)((g + m) * 255);
        int bi = (int)((b + m) * 255);

        return 0xFF000000 | (ri << 16) | (gi << 8) | bi;
    }

    public static int hsvToRgb(float h, float s, float v, float alpha) {
        int rgb = hsvToRgb(h, s, v);
        int a = (int)(alpha * 255);
        return (a << 24) | (rgb & 0x00FFFFFF);
    }

    @Getter
    @RequiredArgsConstructor
    @EqualsAndHashCode
    private static class ColorKey {
        final int red, green, blue, alpha;
    }

    @Getter
    private static class CacheEntry implements Delayed {
        private final ColorKey key;
        private final int color;
        private final long expirationTime;

        CacheEntry(ColorKey key, int color, long ttl) {
            this.key = key;
            this.color = color;
            this.expirationTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + ttl;
        }

        @Override
        public long getDelay(TimeUnit unit) {
            long delay = expirationTime - System.currentTimeMillis();
            return unit.convert(delay, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Delayed other) {
            if (other instanceof CacheEntry) {
                return Long.compare(this.expirationTime, ((CacheEntry) other).expirationTime);
            }
            return 0;
        }

        public boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() > expirationTime;
        }

    }

    public String removeFormatting(String text) {
        return text == null || text.isEmpty() ? null : FORMATTING_CODE_PATTERN.matcher(text).replaceAll("");
    }

    public int getMainGuiColor() {return new Color(20, 20, 24, 255).getRGB();}

    public int getGuiRectColor(float alpha) {return multAlpha(new Color(0x1A1A1F).getRGB(),alpha);}
    public int getGuiRectColor2(float alpha) {return multAlpha(new Color(0x1E1E26).getRGB(),alpha);}

    public int getRect(float alpha) {return multAlpha(new Color(0,0,0,228).getRGB(),alpha);}

    public int getRectDarker(float alpha) {
        return multAlpha(new Color(0x18181E).getRGB(),alpha);
    }

    public int getText(float alpha) {return multAlpha(getText(),alpha);}

    public int getText() {return new Color(255,255,255,255).getRGB();}

    public int getText2() {return new Color(175, 175, 175,255).getRGB();}

    public int getFriendColor() {
        return new Color(0x55FF55).getRGB();
    }

    public int getOutline(float alpha, float bright) {return multBright(multAlpha(getOutline(),alpha),bright);}

    public int getOutline(float alpha) {return multAlpha(getOutline(), alpha);}

    public int getOutline() {
        return new Color(0x373746).getRGB();
    }
}

package rasty.util.config;

import rasty.util.config.impl.ConfigFileHandler;
import rasty.util.config.impl.ConfigPath;
import rasty.util.config.impl.ConfigSerializer;
import rasty.util.config.impl.autosaver.ConfigAutoSaver;
import rasty.util.config.impl.consolelogger.Logger;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;

public class ConfigSystem {

    private static ConfigSystem instance;

    private final ConfigSerializer serializer;
    private final ConfigFileHandler fileHandler;
    private final ConfigAutoSaver autoSaver;
    private final AtomicBoolean initialized;
    private final AtomicBoolean saving;

    public ConfigSystem() {
        instance = this;
        this.serializer = new ConfigSerializer();
        this.fileHandler = new ConfigFileHandler();
        this.autoSaver = new ConfigAutoSaver(this::save);
        this.initialized = new AtomicBoolean(false);
        this.saving = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    }

    public static ConfigSystem getInstance() { return instance; }

    public void init() {
        if (initialized.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            ConfigPath.init();
            fileHandler.createDirectories();
            load();
            autoSaver.start();
            registerShutdownHook();
            Logger.success("AutoConfiguration: System initialized!");
        }
    }

    private void registerShutdownHook() {
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(() -> {
            Logger.info("AutoConfiguration: Shutdown detected, saving...");
            shutdown();
        }, "Rasty-ConfigShutdown"));
    }

    public void save() {
        if (!initialized.get()) return;
        if (!saving.compareAndSet(false, true)) return;
        try {
            String data = serializer.serialize();
            boolean success = fileHandler.write(data);
            if (success) Logger.success("AutoConfiguration: autoconfig.json saved successfully!");
            else Logger.error("AutoConfiguration: autoconfig.json save failed!");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Logger.error("AutoConfiguration: Save error! " + e.getMessage());
        } finally {
            saving.set(false);
        }
    }


    public void saveToFile(Path targetFile) throws Exception {
        if (!initialized.get()) throw new IllegalStateException("ConfigSystem not initialized");

        long waited = 0;
        while (saving.get() && waited < 3000) { Thread.sleep(50); waited += 50; }
        String data = serializer.serialize();
        Files.createDirectories(targetFile.getParent());
        Files.writeString(targetFile, data, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Logger.success("AutoConfiguration: " + targetFile.getFileName() + " saved successfully!");
    }

    public void loadFromFile(Path sourceFile) throws Exception {
        if (!initialized.get()) throw new IllegalStateException("ConfigSystem not initialized");
        if (!Files.exists(sourceFile)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Config file not found: " + sourceFile);
        String data = Files.readString(sourceFile, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (data == null || data.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Config file is empty");
        serializer.deserialize(data);
        Logger.success("AutoConfiguration: " + sourceFile.getFileName() + " loaded successfully!");
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Void> saveAsync() { return CompletableFuture.runAsync(this::save); }

    public void load() {
        if (!fileHandler.exists()) { Logger.info("AutoConfiguration: No config found, creating new..."); save(); return; }
        try {
            String data = fileHandler.read();
            if (data != null && !data.isEmpty()) { serializer.deserialize(data); Logger.success("AutoConfiguration: autoconfig.json loaded successfully!"); }
        } catch (Exception e) { Logger.error("AutoConfiguration: Load error! " + e.getMessage()); }
    }

    public void shutdown() {
        if (!initialized.get()) return;
        autoSaver.shutdown();
        save();
        Logger.success("AutoConfiguration: Shutdown complete!");
    }

    public void reload() { load(); Logger.success("AutoConfiguration: Config reloaded!"); }
    public boolean isInitialized() { return initialized.get(); }
    public boolean isSaving() { return saving.get(); }
    public ConfigAutoSaver getAutoSaver() { return autoSaver; }
}
